jobs.description:
Leads the strategic vision and roadmap for a digital product or products within a specific business area, demonstrating a deep understanding of the digital product(s). Digital products may have enterprise-wide implications.
  
  
**About Vanguard**
Founded in 1975, Vanguard is one of the world's leading investment management companies. The firm offers investments, advice, and retirement services to tens of millions of individual investors around the globe—directly, through workplace plans, and through financial intermediaries.
  
  
**Vanguard India**
Vanguard’s office in India is a significant milestone in our global expansion. We are committed to establishing an enduring technology center in Hyderabad, Telangana and are excited to be adding talent who will focus on Artificial Intelligence (AI), mobile, and cloud-based technologies that drive our business outcomes and deliver a world-class experience for our clients.
  
  
**Role Summary**
The Product Manager, Specialist role is responsible for leading digital product management initiatives, overseeing the development, implementation, and optimization of strategic products. This role requires close collaboration with cross-functional teams to enhance customer experience, define product roadmaps, and drive business growth. The specialist ensures smooth product execution, manages escalations, and employs data-driven insights to refine product strategies. Additionally, they work with stakeholders to align product goals with business objectives and market needs.
  
  
This Product Manager will lead enhancements to the customer service and contact center tools used by our crew to serve clients, including the integration of AI capabilities
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Lead digital product management efforts for multiple digital products or one strategic product, ensuring alignment with business goals.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to implement best practices that enhance the customer experience and drive impactful changes.
* Coach digital product teams on best practices, learnings, and product development methodologies to maximize efficiency.
* Partner with stakeholders to resolve production and implementation issues promptly, supporting escalations when needed to enable rapid delivery.
* Oversee the planning, development, and execution of new digital products, including market analysis, feature definition, and implementation planning.
* Develop pricing and positioning strategies, ensuring products are competitive and aligned with market demand.
* Utilize qualitative and quantitative analysis techniques to continually improve the user experience and optimize product performance.
* Translate product strategy into detailed requirements and prototypes, collaborating with engineering teams to ensure timely and resource-efficient delivery.
* Lead product launches by working closely with marketing teams, executives, and other product management stakeholders to drive successful go-to-market strategies.
* Evaluate promotional plans to ensure consistency with product line strategies and effective messaging across customer segments.
* Participate in ongoing business planning, departmental prioritization activities, and special projects as required.
* Lead the modernization of contact-center desktop capabilities and supporting tools to improve the experience of contact-center staff and participants while enabling stronger customer relationships.
* Coordinate dependencies across multiple applications and product teams by understanding interconnected roadmaps, managing delivery trade-offs, and balancing technical constraints with speed to market.

**Qualifications And Skills**

* Minimum 8 years of related work experience, with at least two years of experience leading large cross-functional teams on major organizational projects.
* Bachelor’s degree (B.E./B.Tech) in Computer Science or IT, or Bachelor’s in Computer Applications (BCA), or Master’s in Computer Applications (MCA).
* Strong expertise in digital product management, market analysis, and user experience optimization.
* Proven ability to translate customer insights into product improvements and new features.
* Experience working with engineering teams to drive product development from concept to launch.
* Excellent strategic thinking, problem-solving, and decision-making skills.
* Strong communication and stakeholder management abilities to align product strategy with business goals.
* Experience in a contact-center or service environment, including familiarity with contact-center operations, desktop platforms, and the tools that support customer-service teams.
* Demonstrated ability to manage cross-product dependencies and collaborate with multiple product managers; financial-services experience is preferred but not mandatory, and relevant banking or healthcare customer-service systems experience may be considered.

**Location**
This role is based in Hyderabad, Telangana at Vanguard India. Only qualified external applicants will be considered.
  
  
**Our mission**
Vanguard adheres to a simple purpose: To take a stand for all investors, to treat them fairly, and to give them the best chance for investment success.
  
  
**Our commitment to you**
Vanguard takes the same long-term view of your success—at work and in life—with Benefits and Rewards packages that reflect what you care about, throughout all the phases and stages of your life. Our Total Rewards programs provide you and your loved ones with wellness support for key areas in your life:
  
  
**Financial wellness**
We're committed to enabling your financial success and provide competitive offers and programs.
  
  
**Physical wellness**
We're committed to providing benefits that support your physical health and wellness.
  
  
**Personal wellness**
We're committed to providing resources that help support the full scope of your life.
  
  
**How We Work**
Vanguard has implemented a hybrid working model for most of our employees (crew members), designed to capture the benefits of enhanced flexibility while enabling in-person learning, collaboration, and connection. We believe our mission-driven and highly collaborative culture is a critical enabler to support long-term client outcomes and enrich the employee experience.

jobs.description:
**Job Title:** **PRODUCTION SPECIALIST L1**
===========================================

City: Bengaluru

State/Province: Karnataka

Posting Start Date: 11/21/26

Wipro Limited (NYSE: WIT, BSE: 507685, NSE: WIPRO) is a leading technology services and consulting company focused on building innovative solutions that address clients’ most complex digital transformation needs. Leveraging our holistic portfolio of capabilities in consulting, design, engineering, and operations, we help clients realize their boldest ambitions and build future-ready, sustainable businesses. With over 230,000 employees and business partners across 65 countries, we deliver on the promise of helping our customers, colleagues, and communities thrive in an ever-changing world. For additional information, visit us at www.wipro.com.

**Role Purpose**

The purpose of the role is to provide effective technical support to the process and actively resolve client issues directly or through timely escalation to meet process SLAs.

**͏**
-----

**Do**
======

* **Support process by managing transactions as per required quality standards**
  ------------------------------------------------------------------------------

  + Fielding all incoming help requests from clients via telephone and/or emails in a courteous manner
  + Document all pertinent end user identification information, including name, department, contact information and nature of problem or issue
  + Update own availability in the RAVE system to ensure productivity of the process
  + Record, track, and document all queries received, problem-solving steps taken and total successful and unsuccessful resolutions
  + Follow standard processes and procedures to resolve all client queries
  + Resolve client queries as per the SLA s defined in the contract
  + Access and maintain internal knowledge bases, resources and frequently asked questions to aid in and provide effective problem resolution to clients
  + Identify and learn appropriate product details to facilitate better client interaction and troubleshooting
  + Document and analyze call logs to spot most occurring trends to prevent future problems
  + Maintain and update self-help documents for customers to speed up resolution time
  + Identify red flags and escalate serious client issues to Team leader in cases of untimely resolution
  + Ensure all product information and disclosures are given to clients before and after the call/email requests
  + Avoids legal challenges by complying with service agreements

**͏**
-----

* **Deliver excellent customer service through effective diagnosis and troubleshooting of client queries**
  --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

  + Provide product support and resolution to clients by performing a question diagnosis while guiding users through step-by-step solutions
  + Assist clients with navigating around product menus and facilitate better understanding of product features
  + Troubleshoot all client queries in a user-friendly, courteous and professional manner
  + Maintain logs and records of all customer queries as per the standard procedures and guidelines
  + Accurately process and record all incoming call and email using the designated tracking software
  + Offer alternative solutions to clients (where appropriate) with the objective of retaining customers and clients business
  + Organize ideas and effectively communicate oral messages appropriate to listeners and situations
  + Follow up and make scheduled call backs to customers to record feedback and ensure compliance to contract /SLAs

**͏**
-----

* **Build capability to ensure operational excellence and maintain superior customer service levels of the existing account/client**
  ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

  + Undertake product trainings to stay current with product features, changes and updates
  + Enroll in product specific and any other trainings per client requirements/recommendations
  + Partner with team leaders to brainstorm and identify training themes and learning issues to better serve the client
  + Update job knowledge by participating in self learning opportunities and maintaining personal networks

**͏**
-----

**Deliver**
-----------

No

Performance Parameter

Measure

  

1

Process

No. of cases resolved per day, compliance to process and quality standards, meeting process level SLAs, Pulse score, Customer feedback

  

2

Self- Management

Productivity, efficiency, absenteeism, Training Hours, No of technical training completed

Mandatory Skills: Investment Banking(Loans) .  
Experience: 1-3 Years .

Join a business powered by purpose and a place that empowers you to design your own reinvention.

jobs.title: Senior Associate - Fraud Strategy
jobs.description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION**  
  
  

**Job Responsibilities**

As a Check Fraud Strategy Senior Associate within Consumer and Community Banking, you will be responsible for managing check deposit fraud losses by developing, implementing, and optimizing strategies that balance fraud losses and operating expenses while minimizing customer friction. You will partner with Consumer and Business Banking, Operations, Technology, and Product teams to deliver best-in-class fraud prevention capabilities that protect our customers and the firm. This is a highly analytical role, leveraging data-driven insights, experimentation, and performance monitoring to quantify trade-offs, identify emerging fraud trends, and continuously improve prevention strategies. Strong storytelling and communication skills are essential to translate complex analyses into clear, compelling narratives that drive alignment and decision-making across stakeholders.

**Required Qualifications, Capabilities, and Skills**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree
* 4+ years of professional experience related to strategic analytics, risk management, or data science
* Strong knowledge of programming language like SAS, SQL, Python, Databricks
* Strong analytical, interpretive, and problem-solving skills with the ability to interpret large amounts of data to monitor and uncover behaviors and trends in fraudulent activity
* Strong, clear, and concise written and verbal communication with ability to edit and prepare executive level communications. Proficient in Excel & PowerPoint
* Excellent organizational and project management skills; able to manage competing priorities under tight deadlines

Bengaluru

Flexible Shifts

jobs.title: AI Go-to-Market Asset & Experience Manager
jobs.description:
**Req ID:** 393722
  
  
NTT DATA strives to hire exceptional, innovative and passionate individuals who want to grow with us. If you want to be part of an inclusive, adaptable, and forward-thinking organization, apply now.
  
  
We are currently seeking a AI Go-to-Market Asset Experience Manager to join our team in Bangalore, Karnātaka (IN-KA), India (IN).
  
  
AI Go-to-Market Asset Experience Manager
  
**Organization:** Global AI Go-to-Market | Role Type: Individual Contributor
  
About the Role
  
NTT DATA is looking for someone to own the digital assets our global AI Go-to-Market organization runs on: the AI demo catalog ("Periodic Table"), software demonstrations, sales and solution presentations, client-ready materials, and enablement content.
  
The job blends digital asset management, content operations, product ownership, and hands-on prototyping. You'll keep the library current and trustworthy, and you'll keep looking for better ways to organize, surface, and reuse this content across SharePoint, Lighthouse, internal portals, and AI-powered knowledge experiences. When the existing tools fall short, you build something lightweight yourself.
  
What You'll Own
  
The AI GTM asset library. Manage the full lifecycle — intake, tagging, review, publication, versioning, ownership, refresh, and retirement — across demos, presentations, use-case and industry materials, videos, architecture artifacts, seller enablement, and reusable pursuit content. Keep what's published accurate, discoverable, and reusable by sellers, solution teams, and delivery organizations globally.
  
The Periodic Table / demo portfolio. Serve as operational owner. Work with demo owners and engineering teams to capture new capabilities; make sure each demo has solid descriptions, screenshots, video, architecture detail, use cases, and sales material; retire what's duplicate, outdated, or unsupported; track ownership; improve taxonomy and navigation; watch usage to find the high-value demos. Push it from a static catalog toward a real AI solution discovery and enablement experience.
  
The content experience. Prototype and improve how assets reach internal users — search, navigation, discovery, personalization, recommendations, metadata generation, summarization, and publishing workflows — using SharePoint, Microsoft 365, Lighthouse, custom portals, search and knowledge-management technology, and conversational interfaces.
  
AI-assisted operations. Use Enterprise ChatGPT and other approved platforms to generate summaries and metadata, recommend taxonomy, spot duplicates, translate technical content into seller language, extract information from decks and documents, and support quality reviews. Automate the repetitive parts while keeping governance and human oversight intact.
  
Governance and stakeholders. Work across AI GTM leadership, offering teams, Forward Deployed Engineering, solution architects, industry teams, marketing, sales, engineering, and alliance partners. Establish clear asset ownership and quality standards through processes light enough that people actually follow them.
  
What You'll Need
  
5+ years across some combination of digital content platforms, knowledge management, web application development, product management, sales enablement technology, digital asset management, or software engineering
  
A track record of bringing order to a large, fast-moving collection of digital assets
  
Hands-on experience with generative AI assistants and LLMs, plus the instinct to experiment and prototype independently
  
Working knowledge of JavaScript/TypeScript, React or similar, HTML/CSS, REST APIs, and Python or Node.js — enough to prototype ideas and integrate systems, not to work as a full-time engineer
  
Experience with SharePoint, Microsoft 365, Power Automate, Power Apps, or Azure, plus Git and standard development practices
  
**Strong writing:** turning complex technical detail into clear, concise content
  
Comfort with both business and technical stakeholders, operating with limited supervision in a global, matrixed organization
  
**Nice to have:** enterprise sales, consulting, solution engineering, or GTM support experience; ownership of a demo environment, solution catalog, developer portal, or digital marketplace; semantic or vector search, RAG, or AI-powered knowledge management; Azure AI, OpenAI APIs, or comparable LLM platforms; metadata, taxonomy, information architecture, and enterprise search; internal web apps and content portals; content analytics; technology consulting or large global professional services.
  
What Success Looks Like
  
Sellers find the right asset fast. Demos have owners and stay current. New assets get added quickly and consistently. Duplicate and outdated content shrinks. The Periodic Table becomes the trusted entry point for discovering NTT DATA's AI capabilities. AI handles more of the ingestion, classification, search, and discovery work. And the organization can see which assets get used — and where the gaps are.
  
The Profile
  
This one is unusual by design. You may have started as a developer, solution engineer, digital experience specialist, knowledge-management professional, or technical product manager — but you enjoy organizing technology as much as building it. In a given week you might restructure a SharePoint information architecture, sit with an engineering team on a new demo, generate metadata with Enterprise ChatGPT, prototype a search experience, review a sales deck, and help a seller find the right demonstration for tomorrow's client meeting.
  
**Above all:** curious, highly organized, technically capable, and motivated by making complex information easier for others to find and use.
  
  
About NTT DATA
  
  
NTT DATA is a $30 billion business and technology services leader, serving 75% of the Fortune Global 100. We are committed to accelerating client success and positively impacting society through responsible innovation. We are one of the world's leading AI and digital infrastructure providers, with unmatched capabilities in enterprise-scale AI, cloud, security, connectivity, data centers and application services. our consulting and Industry solutions help organizations and society move confidently and sustainably into the digital future. As a Global Top Employer, we have experts in more than 50 countries. We also offer clients access to a robust ecosystem of innovation centers as well as established and start-up partners. NTT DATA is a part of NTT Group, which invests over $3 billion each year in RD.
  
  
Whenever possible, we hire locally to NTT DATA offices or client sites. This ensures we can provide timely and effective support tailored to each client’s needs. While many positions offer remote or hybrid work options, these arrangements are subject to change based on client requirements. For employees near an NTT DATA office or client site, in-office attendance may be required for meetings or events, depending on business needs. At NTT DATA, we are committed to staying flexible and meeting the evolving needs of both our clients and employees. Full-time

**About DCM**

DCM Corp Limited builds interbank infrastructure for tokenized deposits in emerging markets. Our entry point is the payment itself: ISO 20022-native messaging with tokenized settlement, running alongside banks' existing core systems rather than replacing them. Our technology already runs a national interbank payment network in production. DCM is the exclusive implementation provider of tokenized deposit solutions for the ADI Foundation, the Abu Dhabi-based foundation backed by IHC, bringing these solutions to banks across MENA and sub-Saharan Africa.

**The role**

You will own the product: strategy, roadmap, and the way we implement it with banks. You will build and lead the product function, working closely with the leadership team.

**What you will do**

* Own the roadmap for our two products: Side-core, a layer that runs alongside a bank's core, and PMP (Payment Messaging Processing), an ISO 20022-native messaging and settlement platform
* Watch the market and shape where the product goes next: regulation, competing platforms, bank demand, and initiatives like CBDC and interbank ledger projects
* Develop the product line beyond current deployments (new capabilities, new deployment models, new markets) with a clear case for each

* A product delivered to banks or payment operators as clients: workshops, scoping, pilot, production, security reviews

* A record of growing a product line: finding what the market needs next and shipping it, not only running an existing roadmap
* 12+ years of experience, at least 5 leading products for B2B infrastructure
* Experience owning a product when engineering sits in another organization
* Comfortable acting as solution architect on early client projects

**Nice to have**

The product team has moved to a tribe model, and this role creates the leadership layer each tribe needs. You'll own the tribe's strategy, outcomes and the quality of its product management, staying close enough to the work to challenge discovery, prioritisation and decisions, and making client onboarding and payments smooth, secure and efficient.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager - Payments Platform
jobs.description:
**Building the Future of Open Finance**
Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout, xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system.
  
  
**The team**
Payward Services is an enterprise infrastructure platform that enables companies to seamlessly integrate trading, payments, funding, and digital asset services through a single unified system. It provides coordinated liquidity, custody, compliance, risk management, and settlement capabilities, reducing operational complexity for fintechs, banks, brokerages, and payment providers.
  
  
Payward's Payments & Blockchain team owns the first and last mile of every dollar that moves in or out of its products. That means dozens of banking partners, PSPs and local rails powering deposits and withdrawals for millions of users.
  
  
The team is looking for a product manager to shape the future of this platform, from the architecture underneath to the API layer internal clients build on. At the center is Payward's in-house PSP: a scalable, multi-tenant payments backend with hosted pages, SDKs, embedded components and direct APIs, so any Payward business can plug in and reach pay-in and payout rails worldwide.
  
  
**The opportunity**

* Own the product vision and roadmap for the Payward payments platform, covering both the shared backend and the integration surfaces internal clients build on (hosted pages, SDKs, embedded components and direct APIs)
* Map requirements across internal clients and use them to evolve the platform's vision and capabilities so it serves a growing range of use cases
* Partner with engineering to turn the target vision into a sequenced, high-impact roadmap, with milestones every client team can plan against
* Prioritize across competing client needs, make the trade-offs visible, and say no with a clear rationale
* Shape the client experience end to end, from first conversation to go-live, so teams can adopt the platform without heavy hand-holding
* Work with the banking and partnerships teams so each new PSP or bank integration is built once on the platform and reaches every Payward business
* Bring compliance, risk and legal requirements across Payward's entities and jurisdictions into the roadmap early, before they become launch blockers
* Set and track platform success metrics, such as time to launch a rail for an existing client, time for a new client to go live, share of rails available through the platform, and payment success rates

**What You Bring**

* 5+ years of product management experience, ideally in a platform, API or infrastructure role where your customers were other internal teams or developers
* Working knowledge of payments: pay-ins and payouts, PSPs and acquirers, bank rails (ACH, SEPA, Faster Payments, SWIFT and local methods), and how money flows between them
* Strong technical fluency. You can read an RFC, challenge an architecture decision, and write an API spec that engineers respect
* Experience shipping developer-facing products such as APIs, SDKs, or embeddable UI components
* Clear, structured writing. You turn complex system designs into docs that product, compliance and business stakeholders can all act on
* Skill at managing many stakeholders with different priorities, and building alignment without direct authority
* Comfort working with data to set goals and measure platform adoption and performance

**Nice to haves**

* Experience at a PSP, payment orchestrator or payments infrastructure company, or building one in-house
* Background with multi-tenant SaaS or B2B2C platforms
* Familiarity with crypto, stablecoins or on/off-ramps
* Experience working across multiple regulated legal entities or licensing regimes

*Unless a specific application deadline is stated in the job posting, applications are accepted on an ongoing basis.*
*Please note, applicants are permitted to redact or remove information on their resume that identifies age, date of birth, or dates of attendance at or graduation from an educational institution.*
*We consider qualified applicants with criminal histories for employment on our team, assessing candidates in a manner consistent with the requirements of the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance.*
**Our commitment**
Payward is powered by people from around the world and we celebrate the diverse talents, backgrounds, contributions, and unique perspectives that everyone brings to the table. We hire based on merit, seeking out people with the right abilities, knowledge, and skills for the job. We encourage you to apply for roles where you don't fully meet the listed requirements, especially if you're passionate or knowledgeable about crypto.

**Summary**

The
**Senior Product Manager – Consumer Products**
is responsible for the end to end product development, delivery, and continuous enhancement of consumer financial products, including credit cards, loans, instalment plans, balance transfers, top ups, and related value added services.

The role will lead product strategy, market research, proposition development, product launches, portfolio management, and continuous improvement. Working closely with Risk, Technology, Operations, Finance, Marketing, Compliance, and other stakeholders, the role will ensure products are commercially viable, customer focused, digitally enabled, and aligned with Finance House’s strategic and regulatory objectives.

**Major Responsibilities**

**Product Strategy & Portfolio Management**

* Develop and execute product strategies and propositions for assigned consumer products, including cards, loans, instalment plans, balance transfers, and related services.
* Own the end to end product lifecycle from market research and business case development through launch, optimization, and product rationalization.
* Develop short, medium, and long term product roadmaps covering product features, digital journeys, underwriting, technology initiatives, and business priorities.
* Conduct customer research, segmentation, competitor analysis, and market reviews to identify new opportunities and enhance existing products.
* Define product propositions, pricing, features, eligibility criteria, and customer value propositions in line with market needs and business objectives.
* Monitor portfolio performance and identify opportunities to improve acquisition, activation, utilization, retention, revenue, profitability, and customer experience.

**Product Development & Digital Transformation**

* Lead the design and delivery of new products, product enhancements, and digital customer journeys from concept through implementation and post launch optimization.
* Define product requirements, customer journeys, business processes, and functional specifications in collaboration with Technology and Operations.
* Drive digital acquisition, onboarding, credit decisioning, fulfilment, servicing, and other initiatives to improve customer experience and operational efficiency.
* Identify opportunities to simplify processes, automate product journeys, improve turnaround times, and enhance digital capabilities.
* Partner with Technology, Data, and Analytics teams to leverage automation, AI, and advanced analytics to improve product performance and customer outcomes.

**Commercial & Financial Management**

* Establish product level financial objectives and monitor revenue, costs, profitability, portfolio growth, and key performance indicators.
* Develop business cases and financial models for new products, product enhancements, pricing changes, campaigns, and strategic initiatives.
* Recommend pricing, fees, promotions, and product economics that balance customer value, competitiveness, risk, and profitability.
* Monitor product P&L and identify opportunities to improve portfolio contribution and sustainable returns.

**Credit, Risk & Governance**

* Partner with Credit Risk to define and optimize product eligibility, underwriting, credit policy, risk appetite, and decisioning requirements.
* Monitor portfolio quality, delinquency, approval rates, utilization, attrition, and other relevant risk and performance indicators.
* Ensure products and product changes comply with approved risk appetite, credit policies, regulatory requirements, and internal governance frameworks.
* Work closely with Compliance, Legal, AML, Risk, and other control functions to ensure regulatory and operational requirements are addressed throughout the product lifecycle.
* Establish and lead product governance routines, including product performance reviews, roadmap reviews, and cross functional forums.
* Represent the function in relevant audits, regulatory reviews, governance committees, and discussions with card schemes, processors, vendors, and strategic partners.

**Product Marketing & Customer Growth**

* Partner with Marketing, Sales, and Distribution teams to develop product positioning, go to market strategies, campaigns, and customer acquisition initiatives.
* Develop strategies to improve customer acquisition, activation, engagement, utilization, retention, cross sell, and customer lifetime value.
* Use customer insights, behavioural data, and portfolio analytics to identify opportunities for targeted propositions and improved customer experiences.
* Monitor campaign and proposition performance and recommend improvements based on measurable business outcomes.

**Stakeholder Management**

* Work closely with Operations, Risk, Technology, Finance, Marketing, Compliance, Legal, AML, Data & Analytics, Collections, Sales, and other stakeholders to deliver customer centric solutions.
* Build strong relationships across the organization and influence stakeholders to achieve product objectives.
* Act as the subject matter expert for assigned products, providing guidance on product strategy, proposition, economics, customer journeys, and portfolio performance.

**Knowledge & Skill Requirements**

* Strong expertise in consumer financial product management, particularly credit cards, personal loans, instalment products, and other consumer lending solutions.
* Strong understanding of the complete product lifecycle, including proposition development, acquisition, onboarding, activation, usage, retention, and portfolio management.
* Strong understanding of consumer credit, underwriting, pricing, portfolio risk, and lending economics.
* Good knowledge of card issuing, card processing, payment schemes, digital lending, credit decisioning, and digital onboarding platforms.
* Strong commercial and financial acumen, with the ability to develop business cases, financial models, pricing strategies, and product performance analysis.
* Strong understanding of digital product development, customer experience, data analytics, AI, and automation.
* Strong analytical, project management, problem solving, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
* Good understanding of the UAE consumer finance and regulatory environment, including relevant CBUAE requirements and applicable card scheme requirements.

**Qualification**

* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Finance, Economics, Marketing, Technology, or a related discipline from a recognized university.
* Professional certification in Product Management, Agile, or a related discipline is preferred.
* Experience
* 10 to 12 years of progressive experience in product management within banking, consumer finance, fintech, payments, or related financial services.
* Strong experience managing consumer lending and/or card products across the complete product lifecycle.
* Proven track record of developing and launching products, enhancing existing propositions, and delivering measurable improvements in revenue, profitability, customer acquisition, or portfolio performance.
* Demonstrated experience in product strategy, roadmap development, pricing, business case development, and product performance management.
* Experience leading digital transformation initiatives involving digital acquisition, onboarding, credit decisioning, automation, or customer experience enhancement.
* Experience working cross functionally with Risk, Technology, Operations, Finance, Marketing, Compliance, and other control functions.
* Experience working within a regulated financial services environment, preferably within the UAE or GCC.
* Experience with card schemes, processors, lending platforms, digital banking ecosystems, or fintech partnerships will be an advantage.

jobs.title: Product Manager
jobs.description:
Welcome to
**MultiBank Group**
, a global financial pioneer established in 2005 in California and now proudly headquartered in Dubai, UAE. We specialize in delivering cutting-edge trading technology, unparalleled liquidity, and exceptional customer service. Our extensive range of financial products includes Forex, Metals, Shares, Indices, Commodities, and Cryptocurrency CFDs.

Join our thriving community of over 2 million clients across 100 countries, contributing to a daily trading volume exceeding US$ 35 billion. As a heavily regulated institution with oversight from 18+ financial regulators across 5 continents, and recipient of over 80 financial awards, MultiBank Group is devoted to innovation, excellence, and empowering our clients to achieve their financial goals.

**Role Overview**

We are looking for an experienced Product Manager / Product Owner to lead the development and continuous improvement of client registration, authentication and onboarding journeys across our CFD and Crypto products.

You will own the end-to-end onboarding experience, from initial registration and account creation to identity verification, compliance approval and client activation. Your objective is to deliver seamless, secure, compliant and conversion-driven onboarding across web and mobile, while supporting multiple regulatory jurisdictions, products and business requirements.

This is a hands-on role requiring close collaboration with Engineering, Design, Compliance, Risk, Operations and business stakeholders.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Product ownership and strategy**

* Own the backlog and roadmap for registration, authentication and onboarding across CFD and Crypto platforms
* Define product requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria and business rules
* Prioritize by business impact, regulatory requirements, customer experience and technical dependencies
* Manage the full delivery lifecycle, from discovery and requirements through development, testing, release and optimization
* Ensure a consistent onboarding experience across web and mobile, while meeting product-specific requirements

**Client registration and authentication**

* Own registration and sign-in journeys: email, password, social authentication, OTP verification and account recovery
* Define requirements for session management, device management, authentication security and fraud prevention
* Optimize registration flows to minimize friction and abandonment while keeping appropriate security controls
* Manage account creation logic, duplicate account detection and client eligibility checks
* Support multiple brands, products and regulatory entities

**Client onboarding and verification**

* Design and optimize onboarding for retail clients and, where applicable, professional and corporate clients
* Own KYC requirements: identity verification, document collection, liveness checks and address verification
* Define onboarding questionnaires, suitability or appropriateness assessments, risk profiling and client declarations
* Manage onboarding statuses, rejection and resubmission scenarios, manual reviews and exception handling
* Coordinate integrations with third-party identity verification, KYC/AML and fraud prevention providers
* Communicate onboarding progress and next steps clearly to clients

**Regulatory and compliance integration**

* Work with Compliance and Legal to translate regulatory requirements into product functionality
* Support jurisdiction-specific requirements, including eligibility, regulatory entity assignment and disclosures
* Implement CFD- and Crypto-specific onboarding requirements
* Support AML, sanctions screening, PEP screening and enhanced due diligence workflows
* Ensure proper consent collection, data protection, audit trails and regulatory recordkeeping
* Coordinate regulatory changes and implement them on time across platforms

**Client experience and conversion optimization**

* Analyze onboarding funnels to identify friction points, drop-offs and opportunities for improvement
* Optimize registration completion, KYC approval and client activation rates
* Collaborate with UX/UI designers on intuitive, accessible onboarding experiences
* Define and monitor onboarding KPIs, dashboards and operational performance metrics
* Run experiments and evaluate improvements using quantitative and qualitative data
* Balance conversion optimization with regulatory compliance and risk management

**Qualifications & Skills**

* 4+ years as a Product Manager or Product Owner, preferably in FinTech, online brokerage, Crypto, banking or other regulated financial services
* Experience owning digital registration, authentication, KYC or client onboarding products
* Understanding of CFD brokerage and/or Crypto trading products and their onboarding requirements
* Familiarity with KYC, AML, sanctions screening, client classification and jurisdiction-specific regulatory requirements
* Experience integrating third-party services and working with APIs
* Strong understanding of web and mobile product development
* Proven ability to translate complex business and regulatory requirements into clear technical specifications and user stories
* Experience in Agile environments using tools such as Jira and Confluence
* Strong analytical, problem-solving and stakeholder management skills
* Excellent written and spoken English

**Why Join Us?**

* Work with an industry-leading global financial institution.
* Competitive salary and comprehensive employee benefits.
* Opportunities for professional growth and career advancement.
* Collaborative, inclusive, and dynamic work environment.
* Commitment to innovation and professional excellence.

jobs.title: Implementation Director

Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid.

At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world.

Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you.

**Job Description**

Visa is transforming the future of banking and payments through Pismo, Visa's cloud-native core banking and issuer processing platform. Built to help financial institutions modernize legacy infrastructure, launch innovative products faster, and scale securely in real time, Pismo is enabling the next generation of digital banking experiences across the globe.

As an Implementation Director, you will lead the successful delivery of some of Visa and Pismo's most strategic client transformation programs. Working with leading banks, fintechs, and financial institutions, you will be responsible for orchestrating large-scale platform implementations that redefine how clients issue cards, process transactions, manage accounts, and deliver modern payment experiences to their customers.

This is a highly visible leadership role that sits at the intersection of technology, payments, and transformation. You will act as the executive sponsor for complex implementation programs, partnering with senior client stakeholders and cross-functional Visa and Pismo teams to drive delivery excellence, mitigate risk, and accelerate value realization.

The successful candidate will combine strategic thinking, executive stakeholder management, and deep program leadership capabilities to guide clients through critical modernization journeys, helping them move from legacy platforms to cloud-native infrastructure that supports future growth and innovation.

**What You'll Do**
------------------

  

* Lead end-to-end implementation and transformation programs for strategic Pismo clients, from contract signature and mobilization through go-live and post-launch stabilization.
* Serve as the primary executive point of contact for client leadership teams, building trusted relationships with C-suite, business, operations, technology, and transformation stakeholders.
* Drive governance, delivery strategy, program execution, dependency management, and risk mitigation across complex multi-workstream initiatives.
* Partner closely with Product, Engineering, Client Success, Information Security, Risk, and Commercial teams to ensure successful delivery against client commitments.
* Establish executive steering committees and governance forums, providing clear visibility into program progress, milestones, risks, decisions, and business outcomes.
* Navigate complex organizational environments to align stakeholders, resolve delivery challenges, and maintain momentum across large-scale transformation programs.
* Champion implementation excellence while ensuring clients achieve measurable business outcomes, operational improvements, and accelerated time-to-value.
* Support clients through change management, platform adoption, and operational readiness as they transition onto Pismo's cloud-native infrastructure.
* Capture lessons learned and implementation best practices to continuously strengthen Visa and Pismo's delivery frameworks.

**Qualifications**

**Basic Qualifications:**

* 10 or more years of work experience with a Bachelor’s Degree or at least 8 years of work experience with an Advanced Degree (e.g. Masters/ MBA/JD/MD) or at least 3 years of work experience with a PhD

  

* Over 15 years of experience in technology-driven financial services, with a strong focus on leading large-scale implementation and transformation projects for global fintech's and banks.
* Detailed technical knowledge of payments ecosystem in GCC countries, more specifically implementation and certification of Jaywan and AEP Switch in UAE
* Technical knowledge of payments and banking platforms operating in the cloud in a microservice architecture, with REST/JSON API’s and data streaming.
* Educational background in solutions architecture and software engineering. Cloud certifications are a plus.
* Having completed a core banking, payments transformation implementation from contract signature to production live.
* Expertise in building and scaling high-performing teams, with a hands-on leadership style that emphasizes mentorship, empowerment, and a culture of accountability.
* Proven ability to deliver complex, multi-market projects on time and within scope, leveraging advanced project management methodologies (Agile, Lean, and hybrid models) and a pragmatic, results-oriented approach.
* Recognized for forging strong, trust-based relationships with C-level executives, clients, and cross-functional partners, ensuring alignment and transparency throughout the implementation lifecycle.
* Adept at translating business strategy into actionable plans, optimizing processes, and driving continuous improvement through data-driven decision-making and KPI management.
* Russian speaker is highly desirable

**Visa is an EEO Employer**

Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status. Visa will also consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with EEOC guidelines and applicable local law.

jobs.title: Senior Analyst, MENA Treasury
jobs.description:
***Company Description***

*We’re**Checkout.com**. You might not know our name, but companies like eBay, Spotify, Klarna, Uber, and Sony do, because we’re behind many of the digital experiences you use every day.*

*We are where the world checks out, enabling over 10 billion transactions yearly for more than one billion global shoppers.*  
  
*Whether you want to book a holiday, order food, renew a subscription, or check out online, there’s a good chance our tech powers the payments behind the scenes. Our platform helps the most ambitious businesses deliver effortless digital experiences, at scale.*  
  
*If you want to do career-defining work, you’ve come to the right place. We move fast, think globally, and believe great teams are built by hiring exceptional people with conviction, curiosity, and the desire to make an impact.*  
  
*With 20 offices across six continents and London as our HQ, we’re shaping the future of fintech – and we’re just getting started.*

**The role**
------------

We are looking for an analytical and organised Senior Analyst to help deliver the MENA Treasury team’s safeguarding and operational responsibilities. Working closely with the Senior Associate, you will take ownership of defined daily processes, including safeguarding calculations and reconciliations, payment and funding activity, exception investigation, and management information. You will use your judgement to resolve routine issues, identify emerging risks, and escalate material or complex matters promptly.

This is a hands-on role in a regulated payments environment, with scope to improve the quality and resilience of Treasury processes. You will apply a strong control mindset and sound technical skills across safeguarding, cash management, liquidity, and Treasury operations, while helping translate policies into consistent day-to-day execution.

**What you will do**
--------------------

* Own the preparation and review of daily safeguarding calculations and reconciliations for assigned MENA merchant funds, ensuring they follow regulations, approved policies, account structures, and controls.
* Analyse balances and supporting data, investigate breaks and aged reconciling items, coordinate resolution with relevant teams, and escalate potential shortfalls, control failures, or unusual activity promptly to the Senior Associate.
* Instruct and monitor approved safeguarding, funding, settlement, and intercompany transfers within delegated authority; perform appropriate checks and maintain clear evidence in line with control requirements.
* Monitor bank accounts, payment flows, and funding positions; analyse variances and follow through on operational queries with internal teams and banking partners.
* Produce and maintain accurate daily Treasury records, reconciliations, trackers, and management information; investigate data-quality issues and highlight meaningful trends or exceptions.
* Prepare recurring reporting and analysis for Treasury management and governance forums, ensuring information is accurate, timely, and clearly explained.
* Maintain procedures, process maps, control evidence, and supporting documentation for assigned processes; identify control gaps and recommend practical process improvements or automation.
* Coordinate evidence and responses for internal and external audits, regulatory reviews, and information requests; track actions to closure and escalate matters requiring interpretation or management input.
* Analyse payment flows and assess potential safeguarding and operational impacts of product, market, or regulatory changes; document findings and recommendations for review.
* Build effective working relationships with Treasury colleagues and partner teams across Finance, Operations, Product, Compliance, and Legal to resolve issues and deliver reliable execution.
* Provide cover for other MENA Treasury activities when required, operating within documented controls and delegated authority.

**What you will bring**
-----------------------

* Typically 3–5 years’ experience in Treasury, payments, banking, finance operations, or a related financial-services role; equivalent relevant experience will also be considered.
* Experience with reconciliations, payment operations, cash movements, or financial controls in a high-volume or regulated environment.
* Working knowledge of safeguarding and customer-funds protection, including segregation, reconciliations, fund flows, and escalation of exceptions.
* Strong numerical and analytical skills, with the ability to interpret data, investigate discrepancies, explain findings, and maintain accurate records.
* Strong Excel or spreadsheet skills and confidence working with operational systems and reporting tools; experience with a Treasury management system is an advantage.
* A control-minded, organised approach and the confidence to raise a concern when something does not look right.
* Clear written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to work constructively across teams and manage competing daily priorities.
* Fluent English; Arabic is an advantage but not essential.

**It would be useful if you also have**
---------------------------------------

* Exposure to a regulated payments provider, Electronic Money Institution, bank, or similar financial institution.
* Familiarity with UAE payments or safeguarding requirements, including the CBUAE framework.
* Exposure to cash management, liquidity monitoring, FX, or Treasury systems such as Kyriba or FXall.
* Experience documenting procedures, supporting audits, or improving and automating operational processes.

**How you will contribute**
---------------------------

You will deliver accurate and timely Treasury processes, provide dependable analysis and control evidence, and ensure exceptions are understood and acted on promptly. You will bring ownership to defined areas of activity and help strengthen the team’s operational resilience across MENA safeguarding and Treasury.

**Additional Information**

**Bring all of you to work**

We create the conditions for high performers to thrive, through real ownership, fewer blockers, and work that makes a difference from day one.

Here, you’ll move fast, take on meaningful challenges, and be recognized for the impact you deliver. It’s a place where ambition gets met with opportunity, and where your growth is in your hands.

We work as one team, and we back each other to succeed. So whatever your background or identity, if you’re ready to grow and make a difference, you’ll be right at home here.

It’s important we set you up for success and make our process as accessible as possible. So let us know in your application, or tell your recruiter directly, if you need anything to make your experience or working environment more comfortable.

**Life at** **Checkout.com**

We understand that work is just one part of your life. Our hybrid working model offers flexibility, with three days per week in the office to support collaboration and connection.

Curious about what it’s like to be part of our team? Visit our Careers Page to learn more about our culture, open roles, and what drives us.

For a closer look at daily life at Checkout.com, follow us on LinkedIn and Instagram

jobs.description:
Job Description

  

Responsibilities

  

Qualifications

**JOB SUMMARY / INTRODUCTION**

To support the Global Treasury, Trade & Tokenization Client Solutions team in originating, structuring and delivering transaction banking solutions for Wholesale Banking Group clients, with primary focus on Real Estate & Hospitality clients. The role will partner with Coverage, Product and control functions to analyze client needs, prepare and execute Cash Management, Liquidity, Trade Finance and digital-channel solutions, and contribute to revenue, CASA, wallet-share and client-experience objectives within First Abu Dhabi Bank’s risk appetite and governance framework.
  
The role is developmental and is expected to progress greater ownership as technical and client capability develops.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Client and opportunity analysis: Analyze client business models, project and operating cash flows, transaction journeys, working-capital cycles, existing bank utilization and competitor positioning to identify Cash, Trade, Liquidity and digital opportunities.
* Sector-focused origination: Support calling plans and account strategies for Real Estate & Hospitality clients, including developers, contractors, property managers, hotel owners and operators, within the assigned Real Estate & Hospitality portfolio.
* Solution development: Work with Coverage and Product teams to design customer-focused solutions across payments, collections, virtual accounts, escrow and project accounts, liquidity and liabilities, host-to-host/API connectivity, cards, core trade, guarantees, open-account trade, Supply Chain Finance and Receivables Finance.
* Client engagement: Prepare client briefs, presentations, proposals, product comparisons, meeting materials and call reports; participate in client meetings, product demonstrations and solution workshops, and maintain disciplined follow-up on agreed actions.
* RFP and proposal management: Coordinate timely, accurate and commercially compelling responses to RFPs, service enquiries and pricing requests, ensuring that solution design, operational readiness, legal terms, economics and implementation requirements are aligned.
* Pipeline and portfolio discipline: Maintain opportunity pipelines, client activity records and management information; track mandates, revenue, CASA, facility utilization, digital penetration, implementation progress and outstanding actions, escalating gaps or delays.
* Transaction execution: Coordinate credit, pricing and product approvals, documentation, implementation readiness and hand-offs with Product, Implementation, Operations, Credit, Legal, Compliance, Finance and other stakeholders.
* Onboarding and service delivery: Support account opening, KYC and due-diligence requirements, documentation follow-up, implementation and resolution of client issues to deliver a timely and high-quality client experience.
* Commercial outcomes: Contribute to growth in transaction banking revenue, CASA and operating balances, trade utilisation, fee income, digital adoption and overall GTx wallet share, with appropriate attention to risk-adjusted returns and pricing discipline.
* Risk and control: Comply with applicable Credit, Compliance, AML, sanctions, fraud, operational-risk, conduct, data-privacy and information-security requirements; identify and escalate exceptions, control issues and client concerns promptly.
* Market and product insight: Monitor sector developments, competitor activity and client trends; share practical insights and identify opportunities for new products, improved structures and better client journeys.
Process improvement and learning: Build strong technical and sector knowledge, support improvements to workflows and reporting, and complete required learning, coaching and on-the-job development activities.  

**REQUIREMENTS / QUALIFICATIONS**

* Minimum qualification: Bachelor’s degree in finance, Accounting, Economics, Business, Commerce or a related discipline.
* Transaction banking knowledge: Basic understanding of cash management, payments, collections, liquidity management, trade finance and digital banking solutions, with the ability and commitment to develop deeper technical knowledge. The role is developmental and is expected to progress greater ownership as technical and client capability develops.
* Client orientation: Professional, responsive and service-focused, with the confidence to support client meetings and follow through with reliably on commitments.
* Communication and presentation: Strong written and verbal English, with the ability to prepare concise proposals, presentations and management updates.
* Stakeholder management: Collaborative and able to coordinate effectively across Coverage, Product, Implementation, Operations, Credit, Legal, Compliance and external client stakeholders.
* Execution discipline: Organised, attentive to detail and able to prioritise multiple tasks, maintain accurate records and deliver against deadlines in a controlled environment.
* Digital and systems capability: Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint; ability to learn CRM, workflow, digital-banking, pipeline and reporting systems. The role is developmental and is expected to progress greater ownership as technical and client capability develops.
* Curious, accountable, adaptable and commercially minded, with a willingness to learn and operate under pressure while maintaining strong conduct and control standards.
* Must be a strong team player who is eager to learn and has good communication skills.
Must be organized, reliable, and able to work under a manager's guidance.  

**Preferred / Beneficial**

* Experience: Graduate or early career profile; 0-2 years of relevant experience in banking, transaction banking, client service, sales support, operations or a related area is preferred.
* Arabic capability is advantageous.

  

About Us

**About Us:**

  

First Abu Dhabi Bank (FAB) is the largest bank in the UAE and one of the world's largest and safest financial institutions. We offer a comprehensive range of personal and private banking services, including credit cards, Islamic banking, investments, loans, and mortgages. Our commitment to excellence and innovation drives us to provide top-tier financial solutions to our clients.

  

**Life at FAB:**

  

Working at FAB means being part of a team of talented and passionate individuals with a shared vision to support the ambitions of our stakeholders to "Grow Stronger." We embrace the needs of our customers across the globe with a sense of responsibility and confidence driven by extensive expertise that can only be delivered by an ambitious world-class organization

  

**Career Development:**

  

FAB offers unique career choices, a chance to innovate, craft solutions for the future, and express yourself in a performance-based culture that will unleash the best in you. Whether you are an experienced professional or just starting your career, FAB provides a range of learning and development initiatives to support all employees through training and skill development.

  

**Our Values:**

  

At FAB, we place our customers at the core of our activities, live our values each day in every way, celebrate achievements, and empower each other to deliver leading solutions. We have structured plans for the recruitment and career progression of Emirati talent to enable them to make a mark in the financial and banking sector both regionally and globaly that rewards your hard work and dedication.

  

Join our team and be part of a journey to shape the future of banking.

jobs.title: Social Media Specialist
jobs.description:
You will run Capital.com's day-to-day social presence across the Middle East and North Africa. Social is often the first place a trader in the region meets our brand, so the work you publish shapes how people understand trading, risk and the platform before they ever open an account. You will sit in the MENA marketing team in Dubai, working with content, performance, compliance and product to turn market moments into clear, useful posts in Arabic and English. Our mission is to give traders clarity and technology they can rely on, and this role carries that into the feed every day.

### **What you will do:**

* Own the weekly content calendar for MENA channels: Instagram, TikTok, X, LinkedIn, YouTube, Snapchat and Telegram.
* Write and publish posts, captions, stories and short-form scripts in Arabic and English that explain markets plainly.
* React to market events (rate decisions, oil moves, earnings, gold) with timely, accurate content within agreed turnaround times.
* Brief the Video Editor and designers, review drafts and keep output on brand.
* Route every post through financial promotions review and keep required risk warnings in place.
* Manage community replies and DMs, escalating client issues to Customer Support and complaints to Compliance.
* Report weekly on reach, engagement, follower growth and social-sourced registrations, and act on what the numbers show.
* Work with the performance team so organic content supports paid campaigns and regional launches.

### **What you bring:**

* 3+ years managing brand social channels, or an equivalent portfolio that shows you grew an audience.
* Native-level Arabic and fluent English, with the judgment to write for Gulf and wider MENA audiences.
* Hands-on experience with native platform analytics and a scheduling tool such as Sprout Social, Hootsuite or Later.
* Comfort editing short-form video and graphics in CapCut, Canva or Adobe Express.
* Accuracy under time pressure: you check facts and figures before anything goes live.
Clear written communication and the ability to take feedback from Compliance without losing pace.  

### **Nice to have:**

* Experience in fintech, brokerage, banking or another regulated industry.
* Working knowledge of financial promotion rules (SCA, FCA COBS 4 or CySEC).
* Familiarity with UAE Media Council advertising and influencer requirements.
* Interest in markets and trading, and an understanding of CFDs.
* Experience with creator or influencer partnerships in the GCC.

### **What you will get in return:**

* **Competitive Salary:** We believe great work deserves great pay! Your skills and talents will be rewarded with a salary that makes you feel valued and motivated.
* **Work-Life Harmony:** Join a company that genuinely cares about *you*—because your life outside of work matters just as much as your time on the clock.

* **Employee Referral Program:** Love working here? Share the love! Bring your talented friends on board and get rewarded for growing our awesome team.
* **Comprehensive Health & Pension Benefits:** From medical insurance to pension plans, we’ve got your back. Plus, location-specific benefits and perks!
* **Workation Wonderland:** Live your digital nomad dreams with 30 extra days to work remotely from anywhere in the world (some restrictions apply). Adventure awaits!
* **Volunteer Days:** Make a difference! Take two additional paid days each year to support causes you care about and give back to the community

jobs.title: Technology - Application Development, Full Time Analyst, Bahrain - Seef 2027
jobs.description:
**Discover your future at Citi**
--------------------------------

Working at Citi is far more than just a job. A career with us means joining a team of approximately 219,000 dedicated people from around the globe. At Citi, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your career, give back to your community and make a real impact.

**Job Overview**
----------------

**You are the brain behind our work …**

At Citi, we do not just adapt to change – we drive it. Our Full Time Technology Analyst Program is where forward-thinking talents meet unparalleled opportunities. This is your chance to innovate, influence, and make an impact on the most global financial institution!

Citi Technology partners to ensure that Citi’s platforms can “Be the Best” for clients globally, with a diverse and ethical workforce that applies innovation and automation to deliver a world class client experience and strengthen our reputation. We have over 30,000 technologists globally who are dedicated to serving our clients’ needs across the firm. By utilizing a broad range of technologies, we are at the forefront of innovation. We seek to drive our systems and processes towards scalable, low-latency, high-performance enterprise systems to support Citi’s strategic priorities.

**We provide you with the knowledge and skills you need to succeed…**

We’re committed to teaching you the ropes. The 2-year Analyst Program starts in July and begins with a robust training program. Here at Citi, rotational programs are intended to help you build a broad skillset and accelerate your career growth by gaining exposure to more than one team. Our rotational program will help you discover the best fit for your skills and long-term career goals at Citi.

**Your time here will look like this...**

You will work in an agile software development environment, developing quality and scalable software solutions using leading-edge technologies. Based on business requirements, you will develop code consistent with quality standards and offer support during testing cycles and post-production deployment. To ensure defect-free programming, you will use the appropriate tools to test and debug code and participate in the review of peer coding. You have additional support, too. You join a cohort of other new hires and go through training together to learn about our company, our tools and processes, and the technical skills you will need to succeed.

  
  

While technologies can vary slightly from team to team, some developers will have exposure within the following categories:

* **Back-End Development:** Java, Python, Spring Framework
* **Front-End Development:** Web (React, TypeScript, Angular, HTML5) and Mobile (Swift, Kotlin)
* **Generative AI & AI Agents****:** GitHub Copilot with various models, Citi Squad (automated code reviews), Devin.AI (Agentic Code generation), Prompt Engineering, Workflow Design, GenAI Optimization, Stylus Workspaces (In-house Gemini)
* **Data Analytics:** Utilizing tools like Splunk, Tableau, and Adobe Analytics to track customer journey adoption and measure the business value of delivered products.
  

  

No matter your team placement, as a member in our program, you can expect:

* **Global Exposure**: Work in globally scoped projects with cross-functional teams and gain insights into how technology drives the financial sector worldwide.

* **Continuous Learning:** Benefit from structured learning, networking, mentoring, and development programs that are designed to sharpen your technical prowess, enhance your business insight, and cultivate your leadership skills.

* **Real Impact**: Contribute to real-world projects that shape the future of banking, from developing next-gen digital banking solutions to enhancing cybersecurity defenses and driving data-powered innovations.

**To join Citi, you should meet the following criteria:**

* Graduation between Dec 2026 and July 2027.

* Educational background: Bachelor's or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Information Technology, Management Information Systems, or other tech related degrees.

* A proactive problem-solver who thrives on innovation and embraces challenges with enthusiasm, leveraging Generative AI to address complex business problems and create novel solutions.

* Possess a global outlook and willingness to collaborate across cultures and time zones.

* Have excellent communication skills, project management, leadership, attention to detail, and the ability to work well within diverse teams.

* Ability to pass technical interviews consisting of basic algorithmic programming exercises.

* Must be collaborative and adaptable, with excellent communication skills. Prior experience working in agile teams is desirable.

* Work Authorization: Authorized to work in Bahrain without the need for employer sponsorship, now or in the future.

**Who we think will be a great fit...**

A steadfast dedication to learning and a true passion for business are vital. As global industries continue to evolve, we are seeking professionals who bring a global perspective to the future of banking and are eager to make an impact at the corporate level using AI. We value diversity and so do you.

This program is ideal for those who:

* Are ambitious, with a relentless drive to succeed in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.

* Are curious about how technology can revolutionize finance and are eager to be at the forefront of this transformation.

* Want to grow into a future tech leader, with a passion for both technology and its application in the global financial industry.

jobs.description:
Dubai, Dubai, AE Permanent ID: TBC

  

### **Description**

Operating in the UAE for over 50 years, CBD manages the financial requirements of some of the largest corporates and businesses operating in the country, driving the UAE economy. Over the years, CBD has transformed into a progressive and modern banking institution winning multiple awards for its digital initiatives, credit cards, bank accounts, mobile app features and services.

CBD has been recognized as the number one bank in the UAE on the Forbes list of The World’s Best Banks 2022.

As we continue to build upon our successes, we are looking for ambitious individuals who are passionate about the banking and finance industry and the markets in which CBD operates. Just as important to us is your ability to demonstrate a talent for dealing with people - your colleagues and our customers and delivering service that really goes the extra mile.

**Job Purpose:** Lead the strategy, commercial performance, development, governance and lifecycle management of the Wholesale Banking Group Payments and Cash Management portfolio, including Payments, Liquidity Management, Merchant Acquiring and Payment Service Provider solutions. Ensure products remain competitive, commercially viable, operationally effective and aligned to client, regulatory and business requirements.

**Principal Accountabilities:**

* Define and execute the PCM product strategy across Payments, Liquidity, Merchant Acquiring and PSP propositions.
* Develop and maintain a portfolio roadmap aligned to business strategy, market developments, client needs and regulatory requirements.
* Own the full product lifecycle from concept, approval and launch through enhancement, monitoring and retirement.
* Manage product governance, inventories, pricing frameworks, documentation, controls and performance measures.
* Drive commercial performance, including revenue growth, profitability, transaction volumes, deposit value and cost optimisation.
* Lead the development and enhancement of domestic and international payment solutions, liquidity products and account-based services.
* Oversee merchant acquiring and PSP product propositions, including partner management, pricing, economics and service performance.
* Develop client-centric solutions by collaborating with Coverage, Sales and key stakeholders to address evolving transaction banking needs.
* Prioritise and govern product change initiatives, business cases, investment decisions and product roadmaps.
* Maintain front-to-back ownership of product effectiveness, client experience, operational efficiency and service quality.
* Manage product risks, controls, governance requirements and remediation activities in partnership with control functions.
* Build strategic partnerships with payment schemes, fintechs, processors, gateways and infrastructure providers.

### **Requirements**

**Requirements:**

**Education and Experience:**

* Significant experience in transaction banking and Payments & Cash Management product leadership within wholesale or corporate banking.
* Strong expertise across payments, liquidity management, collections, merchant acquiring, PSP solutions, account services and digital transaction banking.

* Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Business, Economics, Technology, Engineering or a related discipline.

jobs.title: Director, Product Management - WhatsApp India
jobs.description:
About the TeamMore than 3 billion people in over 180 countries use WhatsApp to stay in touch with friends and family, anytime and anywhere. In India, it is also where a great deal of everyday life gets done - people message businesses, coordinate their families, and increasingly send money as easily as they send a message.We are building a new team to take WhatsApp further in that direction. The newly established WhatsApp Services team is focused on making WhatsApp more useful for more of what people already use it for, and on building what comes next.About the RoleThis PM and Market Leader of India will oversee the newly announced pillar for WhatsApp, treated as a zero-to-one effort so we can move fast, take risks, and build as we go. Staffed and prioritized, like every other WhatsApp pillar, from the very first day. Payments on WhatsApp aren't a bet on paper: live in India since 2020 and growing; the existing WhatsApp payments team moves across as the pillar's foundation.As a Product Leader at WhatsApp, you will use your experience building products from early concept through launch in fast-moving environments and your full range of product development skills to produce intuitive, user-friendly features. You’ll be expected to push the boundaries of what’s possible in a mobile app, while sharing in our commitment to quality and attention to detail. This is a role for someone who can hold both the ceiling and the floor: sets an ambitious long-term vision for what WhatsApp can become in India.
  
  
Director, Product Management - WhatsApp India Responsibilities:
  
  

* Drive product strategy and development for one of the highest-priority initiatives across WhatsApp and Meta
* Establish a shared vision across the company (WhatsApp, Instagram, Facebook, Messenger) and ensure that all teams are clear on the overall strategy, the problem to be solved, timeline, and required contributions
* Ability to move fast to drive alignment and execution – Turn high volumes of different actions into repeatable processes and playbooks, and get alignment within and across teams through both influence and framing clear escalations when team priorities conflict
* Manage multiple products and priorities, scale teams, and ensure org is effective, healthy and set up for success by establishing clear and measurable goals – Collaborate, navigate and influence product teams across WhatsApp
* Consumer, Business, Privacy, Growth and Messaging Services, and the broader Meta organization (including Instagram and Facebook)
* Drive executional excellence and analytical rigor across teams – Drive internal and external process improvements across multiple teams and functions to reduce operational overhead, streamline decision-making and accelerate overall execution
* Manage business reviews (i.e., weekly/monthly business reviews, functional reviews, and other key meetings), staff meetings, and all hands meetings
* Lead reviews of dashboards and reports for stakeholders and team members to drive transparency and track improvements
* Proactively identify issues and needs, escalate as needed, and devise processes to resolve them
* Coordinate working groups for areas of ownership that we need to establish, but which cut across organizational lines
* At times, you may be specifically tasked to own a workstream, or to dive deep into different parts of the organization
* Lead org-wide projects to create business value, aligning multiple stakeholders across Meta, including various product teams, go-to-market, Finance, Operations, Research, and Family of Apps

Minimum Qualifications:
  
  

* 15+ years of product management experience, with at least 5 years leading PM teams (managing managers)
* Strong technical judgment and ability to partner with ML/ranking teams on signal quality, bidding systems, and delivery optimization
* Demonstrated ability to manage a portfolio of bets at different maturity stages — from 0-to-1 incubation to billion-dollar scaled products — simultaneously
* Exceptional cross-functional leadership: ability to drive alignment across engineering, data science, design, sales, partnerships, and policy
* Experience applying analytical rigor and data-driven decision-making, including defining and optimizing product metrics and data-driven decision-making, with experience in defining and optimizing metrics

Preferred Qualifications:
  
  

* B.A. or B.S. in Computer Science or a related field (Statistics, Economics, Mathematics, Business)
* Experience in building and scaling early-stage growth efforts
* Proficiency in using AI tools as part of day-to-day product development and general productivity workflow
* Track record of successfully executing the strategy in the APAC region
* Experience working with payment infrastructure in emerging markets

About Meta:
  
  
Meta builds technologies that help people connect, find communities, and grow businesses. When Facebook launched in 2004, it changed the way people connect. Apps like Messenger, Instagram and WhatsApp further empowered billions around the world. Now, Meta is moving beyond 2D screens toward immersive experiences like augmented and virtual reality to help build the next evolution in social technology. People who choose to build their careers by building with us at Meta help shape a future that will take us beyond what digital connection makes possible today—beyond the constraints of screens, the limits of distance, and even the rules of physics.
  
  
Individual compensation is determined by skills, qualifications, experience, and location. Compensation details listed in this posting reflect the base hourly rate, monthly rate, or annual salary only, and do not include bonus, equity or sales incentives, if applicable. In addition to base compensation, Meta offers benefits. Learn more about benefits at Meta.
