jobs.title: Vice President, Finance Data Product Management – P&L
jobs.description:
The VP, Finance Data Product Owner – P&L Data (India) is the execution lead for the P&L data product agenda on
**One Data Foundation**
, supporting the VP, Global Data Product Owner – P&L. The role starts with
**Revenue and Expense Accrual**
data and sits where Finance, Accounting and Technology meet. It works day to day with data producers, consumers and P&L process owners’ teams, and turns the Global Product Owner’s priorities into certified, reusable data products.
  
  
The leader works with process owners to understand how the data is used and what outcome it supports and documents the manual processes and adjustments on both the production and consumption sides. The goal is to raise productivity and efficiency and keep the data products golden by reducing manual manipulation and point-to-point sourcing. The role builds
**governance by design**
(CDEs, definitions, ownership, lineage, DQ rules and controls) into each product and uses AI and automation to modernize a largely waterfall and manual delivery lifecycle.
  
  
*The Global Data Product Owner sets product strategy, priorities, the portfolio roadmap and senior stakeholder agreements. This role executes, recommends and escalates. Controllers, Global Accounting and FP&A own the process and the reported numbers, and Technology owns engineering and production operations.*
**Key Accountabilities**

* Bridge Producers and Consumers
* Be the working-level link between upstream accrual data producers and downstream consumers, so issues are raised once, routed to the right producer and tracked to closure.
* Partner with P&L process owners’ teams (Controllers, Global Accounting, FP&A and other consumers) to understand how they use the data and the outcome they need. Surface pain points and new needs early to the Global Product Owner.
* Draft and maintain producer–consumer terms: definitions, scope, frequency, granularity, quality thresholds, ownership and issue handling, for approval by the Global Product Owner.
* Support the consumer forum by preparing the agenda and facts, and make differences in how consumers interpret or override the same data visible.
* Understand and Reduce Manual Work
* Document the manual processes, adjustments and overrides on the production and consumption sides of each in-scope P&L process. Quantify the effort and find the root causes.
* Recommend and drive fixes: move adjustments upstream or into the product so they are made once and governed, remove spreadsheet dependencies, and stop point-to-point sourcing. Priorities are agreed with the Global Product Owner.
* Use AI and automation to speed requirements, metadata, CDE identification, lineage, DQ rules, documentation and testing, within agreed controls.
* Execute the P&L Data Products
* Run day-to-day delivery of the accrual data products. Maintain the backlog, define requirements, and work with architecture and engineering on sources, transformations, business rules and lineage.
* Prepare each product for certification: definitions, CDEs, lineage, DQ rules and controls complete, reconciled to the authoritative source, and confirmed to meet accounting requirements.
* Fix issues at the source with producers, strengthen reconciliation, and maintain a shared business glossary.
* Publish and reuse on One Data Foundation, enhancing existing products before creating new ones, and support retiring legacy sources and BI reports in favor of certified data.
* Report, Escalate and Lead
* Give the Global Product Owner clear, regular updates on progress, risks and decisions needed. Escalate early and prepare materials for senior stakeholder discussions.
* Work across time zones with agreed overlap hours, documented handoffs and clear written follow-up.
* Guide and develop team members in India as the work grows.

**Required Qualifications**

* Significant banking or financial services experience in Finance, Accounting or P&L functions.
* Strong working knowledge of revenue and/or expense accruals, accounting concepts, controls and reconciliations.
* Solid grasp of data lineage, quality and governance principles, with the ability to analyze and validate data independently (for example, SQL) and reconcile it to source.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, including the ability to analyze manual processes and adjustments to find root causes and efficiency opportunities.
* Experience working between business and technology teams, with the ability to influence without direct authority and work effectively with global stakeholders across time zones.
* Clear written and verbal communication that explains data issues in terms of business impact.
* Demonstrated curiosity and a record of improving ways of working through automation or AI.

**Preferred**

* Hands-on experience with Databricks, Power BI or similar platforms; working knowledge of SQL and data modeling.
* Exposure to billing, revenue or general ledger systems and how they integrate with reporting platforms.
* Experience with platform migration or re-engineering programs, and with leading complex, multi-team work.
* Familiarity with GenAI or machine learning use cases in Finance, and agile or product ownership experience.
* Background in regulated or audit-sensitive environments, including regulatory and external reporting.
* Professional qualification (CA, CPA, CFA) or a degree in Finance, Accounting, Data or a related field.

MEASURES OF SUCCESS
  
  

* Delivery: accrual data products prepared and certified against the agreed plan, with documented producer–consumer terms.
* Manual work: manual processes and adjustments documented for each in-scope P&L process, with a measurable reduction in manual manipulation, spreadsheet dependencies and point-to-point feeds.
* Consistency and reuse: one agreed definition per P&L measure, more consumers on the certified products, and fewer report-level overrides.
* Issue efficiency: fewer duplicate issues sent to producers and faster resolution.
* Reliability: timely updates, early escalation and clean handoffs, as rated by the Global Product Owner.
* Partnership: process owners and producers report the role is fair, responsive and effective.

LEADERSHIP PROFILE AND CANDIDATE CALIBRATION
  
  

* Bridge-builder mindset (most important)

****What Good Looks Like****
Sits between producers and consumers by choice. Explains each side’s constraints to the other, gets both to commit to a shared agreement, and follows up until it holds.
  
  
**Watch-outs in candidates**
Acts as a requirements taker or a ticket router. Describes the role as “gathering requirements” or “sending tickets.”
  
  

* Curious about the manual work

****What Good Looks Like****
Wants to see how consumers really use the data and finds the adjustments and spreadsheets behind it. Asks why until the root cause is clear.
  
  
**Watch-outs in candidates**
Accepts manual adjustments as normal. Reports what people do without asking why.
  
  

* Ownership of execution

****What Good Looks Like****
Acts as an owner, not an order-taker. Follows through, flags problems early and keeps the Global Product Owner informed without being asked.
  
  
**Watch-outs in candidates**
Waits for detailed direction or makes portfolio-level commitments without agreement from the Global Product Owner.
  
  

* Reuse-first and governance by design

****What Good Looks Like****
Defaults to one certified source and one definition. Builds CDEs, lineage, DQ rules and controls in as the product is built. Challenges point-to-point feeds and local copies.
  
  
**Watch-outs in candidates**
Builds a new dataset for each request. Treats governance as a separate sign-off step.
  
  

* Curious and AI-forward

****What Good Looks Like****
Questions waterfall and manual ways of working. Experiments with AI and automation and keeps controls intact.
  
  
**Watch-outs in candidates**
Defends the current process. Views AI as hype or as a replacement for judgment.
  
  

* Works well across time zone

jobs.title: Senior Manager - Design
jobs.description:
**About Navi**

At Navi, our mission is to simplify finance for a billion people, through technology-first products built at scale.

Founded in 2018 by Sachin Bansal and Ankit Agarwal, Navi has grown rapidly across Loans, UPI, Insurance, Mutual Funds and Digital Gold – building products designed around speed, simplicity and customer experience.

Today, millions of customers use Navi for experiences like instant personal loans, fully digital home loan sanctions within minutes, low-cost mutual funds, instant credit lines in minutes and one of India’s fastest-growing UPI platforms.

**What makes Navi different is the way we build. We move fast, solve real customer problems and give people the ownership to create meaningful impact early in their journey.**

**Why Explore a Career at Navi?**

**Where Ownership Creates Real Impact**

At Navi, ownership starts early. People here are trusted to solve problems, make decisions and drive outcomes that directly shape the products and experiences used by millions of customers every day.

**Where Careers Accelerate**

Growth at Navi is driven by impact, not tenure. We strongly believe in promoting from within and creating opportunities for people to take on larger responsibilities as they grow. If you consistently raise the bar, you’ll find the space to grow quickly here.

**Where Great Talent Builds Together**

We take pride in building high talent-density teams where ambitious people learn from one another every day. Working on high-scale business and technology problems creates steep learning curves, fast execution cycles and opportunities to make visible impact throughout your journey.

**About the Team**

The Product Design team at Navi creates clear, intuitive experiences that put users first. We work end to end across research, interaction, and visual design to shape products that are simple, fast, and purposeful. Our approach is deeply data-driven, combining user insights and product analytics to continuously refine and improve the user experience.

**About the Role**

Navi is seeking a Senior Manager - Design to lead and scale our growing design team. This is a critical leadership role for someone who is not just an expert in design, but an expert in building a team that is "ruthless" in its approach to problem-solving. Your core responsibility will be to lead a team of talented designers who are experts in taste, data, and problem-solving, and who act as a force for alignment across the company. You will be instrumental in fostering a culture of relentless pursuit of excellence and pushing for an incredibly high bar for what we ship. You will be responsible for the overall success and strategy of the design function, from defining the "why" to ensuring a high-quality outcome. The ideal candidate has a strong backbone to take a stand for what is right for the customer and the company , but also has a humble heart to listen and learn.

**What You’ll Own**

* **Strategic Leadership:**

○ Partner with senior leadership (Product, Engineering, Business) to define the design vision and strategy for all charters, aligning with company goals and product principles.

○ Champion a customer-first mindset, ensuring the team starts with the customer's pain and obsesses over making their lives better.

○ Drive a culture of ruthless prioritization, ensuring the team is focused on doing fewer things, but better.

○ Seek clarity relentlessly to unblock your team and ensure everyone is moving fast with purpose and sense.

* **Team Leadership & Management:**

○ Recruit, coach, and lead a high-performing team of product designers, fostering their growth and helping them do their best work.

○ Conduct performance reviews, set career goals, and create a clear path for professional development for the team.

○ Instill the core Navi principles of end-to-end ownership and accountability.

* **Design & Process Excellence:**

○ Maintain and elevate an incredibly high bar for design quality, simplicity, and taste across all products.

○ Oversee the design process, ensuring it is data-informed and focused on clear outcomes.

○ Establish and evangelize best practices, design patterns, and standards across the organization.

**What Makes You a Great Fit**

* 7+ years of experience in product design, with a minimum of 2-3 years in a formal management or leadership role.
* A proven track record of hiring, mentoring, and leading high-performing design teams in a fast-paced, agile environment.
* A strategic portfolio that demonstrates how your leadership and design vision drove significant business impact and customer value.
* Deep domain expertise in fintech or a related industry.
* Expertise in user-centered design principles and methodologies.
* Exceptional communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence and build consensus at a senior leadership level.

**The Navi OS**

The Navi OS is our Operating System for how we work every day. Success at Navi is defined by living these core values.

* **Start with the Customer**
* Master the Details
* Act with Urgency
* Own the Outcome
* Build for a Decade - Not a Day
* Win as One

We hire talented individuals who already show these strengths, because those who share these values thrive at Navi and grow with the organisation.

To read more about the Navi OS, visit
navi.com/our-values

**Life at Navi**

Life at Navi is fast-paced, ambitious and deeply collaborative. Beyond work, teams come together through sports, celebrations, offsites, music jams, team outings and many more shared experiences that make the journey exciting and memorable.

We believe people do their best work when they feel supported, through flexible leave policies, strong health and wellness benefits, free financial, legal and medical consultations, ESOPs and a workplace designed for both productivity and well-being.

Whether it’s the sports turf, gym, focus zone or nap rooms, the campus is built to make everyday work more enjoyable.

If you’d like to know more about life at Navi, our culture and employee benefits, head to our careers page:
navi.com/careers/life-at-navi

If solving meaningful problems, building at scale and growing alongside ambitious teams excites you,

**Navi could be the place for you.**

jobs.title: Engineering Manager
jobs.description:
Step into the role of Engineering Manager at Barclays, we are more than a Bank, we are force of progress. As an Engineering Manager you will lead and manage engineering teams, providing technical guidance, mentorship, and support to ensure the delivery of high-quality software solutions, driving technical excellence, fostering a culture of innovation, and collaborating with cross-functional teams to align technical decisions with business objectives.
  
  
To be successful as an Engineering Manager, you must have experience with:
  
  
  

* Knowledge of ‘Micro-Service’ driven approach to design, build, test and deployment of a major system.
* Experience in Software development consisting of the languages and technologies like Spring, Springboot, Spring MVC, Spring Security, React and Node.js
* Recognising, selecting and applying appropriate Design patterns, frameworks according to business benefit, maintainability and delivery priorities and constrains.
* Writes and review code in adherence to the well-defined acceptance criteria and definition of done.
* Applies product development & engineering best practices.
* Participate in design reviews and provides feedback to the team.
* Creates and Maintains architecture, framework, technical documentation.
* Good knowledge about Test Driven Development (TDD) and/or Behavior Driven Development (BDD) to improve the test coverage and automation of unit and integration test along with the extended testing teams.
* Support best practices and proactively takes measures to empower support teams to resolve issues with agility.
* Clear & concise verbal and written communication skills
* Analytical with a structured approach
* Experience of Cloud technologies.
* Understand DevOps principles and Tools

**Additional Relevant Skills Given Below Are Highly Valued**

* Knowledge of integrating testing into the DevOps pipeline for automated build and deployment using tools like Jenkins, Travis CI and similar tools.
* Support, monitoring and troubleshooting of both production and non-production environments
* Source code repository management and tools like Git, GitHub, Bitbucket and Gitlab.
* Owns and runs with release tasks and collaborates with Release/BA/QA teams to make sure production releases are performed with high levels accuracy.
* Assist L2 Support teams to resolve user queries and production issues
* Participates in team retrospective / product demo(s) and provides valuable insights and improvements for future development.

You may be assessed on the key critical skills relevant for success in role, such as risk and controls, change and transformation, business acumen strategic thinking and digital and technology, as well as job-specific technical skills.
  
  
This role is based in our Pune office.
  
  
**Purpose of the role**
To lead and manage engineering teams, providing technical guidance, mentorship, and support to ensure the delivery of high-quality software solutions, driving technical excellence, fostering a culture of innovation, and collaborating with cross-functional teams to align technical decisions with business objectives.
  
  
**Accountabilities**

* Lead engineering teams effectively, fostering a collaborative and high-performance culture to achieve project goals and meet organizational objectives.
* Oversee timelines, team allocation, risk management and task prioritization to ensure the successful delivery of solutions within scope, time, and budget.
* Mentor and support team members' professional growth, conduct performance reviews, provide actionable feedback, and identify opportunities for improvement.
* Evaluation and enhancement of engineering processes, tools, and methodologies to increase efficiency, streamline workflows, and optimize team productivity.
* Collaboration with business partners, product managers, designers, and other stakeholders to translate business requirements into technical solutions and ensure a cohesive approach to product development.
* Enforcement of technology standards, facilitate peer reviews, and implement robust testing practices to ensure the delivery of high-quality solutions.

**Vice President Expectations**

* Advise key stakeholders, including functional leadership teams and senior management on functional and cross functional areas of impact and alignment.
* Manage and mitigate risks through assessment, in support of the control and governance agenda.
* Demonstrate leadership and accountability for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work your team does.
* Demonstrate comprehensive understanding of the organisation functions to contribute to achieving the goals of the business.
* Collaborate with other areas of work, for business aligned support areas to keep up to speed with business activity and the business strategies.
* Create solutions based on sophisticated analytical thought comparing and selecting complex alternatives. In-depth analysis with interpretative thinking will be required to define problems and develop innovative solutions.
* Adopt and include the outcomes of extensive research in problem solving processes.
* Seek out, build and maintain trusting relationships and partnerships with internal and external stakeholders in order to accomplish key business objectives, using influencing and negotiating skills to achieve outcomes.

All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. They will also be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Mindset – to Empower, Challenge and Drive – the operating manual for how we behave.

jobs.title: Head of Technology / VP Engineering
jobs.description:
**Hiring: Head of Technology / VP Engineering**

**Company:**
KGIL Fintech Solutions Pvt. Ltd. (SwipeLoan)

**Location:**
Hinjawadi, Pune | Work from Office

**Experience:**
10–15+ years in Technology, Software Engineering, Architecture and Engineering Leadership

**CTC:**
₹18–24 LPA, depending on experience and technical expertise

**Reporting to:**
Founder & CEO

**About KGIL**

KGIL is building a diversified technology ecosystem with products spanning fintech, digital lending, credit solutions and emerging consumer internet businesses.

Through SwipeLoan and our expanding portfolio of digital platforms, we aim to develop and scale technology-driven businesses across multiple industries.

**About the Role**

We are looking for a highly experienced, hands-on technology leader with
**CTO-level capabilities**
who can take complete ownership of technology strategy, architecture, engineering, infrastructure, cybersecurity and product development across our growing ecosystem.

This is not a conventional IT management role.

The selected candidate must be capable of independently evaluating new business concepts, selecting appropriate technology stacks, designing scalable systems, building engineering teams and delivering end-to-end technology solutions.

We are looking for a technology generalist with deep engineering expertise who is comfortable working across different programming languages, frameworks, architectures and business domains.

The candidate should have the technical judgment and leadership ability to build products using both existing and emerging technologies, without being restricted to any single programming language or framework.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. End-to-End Technology Ownership**

* Own the complete technology function across existing and future KGIL platforms.
* Define long-term technology strategy, architecture standards and engineering roadmaps.
* Independently translate business ideas into technical requirements, architecture and execution plans.
* Take responsibility for technology decisions from product conceptualisation to development, deployment, scaling and maintenance.
* Act as the primary technology advisor to the Founder & CEO.
* Evaluate technical feasibility, development timelines, resource requirements and infrastructure costs for new businesses.
* Ensure all platforms are secure, scalable, reliable and commercially efficient.

**2. Multi-Technology & Full-Stack Engineering Leadership**

Lead engineering across multiple technology stacks, including but not limited to:

* **Backend:**
  PHP, Laravel, Node.js, Python, Django, FastAPI, Java, Spring Boot, Go and other relevant technologies.
* **Frontend:**
  React.js, Next.js, JavaScript, TypeScript, Angular and modern frontend frameworks.
* **Mobile Applications:**
  Flutter, React Native, native Android and iOS development.
* **Databases:**
  MySQL, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Redis and other SQL/NoSQL technologies.
* **Cloud & Infrastructure:**
  AWS, cloud-native architecture, Docker, Kubernetes, serverless systems and CI/CD.
* **Integrations:**
  REST APIs, GraphQL, webhooks, third-party APIs, payment gateways and external services.
* **AI & Automation:**
  AI/ML integrations, LLM-based applications, intelligent automation and data-driven product capabilities.

The candidate is not expected to write production code in every language personally but must possess sufficient architectural and technical depth to evaluate, guide and manage engineering teams working across different technology stacks.

**3. New Product Development & Technology Expansion**

* Lead technology development for new businesses across fintech and non-fintech industries.
* Evaluate new product ideas and recommend the most suitable technology stack for each business.
* Design and deliver MVPs, scalable applications and enterprise-grade platforms.
* Lead development of consumer applications, marketplaces, subscription platforms, SaaS products, social networking applications and e-commerce solutions.
* Build reusable technology components, shared services and APIs wherever commercially appropriate.
* Evaluate build-versus-buy decisions, third-party platforms and outsourcing opportunities.
* Ensure new product launches meet defined timelines, budgets and quality standards.
* Support rapid experimentation, prototyping and product-market validation.

**4. Technology Architecture & Scalability**

* Design scalable, secure and high-performance application architectures.
* Make informed decisions between monolithic, modular and microservices architectures.
* Establish standards for API design, database architecture, system integrations and data management.
* Implement performance optimisation, caching, monitoring and system observability.
* Plan infrastructure capacity for high-volume applications and rapid user growth.
* Ensure appropriate system resilience, backup, disaster recovery and business continuity arrangements.
* Identify and resolve technical debt and architectural limitations.

**5. Engineering Team Leadership & Recruitment**

* Lead existing backend, frontend, mobile, QA, DevOps and AI/ML teams.
* Independently recruit developers, architects and technical specialists based on business requirements.
* Build and manage multiple engineering teams working on different products simultaneously.
* Establish clear reporting structures, engineering ownership and accountability.
* Define development standards, code review processes and technical documentation requirements.
* Conduct technical interviews and assess candidate capabilities across different technology stacks.
* Mentor engineering leads and develop future technology leaders.
* Manage internal development teams, freelancers, technology vendors and outsourced partners.

**6. DevOps, Cloud Infrastructure & Cybersecurity**

* Own cloud infrastructure, deployment pipelines, production environments and system monitoring.
* Manage AWS infrastructure and evaluate alternative cloud services where appropriate.
* Establish robust CI/CD, release management and automated testing processes.
* Implement cybersecurity controls, vulnerability management, access controls and secure development practices.
* Oversee incident response, disaster recovery and infrastructure reliability.
* Coordinate technical security requirements relating to ISO 27001, applicable data protection laws and regulatory obligations.
* Ensure company-controlled access to source code, repositories, servers, cloud accounts and technology assets.
* Monitor infrastructure expenditure and implement cost optimisation initiatives.

**7. Fintech & Third-Party Integrations**

* Oversee technology integrations with banks, NBFCs, credit bureaus, KYC providers, Account Aggregators, payment gateways and other financial technology service providers.
* Ensure reliability, security and performance of partner APIs.
* Support lending journeys, credit eligibility systems, subscription payments and automated financial workflows.
* Coordinate with business and compliance teams on technology-related regulatory requirements.

**8. Product, Business & Leadership Collaboration**

* Work closely with the Founder & CEO to evaluate and execute new business opportunities.
* Collaborate with Product, Marketing, Finance, Business Development and Operations teams.
* Provide technical recommendations in business planning and strategic discussions.
* Prepare technology budgets, development roadmaps and resource allocation plans.
* Communicate technical risks, dependencies and investment requirements clearly to non-technical stakeholders.
* Take independent ownership of technical execution while keeping management informed of major decisions.

**Candidate Requirements**

**Mandatory**

* 10–15+ years of software engineering experience, including at least 4–5 years in engineering leadership or architecture roles.
* Strong hands-on software engineering background with experience designing and scaling production app

**Overview**

The Head of Product, Distribution & Revenue Generation is a senior product leadership role responsible for the strategy and delivery of Access Hospitality's distribution and revenue-generation capability across the APAC region – spanning Channel Management, Booking Engine, Rate Shopping, Connectivity, Revenue Management Systems, Review Management and Digital Marketing Services. This role succeeds Gavin Jeddo, Founder of STAAH, and carries the responsibility of preserving and extending the credibility STAAH has built with OTA, channel and technology partners across the region while integrating the product into Access's broader Accommodation platform strategy.

Reporting to the MD, India / Hospitality Capability Centre with a dotted line into the Head of Product, Accommodation (UK), this leader owns the regional distribution and revenue product roadmap and is the primary internal and external voice for how independent hotels and hotel chains in APAC drive bookings, optimise rate and channel mix, and reduce dependency on costly OTA distribution. The role sits within Access's Federated Product, Shared Capability operating model – balancing HCC and regional market/partner depth with alignment to the global Accommodation platform and the 2027 AI-native migration priority. The role is based in Pune and will work closely with product engineering leadership based across Pune, UK, US and NZ, with some travel required.

The ideal candidate brings deep, hands-on accommodation-technology domain expertise – built inside an OTA, PMS company, channel manager, revenue management system or adjacent part of the accommodation technology stack – combined with the commercial instincts to connect product decisions directly to distribution cost, direct booking share and revenue outcomes for customers.

*Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*
**Title And Summary**
Lead Product Management – Technical – AI Transformation
  
  
**Overview**
Mastercard is a global technology company in the payments industry. Our mission is to connect and power an inclusive, digital economy that benefits everyone, everywhere by making transactions safe, simple, smart, and accessible. Using secure data and networks, partnerships and passion, our innovations and solutions help individuals, financial institutions, governments, and businesses realize their greatest potential.
  
  
The Services Business represents over a third of Mastercard revenues and is a key differentiator for Mastercard. Services use our unique and proprietary data, technology, insights and expertise to deliver solutions that meet the needs of our customers. Services is critical for the sustained, long-term growth of Mastercard.
  
  
Within the Services organization, this role sits within the Business & Markets Insights (BMI) organization. The Business & Market Insights vertical is focused on creating products and solutions that create value for customers through Analytics, Insights, Business Experimentation, and Payment Consulting & Innovation.
  
  
Under BMI, Payment Performance Intelligence Program's Global Product Management team is seeking an accomplished technology-focused Product Manager to support the evolution of its products to include AI intelligence. This person will be part of a team of product managers that oversee key activities including execution of the AI product strategy, management of the roadmap, shaping the product platform architecture and the creation of technical requirements.
  
  
This individual will partner closely with other members of the Global Product Management team including data scientists to support development of Gen AI chatbot use cases & agentic services and ensuring product priorities are well-aligned with strategic objectives. This individual will also be the key collaborator with the Platform team to shape the long-term vision for the product and ensure efficient development execution.
  
  
Role
  
  

* Support the definition and execution of the AI product roadmap for Payment Performance Intelligence, contributing to strategy and investment discussions led by senior product leadership.
* Own delivery of assigned AI product areas end to end, from discovery and requirements through development, launch, and post-launch iteration.
* Help identify and validate high-value use cases for GenAI, chatbots, agentic services, predictive insights, and self-service analytics.
* Translate customer needs, market inputs, and business objectives into clear user stories, technical requirements, and acceptance criteria.
* Work day to day with Data Science, Engineering, and Platform teams to groom the backlog, unblock dependencies, and maintain sprint velocity.
* Coordinate with Commercial, Risk, Legal, Security, and Compliance partners to ensure products meet regulatory and responsible AI requirements.
* Recommend prioritization based on customer value, commercial impact, technical feasibility, and effort, escalating trade-offs where needed.
* Define and track success metrics for owned features, reporting progress, risks, and adoption to stakeholders.
* Prepare and present roadmap updates, demos, and release communications to internal stakeholders and customer-facing teams.
* Mentor junior product managers and associates, and contribute to improving agile practices and product documentation standards across the team.

**All About You**

* Solid experience in agile product management for analytics, data insights, AI-enabled, or financial services products.
* Working knowledge of GenAI use cases, predictive insights, self-service analytics, and the data foundations required to support them.
* Demonstrated ability to convert customer problems into requirements, user stories, and measurable product outcomes.
* Experience collaborating across Product, Engineering, Data Science, Commercial, Risk, Legal, Security, and Compliance teams.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.
* Comfortable operating with a degree of ambiguity, managing competing priorities, and driving execution in a fast-paced environment.
* Experience mentoring or guiding peers and junior team members is preferred; formal people management experience is not required.
* Highly organized and analytical, with strong attention to detail in backlog management and delivery tracking.
* Bachelor's degree in business, technology, or equivalent experience required; technical background, payments experience, or product certification preferred.

**Corporate Security Responsibility**
All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:
  
  

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

jobs.title: Urgent Opening For Senior Visa Executive(Chennai/Pune)
jobs.description:
**ABOUT THE ROLE**

We are launching a new visa and travel documentation service for travellers based in Kuwait, delivered in partnership with an established Kuwait travel agency. You will be the first hire on this desk: you will prepare and manage visa applications end to end, from checking what each traveller needs to booking their appointment and tracking the result.

Applicants hold many different passports, including Kuwaiti, Indian, other South Asian, Arab and other expatriate nationalities, and apply through embassies and visa application centres in Kuwait. The core skill is working out exactly what each case requires, not following a single checklist.

The desk covers **every destination and visa category that travellers can apply for from Kuwait**: visit and tourist, business, student, work, family and dependant, and transit visas, for destinations such as the UK, the US, the Schengen Area, Canada, Australia, the other Gulf states and Asia. Because this is a new desk, you will help shape how it works, and the role will grow with the volume.

  

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Receive new cases from our partner agency and confirm each traveller's nationality, destination, travel dates and purpose.
* Determine visa requirements for each case (whether a visa is needed, which category and which documents) and send the traveller a tailored checklist.
* Review documents such as passports, bank statements, employment and salary letters, bookings and invitations; flag gaps or risks before submission.
* Complete online and paper applications accurately for any destination, such as UK visa forms, the US DS-160 and Schengen, Canadian and Australian applications.
* Book and manage appointments at embassies and visa application centres in Kuwait, and brief travellers on their in-person biometrics visit.
* Draft supporting documents: cover letters, day-by-day travel itineraries and invitation-letter templates.
* Track every application in a shared case log and keep the partner agency and management informed of status, delays and outcomes.
* Keep up to date with changes in visa rules, fees and appointment procedures, and maintain internal checklists for each destination and nationality.
* Refer any case that needs licensed immigration advice in the destination country to a qualified, regulated adviser.
* Handle all client documents and personal data in strict confidence, following iMarque's data-security procedures.

  

**REQUIREMENTS**

* At least 3 years of hands-on visa processing at a visa consultancy, travel agency or travel management company (TMC); more experience is welcome.
* Proven experience preparing visa applications for multiple destinations, including at least the UK, the US and the Schengen Area.
* Experience across several visa categories (visit, business, student, work and family), and an understanding of how requirements differ by nationality and country of residence.
* Quick to learn a new country's process from official sources.
* Excellent written English; able to draft clear, professional cover letters.
* Strong attention to detail: an error on a form can mean a refusal.
* Organised and comfortable managing many cases at once in Excel or Google Sheets.
* Comfortable working a shift aligned to Kuwait business hours.
* Willing to undergo a background verification.

  

**NICE TO HAVE**

* Experience with applications filed from Kuwait or another Gulf Cooperation Council (GCC) country.
* Experience with online portals of visa application centres.
* Experience with Canada, Australia, GCC or East Asian visa processes.
* Hindi, Arabic, Malayalam or Urdu.

  

**WHAT WE OFFER**

* Competitive salary based on experience.
* The chance to build a new service line from the ground up.
* A growth path to lead the visa desk as the team expands.

  

**HOW TO APPLY**

We are hiring immediately; immediate joiners, or candidates with a notice period of 30 days or less, are preferred.

Send your CV to **[Application email]** with the subject line **Senior Visa Executive – [Your Name]”**. In a few lines, tell us which countries' visas you have handled and roughly how many applications you processed per month in your last role.

jobs.title: VP Client Relationship Servicing
jobs.description:
**Some Careers Shine Brighter Than Others.**
If you’re looking for a career that will help you stand out, join HSBC and fulfil your potential. Whether you want a career that could take you to the top, or simply take you in an exciting new direction, HSBC offers opportunities, support and rewards that will take you further.
  
  
HSBC is one of the largest banking and financial services organisations in the world, with operations in 64 countries and territories. We aim to be where the growth is, enabling businesses to thrive and economies to prosper, and, ultimately, helping people to fulfil their hopes and realise their ambitions.
  
  
We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of
**VP Client Relationship Servicing(CRS)**
CIB COO delivers strategic execution for the CIB businesses across the globe. Through transformative data and digital solutions, customer servicing throughout the customer lifecycle, and delivering safe growth supported by non-financial risk expertise, we collaborate across the global businesses and global functions to get it done. Client Authorities & Confirmation Services (CACS) is part of the CIB CRS supporting CIB business by handling customer servicing requests across two journeys – Client Authorities and Audit Confirmation Services. Beyond day-to-day operations leadership, the role holder is the Service Delivery Lead for the end-to-end transformation of CACS team journeys - a critical, dual-mandate accountability that combines run-the-bank operations leadership with change-the-bank delivery ownership. This includes supporting the deployment of global technology solutions, working hand-in-hand with the Transformation function on requirements definition and testing, and directly shaping the future-state operating and technology architecture for CACS.
  
  
**In This Role, You Will**

* Own the end-to-end client experience for Audit Confirmations and Mandates/Authorities journeys, acting as the single point of accountability across the full process rather than for individual process steps. Redesign and simplify the CACS operating model to minimise handoffs and touchpoints between teams, reducing cycle time, rework and risk of error at each handover. Use client feedback, complaints and journey/turnaround-time analytics to identify friction points in the end-to-end process and prioritise fixes accordingly.
* Own and drive delivery of Client Authorities & Confirmation Services, objectives and key results (OKRs) aligned to CIB CRS priorities. Act as a primary point of contact and coordinator for relevant CIB Servicing Business Stakeholders and partner teams supporting CIB customers. Partner with business stakeholders to shape and agree the service proposition, including management information, service performance, and service level agreements (SLAs).
* Act as the Service Delivery Lead for the end-to-end transformation of CACS team journeys, owning the CACS-side accountability for translating business and client needs into deliverable, adopted technology outcomes. Drive the digital change agenda to improve customer experience, reduce operational effort across the end-to-end customer journey, and support and/or lead delivery of strategic tooling and automation initiatives (e.g., digital workflow and AI-enabled solutions) to enable the future-state servicing architecture and its adoption.
* Partner closely with the global Transformation function throughout the delivery lifecycle — defining and prioritising business requirements, validating solution design against operational reality, and sequencing releases against CACS servicing priorities.
* Own User Acceptance Testing (UAT) for CACS-impacting releases: design test scenarios, coordinate subject-matter-expert testers from the operations team, triage and track defects, and provide formal sign-off ahead of go-live. Track and report transformation milestones, risks, dependencies and benefits realisation to CIB CRS leadership, ensuring the CACS journey transformation stays aligned to global programme timelines. Champion change adoption within the CACS team — ensuring readiness, training, communication and embedding of new tools and ways of working through go-live and hypercare.
* Provide leadership across a diverse, multi-location and/or virtual team environment, driving performance to global standards in a matrix structure. Act as the primary representative for Client Authorities & Confirmation Services for the relevant value stream and stakeholders. Build a culture of continuous improvement, collaboration, pace and accountability, ensuring teams understand priorities, processes and expected outcomes. Lead, coach, and develop a large team of specialists, fostering a culture of continuous improvement and professional growth.

**To Be Successful You Will**

* Proven ability to run a large, multi-market teams across geographies and operating effectively across cultures and diverse working environments. Comfortable partnering with technology/ transformation teams to shape and adopt new tools – doesn’t need to run the transformation just needs to engage credibly and hold the CACS team accountable for adoption.
* Track record of client-centric decision-making prioritising client outcome over internal convenience. Demonstrable communication and presentation skills, with the ability to simplify complex concepts and drive alignment between operations, technology and client-facing audiences.
* Strong commercial mindset, including financial management capability and business acumen. Proven leadership and team management skills, with a focus on developing and motivating team members and experience in managing large, virtual teams. A natural go getter who moves things forward rather than escalating and waiting.
* Energised by ambiguity and comfortable running BAU, people, transformation agendas in parallel. Dedicated to being an early adopter of new technology and nurturing and environment where teams are excited to pilot new ways of working and technologies in the pursuit of sustainable improvements. Comfortable operating at the intersection of operations and technology, translating business needs into clear, testable requirements. Client-first mindset — instinctively thinks in terms of the client's end-to-end experience rather than individual internal process steps.
* Resilient under competing priorities and reprioritises on their own rather than needing structure imposed direction. CIB CRS / Servicing Operations leadership and regional/country teams. CIB CRS – Global and Regional Leads. Product partners and product teams (Trade, GPS, Credit) supporting CIB clients. Global Transformation and Technology delivery teams (product owners, business analysts, engineering) supporting servicing transformation and tooling. Control functions and key partners as required to support safe, compliant servicing delivery

**You’ll achieve more at HSBC**

HSBC is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and, opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment. We encourage applications from all suitably qualified persons irrespective of, but not limited to, their gender or genetic information, sexual orientation, ethnicity, religion, social status, medical care leave requirements, political affiliation, people with disabilities, color, national origin, veteran status, etc., We consider all applications based on merit and suitability to the role.”

jobs.title: Product Manager, Input Zone
jobs.description:
**Product Manager, Input Zone**

  

**About our Team:-**

DSM Product is the product management team within Data Source Management (DSM, led by Adrian Scotney), part of Data Operations (led by Kanwar Singh). It is led by the Head of Product Management and owns product management for how publisher content enters the Input Zone, Elsevier’s governed gateway for academic publisher content. This includes technical onboarding, ingestion development, publisher rights data (Salesforce) and the Platform Intelligence reporting that supports content providers.

The team is organised around three areas: Platform Intelligence (PLINT), Salesforce/SCM, and the Content Acquisition Liaisons functions that cover ingestion development and technical onboarding.

  

**About the Role:-**

The Product Manager, Input Zone will own the technical onboarding and ingestion-development activities for the Content Acquisition Liaisons group and lead execution of related workstreams. They will own the development plan for the ingestion pipeline and technical onboarding workflow, represent this area within the PM team, and have a solid understanding of content providers and publishers. They will represent their technical needs to the delivery team, prioritise and communicate production issues affecting ingestion or onboarding, and support and participate in demos to key stakeholders at programme milestones.

  

**Responsibilities:-**

  

**Customer Focus**

* Interacts with content providers, publishers, and internal engineering teams during technical onboarding and represents their requirements.

* Anticipates onboarding and ingestion needs (for example, journal processing moving to the DPOP-601 workflow and the Scopus transition off the legacy OpsBank workflow) and prioritises them for the group.

* Acts as a named Onboarding Technical Liaison, fielding technical questions from content providers and publishers during negotiation so engineering capacity stays focused on implementation.

* Focuses on meeting onboarding timelines without compromising the completeness or quality of ingested content.

**Data-Driven Decision-Making & Analysis**

* Autonomously analyses onboarding, delivery, and completeness-checking data from multiple sources (content providers, engineering, Governance reporting).

* Compares and evaluates ingestion and onboarding options, and makes recommendations that consider business implications.

* Uses AI tools responsibly to accelerate analysis, and validates the results before acting on them.

**Onboarding & Content Acquisition Lifecycle**

* Communicates technical requirements and timelines clearly to negotiation and engineering stakeholders.

* Coordinates with the LeapSpace negotiation team, system test team, and OpsBank test team on technical onboarding execution once a negotiation concludes.

* Answers internal and provider-facing questions on ingestion capability, manifest handling, and onboarding scope.

* Prioritises and communicates production issues and defects affecting ingestion or onboarding, based on relevant data.

**Product Delivery & Development Lifecycle**

* Leads execution of the development plan for the ingestion pipeline and technical onboarding workflow.

* Defines and prioritises requirement changes for engineering and performs analysis to meet acceptance criteria.

* Authors clear, testable specifications (requirements, acceptance criteria, manifest and validation rules) as the shared source of truth for engineering and AI-assisted development, in line with spec-driven development (SDD).

* Reviews AI-assisted outputs (generated specs, test cases, prototypes) against requirements and is accountable for their quality before they reach engineering.

* Participates in product discovery and process improvement, and contributes to prototypes (for example, content provider manifest ingestion and PDF identification).

* Is familiar with SDLCs identified by management, for example agile processes.

**Strategy & Commercial Acumen**

* Contributes to the strategy and development plans for ingestion and technical onboarding, shared across the roles carrying the Onboarding Technical Liaison responsibility.

* Understands the operating cost and effort involved in onboarding a new content provider or source.

* Makes links between personal goals and the team and business strategy.

**Technical Skills**

* Understands the Input Zone's data and technical architecture — publisher drop zones, ingestion validation, and the downstream handoff — well enough to liaise credibly with engineering.

* Uses technologies to assist day-to-day tasks (Excel, SQL, Jira, Confluence; familiarity with Salesforce/Snowflake rights data flows and sFTP/S3 publisher landing zones).

* Has working experience with generative AI tools and AI-assisted development workflows (for example prompt design, specification-to-code generation, AI-supported testing) and understands their limitations, including accuracy, data confidentiality, and publisher-content handling.

* Ability to engage developers to understand technology constraints.

**Competencies**

**Personal Capability**

**Practices Self-Development**

* Is curious and keen to learn and develop new ideas, skills, and knowledge.

* Acts on feedback to improve him/herself.

* Looks for developmental opportunities in day-to-day work.

* Invests time and energy in self-development (professional qualifications, relevant reading, networking, keeping up with AI-assisted product and development practices).

**Solves Problems and Analyses Issues**

* Is able to ask effective questions and collect facts from multiple sources in order to solve problems.

* Is able to effectively identify and analyse problems and propose solutions.

* Effectively manages day-to-day issues and problems without intervention.

**Innovates**

* Brainstorms with others to look for different approaches to current processes and tasks.

* Looks for opportunities to develop new ideas or thinking within own role.

* Experiments with new ideas, including applying AI and SDD to onboarding and ingestion workflows, and shares what works with the team.

**Interpersonal Skills**

**Communicates Powerfully and Prolifically**

* Demonstrates effective conversational skills, including active listening and questioning.

* Shares information relevant to own role.

* Participates in team presentations.

**Collaboration and Teamwork**

* Develops co-operative working relationships within the team.

* Considers how own style affects others and tailors interactions accordingly.

* Looks for ways to develop mutually beneficial relationships across teams.

**Builds Relationships**

* Is approachable and friendly.

* Asks for opinions of others.

* Participates in formal and informal gatherings to meet new people and develop new relationships.

**Inspires and Motivates Others to High Performance**

* Brings enthusiasm to the team.

* Gets to know others in the team and what is important to them.

* Observes behaviours and models self after others.

* Leads by example by performing at high levels.

**Focus on Results**

**Drives for Results**

* Works hard to achieve objectives.

* Stays focused on key commitments.

* Looks to overcome obstacles or barriers to performing.

* Works with others to achieve joint goals.
  

**Requirements:** -

**Suggested minimum years of PM experience:** 4-6 years

**Critical Experiences**

* Recognised as full owner of a technical onboarding, ingestion, or comparable technical-liaison feature area.

* Demonstrated ability to manage multiple tasks, projects, and priorities, and to work with engineers, content providers, publishers, or negotiation teams to modify or maintain a product and identify technology challenges.

The role requires strong industry knowledge, proven sales capabilities, excellent communication skills and the ability to independently engage with business owners, company directors and senior financial decision-makers.

Candidates must demonstrate excellent corporate communication, financial product knowledge, negotiation skills, client acquisition capability, CRM proficiency and a proven record of achieving sales targets.

Identify prospective corporate clients, startups, MSMEs, entrepreneurs and business organizations requiring financial advisory or funding solutions.

Develop a qualified pipeline of prospective clients through corporate meetings, referrals, professional networking and systematic business outreach.

Work closely with authorized banks, NBFCs, financial institutions and internal advisory teams.

Develop monthly sales plans, monitor business opportunities, maintain CRM records and work toward assigned revenue and business development targets.

D. Corporate Relationship Management

Establish professional relationships with business owners, promoters, Directors, CFOs, financial consultants and institutional stakeholders.

E. Team Management

Guide Business Development Executives and authorized DSA/Channel Partners, monitor their activities and support improvements in sales productivity.

F. Management Reporting

Submit daily activity reports, weekly business pipeline updates and monthly performance reviews to senior management.

5. Mandatory 10-Day Capacity Assessment

Shortlisted candidates must be willing to participate in a 10-Day Practical Capacity Assessment before final appointment.

During this assessment, candidates will be required to demonstrate their practical capabilities in the following areas:

1. Financial Expertise: Demonstrate sound knowledge of business loans, corporate funding, financial products and funding procedures.

2. Client Identification: Identify suitable prospective business clients and prepare a structured prospect pipeline.

3. Corporate Communication: Demonstrate the ability to professionally communicate with company Directors, CFOs and business promoters.

4. Business Development: Prepare and execute an approved business development action plan.

5. Client Meetings: Demonstrate the ability to arrange and conduct professional business discussions with genuine prospective clients.

6. Financial Assessment: Understand client funding requirements and prepare preliminary client profiles.

7. Negotiation Skills: Demonstrate effective professional negotiation, relationship management and follow-up.

8. Sales Leadership: Demonstrate the ability to organize sales activities and guide junior business development personnel.

9. Documentation and Reporting: Prepare accurate daily reports and maintain professional client records.

10. Final Business Presentation: Present a realistic 30-day and 90-day business development strategy to company management.

Financial Industry Knowledge| 20%

Client Identification and Qualification| 20%

Corporate Communication and Meetings| 20%

Business Development Planning| 15%

Negotiation and Relationship Management| 10%

Reporting and Documentation| 10%

Total| 100%

The company may use a proposed qualifying benchmark of 80%, subject to its approved recruitment policy.

The assessment will focus on demonstrated professional competence and genuine business opportunities. Loan disbursement or funding approval will not be guaranteed or treated as solely within the candidate's control.

Assessment remuneration, expenses, working hours and other conditions will be communicated in writing before commencement and will comply with applicable law.

7. Compensation

The detailed salary structure, applicable statutory benefits, deductions and employment conditions will be specified in the formal appointment letter.

Stage 1: Resume Screening and Eligibility Verification

Stage 2: Professional and Technical Interview

Stage 5: Final Selection and Appointment Letter

If you’re looking for further opportunities to develop your career, take the next step in fulfilling your potential right here at HSBC.

  

HSBC is one of the largest banking and financial services organizations in the world, with operations in 58 countries and territories. We aim to be where the growth is, enabling businesses to thrive and economies to prosper, and, ultimately, helping people to fulfil their hopes and realize their ambitions.

  

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role **Head of Business Technology Intelligence**.

  

**The Opportunity**

  

Data and Analytics Professionals at HSBC have responsibility for executing our HSBC Data Strategy. Their responsibilities are threefold:

  

* Recognising data as an asset to HSBC by managing Data Risk and ensuring we are compliant with our Data standards and policies;

* Using analytics and data science to unlock the value of our data; and

* Implementing and maintaining our Data Technologies. Data and Analytics Professionals are geographically dispersed and aligned to the Global Businesses / Global Functions or regions.

**What you will do:**

  

As an influential and visionary servant leader, you’ll lead and empower delivery teams to execute the Group Business and Technology Data Strategy and roadmap. You’ll provide direct and indirect leadership, fostering innovation across the organisation through agile ways of working and effective agile leadership.

  

Leading by example, you’ll enable teams to deliver high-quality technology, data products and services that meet customer and business requirements. You’ll help create an environment where people can succeed, collaborate effectively and deliver measurable value at pace.

  

The Head of Data Group Chief Information Office is accountable for the strategic design, implementation, governance, and ongoing management of the end-to-end enterprise data model across Group Chief Information Office. The role ensures that data is structured, governed, trusted, and managed as a strategic asset, enabling effective decision-making, operational excellence, regulatory compliance, and technology transformation.

  

The role leads the development and execution of the organisation's data architecture, data quality, lineage, metadata, and data management capabilities, establishing robust controls and standards across the technology estate while driving adoption and accountability throughout the organisation.

  

**Key Responsibilities**

Enterprise Data Model Ownership:

* Define, own, and continuously evolve the end-to-end enterprise data model.
* Establish a strategic target-state data architecture aligned to business, technology, risk, and regulatory requirements.
* Ensure consistency, standardisation, and reuse of data assets across platforms, functions, and technology domains.
* Govern data model design decisions and oversee implementation across programmes and change initiatives.

Data Management and Governance:

* Drive adoption of data management best practices across all technology teams.
* Ensure alignment between data strategy, architecture standards, and delivery programmes.
* Identify, assess, and actively manage data-related risks across the technology estate.
* Establish appropriate controls to ensure integrity, accuracy, completeness, and traceability of data.
* Support regulatory, audit, and risk management requirements through effective data governance and management practices.
* Ensure remediation plans are implemented and tracked where control weaknesses are identified.
  

**What you will need to succeed in the role:**

  

* Director-level leadership experience in Data & Analytics, preferably in Banking or Financial services
* Proven experience defining and executing an Enterprise Data Strategy, roadmap and target operating model aligned with business, technology, risk and regulatory objectives.
* Strong expertise in Enterprise Data Management, data architecture and data modelling, including ownership of end-to-end enterprise data models and target-state architecture.
* Extensive experience in data governance, data risk and controls, including data quality, lineage, ownership, audit, regulatory requirements and remediation.
* Strong technical knowledge of SQL, Python, BigQuery and GCP (Google Cloud Platform), with experience overseeing data extraction, transformation, integration and cloud-based data platforms.
* Proven Agile Project Management and leading geographically distributed, multidisciplinary teams, influencing senior stakeholders and delivering measurable value at pace within a regulated environment.
* Experience delivering data analysis, data mining, data wrangling and data delivery, producing trusted, reusable and scalable data products for business, operational, risk and regulatory requirements.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills
  

**You’ll achieve more at HSBC.**

jobs.title: Banking Alliances & Partnerships Manager
jobs.description:
WE'RE HIRING! | Banking Alliances & Partnerships Manager.

We are hiring a banking professional who can open, run and protect To The Moon Technologies Pvt Ltd's banking relationships: INR pay-in, payout, virtual accounts, CMS and API banking for a crypto trading platform.

* **Department:** Strategic Partnerships (Banking & Payments)
* **Reports To:** Founder & CEO
* **Location:** Lucknow
* **Travel:** Regular travel to Mumbai, Delhi NCR & Bengaluru for bank meetings
* **Experience:** 5+ years in Banking or Fintech
* **Required Expertise:** Digital Banking, API Banking, CMS & Virtual Accounts
* **Employment Type:** Full-time
* **Seniority:** Senior Executive to Manager, based on experience

**About ToTheMoon Technologies Pvt Ltd**

ToTheMoon Technologies Pvt Ltd is an FIU-IND registered Indian cryptocurrency exchange, headquartered in Jaipur and operating since 2021. We run spot and futures trading plus OTC on-ramp and off-ramp services for Indian users. INR flows, deposits, withdrawals and settlements, sit at the center of our business, and they depend on strong, compliant banking partners.

**Role purpose**

You will own ToTheMoon Technologies Pvt Ltd's banking ecosystem end to end. That means finding and onboarding banks, getting API banking, virtual accounts and CMS live, and keeping every relationship healthy. You will also build backup banking so no single bank or payment rail can stop INR deposits or withdrawals.

**Key responsibilities**

1.Bank partnerships and onboarding

a. Find, pitch and onboard private, small finance, cooperative and new-age banks for current accounts, escrow/nodal accounts, pay-in and payout.

b. Present ToTheMoon Technologies Pvt Ltd's business model, FIU-IND registration, AML/KYC framework and risk controls to bank product, risk and compliance teams.

c. Lead the bank's due diligence: documents, questionnaires, site visits and onboarding

paperwork.

2. API banking, virtual accounts and CMS

a. Set up and expand virtual account (VAN) structures for user-wise INR deposit collection

and auto-reconciliation.

b. Get API banking live for IMPS, NEFT, RTGS and UPI payouts, plus balance, statement and

status APIs.

c. Set up CMS for collections and bulk payouts, and drive integration with our tech team

through UAT and go-live.

d. Work with UPI collect, payment aggregator and PSP partners as extra deposit rails.

3. Relationship management

a. Act as the single point of contact for every banking partner, from relationship managers

up to senior leadership.

b. Handle account freezes, lien marks, LEA and cyber-cell requests, chargebacks and

transaction holds with the bank and our compliance team.

c. Run regular reviews of volumes, TAT, success rates and issues with each bank.

4. Negotiation and commercials

a. Negotiate pricing, transaction limits, float terms, MDR, payout charges and SLAs.

b. Review and close banking agreements, API terms and SLAs with our legal team.

5. Business continuity

a. Always keep at least two live banking partners for pay-in and payout, with tested

failover.

b. Spot risk early, regulatory changes, a bank's appetite for VDA business and line up

alternatives before they are needed.

6. Compliance and internal coordination

a. Work with compliance, finance, operations and tech so bank requirements under PMLA,

FIU-IND and RBI guidelines are met.

b. Keep partner dashboards, MIS and documentation current for management.

**Must-have requirements**

* 5+ years in banking or fintech, with hands-on work in digital banking, API banking, CMS and

virtual accounts.

* Has managed these products for a corporate client, a fintech platform, a stockbroker, a payment

aggregator or a crypto exchange from the bank side or the client side.

* Has taken at least 2–3 bank integrations (VAN, payout API or CMS) from first meeting to go-live.

* An active network of decision-makers in transaction banking, CMS, digital/API banking and

fintech partnership teams at Indian banks.

* Clear understanding of INR payment rails: IMPS, NEFT, RTGS, UPI, NACH, and escrow/nodal

account structures.

* Working knowledge of KYC/AML, PMLA, FIU-IND and RBI rules relevant to banks serving fintechs

and VDA businesses.

* Strong negotiation, presentation and written communication skills in English and Hindi.

* Graduate in any field; MBA in Finance, Banking or Business preferred.

**Skills and Competencies**

* **Banking Products:** Knowledge of current, escrow and nodal accounts; virtual accounts; CMS collections and payouts; API banking; UPI collect and payout.
* **Technical Fluency:** Ability to read API documentation and understand webhooks, callbacks, reconciliation files and UAT; comfortable coordinating with developers and bank technology teams.
* **Negotiation:** Ability to negotiate pricing, transaction limits, SLAs and agreements while maintaining strong banking relationships.
* **Communication:** Strong presentation and email-writing skills; confident in meetings with bank CXOs, risk and compliance heads.
* **Stakeholder Management:** Ability to align compliance, finance, technology and operations teams around bank integration timelines.
* **Problem Solving:** Ability to resolve account freezes, failed payouts, settlement delays and reconciliation gaps quickly.
* **Ownership:** Self-driven, works independently and takes complete responsibility for follow-through until go-live.
* **Integrity:** Handles confidential banking and customer data with utmost discretion.

**Good to have**

•Earlier work in a bank's transaction banking, CMS, digital banking or fintech alliances team.

•Experience at an Indian crypto exchange, stockbroker, payment gateway, PSP or NBFC.

•Has onboarded a VDA or high-risk business with a bank and understands the bank's concerns.

•Exposure to payment aggregator rules, cross-border payments or stablecoin on/off-ramp flows.

•Familiarity with reconciliation tools, MIS reporting and Excel-based analysis.

Pay: ₹444,000.00 - ₹700,000.00 per year

Work Location: In person

Lead acquisition, activation, value build-up and retention of high-quality current-account relationships across an assigned cluster. The role owns the cluster’s current-account growth agenda across business segments—including traders, wholesalers, manufacturers, service professionals, institutions and emerging enterprises—while building fee income and cross-sell penetration.

The Cluster Sales Head will lead a team of current-account sales team and relationship managers, work closely with branches and product partners, and ensure the cluster delivers profitable, compliant, transaction-active current-account growth.

Cluster Head

Defined cluster of branches, catchments and business hubs

**Key Partners**

Branch Managers, Product, Cash Management, POS/QR, Operations, Compliance and Service teams

* Deliver new-to-bank current-account acquisition, account activation, average quarterly balance growth, transaction throughput and fee-income targets for the cluster.

* Build and execute a catchment-led acquisition strategy for high-potential business segments such as wholesalers, distributors, manufacturers, traders, schools, hospitals, clinics, professional firms and service establishments.

* Own the current-account business plan, sales funnel, conversion pipeline and weekly performance rhythm.

**2. Sales Leadership and Channel Execution**

* Lead, coach and motivate a field-sales organisation to consistently deliver acquisition and value-build targets.

* Establish a disciplined sales cadence covering joint calls, market visits, lead reviews, branch huddles, pipeline reviews and conversion tracking.

* Ensure each relationship manager follows a profile-based sales approach rather than a generic product pitch.

* Develop market intelligence on competitor propositions, local business clusters, referral sources and emerging commercial hubs.

* Build productive referral ecosystems with Chartered Accountants, trade associations, market intermediaries, merchant networks, developers, institutional administrators and existing clients.

**3. Current-Account Activation and Value Build-Up**

* Ensure newly acquired accounts become transaction-active within defined activation timelines.

* Drive operating balances, inward credits, collections, payment activity and digital banking adoption.

* Track early-warning indicators including low funding, non-activation, declining balances, low transaction velocity and potential attrition.

* Drive customer retention through proactive engagement, problem solving and relevant product deepening.

* Ensure all sourcing, onboarding and account activation follows internal policies and applicable KYC, AML, fraud-risk and regulatory requirements.

* Maintain high standards of customer due diligence, documentation quality, source-of-funds understanding and business-profile validation.

* Monitor exceptions, unusual transaction behaviour, documentation gaps and operational risks; escalate promptly where needed.
