* Combine client relationship management with strong risk assessment and management capabilities ensuring the required credit quality & requisite returns on risk
* Responsible for the delivery of BCO tasks in line with agreed OKRs, SLAs and KPIs

* Strong understanding of financing instruments and banking products for Wholesale Banking
* Strong stakeholder management skills, with the ability to navigate complex situations and drive alignment among senior leaders

11/30/2026 (MM/DD/YYYY) at 11:59pm UTC

**Description**

At the **International Finance Corporation (IFC)**, a member of the **World Bank Group (WBG)**, you’ll join a diverse, global community working across cultures, disciplines, and borders to address the world’s most pressing development challenges. With 1.2 billion young people reaching working age in the decade ahead, the challenge of job creation has never been greater. Through partnerships across 145 countries and more than 182 offices worldwide, we work with governments, private sector, development partners and other stakeholders to invest in people, strengthen markets, and deliver scalable, data-driven solutions that generate more and better jobs and improve lives. In fiscal year 2026, IFC committed a record $105.6 billion to private companies and financial institutions in developing countries. For more information, visit www.ifc.org.

The CFO and Capital Mobilization Vice Presidency, led by IFC’s Vice President and CFO, mobilizes private capital at scale to support clients that create jobs and drive growth in emerging markets. It brings together debt and equity mobilization, investor engagement, blended finance, and partnerships functions to expand the pool of capital available for development, while also overseeing the Corporation’s financial strategy and reporting, balance sheet management, and treasury functions. This prudent financial stewardship safeguards IFC’s AAA credit rating and ensures discipline, transparency, and alignment with institutional priorities.

Looking ahead, the VPU’s vision is to channel private capital into the sectors with the greatest potential to create jobs by embedding Originate-to-Distribute (OtD) approaches into IFC’s operating model, deepening and diversifying engagement with investors, donors, and development partners, and delivering innovative financial solutions that attract institutional capital to emerging markets. It will leverage data, technology, and market expertise to scale impact and improve efficiency.

As IFC continues to scale its impact and mobilize private capital at scale, in support of the WBG goal of creating jobs that lift people out of poverty, its ability to attract long term institutional investors to invest in IFC-originated emerging market assets has become increasingly central to its operating and financial model. In the context of heightened global uncertainty, constrained public resources, and rising development needs, effective engagement with institutional investors is critical to creating jobs, and sustaining and expanding development impact across emerging markets.

IFC’s originate-to-distribute and capital mobilization initiatives—including securitization, the Managed Co Lending Portfolio Program (MCPP), B Loan syndications, parallel loans, private equity funds and anchor bond investing, thematic bond issuances, blended finance facilities, and other structured mobilization vehicles—have expanded substantially in recent years, reflecting IFC’s strong focus on originating assets that both meet World Bank Group’s development mandate and are consistent with the investment preferences of institutional investors.

To support this strategically critical agenda, IFC is seeking Principal Investor Relations Officers in IFC’s Global Investor Relations function to work in collaboration with IFC’s originate-to-distribute (OtD) initiative and to help embed OtD into the operating model of IFC, by leading and strengthening IFC’s global investor engagement approach. The role will be to lead IFC’s critical institutional investor relationships, positioning IFC as a partner of choice for institutional investors while embedding scalable, best-in-class investor relationship management practices across the organization.

The Principal Investor Relations Officer will be responsible for deepening long-term investor relationships, expanding and diversifying IFC’s investor base, aligning investor mandates with IFC’s mobilization priorities, strengthening IFC’s visibility and credibility in global capital markets, integrating investor intelligence into institutional decision-making, and institutionalizing robust systems, governance, and standards for investor relationship management.

This vacancy announcement is for nine (9) positions posted across multiple duty stations. The selected candidates’ duty stations will be determined based on organizational requirements and business needs.

**Duties and Accountabilities:**

The selected candidate is responsible for performing activities in the following areas:

Own day-to-day IFC relationships with assigned Tier 1 and Tier 2 investors, under the Director’s executive sponsorship for the most significant relationships and expand participation in IFC-originated assets by connecting investor demand with IFC opportunities and the Originate-to-Distribute agenda.

**Relationship ownership & growth responsibilities:**

* Serve as accountable owner and primary point of contact for assigned investors. Where designated as geography Team Lead, lead and coordinate the other officers in the regional hub.
* Map investor interests and identify opportunities across IFC products, platforms and programs.
* Build trusted senior relationships and coordinate integrated engagement with product, regional, industry, transaction and country teams.
* Sponsor priority platforms, roadshows, investor education and external engagements for assigned relationships

**Planning, reviews & execution responsibilities:**

* Develop customized engagement plans, including strategic dialogues, co-investment discussions, site visits, reporting, events and investor education.
* Lead MOUs, frameworks, and commercial terms, subject to Legal clearance and authorized approval/signature.
* Lead onboarding and coordinate KYC and due diligence logistics.
* Conduct quarterly business and annual strategic reviews and maintain accurate Salesforce records and relationship updates.
* Support syndication and structuring teams while engaging with investors.

**Demand, risk & coordination responsibilities:**

* Capture risk appetite, pricing, tenor, sector interests and other actionable demand signals.
* Consolidate and propose relationship risk limits for funds, subsidiaries and insurers and assess financial sustainability.
* Communicate structured investor feedback to Syndications, with the OTD Analytical Team supporting consolidation and analysis.
* Advise underwriting and structuring on investor demand; designated authorities retain decisions. Participate occasionally in OtD or strategy meetings when relevant.
* Ensure that investor engagement activities are conducted in accordance with IFC policies, World Bank Group ethical standards, and applicable legal and regulatory requirements.
* Partner with Legal and Compliance teams on investor agreements, side letters, and co-investment arrangements.

**Selection Criteria**

* Master’s degree or MBA, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
* A minimum of 12 years of relevant professional experience of increasing complexity and responsibility in institutional investor relations, capital markets, private markets, asset management, investment banking, or related areas.
* Extensive experience developing and managing senior-level relationships with institutiona

You will own how we find people who want help with their money and connect them with the financial product distributors on our platform. You will run paid campaigns, host webinars and events, work with our product team to build lead generation into the product itself and create marketing material that distributors can use to win clients on their own.

jobs.title: Director of Engineering
jobs.description:
About
**Bright Money**

Bright Money
is a Consumer FinTech for middle-income consumers. It brings together SaaS products that help consumers build credit, manage their debt, and access suitable loans and credit cards - the major financial needs of middle-income consumers living paycheck to paycheck.

Bright is a profitable, India-built, U.S.-market Consumer FinTech, with a revenue trajectory to $100M in the coming 6 months. The business model combines subscription revenue with financial services marketplace revenue from loans, credit cards, and credit-building tools.

Bright has launched an AI money assistant and AI agentic UX flows for access to credit. It will be the first AI-driven Consumer FinTech for middle-income consumers.

The Bright product suite has potential for global markets beyond the US. The market size is 100M global middle-income consumers, with a revenue pool opportunity of $15B.

Bright is backed by three top global venture capital firms and leading tech angel investors in the USA, Europe, and Asia.

Bright was established in 2019 by a leadership team drawn from McKinsey’s Banking Practice (Petko Plachkov and Avi Patchava) and InMobi’s Data Sciences organisation (Varun Modi and Avi Patchava). The core team is ex-InMobi Engineering and Data Sciences, joined more recently by senior leaders from McKinsey. Bright has a data-driven, fast-paced execution culture, and is building a global Consumer FinTech with all functions operating from India.

**What is the role about?**

Bright is looking for a Director - Engineering to lead and scale a core part of our engineering organisation in Bengaluru, reporting to the CTO. You will own delivery and technical direction for the systems behind Bright’s consumer app, credit decisioning, and AI products, and you will build the leadership layer that runs them.

This is a leader-of-leaders role. You will manage engineering managers and leads, shape architecture and platform strategy for your area within the CTO’s technical direction, own headcount, budget, and cloud spend for your teams, and partner with Product, Data Sciences, and the wider leadership team on what gets built next.

Bright is profitable, scaling fast in the U.S. market, and building AI into both the product and how the company runs. The systems are distributed, data-heavy, and carry real money and credit decisions, so engineering quality is a business outcome here, not an internal metric.

**What will you do?**

* Lead your organisation: Own and scale a multi-team group, with engineering managers and leads reporting to you; set the operating rhythm, standards, and performance bar across your teams.
* Build the leadership layer: Hire, coach, and retain senior engineers, leads, and managers, and develop the next line of engineering leadership beneath you.
* Technical strategy: Shape and execute architecture and platform strategy across services, data, and developer tooling for your area, in line with the CTO’s technical direction, and make the build-versus-buy and platformisation calls that shape how fast your teams can ship.
* Delivery at scale: Own end-to-end delivery of distributed, data-heavy systems - roadmap commitments, release predictability, and the trade-offs between speed and durability.
* Reliability & risk: Own availability, performance, security, and the engineering side of compliance obligations for the systems your teams run in a U.S. consumer-lending business.
* AI & ML in production: Partner with Data Sciences to productionise ML and Gen AI systems-serving, monitoring, and retraining - and raise engineering leverage through AI tooling across the org.
* Cross-functional leadership: Partner with Product, Data Sciences, Infrastructure, and business teams on priorities, sequencing, and the commitments engineering makes to them.
* Planning & budget: Own annual and quarterly planning for your area - headcount, vendor decisions, cloud cost and TCO, and the resourcing choices behind them.
* Reporting & visibility: Report clearly to the CTO and the wider leadership team on progress, risk, capacity, and investment, and contribute to leadership reviews as needed.

**Ideal candidate profile**

**Experience & Background:**

* Experience: 12+ years in engineering, with 5+ years in engineering leadership and at least 2 years managing managers or leads.
* Organisation scale: Has led a multi-team group of 20+ engineers, and has grown a team through a period of rapid scaling.
* Systems depth: Deep hands-on background in distributed, high-throughput, data-heavy systems; still able to go deep in a design review and hold a credible technical argument.
* Architecture & platform: Proven ownership of architecture, platformisation, and developer tooling, with evidence of the delivery gains those investments produced.
* ML & AI in production: Experience productionising ML or Gen AI systems in partnership with data science teams.
* Commercial ownership: Experience owning engineering budgets, cloud cost and TCO, vendor decisions, and resource planning.
* Hiring record: A strong track record of hiring and developing senior engineers and engineering managers.
* Domain: Experience in fintech, payments, lending, or another regulated, high-reliability consumer business is a strong plus.
* Location: Based in Bengaluru, or willing to relocate.

**Mindset & Operating DNA:**

* Ownership: Takes accountability for outcomes beyond their own remit, not only for their teams’ deliverables.
* Technical credibility: Earns the respect of senior engineers through judgment and depth, not position.
* Strategic thinking: Connects technical choices to business outcomes and can defend the trade-offs to a non-technical audience.
* Builder of leaders: Measures success by the strength of the managers and engineers they develop.
* Pace: Thrives in a high-growth environment where structure is still being built, and brings clarity rather than waiting for it.

**Non-Fit Profiles**

* Individual contributors or architects without sustained people-leadership experience.
* Managers who have led a single team, without experience managing managers or leading a group through scale.
* Leaders who have moved fully away from technical depth and cannot hold their own in architecture and design discussions.
* Candidates from large, process-heavy environments who need established structure, and are uncomfortable in a fast-moving, ambiguous setting.
* Delivery or programme managers without hands-on engineering ownership.

**What Bright Offers?**

* A profitable sub-unicorn with U.S. market scale - liquidity potential at $1-3B valuations.
* Real ownership: You own delivery and technical direction for a core part of the platform, with a direct line to the CTO.
* Wealth creation: Equity at an inflection stage of scale.
* A data-driven, high-cadence culture that combines consulting rigor with FinTech speed.
* Benefits: Excellent benefits package in line with sector best practice.

jobs.title: Associate Director - Credit Card Sales
jobs.description:
**About WeRize**

Founded in 2019 by Vishal Chopra and Himanshu Gupta, WeRize is building India’s largest full stack fintech platform for 500 million underserved middle-class customers who live in 5000+ small towns of India. WeRize (Wortgage technologies pvt ltd) also owns RBI registered NBFC subsidiary (Wortgage Finance pvt ltd).

This customer segment is not served by private sector banks, Insurers and Mutual Fund companies due to their low ticket-size and lifetime value and is dependent on PSU/Govt. banks. PSU/Government banks rarely provide financial products beyond basic savings accounts and these customers lack access to unsecured loans, MSME loans, credit cards, affordable housing loans, loan against property , health/life insurance and investment products. WeRize manufactures innovative unsecured consumer credit, mortgages, loan against property, MSME loans, savings and insurance products designed for this customer base keeping in mind their needs, requirements and purchasing power, with a view to add a layer of financial security to their lives and enable access to credit.

While customers in these geographies use smartphones, they need proper guidance and support when purchasing the right financial products for themselves. So, a pure digital model doesn’t work for this segment. WeRize has innovated on this front through its ‘Finance ki online dukaan (Social Shopify of Finance)’, a first of its kind social distribution tech platform in the financial services space that educates and enables local financially literate freelancers across these small towns to source business through online and offline channels, recommend the right financial product(s) to customers as well as provide after sales support. These freelancers, who are located in more than 5000+ towns and cities, earn as much as INR 30,000 a month from WeRize in commissions.

Our social distribution platform supported by financially literate freelancers means exceptionally low cost of customer acquisition (CAC) and operations costs compared to both fully digital and on the-ground financial services providers. Digital conversions among this target group are way lower when compared to upper income customers in metros and hence pure digital CAC doesn’t work for this segment. While companies like LIC and Fino Bank also rely on freelancer distribution, they deploy local on-field teams/branches to manage freelancers in every city. That results in very high CAC and operations costs for such companies. WeRize on the other hand, has been able to acquire, train and manage thousands of freelancers in 5000+ cities only through its tech platform and without any feet-on-street team of its own. This results in highly profitable business model for Werize.

To know more about the company, please visit: https://www.werize.com/

**Position Overview**

We are looking for a high-impact, business-driven
**Chief Manager / Associate Director – Credit Card Sales**
to lead and scale our Credit Card vertical. In this role, you will be responsible for building end-to-end sales strategies, managing banking and co-branded card partnerships, and scaling credit card distribution across our social freelance partner network in 5,000+ small towns.

You will act as the single point of contact between bank partners, internal product/tech teams, and our freelancer channel to drive high-volume, cost-effective, and compliant credit card issuance tailored to India’s middle-income segment.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Strategic Leadership & Sales Execution**

* Own the P&L, sales targets, and portfolio growth for the Credit Cards vertical across 5,000+ towns.
* Formulate and execute scalable sales strategies to drive credit card adoption through our unique tech-enabled freelancer distribution platform (
  **‘Finance ki Online Dukaan’**
  ).
* Analyze regional performance, conversion funnels, and customer approval rates to continuously optimize sales pipelines.

**Partnership & Ecosystem Management**

* Onboard, manage, and scale partnerships with leading banks, card issuers, and fintech partners.
* Collaborate with partner institutions to design customer journeys, credit policies, and product variants tailored to Tier 2/3/4 customer profiles.
* Serve as the key liaison for day-to-day operations, SLA management, and approval rate optimizations with partner banks.

**Partner Enablement & Channel Engagement**

* Work alongside channel and marketing teams to design training modules, sales enablement toolkits, and commission/incentive structures for local freelancers.
* Drive engagement, active sourcing, and product cross-selling across the freelancer network to maximize card issuance.

**Cross-Functional Collaboration**

* Partner closely with internal Product, Tech, and Analytics teams to enhance digital application flows, minimize friction, and automate approval pipelines.
* Ensure strict adherence to RBI guidelines, partner bank compliance, data privacy, and ethical selling practices across the freelance network.

**Qualifications & Skill Set**

* **Experience:**
  8 to 15 years of core experience in Credit Card sales, partner management, or unsecured lending within Banks, NBFCs, or Fintechs.
* **Distribution Expertise:**
  Proven track record in scaling financial products through indirect channels, agency networks, DSAs, or tech-enabled social/freelancer distribution.
* **Banking Partnerships:**
  Prior experience managing relationships, integrations, and SLAs with major credit card issuing banks.
* **Data-Driven Approach:**
  Deep understanding of approval funnels, customer acquisition metrics (CAC, LTV), and credit underwriting basics for middle-income segments.
* **Entrepreneurial Mindset:**
  Ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment, solve unstructured problems, and take complete ownership of product-line growth.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager
jobs.description:
At Goodscore, our vision is simple: your credit should manage itself. Our AI agents continuously monitor your credit, identify problems, negotiate with lenders, help resolve overdues, manage payments and rewards and unlock better credit as your profile improves. What started in 2023 as personalised credit guidance is evolving into an intelligent credit partner that works for you 24/7. With 8M+ users, a $13M Series A led by Peak XV Partners, and a rapidly expanding credit marketplace, we’re in the next phase of our growth.

We’re looking for an exceptional Senior Product Manager to own high-impact product areas from strategy → 0→1 → scale. You’ll work closely with the Founder, Product, Engineering, Design and business leadership to identify the biggest customer problems, define the product vision, make high-conviction bets and drive them through execution.

This is a role for someone who wants to build products, not just manage roadmaps.

**What you’ll do**

* Own Product Strategy - Define the vision, strategy and roadmap for your product area. Identify high-impact opportunities through customer insights, data, market trends and first-principles thinking. Translate ambiguous problems into clear product bets and measurable outcomes.
* Build 0→1 and scale products - Take products from problem discovery → product definition → launch → iteration → scale. Partner closely with Engineering and Design to ship high-quality products quickly.
* Build AI-native experiences - Identify where AI and agents can fundamentally improve the credit experience, rather than simply adding AI features. Experiment with new AI capabilities, workflows and agentic experiences and turn emerging technology into simple, useful experiences for millions of consumers.
* Own outcomes, not outputs - Define north-star and product metrics. Monitor performance, identify opportunities and continuously improve the product. Balance user value, business impact and execution velocity.
* Lead cross-functional execution - Work across Engineering, Design, Growth, Analytics, Marketing and Operations. Create alignment around priorities and drive execution through ambiguity. Influence without authority and bring teams together around a clear product direction.
* Be relentlessly close to the customer - Talk to users, understand their financial behaviour and uncover unmet needs. Combine qualitative insights with data to make better product decisions. Build products that are simple enough for the next 10 million users.

**What we’re looking for**

* Exceptional academic and professional track record; IIT/NIT or equivalent undergraduate degree and/or top-tier MBA.
* 5+ years of product management experience, ideally building consumer products at scale with experience owning products end-to-end, including 0→1 launches.
* Strong product sense and ability to turn ambiguous problems into simple, compelling products. Strong analytical and structured problem-solving skills; comfortable working with data and product metrics.
* Excellent written and verbal communication with strong stakeholder management skills.
* Genuine curiosity about AI, fintech, consumer technology and emerging products.
* Experience with AI/ML products, fintech, lending, credit, payments or marketplaces is a strong plus.

*GoodScore is an equal opportunity employer. We hire for ability, potential and impact, and welcome talented people from all backgrounds. We do not discriminate based on gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, caste, religion, race, ethnicity, age, disability, marital or parental status, nationality, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. Different perspectives make better products. We’re building a team that reflects the users we serve.*

* Work closely with Supply Chain to ensure stock availability in q-commerce warehouses and dark stores.
* Build quick commerce as a separate high-growth business pillar for the company.

**6. Revenue, Margin and Profitability**

* Work with Finance to track SKU-wise, platform-wise and channel-wise profitability.
* Review gross margin, contribution margin, ad spend, discounts, returns, claims, damages, marketplace commission and logistics cost.
* Identify cases where revenue is growing but profit is falling and create action plans with pricing, ads, promotion and assortment correction.
* Ensure growth is profitable and not driven only by discounts or inefficient ad spending.
* Improve profitability through better pricing, assortment, ads efficiency, margin tracking and cost discipline.

**7. Inventory and Availability Coordination**

* Track platform-wise stock cover, stockout risk, lost sales due to stockout, upcoming campaign stock needs and new launch stock readiness.
* Work closely with Supply Chain for platform replenishment planning and stock allocation.
* Ensure no major campaign, sale event or platform launch is planned without stock readiness confirmation.
* Clarify that Supply Chain owns procurement, PO release, manufacturer coordination, stock movement and overall inventory-days discipline; Digital Commerce owns platform-level availability visibility and demand communication.

**8. New Launch Execution**

* Own marketplace and quick commerce execution for new product launches.
* Ensure listing creation, content upload, pricing, stock availability, ads plan, platform launch date, KAM alignment and promotion plan are ready before launch.
* Track 30-day, 60-day and 90-day launch performance across sales, reviews, ranking, conversion, ads and profitability.
* Give feedback to Brand, NPD, Finance and Supply Chain on launch performance and scale-up actions.

**9. Data, Reporting and Reviews**

* Build and own daily, weekly and monthly digital commerce dashboards.
* Prepare monthly business review decks for leadership with platform-wise performance, growth levers, profitability, issues and next actions.
* Track key dashboards for sales, ads, pricing, promotions, catalog health, account health, stockout risk, quick commerce availability and P&L.
* Use data to identify trends, risks, margin leakage, platform issues and growth opportunities.

**Required Skills and Experience**

* Strong experience in marketplace business management, marketplace ads, quick commerce or digital commerce leadership.
* Hands-on understanding of Amazon, Flipkart, Nykaa, Myntra and quick commerce platforms such as Blinkit, Zepto and Instamart.
* Strong business ownership with ability to drive revenue, margin, pricing, promotions and platform-wise profitability.
* Strong understanding of ads metrics such as ROAS, ACOS, TACOS, CTR, CVR and conversion funnel.
* Ability to lead catalog, account management, platform operations and quick commerce teams.
* Strong analytical skills with comfort in Excel, dashboards, platform reports and business review decks.
* Good understanding of inventory availability, stockout impact, platform replenishment and cross-functional coordination with Supply Chain.
* Ability to work with Finance on SKU-wise and platform-wise P&L.
* Excellent stakeholder management with marketplace teams, internal teams and leadership.
* Strong execution discipline, ownership mindset and ability to work in a fast-growth environment.

**Good to Have**

* Experience in beauty, personal care, grooming, FMCG, fashion, lifestyle or consumer products.
* Experience scaling marketplace or quick commerce revenue across multiple brands.
* Existing working relationships with marketplace and quick commerce platform teams.
* Experience managing large sale events, new product launches and platform-specific growth plans.
* Experience working with multi-brand portfolios and cross-functional teams.

jobs.title: Senior Call Center Manager

* Drive business growth through End to End journey fulfilment and lead conversion strategies.

* Work with Analytics, BIU, Marketing, Digital, and Product teams to enhance lead quality and customer targeting.

* Monitor conversion rates at every stage of the sales funnel and implement corrective actions.

* Enhance customer experience through simplified sales processes and reduced turnaround times.

* Partner with Product, Technology, Operations, and COE teams to develop new capabilities and automation solutions.

* Champion adoption of new technologies, AI-enabled solutions, dialer systems, CRM enhancements, and digital sales tools.

Jive Jar builds and markets its own digital products and helps clients grow through performance marketing, SEO, content, social media, creative and digital strategy.

About the role

We’re looking for a hands-on Head of Marketing who can grow Jive Jar’s own business and lead marketing delivery across multiple client accounts. You’ll work with leadership, clients and a multidisciplinary marketing team. Opus Bloc Pvt. Ltd. is a fractional real estate platform in India that enables individuals to invest in premium properties through fractional ownership units called blocs, starting at ₹10,000. Each property is held via a dedicated Special Purpose Vehicle registered as an LLP, ensuring ownership is housed in a legally independent entity with details verifiable through Ministry of Corporate Affairs records. The Opus Bloc app streamlines the entire ownership journey, including onboarding, KYC, documentation, portfolio monitoring, and voting, while professional teams manage the properties. A secondary market for reselling holdings is under development, reinforcing liquidity and investor flexibility. Guided by the principles of Accessibility, Control, Transparency, and Ease (ACTE), the company focuses on making premium property ownership structured and accessible to a wider investor base in India.

The Head of Growth is a full-time, on-site role based in Hyderabad, responsible for driving user and revenue growth across the Opus Bloc platform. The ideal candidate will have extensive experience in forging operations, production planning, process optimization, quality management, and team leadership within a steel or heavy manufacturing environment.

The incumbent will be responsible for overseeing end-to-end forging operations, ensuring production efficiency, product quality, workplace safety, cost optimization, and on-time delivery while driving continuous improvement initiatives.

**1. Forging Operations & Production Management**

* Monitor production output, cycle time, rejection rates, and overall equipment effectiveness (OEE).

**2. Process Optimization & Operational Excellence**

* Drive continuous improvement initiatives to improve productivity, reduce cycle time, and minimize material wastage.

**4. Maintenance & Equipment Management**

* Coordinate with the Maintenance team to ensure equipment reliability and minimum downtime.
* Drive preventive and predictive maintenance practices for forging equipment and furnaces.

**5. Safety & Compliance**

**6. Team Leadership & Development**

**Required Experience & Skills**

* Minimum **15+ years of experience** in manufacturing, preferably in the steel, forging, automotive components, heavy engineering, or allied industries.

jobs.title: Customer Service Executive – Customer Support & Loan Servicing
jobs.description:
**Company:** Loan2grow Fincap Private Limited  
**Department:** Customer Service & Operations  
**Designation:** Customer Service Executive  
**Location:** Lucknow, Uttar Pradesh  
**Employment Type:** Full-time, Office-based  
**Working Days:** Monday to Saturday  
**Reporting To:** Customer Service Manager / Head of Operations  
**Salary:** As per experience and suitability (Fixed + Performance Incentive)

1. About Loan2grow Fincap

Loan2grow Fincap Private Limited is a growing lending and financial services company focused on providing responsible, accessible and technology-enabled credit solutions to underserved customer segments.

The company offers financing solutions across multiple customer categories and is expanding its digital lending and financial services operations.

At Loan2grow, we believe that a good customer experience is central to responsible lending. We aim to make financial services accessible, transparent and convenient through technology-enabled platforms and responsive customer support.

2. About the Role

We are looking for customer-oriented and proactive professionals to join our Customer Service & Operations team as Customer Service Executives.

The selected candidates will be responsible for handling customer queries, providing assistance throughout the loan application and servicing journey, resolving customer complaints and coordinating with internal teams to ensure timely resolution of customer issues.

The role will involve handling inbound and outbound customer calls, responding to service requests, guiding customers through digital processes and maintaining accurate records of customer interactions.

The Customer Service Executive will serve as an important point of contact between the company and its customers, ensuring that customer concerns are addressed professionally, efficiently and within defined timelines.

This is a full-time, office-based role involving regular telephone-based customer interaction and coordination with internal departments.

3. Key ResponsibilitiesA. Customer Support & Query Management

* Handle inbound and outbound customer calls relating to loan products and financial services.
* Respond to customer queries regarding loan features, eligibility, application procedures and documentation requirements.
* Provide information on loan application status, approval, disbursement and repayment schedules.
* Assist customers in understanding their loan accounts, outstanding balances, EMI obligations and payment timelines.
* Provide accurate information regarding applicable interest rates, processing fees, charges and other loan-related terms.
* Ensure that customer queries are addressed in a professional, courteous and timely manner.
* Escalate complex queries to the appropriate internal teams.

B. Loan Application & Customer Onboarding Support

* Assist prospective customers with the digital loan application process.
* Guide customers through KYC verification, documentation and other onboarding requirements.
* Help customers resolve issues related to application submission, document uploads and verification.
* Follow up on incomplete applications and pending documentation.
* Coordinate with Credit and Operations teams to track application progress.
* Keep customers informed about application status and pending requirements.
* Assist customers in navigating the company's digital platforms and applications.

C. Loan Servicing & Repayment Support

* Handle customer queries relating to loan disbursement, repayment schedules and EMI deductions.
* Assist customers with repayment-related issues, including failed transactions, incorrect deductions and payment confirmation.
* Guide customers on approved repayment channels and payment procedures.
* Coordinate with Finance and Collections teams to resolve payment reconciliation issues.
* Support customers in obtaining loan statements, repayment schedules and other account-related information.
* Track and follow up on unresolved loan servicing requests.
* Ensure that customer concerns relating to loan servicing are addressed within defined timelines.

D. Customer Complaint & Grievance Resolution

* Receive, register and track customer complaints and service requests.
* Understand the nature of customer grievances and identify the appropriate resolution mechanism.
* Coordinate with relevant departments to resolve complaints.
* Follow up on pending complaints until closure.
* Maintain accurate records of complaints, actions taken and resolution timelines.
* Escalate unresolved or sensitive customer grievances to the reporting manager.
* Ensure that customer complaints are handled in accordance with company policies and applicable regulatory requirements.

E. Customer Relationship & Communication

* Maintain professional and positive relationships with customers.
* Communicate loan-related information in simple, clear and understandable language.
* Proactively contact customers regarding pending documentation, application updates and service requests.
* Provide appropriate guidance to customers throughout their loan journey.
* Handle dissatisfied customers and difficult conversations with patience and professionalism.
* Ensure transparency in all customer communications.
* Never make unauthorised commitments regarding loan approvals, interest waivers, settlements or changes in repayment terms.

F. Coordination with Internal Teams

* Coordinate with Sales and Business Development teams for customer acquisition and onboarding-related queries.
* Work with Credit teams to obtain updates on loan applications and pending verifications.
* Coordinate with Operations for documentation, disbursement and loan servicing issues.
* Work with Collections teams on repayment-related customer queries and payment confirmation.
* Coordinate with Finance for payment reconciliation and account-related discrepancies.
* Ensure timely communication and closure of customer requests across departments.

G. Customer Service MIS & Reporting

* Maintain accurate records of customer calls, queries, complaints and service requests.
* Update customer interactions and service request status in the CRM or designated systems.
* Maintain daily customer service reports covering:
* Total inbound and outbound calls.
* Customer queries received.
* Customer requests registered.
* Complaints received and resolved.
* Pending service requests.
* Average query resolution time.
* Escalated complaints.
* Customer follow-up status.
* Share daily and weekly performance updates with the reporting manager.
* Identify recurring customer issues and highlight opportunities to improve service delivery.

4. Qualifications & Experience

**Essential Qualifications:**

* Graduate in any discipline.
* 1–3 years of experience in customer service, customer support, telecalling, contact centres or customer relationship management.
* Good verbal communication skills in Hindi and basic English.
* Comfortable handling inbound and outbound customer calls.
* Basic proficiency in MS Excel, Google Sheets and customer management systems.
* Ability to handle multiple customer queries and service requests simultaneously.

**Preferred Experience:**

* Prior experience in banking, NBFCs, fintech, digital lending, microfinance or other financial services organisations.
* Experience handling loan-related customer queries and servicing requests.
* Familiarity with loan application processes, KYC documentation and digital onboarding.
* Experience resolving EMI, repayment and payment-related queries.
* Experience working with CRM, LOS or LMS platforms.
* Exposure to complaint management and customer grievance resolution.

5. Key Skills & Competencies

* Excellent verbal communication and listening skills.
* Customer relationship management.
* Problem-solving and query resolution.
* Professional telephone etiquette.
* Patience and empathy in customer interactions.
* Ability to handle difficult customer conversations.
* Follow-up and service

jobs.title: Sales & Operations Manager
jobs.description:
**About the Company:**

DigieSign is a Bengaluru-based legal-tech and fintech company building a connected suite of products that help lenders digitise the full lifecycle of a loan — from signing the agreement to recovering dues and resolving disputes. Our customers are NBFCs, banks and financial institutions across India.

Our product suite:

* DigieSign – Aadhaar and DSC-based eSignatures and digital document execution for loan agreements, sanction letters and other lending documents.
* Serve – End-to-end legal notice dispatch: multilingual notice generation, digital delivery (email, SMS, WhatsApp) and physical dispatch via India Post, with tracking and court-ready delivery reports.
* Collect – Collections automation that helps lenders reach delinquent borrowers at scale and improve recovery rates.
* Resolve – Online Dispute Resolution (ODR) for faster, cheaper resolution of lending disputes through arbitration, conciliation and mediation. We already work with leading NBFCs, and we are now building city-level teams to grow faster. Bengaluru is our home city and the first of these hubs.

**Role Overview**

As City Manager – Sales & Operations, Bengaluru, you will own our business in the city end to end. You will bring in new NBFC and bank customers, and you will make sure that every customer we sign is onboarded smoothly, served well and keeps growing with us. You will run the city like a business unit: pipeline, revenue, delivery quality and client satisfaction are all yours.

This role suits someone who enjoys being in front of credit, legal and collections leaders at lending institutions, and who also likes making operations run cleanly behind the scenes.

**Key Responsibilities**

**A. Sales & Business Development (approx. 60%)**

•Find, prospect and acquire new NBFCs, banks (private, small finance, cooperative), HFCs and MFIs headquartered or with major operations in Bengaluru and Karnataka.

•Build and manage a healthy pipeline: research target accounts, map decision-makers (Heads of Collections, Legal, Credit Operations, Risk, IT/Digital) and run multi-stakeholder sales cycles.

* Run product demos and discovery meetings, and position the full suite: DigieSign, Serve, Collect and Resolve.

* Build proposals, commercial quotes and pricing in line with company guidelines; negotiate and close agreements.

* Handle procurement processes, vendor empanelment, RFPs, information security questionnaires and legal/compliance reviews at client institutions.

* Cross-sell and upsell across the suite to existing accounts (for example, moving a Serve customer onto Collect or Resolve).

* Meet monthly and quarterly targets for new logos, revenue and pipeline.

* Keep the CRM up to date and share accurate forecasts with leadership.

* Represent DigieSign at BFSI industry events, NBFC forums and legal-tech meetups in the city.

**B. City Operations & Client Delivery (approx. 40%)**

* Own client onboarding for the city: account setup, user training, template configuration, data upload formats and go-live.

* Oversee day-to-day delivery for Bengaluru clients, including legal notice dispatch batches, India Post coordination, eSign volumes and ODR case flows, so that SLAs and turnaround times are met.

* Coordinate with internal product, tech, legal and support teams to resolve client issues and escalations quickly.

* Make sure clients receive timely MIS and delivery reports, and review account health with them regularly (monthly reviews and QBRs).

* Track usage, wallet/billing status and collections on invoices for city accounts, and follow up on receivables.

* Manage local vendors and partners (printing, dispatch, courier and field partners) where needed.

* Capture client feedback and feature requests and pass them to the product team in a structured way.

* As the city grows, hire, train and lead a small team of sales and operations executives.

**Key Performance Indicators**

* New NBFC and bank customers signed per quarter

* Revenue and pipeline value against target

* Time from signature to go-live for new clients

* SLA adherence for notice dispatch, eSign and ODR delivery

* Client retention, expansion revenue and cross-sell across products

* Receivables collected on time

**Requirements Must have**

* Graduate in any discipline; MBA preferred.

* 3–6 years of experience in B2B / enterprise sales, account management or operations in BFSI, fintech, legal-tech or SaaS.

* A proven record of selling to NBFCs and/or banks, with an existing network among collections, legal, credit or operations leaders.

* Understanding of the lending lifecycle in India — loan origination, documentation, collections, NPA recovery and legal/recovery processes (SARFAESI, Section 138 NI Act, arbitration).

* Comfort managing operational processes, SLAs and client escalations.

* Strong communication, presentation and negotiation skills in English; Kannada and/or Hindi strongly preferred.

* Comfortable with CRM tools, Excel/Google Sheets and preparing MIS reports.

* Willing to travel within Bengaluru and Karnataka for client meetings. Good to have

* Experience selling eSign, eStamp, legal notice, collections or ODR solutions.

* Exposure to RBI digital lending guidelines and outsourcing norms for regulated entities.

* Experience setting up or scaling a city or regional business from an early stage.

* Experience hiring and leading a small team.

**What We Offer**

* A chance to build and own a city business at an early-stage, fast-growing legal-tech company.

* Direct work with the founding team and real influence on product and go-to-market.

* Competitive fixed pay plus a performance-linked incentive plan.

* A clear growth path to Regional / Zonal Head as we expand to more cities.

Pay: ₹70,000.00 - ₹110,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person

**Context of the role**
We're looking for a Data and AI Lead who is passionate about turning data into products and decisions, and wants to work in a disruptive, fast-growing and exciting environment. Every transaction on our network tells us something about what customers want, which products perform in which markets and how our partners can grow. This role will bring that intelligence together and put it to work across the business.
  
  
You will combine a startup mindset with the scale of an industry leader. Working closely with the leadership team, product, engineering and commercial teams, you will set the direction for how DT One uses data, analytics and AI, build the team to deliver it, and make sure it has a measurable impact on growth and profitability.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
We're looking for a highly driven, commercially minded leader who is truly excited about having a meaningful impact within the company. In this role, you will own data and AI end to end, from strategy and platforms through to the products, insights and automation that our teams and partners use every day.
  
  

* Define and drive the data and AI strategy and roadmap, making sure it is aligned with commercial, product and technology priorities
* Build, lead and grow a multi-disciplinary team across data engineering, data science and machine learning, analytics and data governance
* Own the data platform, bringing together transaction, product and partner data into a trusted, scalable foundation for real-time and batch analytics
* Deliver data and AI products that drive growth, such as product recommendations, pricing and demand insights, partner performance analytics, and fraud and anomaly detection
* Lead the adoption of AI, including generative AI, to automate operations and improve decision-making across the business
* Establish data governance, quality, privacy and compliance standards that work across multiple markets and regulatory environments
* Partner with the leadership team and business units to prioritise use cases, measure value delivered and manage the data and AI budget
* Act as a senior voice for data and AI with partners and the wider Thunes group

**What we are looking for**

* 15+ years' experience in data, analytics and machine learning, including several years leading data and AI functions
* Advanced degree (MSc or PhD) in Machine Learning, Computer Science, Statistics or a related field, or equivalent experience
* A proven record of building and scaling multi-disciplinary data teams, including across multiple countries
* Experience delivering data platforms and data products at scale in digital, e-commerce, fintech or other high-volume consumer businesses
* Hands-on depth in applied machine learning in production, such as personalisation, recommendation, forecasting or customer analytics
* Experience setting up data governance and working with data privacy requirements across multiple jurisdictions
* The ability to translate business goals into a clear data roadmap, and to communicate with and influence senior stakeholders
* Experience with fintech, payments or mobile data, or with deploying generative AI in production, is a plus
* Interest in the Fintech industry and market innovations

Our core services tech stack is hosted on Amazon Web Services.
  
  
Our main tech stack consists of Golang, Python, Perl (Mojolicious), PostgreSQL, Vue.js, Docker and Nginx.
  
  
We can offer you an environment with a culture of learning and feedback. You will have real ownership of data and AI across a network that operates 24/7 around the world, with the scope to build a team and shape how the business makes decisions. You will work with teams in different countries, and our environment and packages match the ambition of the company: building world-class teams.
  
  
**Sound like you? Apply now!**

jobs.title: Chief Technology Officer
jobs.description:
**Chief Technology Officer (CTO)**

**The Role**

The CTO is a senior executive responsible for defining and governing the company’s overall technology strategy, ensuring alignment with business growth, regulatory requirements, and investor expectations. This role operates at the enterprise level, owning strategic direction, technology risk mitigation, organisational performance and delivery outcomes through accountable senior leaders.

The CTO is a core member of the executive leadership team, reporting to the CEO and working closely with the executive team, with regular engagement with the Board, regulators and investors. Success in this role is defined by long-term platform scalability, resilience and commercial value creation.

This is a strategy-first executive role with accountability for delivery and production outcomes through senior leaders, requiring technical judgement and leadership at Board and regulator level. Day-to-day coding and engineering execution sit with the engineering teams.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Technology Strategy & Executive Leadership**

* Define and maintain a multi-year technology strategy aligned with company growth, product expansion, and geographic scale.
* Own the technology roadmap at executive level, ensuring clear prioritisation aligned to commercial outcomes.
* Act as the primary technology advisor to the CEO, Board, and investors.
* Translate complex technology topics into clear business decisions for non-technical stakeholders.
* Lead company-wide AI governance and adoption, shape AI and data strategy with business leaders and specialists, and own the supporting technology delivery.

**Architecture Governance & Technical Accountability**

* Maintain governance frameworks for platform architecture, ensuring scalability, resilience, and future readiness.
* Challenge and approve major architectural decisions and investment trade-offs, holding architecture and engineering leaders accountable for sound design and implementation.
* Ensure technology standards are defined and adhered to across all engineering and platform teams.

**Regulatory, Risk & Compliance Ownership**

* Own technology risk identification, mitigation and reporting, working with the CRO, who owns the enterprise risk register.
* Act as the primary interface with regulators (e.g., central bank authorities) on all technology-related matters.
* Ensure full compliance with regulatory technology requirements, including timelines, audits, and controls.
* Be accountable for cybersecurity posture, operational resilience and technical data custody, supporting enterprise data governance with the accountable business owners.

**Commercial & Financial Accountability**

* Own technology financial planning, including budgeting, cost optimisation, and investment prioritisation.
* Establish and maintain platform cost models (e.g., cost per transaction, cost per user) and ensure alignment with unit economics.
* Partner with the CFO to ensure technology investments deliver measurable business value.
* Lead technology input into investor discussions, due diligence processes, and funding activities.

**Technology Organisation and Sourcing Leadership**

* Build on and strengthen the established technology organisation, delivering through a lean internal team and external engineering partners, with further organisational changes driven by demonstrated business needs.
* Lead engineering, architecture, delivery, technology operations, DevOps/SRE and cybersecurity through accountable senior leaders.
* Set performance expectations and accountability frameworks across senior technology leaders.
* Build a culture of ownership, governance, and execution discipline at leadership level.
* Own build-versus-buy decisions, engineering-partner performance and controlled supplier transitions.

**Governance & Operational Oversight**

* Maintain and strengthen enterprise governance frameworks covering change control, incident management, and operational risk.
* The CTO is accountable for technology delivery, production performance and transformation outcomes through senior leaders, without personally coding, managing sprints or owning team backlogs.
* Ensure organisational readiness for scale, audits, and external scrutiny.

**Investor & Board Engagement**

* Present technology strategy, risks, and investment cases directly to Board members and investors.
* Ensure the technology function is fully prepared for external due diligence.
* Provide transparency on risks, trade-offs, and investment requirements.

**Required Experience and Qualifications**

* Established CTO, or CIO with equivalent scope, with substantive executive accountability in regulated fintech or financial services, and a proven record of independently leading the full technology function, including software engineering, through growth and transformation.
* Proven experience leading regulated wallet or payments platforms, with sound judgement across transaction integrity, reconciliation, settlement and partner integrations.
* Proven experience protecting live payments while building and safely migrating to new platforms, delivering through internal teams and external partners, with measurable improvements in reliability, delivery speed and cost.
* Demonstrated track record of scaling technology platforms through significant growth phases.
* Experience operating at Board and investor level, including direct engagement on strategy and risk.
* Strong understanding of regulatory environments and technology compliance obligations.
* Experience leading the full technology function through senior leadership teams, with accountability for delivery, operations, architecture and security.

**Skills and Characteristics**

* Executive-level thinker with the ability to connect technology decisions to commercial outcomes.
* Strong governance and risk management mindset.
* Ability to operate effectively with ambiguity at enterprise scale.
* Clear and confident communicator at Board and investor level.
* High level of accountability and ownership for outcomes.
* Technically credible across platform architecture, payments and engineering, able to challenge designs, make sound decisions, and hold engineering to account, without being hands-on.

**What This Role Is**

* A C-suite CTO role with executive ownership of strategy, governance, business alignment and technology outcomes.
* An executive leadership position, driving outcomes through accountable senior leaders and intervening where material decisions, risks or performance require it.
* A role with executive accountability for technology risk, technology-related regulatory compliance and transparent Board and investor reporting.

**What This Role Is Not**

* This is not a hands-on engineering or architecture role.
* This role does not involve direct coding, sprint management, or backlog ownership.
* This is not an engineering manager or individual contributor position.

**Key Stakeholders**

* CEO
* CFO
* CPO
* COO
* CRO
* Board of Directors
* Investors
* Regulatory Authorities

jobs.title: Chief Marketing Officer
jobs.description:
**About Us**

UMO is a stealth-mode FinTech venture aiming to evolve the way people experience money by building a unified, AI-powered, yet deeply human money platform across fiat, crypto, and investments – subject to regulatory approvals. The platform is being designed to break down traditional barriers to money across access, assets, and experience, enabling simpler, more adaptive ways for people to interact with financial services.

We are currently developing our MVP and navigating licensing requirements, with a multidisciplinary team of 100+ people representing 20+ nationalities. With our headquarters in the UAE, we are united behind a shared ambition and a relentless focus on serving our customers.

**About this role**

As a part of our team, you'll help us shape a platform that works for One — a business owner, an artist, a freelancer. In this role, you will build and manage a growth system based on data, AI, and user intent, transforming marketing from a communication function into a real-time decision layer. We provide the space for you to exercise true strategic autonomy, stripping away micromanagement so you can integrate marketing directly into the product, drive user acquisition and retention through intent detection, and evolve UMO into a trusted financial assistant end-to-end.

**You'll take ownership of:**

* **Growth & Decision Layer (The Core):**
  Build an intent detection and decisioning system based on user data. Integrate marketing directly into the product (product-led growth) to drive "one intent -> one action" logic, shaping the user's experience by correctly reacting to their state in the moment.
* **Data & MarTech Architecture:**
  Build our first-party data strategy, developing the CDP, data layer, event tracking, and data clean rooms while maintaining data quality, structure, and accessibility for automated decisioning.
* **Customer Lifecycle & Personalization:**
  Design the end-to-end customer journey, transitioning from traditional segments to individual scenarios powered by behavior, context, financial status, and life event triggers.
* **Go-to-Market & Growth Execution:**
  Develop GTM strategies for new products and markets while managing performance, partnership, and product-led acquisition channels focused on LTV, engagement, and value delivered.
* **Brand & Trust:**
  Shape UMO's positioning as an AI-native financial assistant and trusted decision layer, ensuring absolute communication consistency across all customer touchpoints.
* **Compliance & Data Governance:**
  Ensure strict compliance with GDPR, privacy rules, advertising standards, and consent management frameworks in close coordination with CISO, Risk, and Legal teams.
* **Analytics & Intelligence:**
  Build a real-time metrics system measuring intent detection accuracy, context conversions, LTV, retention, and value delivered.
* **Leadership & Cross-Functional Alignment:**
  Lead Growth, Data, Marketing, and CRM/Lifecycle teams while partnering closely with Product, Tech, AI, Risk, and Compliance.

**About you:**

* **Executive Growth Leadership:**
  You have extensive commercial experience in a senior marketing or growth leadership capacity (at least 7+ years) within high-growth fintech, tech, or data-driven digital environments.
* **Data & AI-Native Architecture:**
  You feel at home building first-party data strategies, CDPs, and event-tracking frameworks, leveraging AI tooling and predictive models to turn raw data into actionable decision engines.
* **Product-Led Growth (PLG) Depth:**
  You have proven experience driving acquisition, engagement, and retention directly through product workflows rather than relying solely on external ad campaigns.
* **Regulated Environment & Compliance:**
  You understand data protection principles, GDPR, advertising regulations, and consent governance, ensuring data is used transparently and in the user's best interest.
* **Autonomous Milestone Execution:**
  You manage complex growth goals comfortably, taking complete end-to-end problem ownership over market entry, LTV metrics, and product-led journeys.
* **Transparent & Supportive Leadership:**
  You communicate openly, foster cross-functional collaboration with product and tech teams, and prioritize an absolute zero-tolerance policy for rudeness or politics.
* **Linguistic Fluency:**
  You speak and write English fluently to comfortably lead global teams and align cross-functional executive tracks.

**Can get you a few bonus points:**

* **Fintech & Digital Asset Background:**
  Prior experience building growth systems or personalized financial products within fintech, neobanks, or regulated web3 platforms.
* **MarTech & AI Tooling Expertise:**
  Direct experience configuring advanced CDP platforms, custom LLM prompt setups, or AI-driven marketing automation engines.
* **Startup Agility:**
  Experience operating within zero-to-one or lean startup environments where market entry strategies evolve quickly.

**The UMO Standard**

* Mandate & Ownership: Full ownership of the product organization and roadmap, reporting directly to the founders.
* Equity: A meaningful equity stake in a venture built from zero to one.
* Location & Flexibility: Base yourself in Lisbon, Dubai, Kyiv, or Lviv, with openness to remote for the right fit.
* Impact & Ownership: Your work directly shapes the product and company direction — not just executes it.

**Unit Leader - Client Acquisition**

**About the Role:**

YubiLoans UAE is seeking a dynamic and strategic leader to lead the SME Loans Segment. This role is central to driving the growth of our SME marketplace by acquiring corporate borrowers and successfully onboarding them onto our platform. As the Team Leader, you will manage a team responsible for identifying, engaging, and facilitating the onboarding of SME borrowers, ensuring they can connect with the right lenders through our marketplace. You will be at the forefront of shaping the acquisition strategy, ensuring the smooth onboarding of borrowers, and building strong relationships with potential clients. This role requires a leader with a deep understanding of the SME lending landscape, excellent team management skills, and the ability to drive marketplace growth through strategic partnerships and efficient processes.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**Leadership & Team Management:**

* **Team Leadership**
  : Lead and inspire a team of SME loan acquisition specialists and onboarding managers, ensuring they meet loan origination targets and contribute to the growth of Yubiloans' SME borrower base across all SME loan variants including business loans, POS loans, asset backed loans, commercial vehicle and fleet finance, working capital loans, loan against property and capex loans.
* **Performance Management**
  : Establish and monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) for your team, tracking progress and providing coaching to improve team performance and overall contribution to business goals.
* **Coaching & Development**
  : Develop a high-performance culture, providing ongoing training and development to enhance the skill sets of your team members.

**Borrower Acquisition & Onboarding:**

* **Market Development**
  : Drive efforts to identify and target potential SME and corporate borrowers across the MENA region, focusing on those who would benefit from connecting with lenders through the Yubiloans marketplace.
* **Client Engagement**
  : Establish relationships with potential borrowers, understand their financing needs, and position Yubiloans as the optimal solution for connecting them with the right lending partners.
* **Onboarding Process**
  : Oversee the seamless onboarding of borrowers onto the Yubiloans platform, ensuring they are fully equipped to access financing options that best meet their needs.
* **Sales Strategy**
  : Develop and implement strategies to acquire a diverse set of borrowers, balancing volume with quality to maximize the overall growth and health of the marketplace.

**Partnership & Relationship Management:**

* **Lender Network Collaboration**
  : Collaborate closely with Yubiloans' lender partners to understand their requirements and ensure the borrowers you onboard are well-matched with appropriate lenders.
* **Strategic Partnerships**
  : Build and maintain strong relationships with key corporate clients, industry associations, and other stakeholders to attract new borrowers to the platform.
* **Customer Service Excellence**
  : Ensure a high-quality onboarding experience for borrowers, guiding them through the platform and answering questions to ensure smooth adoption.

**Operational Excellence:**

* **Process Optimization**
  : Work closely with operations, product, and technology teams to continuously refine and streamline the borrower onboarding process for greater efficiency and scalability.

jobs.title: Director, Consulting Delivery, VCA-X
jobs.description:
**About Us**
Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid.
  
  
At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world.
  
  
Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you.
  
  
**Job Description**
Visa Consulting and Analytics (VCA) is the consulting arm of Visa, and drives tangible, impactful results for clients. Drawing on our expertise in consulting, data analytics, technology, payments and economics, VCA solves the most strategic problems for our clients. VCA's core client segments include issuers, acquirers, merchants, fintech's, payment enablers and governments.
  
  
VCA-X is VCA's global delivery capability, designed to scale high-value solutions across Regions through multidisciplinary teams, common delivery standards, AI-enabled assets, and continuous learning from delivery. Working in partnership with Regional teams and Practice Areas, VCA-X enables consistent, efficient, and scalable delivery while maintaining client and market relevance.
  
  
Specialist & Consulting Delivery is a core pillar of the VCA-X operating model. It provides the specialist expertise, consulting delivery capacity, consulting leadership, and quality oversight required to ensure VCA-X delivers credible, consistent, and client-ready outputs.
  
  
The role operates within one of three core delivery leadership pillars within VCA-X, alongside Program Management and Data & Analytics Delivery. It will form part of the VCA-X Extended Leadership Team, and report directly to the Senior Director and Head of Specialist & Consulting Delivery, VCA-X.
  
  
**What a Director, Consulting Delivery, VCA-X Does At Visa**
The Director, Consulting Delivery will lead the consulting delivery team within VCA-X and will be responsible for ensuring consulting resources are effectively deployed, developed, and supported across the portfolio. They will be responsible for ensuring that the consulting delivery team delivers credible, consistent and client-ready outputs across engagements.
  
  
This leader will ensure VCA-X engagements have the consulting capacity, expertise, and leadership required to deliver high-quality client outcomes. Working closely with Practice Areas and Regional VCA teams, the Director will operationalize methodologies, be responsible for consulting capability, and establish the standards required for scalable consulting delivery excellence.
  
  
**Core Responsibilities Of The Role Include**
Specialist & Consulting Organization Leadership
  
  

* Build and manage a flexible consulting delivery pool that can be deployed across priority use cases, Regions, and multidisciplinary engagement teams.
* Recruit, develop, and retain high-performing specialist and consulting talent.
* Partner with Program Management to forecast consulting resource needs and ensure sufficient consulting delivery capacity to support engagement demand.
* Foster a culture of intellectual rigor, collaboration, learning, and client impact.

Consulting Delivery Leadership
  
  

* Ensure engagements are staffed with the appropriate consulting capabilities and delivery support required to achieve engagement objectives.
* Provide oversight for complex, high-impact, or strategically important engagements.
* Lead deployment of consulting delivery resources across the VCA-X portfolio, balancing expertise, capacity, development opportunities, and delivery priorities.
* Coach teams in structured problem solving, insight development, recommendation formulation, and executive communication.
* Serve as an advisor and first escalation point for delivery teams.

Delivery Quality & Client Readiness
  
  

* Establish delivery standards, quality expectations, and review processes across the VCA-X portfolio.
* Ensure outputs are commercially relevant, supported by sound specialist judgement, and appropriate to client and market context.
* Drive continuous improvements in delivery quality, consistency, and effectiveness.
* Partner with Regional VCA teams to ensure outputs support successful client engagement.

Practice Area Partnership & Methodology Enablement
  
  

* Partner with Practice Areas to operationalize established methodologies into scalable delivery approaches.
* Lead validation of new use cases and delivery approaches before they are scaled broadly across the VCA-X portfolio.
* Capture delivery feedback and provide structured input to methodology evolution and improvement.

Expertise Development & Continuous Learning
  
  

* Define the specialist expertise and consulting capabilities required across the portfolio.
* Establish learning pathways and leadership development approaches.
* Capture specialist, consulting and quality learnings from engagements and translate them into improved methodologies, delivery approaches, training and reusable assets.
* Partner with Analytics and Engineering teams to strengthen multidisciplinary delivery.

Why this is important to Visa
  
  
Scaling VCA-X is central to VCA's strategy for expanding delivery capacity, accelerating execution, and creating greater impact for clients globally.
  
  
The ability to scale delivery successfully depends not only on capacity but on maintaining the quality, expertise, and consulting rigor that clients expect from VCA.
  
  
This role is critical to ensuring that VCA-X delivers consistent, high-quality outputs while building the specialist and consulting capability required to support future growth. The Director will play a key role in strengthening delivery excellence, accelerating learning, and increasing the impact of VCA across Regions.
  
  
Visa requires at least 3 days in office, expectations of these days will be confirmed by your Hiring Manager.
  
  
**Qualifications**
Basic Qualifications:
  
  

* 15 or more years of work experience with a Bachelor’s Degree or at least 12 years of work experience with an Advanced Degree (e.g. Masters/ MBA)

**Preferred Qualifications**

* 15 or more years of work experience with a Bachelor’s Degree or at least 12 years of work experience with an Advanced Degree (e.g. Masters/ MBA)

**What You Will Need**

* 15+ years of experience in consulting, advisory services, professional services, specialist delivery, or related fields.
* Demonstrated success leading complex client engagements and ensuring executive-level quality standards.
* Strong consulting toolkit including structured problem solving, analytical reasoning, synthesis, storylining, and recommendation development.
* Experience scaling consulting organizations across multiple markets or regions.
* Ability to translate methodologies into repeatable and scalable delivery approaches.
* Executive presence and strong stakeholder-management skills.
* Proven ability to recruit, develop, and lead high-performing teams.
* Demonstrated ability to influence senior leaders and build partnerships across matrixed organizations.
* Strong academic credentials with an undergraduate or advanced degree in a relevant discipline, or equivalent professional experience.
* What will also help:
* Expertise in one or more VCA domains such as portfolio optimization, risk, or digital.
* Experience operating within global consulting, managed-services, or professional-services organizations.
* Knowledge of payments, financial services, or adjacent industries.
* Experience building new capabilities, operating models, or delivery organizations from the ground up.

**Visa is an EEO Employer**
Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender
