jobs.title: ED - Head, Margin & Collateral Operations
jobs.description:
**Job Summary**

* The Executive Director – Global Head, Margin and Collateral Operations is accountable for the global end-to-end delivery, control and transformation of the Bank’s uncleared margin and collateral franchise across non-centrally cleared derivatives, repo, securities borrowing and lending, structured financing, commodities, precious metals and other collateralised businesses.
* The role owns Initial Margin, Variation Margin, Independent Amount, portfolio reconciliation, dispute management, collateral allocation, settlement, interest, static data, reconciliations, reporting and exception management across the full lifecycle—from legal-agreement and counterparty onboarding through daily exposure calculation, margin exchange and collateral return.
* The role ensures compliance with applicable uncleared margin, segregation, portfolio-reconciliation, dispute-reporting, client-asset, liquidity and books-and-records obligations across all relevant jurisdictions and legal entities, and is accountable for timely, evidenced delivery of regulatory, audit, assurance and risk-remediation commitments.
* The role leads the global target operating model, people strategy and investment roadmap to deliver upcoming global and local margin regulations, maintain compliance with existing requirements through adequate preventive and detective controls, and resolve conflicts between global standards and local regulatory, legal-entity, currency, custody and settlement obligations. The role is accountable for evolving MARS into the Bank’s strategic straight-through and zero-touch collateral management solution, enabling artificial intelligence and effective integration with industry utilities and vendors, including TriOptima and AcadiaSoft, while supporting digital-currency margining, Prime Crypto and other new-business requirements across Asia and the wider Bank.

Strategy
  
  

* Define and execute the global strategy for uncleared Margin and Collateral Operations, aligned with Global Markets Operations, business growth, counterparty credit-risk mitigation, liquidity objectives and risk appetite.
* Own the forward regulatory roadmap for global and local margin reforms, translating emerging rules into coordinated legal, client, model, process, technology, custody, settlement, finance and control deliverables while sustaining compliance with existing regulations.
* Establish a scalable target operating model with global process ownership, follow-the-sun delivery, resilient location strategy, clear service segmentation and effective capacity planning.
* Set the strategic direction for MARS as the Bank’s authoritative collateral management platform, delivering end-to-end straight-through processing and zero-touch processing across calculation, margin exchange, allocation, settlement, reconciliation, reporting and exception management.
* Own the multi-year transformation and investment roadmap for standardisation, artificial intelligence, real-time settlement transparency, collateral optimisation, common data, strategic platform integration and controlled decommissioning of legacy processes and systems without service or control degradation.
* Establish strategic partnerships and interoperable solutions with global vendors and industry utilities, including TriOptima and AcadiaSoft, to increase automation, strengthen portfolio reconciliation and dispute management, and support exception-led operations.
* Set measurable outcomes covering regulatory compliance, margin timeliness, settlement success, disputes, reconciliations, risk reduction, productivity, resilience, client service, collateral utilisation, funding efficiency and financial-data accuracy.
* Anticipate regulatory, market, product and infrastructure developments and ensure the operating model remains controlled, scalable and fit for global flow business and complex local or bespoke requirements.

Business
  
  

* Act as the senior global Operations owner for uncleared margin and collateral services, maintaining effective service across products, legal entities, regions and client segments.
* Partner with Trading, XVA, Treasury, Repo, Prime, Product, Sales and Client Coverage to enable new clients, products, markets and bespoke structures with transparent operational readiness, risk assessment, approvals, capacity and controls.
* Lead the operational enablement of digital-currency margining, Prime Crypto, crypto spot, crypto derivatives and other emerging business propositions, ensuring appropriate agreement structures, segregated or cross-service margin treatment, settlement, custody, valuation, reconciliation, reporting and risk controls.
* Support the Bank’s growth across diverse Asian markets by delivering scalable solutions for local currencies, local custodians, domestic settlement infrastructure, country-specific collateral rules and bespoke regulatory margin requirements.
* Protect the Bank from counterparty credit, liquidity, market, conduct, operational, regulatory and reputational impacts arising from ineffective margining, collateralisation, disputes or settlement.
* Maximise utilisation of the Bank’s collateral inventory through eligibility, concentration, substitutions, intragroup margining, cross-product opportunities and cheapest-to-deliver allocation, while ensuring optimal funding, liquidity, legal-entity and regulatory outcomes.
* Represent Margin and Collateral Operations in senior business, client, risk, governance, audit and investment forums, providing clear decisions and escalation on material matters.

**Processes**

* Own the global control and service framework for agreement onboarding and static data; trade and valuation feeds; IM, VM and Independent Amount calculation; SIMM; margin issuance and response; dispute investigation; collateral selection and movement; interest; substitutions; returns; reconciliations; and reporting.
* Ensure margin calls and collateral movements are complete, accurate, timely and consistent with legal terms, credit requirements, settlement instructions, eligibility schedules, thresholds, minimum transfer amounts, haircuts and concentration limits.
* Deliver change for new and amended global margin regulations and local addenda, including impact assessment, requirements interpretation, controls, documentation, client repapering, model approval, custody and settlement readiness, testing, training, implementation and post-go-live assurance.
* Design and operate a defensible framework for conflicting global and local requirements, with documented rule hierarchy, legal and compliance interpretation, country-specific configurations, approvals, traceability and evidence that each applicable obligation is met.
* Enhance MARS and its upstream and downstream interfaces to enable STP and ZTP processing, AI-supported ingestion and exception analysis, real-time connectivity with TriOptima and AcadiaSoft where appropriate, and controlled handling of clients or markets that cannot use industry utilities.
* Provide real-time or near-real-time settlement status for cash and securities, with end-to-end acknowledgement, fail management, aged-item escalation and reconciled views across MARS, settlement platforms, custodians, triparty agents, nostro and ledger records.
* Ensure complete, accurate and timely feeds of collateral positions, valuations, movements, interest, encumbrance and accounting attributes to Finance, Aspire and other downstream liquidity, ledger, regulatory and management-reporting systems, supported by controls and reconciliations.
* Maintain a robust portfolio-reconciliation and dispute-management model with risk-based prioritisation, ageing, escalation, regulatory reporting and accountable root-cause remediation.
* Establish complete reconciliations across margin systems, trade platforms, settlement systems, Finance, Aspire, custodians, triparty agents, nostro and ledger records; ensure all breaks are risk-assessed, owned, aged and resolved with

**Head, Credit Risk Review, Specialised Finance**
in the
**Banking**
division.

This role offers an exciting opportunity to join a global team, providing top-tier service to existing and prospective clients while expanding the business on a product and global level.

**Job Description:**

**Job Summary:**

* Lead independent, technical, and forward-looking assessments of the credit quality, risk governance, and control environment across the Group's global Specialized Finance portfolio.
* Exercise independent challenge and escalation authority under the Credit Risk Review mandate while maintaining clear separation from first-line credit and business decision-making.
* Conduct independent reviews that drive strategic and business outcomes, including decisions on portfolio growth, risk appetite, sector and country concentrations, capital deployment, hold levels, and distribution strategy.
* Identify emerging and systemic risks, influence improvements in underwriting, structuring, and portfolio management, and ensure timely remediation of material weaknesses.
* Provide senior management, risk committees, and regulators with independent assurance on underwriting, structuring, portfolio quality, risk appetite alignment, lifecycle monitoring, and problem-credit management.
* Perform Business Credit Application and portfolio reviews across Project Finance, Sponsor Finance, Private Credit, Commercial Real Estate (CRE), Infrastructure & Power, Natural Resources, Transportation (Shipping/Aviation), Export Finance, Structured Asset Finance, and other asset-backed or cash-flow-based lending.
* Focus on Credit Risk and its interaction with ESG, climate, and country risks.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**Strategy
:**

Maintain awareness of the Group's Specialized Finance strategy and assess whether growth priorities, sector and country concentrations, tenor, leverage, distribution assumptions and originate-to-distribute activity remain aligned with approved risk appetite. Specifically the role requires:

* Served as the senior independent reviewer for Specialized Finance, providing oversight and escalation of key credit and portfolio risks.
* Advised leadership on portfolio strategy, risk appetite, growth priorities, capital deployment, and concentration limits.
* Identified emerging and systemic risks across sectors and regions, recommending risk mitigation and control enhancements.
* Assessed portfolio sustainability under stressed conditions, balancing risk, return, capital, and concentration exposures.
* Independently challenged underwriting, portfolio management, and strategic decisions to ensure compliance with approved risk appetite.
* Monitored portfolio vulnerabilities and concentrations, ensuring timely identification and remediation of material risks.

**Business**
:

* Provided strategic oversight of Specialized Finance portfolios, aligning growth, capital allocation, sustainability objectives, and distribution strategies with risk appetite.
* Assessed macroeconomic, sector, sovereign, commodity, and market risks impacting portfolio performance and resilience.
* Evaluated portfolio exposures to concentration, refinancing, interest rate, inflation, and other emerging risk factors through forward-looking reviews.
* Led independent assessment of complex project and structured finance transactions, including cash flow analysis, ESG/climate risks, and distressed assets.
* Translated portfolio and thematic review findings into strategic recommendations to enhance underwriting, structuring, and portfolio management practices.
* Influenced senior stakeholders to strengthen credit governance, risk controls, risk appetite adherence, and portfolio resilience through effective challenge and remediation oversight.

**Processes**
:

* Led Specialized Finance credit reviews, ensuring compliance with policies, regulations, and governance standards.
* Enhanced review methodologies, portfolio analytics, and risk assessment frameworks.
* Conducted end-to-end credit reviews, including transaction assessment, model validation, and stakeholder engagement.
* Developed risk-based review programs covering high-risk sectors, jurisdictions, refinancing risks, and portfolio concentrations.
* Evaluated complex financing structures and key legal, ESG, technical, valuation, and financial risks.
* Identified and escalated material underwriting, monitoring, concentration, and control weaknesses, driving timely remediation.

**Risk Management:**

* Conducted end-to-end reviews of Specialized Finance transactions, assessing sponsor strength, project viability, leverage, cash flows, covenants, and refinancing risk.
* Performed stress testing and scenario analysis to evaluate repayment capacity, credit quality, and recovery outcomes.
* Reviewed funding structures, covenant compliance, drawdown controls, reserve adequacy, and sponsor support arrangements.
* Assessed risk ratings, expected loss, collateral valuations, and recovery assumptions for accuracy and appropriateness.
* Evaluated distressed credits, restructuring strategies, refinancing options, and recovery plans.
* Identified, challenged, and escalated material credit and structural risks, driving effective risk mitigation and remediation.

**Governance**
:

* Assess the effectiveness of global, regional and country governance for Specialized Finance, including sector oversight, delegated authorities, credit committee challenge, exception governance, portfolio limits, concentration monitoring, model governance and watchlist escalation.
* Awareness and understanding of the regulatory framework in which the Group operates, and the regulatory requirements and expectations relevant to the role.
* Deliver effective governance through credible challenge of senior executives on complex Specialized Finance judgements and maintain open, cooperative engagement with relevant regulators.

**Regulatory and Business Conduct:**

* Display exemplary conduct and live by the Group's Valued Behaviours and Code of Conduct.
* Take personal responsibility for embedding the highest standards of ethics, including regulatory and business conduct, across Standard Chartered Bank. This includes understanding and ensuring compliance with, in letter and spirit, all applicable laws, regulations, guidelines and the Group Code of Conduct.
* Lead the team to achieve the outcomes set out in the Bank's Conduct Principles: Fair Outcomes for Clients; Effective Operation of Financial Markets; Financial Crime Prevention; and The Right Environment.
* Effectively and collaboratively identiW, escalate, mitigate and resolve risk, conduct and compliance matters.

jobs.title: Model Risk Lead
jobs.description:
**Why Mizuho**

At Mizuho, we provide the stability of an international industry leader with the career trajectory of a growing business. Our steady, strategic growth gives our people at all levels rewarding degrees of responsibility and richer work experience than a boutique firm or an established giant could offer alone.

It’s the local expertise of our employees that makes our global network so powerful. By collaborating with colleagues and clients who share the same ambition and drive, you can amplify your sphere of influence and base of knowledge as part of one of the largest banks in the world.

**Role Overview:**

Mizuho America’s Model Risk Management is the firm’s second line of defense and is responsible for managing model risk generated via the firm’s various entities and corporate functions. The group is tasked with establishing and implementing an SR 26-2 consistent risk management framework by which the firm’s model inventory is effectively challenged and validated. The group is also tasked with managing model risk governance, ensuring compliance with policies, procedures, and regulations. Mizuho seeks a highly motivated individual to serve as a Director, responsible for building and leading Model Risk team at the Mizuho Pune office. The role reports locally to the Mizuho Pune Head of Risk and globally to the Head of Model Risk Management within America’s Risk Management department.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Establish and lead the Model Risk capability in Mizuho Pune, including operating model, processes and ways of working.
* Build and lead a high-performing Pune Model Risk team and help evolve Mizuho Pune into an active risk-management hub.
* Act as the senior Model Risk point of contact for the Pune site, ensuring effective connectivity with MUSO and global Model Risk teams.
* Manage a team of validation specialists, focusing on Pricing/Valuation models for Equity and Fixed Income Derivatives, XVA and other related models, providing guidance as necessary to ensure that the most robust independent review and challenge is possible
* Train and develop junior team members focusing on overlapping areas of expertise within the team, independence of view, and vocal challenge
* Design, build, and manage Model Risk workflow management, including AI tools, to assist in the efficient execution of the group's framework.
* Assist in maintaining a strong model governance framework, working with management and model owners to ensure maximum alignment with regulatory and policy requirements

**Education, Knowledge, and Experience Qualifications:**

* 18-20+ years of experience in financial services with specific experience in Model Risk
* Solid understanding of risk management concepts
* Working knowledge of SR 11-7 and SR 26-2 guidance on model risk management
* Strong management skills with experience in managing quants while maintaining strong relationships with management and business stakeholders
* Demonstrable experience in responding to audit and regulatory requests
* Impeccable attention to detail and a high standard of polish with regards to documentation and presentation materials

**Company Overview:**

Mizuho Pune is an integral part of Mizuho Financial Group, one of the world’s leading financial institutions with a strong global presence across the Americas, EMEA, and Asia. Based in India, Mizuho Pune supports Mizuho’s international businesses by delivering high-quality, scalable, and resilient services across multiple functions.

Mizuho Pune plays a critical role in driving operational excellence, standardization, and innovation for Mizuho Americas. By combining deep domain expertise with strong process, technology, and analytical capabilities, it partners closely with regional and global teams to support corporate and investment banking, capital markets, and corporate services functions, while adhering to the highest standards of risk management, regulatory compliance, and control.

Mizuho Pune offers competitive compensation and benefits package aligned with industry standards and local market practices.

Mizuho Pune is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse workplace.

Employment is subject to applicable background verification checks in accordance with Indian laws and company policies.

jobs.title: Customer Relationship Manager
jobs.description:
**Role & responsibilities**

  

We are looking for an experienced and customer-centric **Customer Relationship Manager (CRM)** to manage post-sales client interactions for our residential project. The ideal candidate will have at least 5 years of hands-on experience in residential real estate, covering the entire customer lifecycle from booking and collections to documentation, flat handover, and referral generation.

  

**1. Customer Relationship & Experience Management**

* Serve as the primary point of contact for customers from the time of booking until final flat possession.
* Address and resolve customer queries, complaints, and escalations promptly via calls, emails, and in-person meetings.
* Conduct regular site visits with customers to update them on construction milestones and build strong, long-term relationships.

**2. Collections & Payment Updation**

* Track construction-linked payment milestones and generate timely demand letters and payment reminders.
* Follow up with customers and coordinate with banks/housing finance institutions to ensure timely disbursement and collection of dues.
* Update all received payments accurately in the ERP/CRM software and share receipts with customers.

**3. Documentation & Legal Coordination**

* Coordinate the preparation, verification, and execution of key legal documents, including Allotment Letters, Agreements for Sale (AFS), Possession Letters, and NOCs.
* Assist customers with stamp duty, registration processes, and home loan documentation.

**4. Data Maintenance & Financial Reconciliations**

* Maintain accurate, up-to-date customer ledgers, booking records, and communication logs in the CRM/ERP system.
* Perform regular financial reconciliations in coordination with the Accounts/Finance team to ensure zero discrepancies in customer statements of account (SOA).
* Generate periodic MIS reports on collections, outstanding dues, cancellations, and possession status for management review.

**5. Flat Handover & Possession**

* Coordinate internally with the Engineering, Quality, and Facility Management teams to ensure units are snag-free and ready for possession.
* Facilitate smooth physical flat handovers, complete with key handover checklists, utility meter transfers, and society formation documentation.

  

**Preferred candidate profile**

  

* **Education:** Bachelors degree (Graduate) in any discipline specialization.
* **Experience:** Minimum 5 years of dedicated post-sales CRM experience specifically within **residential real estate projects**.

* **Domain Knowledge:** Strong understanding of RERA guidelines, stamp duty/registration procedures, and home loan disbursement workflows.

jobs.title: Marketing Analyst

**Job Description: Marketing Analyst - Marketing Intelligence (Head Office)**  
   
**Position Overview**  
The Business Analyst will serve as the **central analytics and intelligence function within the marketing organization**, responsible for transforming raw internal and external data into actionable insights that drive strategic decision-making.  
The role involves **market intelligence development, advanced data analysis, 360 competitive benchmarking, pricing, trade analysis, and strategic business reporting** to support senior leadership in identifying growth opportunities and optimizing market performance. Core objective to **increase market share**, **increase demand** in new plus existing markets.  
The Business Analyst will collaborate closely with **sales, marketing, business development, CRM, manufacturing, supply chain and finance teams** to ensure data-driven planning and performance monitoring across markets.  
  
**Work Experience**  
2+ years of experience in trade margin structure building, research analysis, directly handling pricing, EBITDA management, demand surge analysis, competition tracking, high volume data driven decision making, knowledge of ERP, CRM, product management & PLC roadmap, customer philosophy understanding, etc.   
Person with work experience in FMCG, Consulting firms, Consumer Durables, Banking, is preferred.  
   
**Educational Qualification**  
B.Tech / B.E. (Engineering) or Commerce (Grade A) background + MBA full time in Marketing / Business Analytics / Strategy; All from Tier 1 or Tier 2 institutes. Or Masters in Statistics / Economics / Data Analytics with strong business analytics exposure.  
  
   
**Key Responsibilities**  
**1. Strategic Market Intelligence & Industry Analysis**  
Develop a comprehensive **market intelligence framework** to track and interpret trends affecting the cement and construction ecosystem.

* Monitoring macroeconomic indicators, infrastructure investments, and construction sector activity impacting cement demand.
* Tracking regional market performance, capacity utilization, and demand growth patterns across districts and states.
* Building structured databases on competitor capacities, plant expansions, distribution networks, and product portfolios.
* Conducting periodic industry benchmarking studies to evaluate the company's market position relative to competitors.
* Preparing quarterly/half yearly industry outlook reports highlighting emerging market opportunities and risks.

**2. Sales & Market Performance Analytics**  
Analyze sales and market data to identify trends, opportunities, and operational gaps.  
Activities include:

* Evaluating sales performance across products, regions, dealer networks, and market segments.
* Identifying high-growth and underperforming markets through trend analysis and market penetration studies.
* Developing analytical models to track dealer productivity and distribution efficiency.
* Conducting variance analysis between planned targets and actual performance.
* Supporting regional leadership with actionable insights to improve market coverage and sales effectiveness.

**3. Pricing Intelligence & Strategy Analytics**  
The Business Analyst will play a key role in supporting pricing strategy through detailed data analysis and market intelligence.

* Track and maintain a regional pricing intelligence database covering competitor prices across districts and key markets.
* Analyze price movement trends across markets, identifying patterns linked to supply, demand, infrastructure activity, and competitor strategies.
* Evaluate the impact of price changes on sales volumes, dealer behaviour, sub-dealer sentiment, influencer reaction on purchase providing insights to support pricing decisions.
* Conduct price benchmarking studies across competitors, identifying pricing gaps and potential opportunities for premium or tactical pricing strategies.
* Support leadership in designing region-specific pricing strategies based on market competitiveness, logistics costs, dealer margins, and customer segments.
* Monitor the relationship between price positioning and brand perception in the trade and sub-dealer/Builder/influencer ecosystem.

**4. Trade & Channel Performance Analysis**  
The Business Analyst will analyze the effectiveness and performance of the company's trade ecosystem including dealers, distributors, and retail networks.

* Evaluate dealer productivity metrics such as sales volume per dealer, growth trends, and contribution to regional sales.
* Analyze trade scheme effectiveness, including incentives, promotional programs, and dealer engagement initiatives.
* Monitor distribution network efficiency, identifying markets with inadequate dealer coverage or low penetration.
* Assess trade margin structures and incentive programs, benchmarking them against competitor offerings.
* Identify high-potential dealers and underperforming trade partners, supporting the sales team in optimizing the dealer network.
* Analyze the relationship between dealer expansion, retail coverage, and market growth to support channel strategy.

**5. Market Share Growth Strategy Analytics**  
The Business Analyst will support leadership in identifying and developing strategies to expand market share in key regions and districts.

* Conduct district-wise market share analysis comparing company performance with major competitors.
* Identify high-potential growth markets where the company can gain share through focused sales, distribution expansion, or marketing initiatives.
* Analyze competitor strengths and weaknesses across markets, including distribution coverage, dealer relationships, product positioning, and pricing strategy.
* Develop data-driven market penetration strategies targeting key customer segments such as contractors, builders, and retail dealers.
* Track the impact of marketing initiatives and sales campaigns on market share movement.
* Provide leadership with strategic recommendations to improve competitive positioning in priority markets.

**6. Pricing & Competitive Intelligence**  
Provide analytical support for pricing decisions and competitive positioning.  
Responsibilities include:

* Monitoring competitor pricing trends across markets.
* Evaluating price elasticity and impact of pricing changes on sales volumes.
* Analyzing dealer margins, trade schemes, and promotional programs across competitors.
* Preparing strategic pricing intelligence reports to support leadership decisions.

**7. Data Management & Business Reporting**  
Ensure availability of accurate, structured, and actionable data across the marketing organization.  
Key responsibilities:

* Consolidating data from ERP systems, CRM platforms, sales reports, and market intelligence sources.
* Designing automated dashboards and visualization tools using platforms such as Power BI or Tableau.
* Standardizing reporting formats for regional and national business reviews.
* Supporting management review meetings with structured analytical presentations.

**8. Strategic Decision Support**  
Act as a strategic partner to senior management by providing analytical insights that guide business decisions.  
Responsibilities include:

jobs.title: Area Manager - Credit & Operations
jobs.description:
JOB DESCRIPTIONAREA MANAGER – CREDIT & OPERATIONS

**Industry:** NBFC- Gold Loan  
**Location:** Thiruvananthapuram / Assigned Area  
**Department:** Credit & Operations  
**Reporting To:** Regional Manager / Head of Operations

1. Job Purpose

The Area Manager – Credit & Operations will be responsible for managing credit operations, customer visits, loan appraisal and approval, branch performance, business development and portfolio quality across assigned branches.

The position requires an experienced professional who can balance credit discipline with business growth, regularly visit branches, motivate employees, support customer acquisition and ensure efficient branch operations.

The Area Manager will play a key role in improving business performance across Gold Loan, Business Loan and Commercial Property Loan products.

2. Duties & Responsibilities

**A. Branch Visits & Business Development**

* Visit every assigned branch at least once a week.
* Review branch-wise business performance, loan disbursements, outstanding and collection efficiency.
* Motivate Branch Managers and employees to improve business sourcing and achieve assigned targets.
* Conduct regular meetings with branch teams to review performance and business plans.
* Identify local business opportunities and support branches in acquiring new customers.
* Participate in important customer meetings and assist branch teams in converting high-value loan proposals.
* Identify operational and business challenges and provide suitable solutions.
* Monitor staff productivity and provide guidance to improve individual performance.
* Develop strategies to improve branch business across Gold Loans, Business Loans and Commercial Property Loans.
* Submit weekly branch visit reports with observations, business updates and action plans.

**B. Customer Visits & Credit Assessment**

* Conduct regular customer visits for Business Loan and Commercial Property Loan proposals.
* Visit business premises, commercial establishments and properties to assess customer credentials and business activities.
* Evaluate customer repayment capacity, business operations and financial position.
* Independently verify information provided in loan applications and identify discrepancies.
* Meet prospective and existing customers to understand their financial requirements.
* Support branch teams in handling high-value and critical loan proposals.
* Ensure proper field verification and due diligence before recommending loan proposals.

**C. Credit Appraisal & Loan Approval**

* Review and evaluate loan applications across assigned branches.
* Assess customer eligibility, repayment capacity, income documents and credit history.
* Ensure proper assessment of collateral, property valuation and legal documentation.
* Review and approve or recommend loan proposals within delegated authority.
* Ensure adherence to credit policies, lending norms and product-specific eligibility criteria.
* Identify potential credit risks and take preventive measures.
* Ensure proper documentation and verification before loan disbursement.
* Improve credit processing turnaround time without compromising lending standards.

**D. Gold Loan Operations**

* Monitor gold loan appraisal procedures and ensure adherence to company guidelines.
* Ensure accuracy in gold purity testing, weight assessment and valuation.
* Monitor Loan-to-Value (LTV) compliance and applicable regulatory requirements.
* Conduct surprise inspections and verification of gold packets and vault procedures.
* Ensure proper custody, security and reconciliation of pledged gold ornaments.
* Monitor gold loan renewals, closures, overdue accounts and auction procedures.

**E. Business Loan & Commercial Property Loan Operations**

* Supervise credit evaluation and processing of Business Loan and Commercial Property Loan applications.
* Review financial statements, bank statements, income documents and business cash flows.
* Ensure proper property valuation, legal scrutiny and title verification for property-backed loans.
* Coordinate with legal, technical and credit teams for timely processing.
* Ensure compliance with approved lending policies and sanction conditions.
* Monitor documentation, disbursement and post-disbursement compliance.

**F. Branch Operations & Process Control**

* Monitor daily branch operations and ensure operational discipline.
* Conduct periodic branch inspections and operational audits.
* Ensure proper cash management, document custody and record maintenance.
* Review daily transactions, disbursement reports and operational MIS.
* Identify process gaps and implement corrective measures.
* Ensure adherence to internal SOPs and operational guidelines.

**G. Portfolio Monitoring, Collections & Recovery**

* Monitor branch-wise portfolio performance and overdue accounts.
* Track NPA, delinquency and collection efficiency.
* Identify early warning signals and potentially stressed accounts.
* Coordinate with Branch Managers for recovery and overdue reduction.
* Ensure timely follow-up of maturing and overdue loan accounts.
* Recommend corrective actions to improve portfolio quality.

**H. Team Management & Motivation**

* Guide, supervise and motivate Branch Managers and branch employees.
* Train branch teams on credit policies, documentation and operational procedures.
* Conduct regular performance reviews and operational training.
* Ensure accountability and adherence to defined responsibilities.
* Support branch teams in achieving business and collection targets.
* Build a customer-focused and result-oriented working culture.

**I. Compliance, Risk Management & Audit**

* Ensure compliance with applicable RBI regulations and internal policies.
* Monitor KYC, AML and customer due diligence requirements.
* Coordinate internal, concurrent and statutory audits.
* Ensure timely closure of audit observations.
* Report operational irregularities, fraud indicators and policy violations to management.
* Ensure effective implementation of risk management practices across branches.

**J. MIS & Management Reporting**

* Prepare and review branch-wise credit and operational performance reports.
* Monitor loan sanctions, disbursements, outstanding, collections and overdue positions.
* Submit periodic reports to Regional Management / Head Office.
* Analyse operational bottlenecks and recommend process improvements.
* Prepare weekly branch visit reports and follow up on pending action points.
* Support management in implementing business growth and risk management strategies.

3. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

* **Branch Visits:** Minimum one visit to every assigned branch every week.
* **Business Growth:** Improvement in branch-wise sourcing and loan disbursements.
* **Customer Visits:** Regular field visits for customer verification and credit assessment.
* **Credit Approval:** Timely appraisal and decision-making.
* **Branch Motivation:** Regular performance meetings and staff engagement.
* **Credit Quality:** Effective control over NPA and overdue accounts.
* **Gold Loan Operations:** Accuracy in appraisal, LTV compliance and gold security.
* **Operational Efficiency:** Audit scores, process adherence and documentation quality.
* **Collections:** Improvement in recovery and collection efficiency.
* **Reporting:** Timely submission of weekly and monthly MIS reports.

4. Candidate Profile

* Graduate / Postgraduate in any discipline; finance or banking qualifications preferred.
* 8–15 years of experience in Banking or NBFC operations.
* Strong experience in credit appraisal, loan operations and branch administration.
* Exposure to Gold Loans, Business Loans and Loan Against Property / Commercial Property Loans.
* Experience in handling multiple branches or geographical areas preferred.
* Good knowledge of RBI regulations, KYC, AML and credit risk management.
* Strong customer relationship, business development and team leadership skills.
* Willingness to travel regularly

jobs.description:
**Product Manager, Input Zone**

  

**About our Team:-**

DSM Product is the product management team within Data Source Management (DSM, led by Adrian Scotney), part of Data Operations (led by Kanwar Singh). It is led by the Head of Product Management and owns product management for how publisher content enters the Input Zone, Elsevier’s governed gateway for academic publisher content. This includes technical onboarding, ingestion development, publisher rights data (Salesforce) and the Platform Intelligence reporting that supports content providers.

The team is organised around three areas: Platform Intelligence (PLINT), Salesforce/SCM, and the Content Acquisition Liaisons functions that cover ingestion development and technical onboarding.

  

**About the Role:-**

The Product Manager, Input Zone will own the technical onboarding and ingestion-development activities for the Content Acquisition Liaisons group and lead execution of related workstreams. They will own the development plan for the ingestion pipeline and technical onboarding workflow, represent this area within the PM team, and have a solid understanding of content providers and publishers. They will represent their technical needs to the delivery team, prioritise and communicate production issues affecting ingestion or onboarding, and support and participate in demos to key stakeholders at programme milestones.

  

**Responsibilities:-**

  

**Customer Focus**

* Interacts with content providers, publishers, and internal engineering teams during technical onboarding and represents their requirements.

* Anticipates onboarding and ingestion needs (for example, journal processing moving to the DPOP-601 workflow and the Scopus transition off the legacy OpsBank workflow) and prioritises them for the group.

* Acts as a named Onboarding Technical Liaison, fielding technical questions from content providers and publishers during negotiation so engineering capacity stays focused on implementation.

* Focuses on meeting onboarding timelines without compromising the completeness or quality of ingested content.

**Data-Driven Decision-Making & Analysis**

* Autonomously analyses onboarding, delivery, and completeness-checking data from multiple sources (content providers, engineering, Governance reporting).

* Compares and evaluates ingestion and onboarding options, and makes recommendations that consider business implications.

* Uses AI tools responsibly to accelerate analysis, and validates the results before acting on them.

**Onboarding & Content Acquisition Lifecycle**

* Communicates technical requirements and timelines clearly to negotiation and engineering stakeholders.

* Coordinates with the LeapSpace negotiation team, system test team, and OpsBank test team on technical onboarding execution once a negotiation concludes.

* Answers internal and provider-facing questions on ingestion capability, manifest handling, and onboarding scope.

* Prioritises and communicates production issues and defects affecting ingestion or onboarding, based on relevant data.

**Product Delivery & Development Lifecycle**

* Leads execution of the development plan for the ingestion pipeline and technical onboarding workflow.

* Defines and prioritises requirement changes for engineering and performs analysis to meet acceptance criteria.

* Authors clear, testable specifications (requirements, acceptance criteria, manifest and validation rules) as the shared source of truth for engineering and AI-assisted development, in line with spec-driven development (SDD).

* Reviews AI-assisted outputs (generated specs, test cases, prototypes) against requirements and is accountable for their quality before they reach engineering.

* Participates in product discovery and process improvement, and contributes to prototypes (for example, content provider manifest ingestion and PDF identification).

* Is familiar with SDLCs identified by management, for example agile processes.

**Strategy & Commercial Acumen**

* Contributes to the strategy and development plans for ingestion and technical onboarding, shared across the roles carrying the Onboarding Technical Liaison responsibility.

* Understands the operating cost and effort involved in onboarding a new content provider or source.

* Makes links between personal goals and the team and business strategy.

**Technical Skills**

* Understands the Input Zone's data and technical architecture — publisher drop zones, ingestion validation, and the downstream handoff — well enough to liaise credibly with engineering.

* Uses technologies to assist day-to-day tasks (Excel, SQL, Jira, Confluence; familiarity with Salesforce/Snowflake rights data flows and sFTP/S3 publisher landing zones).

* Has working experience with generative AI tools and AI-assisted development workflows (for example prompt design, specification-to-code generation, AI-supported testing) and understands their limitations, including accuracy, data confidentiality, and publisher-content handling.

* Ability to engage developers to understand technology constraints.

**Competencies**

**Personal Capability**

**Practices Self-Development**

* Is curious and keen to learn and develop new ideas, skills, and knowledge.

* Acts on feedback to improve him/herself.

* Looks for developmental opportunities in day-to-day work.

* Invests time and energy in self-development (professional qualifications, relevant reading, networking, keeping up with AI-assisted product and development practices).

**Solves Problems and Analyses Issues**

* Is able to ask effective questions and collect facts from multiple sources in order to solve problems.

* Is able to effectively identify and analyse problems and propose solutions.

* Effectively manages day-to-day issues and problems without intervention.

**Innovates**

* Brainstorms with others to look for different approaches to current processes and tasks.

* Looks for opportunities to develop new ideas or thinking within own role.

* Experiments with new ideas, including applying AI and SDD to onboarding and ingestion workflows, and shares what works with the team.

**Interpersonal Skills**

**Communicates Powerfully and Prolifically**

* Demonstrates effective conversational skills, including active listening and questioning.

* Shares information relevant to own role.

* Participates in team presentations.

**Collaboration and Teamwork**

* Develops co-operative working relationships within the team.

* Considers how own style affects others and tailors interactions accordingly.

* Looks for ways to develop mutually beneficial relationships across teams.

**Builds Relationships**

* Is approachable and friendly.

* Asks for opinions of others.

* Participates in formal and informal gatherings to meet new people and develop new relationships.

**Inspires and Motivates Others to High Performance**

* Brings enthusiasm to the team.

* Gets to know others in the team and what is important to them.

* Observes behaviours and models self after others.

* Leads by example by performing at high levels.

**Focus on Results**

**Drives for Results**

* Works hard to achieve objectives.

* Stays focused on key commitments.

* Looks to overcome obstacles or barriers to performing.

* Works with others to achieve joint goals.
  

**Requirements:** -

**Suggested minimum years of PM experience:** 4-6 years

**Critical Experiences**

* Recognised as full owner of a technical onboarding, ingestion, or comparable technical-liaison feature area.

* Demonstrated ability to manage multiple tasks, projects, and priorities, and to work with engineers, content providers, publishers, or negotiation teams to modify or maintain a product and identify technology challenges.

* Hands-on experience applying AI tools in product management work, such as specification writing, analysis, or prototyping.

* Experience writing or working from specifications in a spec-driven or specification-first delivery mod

------------

------------------

The Senior Manager, Business Governance & Controls (BG&C), leads the first-line operational risk and control agenda for the Bengaluru GCC. The role establishes a consistent and effective risk and control environment aligned with ANZ’s Risk Appetite and enterprise risk framework, while ensuring business and functional leaders retain clear ownership of their risks and controls.

  

As the senior risk partner to the GCC Head and GCC Leadership Team, the role provides independent-minded advice and constructive challenge, strengthens risk culture and operational resilience, and enables well-informed business decisions. The role also leads the continuous improvement of control testing, assurance insights and governance reporting across the GCC.

  

Banking is changing and we’re changing with it, giving our people great opportunities to try new things, learn and grow. Whatever your role at ANZ, you’ll be building your future, while helping to build ours.

  

**Role Type: Full Time, Permanent**  
**Role Location: Bengaluru**

**What will your day look like?**
---------------------------------

As a Senior Manager, BG&C, you will:

  

* Develop and execute the GCC first-line risk and control strategy, aligned with ANZ’s Risk Appetite, enterprise risk framework and relevant regulatory obligations.
* Establish and maintain a consistent GCC-wide approach to identifying, assessing, managing, monitoring and reporting operational and compliance risks, with clear business ownership of risks and controls.
* Act as the senior risk partner to the GCC Head and GCC Leadership Team, providing timely advice, evidence-based insights and constructive challenge to support informed decision-making.
* Lead GCC-wide risk assessments across operational, technology, cyber, data, third-party, people, conduct, regulatory and change risks, ensuring material exposures and emerging themes are identified and addressed.
* Oversee the GCC operational resilience agenda, including first-line oversight of critical operations, material service providers, intra group arrangements, business continuity and key dependency or concentration risks.
* Coordinate GCC implementation of relevant enterprise and regulatory risk requirements, including PACT, NFR framework changes and CPS 230-related obligations, in partnership with Group Risk and specialist teams.
* Lead the design, uplift and consistent application of control testing methodologies, quality benchmarks, documentation standards and review practices across GCC teams and portfolios.
* Champion data-led and automated testing approaches where appropriate, ensuring enhancements are well governed, scalable and improve the quality and efficiency of assurance outcomes.
* Synthesise risk assessments and control testing outcomes into clear, prioritised insights for the GCC Leadership Team and relevant governance forums, including transparent escalation of material weaknesses, systemic issues and non-compliance risks.

* Oversee the quality and progress of remediation, challenging whether actions address root causes and provide sufficient evidence of sustainable closure, while retaining accountability with the relevant business owner.
* Lead first-line coordination of internal, external and in-country audits for the GCC, ensuring effective business engagement, timely responses and disciplined tracking of agreed actions.

* Lead and develop the BG&C team, ensuring effective resourcing, clear priorities and the skills and capability required to meet current and future GCC needs.
* Drive continuous improvement of the GCC risk and control environment, supporting business, process, systems and automation changes while ensuring associated risks are understood and appropriately managed.

* Analytical capability to interpret data, identify patterns, and translate findings into actionable insights.

* Ability to assess control adequacy and effectiveness, including root‑cause analysis and evidence evaluation.
* Stakeholder engagement and relationship‑building skills, with confidence to challenge constructively.
* Planning and prioritisation skills to manage testing cycles, competing workloads, and quality standards.
* Experience delivering control testing, quality assurance, or risk assessment activities in a regulated environment.
* Demonstrated involvement in analysing business processes and identifying control gaps or compliance issues.
* Strong understanding of risk management and operational risk
* Strong communication skills, with the ability to lead discussions and partner effectively with stakeholders across geographies
* Knowledge of banking processes and/or products
* Extensive experience in enterprise risk management and/or leadership roles within the banking, financial services or KPO sectors
* Knowledge of retail banking products and processes
* Demonstrated experience in risk and compliance management
* Strong stakeholder management
* Demonstrated experience in people leadership and capability development

**‘****Good to have’ knowledge, skills and experiences**

  

* ERP systems and Risk toolkits
* PACT
* Proficient in Microsoft Office Programs
* Business and Executive Report Writing

  

**Qualifications**

  

* Relevant tertiary qualifications

**Job Description**
Vice President, Restructuring
  
  
**Location:**
Dubai, United Arab Emirates
  
  
**About Jefferies**
Jefferies is a leading global, full-service investment banking and capital markets firm, delivering strategic advisory, financing and capital markets solutions to corporate, sponsor and institutional clients worldwide.
  
  
Our Restructuring and Liability Management Advisory practice advises companies, shareholders, lenders, sovereign-related entities and other stakeholders on complex capital structure challenges, balance sheet optimisation, distressed situations, recapitalisations and strategic alternatives. As activity across the Middle East continues to evolve, we are looking to expand our Dubai-based team with the addition of an experienced Vice President.
  
  
The Opportunity
  
  
This is a unique opportunity to join a growing franchise and play a leading role in advising clients across the Middle East, North Africa and broader EMEA region on complex restructuring, liability management and special situations transactions.
  
  
The successful candidate will work directly with senior bankers and clients, leading transaction execution while helping to develop and grow Jefferies' restructuring advisory presence across the region.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Lead the execution of restructuring, refinancing, recapitalisation, liability management and distressed M&A mandates across the Middle East and broader EMEA region.
* Manage all aspects of transaction execution, including financial analysis, stakeholder coordination, due diligence and project management.
* Develop and review complex financial models, liquidity analyses, business plans, capital structure assessments and valuation materials.
* Prepare high-quality client presentations, strategic reviews, board materials and transaction documentation.
* Work closely with corporate clients, financial institutions, sovereign-related entities, private equity sponsors and creditor groups.
* Support Managing Directors in business development efforts, market coverage and origination activities.
* Identify and evaluate new restructuring and special situations opportunities across the region.
* Lead and mentor Analysts and Associates, ensuring high-quality work product and professional development.
* Coordinate effectively with legal advisers, accounting firms, lenders, investors and other external stakeholders throughout transaction processes.

Requirements
  
  

* 6-10+ years of relevant experience within an investment bank, restructuring advisory practice, financial advisory firm or leading professional services organisation.
* Strong transaction experience across restructuring advisory, special situations, leveraged finance, debt advisory or corporate finance.
* Excellent financial modelling, valuation and analytical skills.
* Strong understanding of debt products, capital structures, credit markets and restructuring solutions.
* Proven ability to manage multiple workstreams and execute transactions in a fast-paced environment.
* Experience interacting with senior management teams, boards, lenders and investors.
* Exceptional presentation, communication and stakeholder management skills.
* Strong leadership capabilities with experience managing and developing junior team members.
* Bachelor's degree in Finance, Economics, Accounting or a related discipline.

**About Us**
Jefferies is a leading global, full-service investment banking and capital markets firm that provides advisory, sales and trading, research, and wealth and asset management services. With more than 40 offices around the world, we offer insights and expertise to investors, companies, and governments.

We have made a commitment to building a culture that provides opportunities for all employees regardless of our differences and supports a workforce that is reflective of the communities where we work and live. As a result, we are able to pool our collective insights and intelligence to provide fresh and innovative thinking for our clients.
  
  
Jefferies is an equal employment opportunity employer, and takes affirmative action to ensure that all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, creed, color, national origin, ancestry, religion, gender, pregnancy, age, physical or mental disability, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, veteran or military status, genetic information, reproductive health decisions, or any other factor protected by applicable law. As part of this commitment, Jefferies will extend reasonable accommodations to individuals with disabilities, as required by applicable law.

jobs.description:
**Job Description**

**Organization Unit Purpose**

The Precious Metals business originates, structures and delivers physical and financial precious metals solutions for the Bank’s corporate, institutional, commercial and wealth clients. The unit connects client coverage with trading, structuring, operations, legal, credit and compliance capabilities to build a scalable, well-controlled and profitable bullion franchise across the UAE and ENBDs network markets.

**Job Purpose**

The Director – Precious Metals Sales is responsible for originating and growing precious metals revenue by developing client relationships and delivering solutions across physical bullion, price-risk management, financing and investment products. The role leads opportunity identification, solution design and transaction execution while ensuring suitability, documentation, conduct, operational readiness and risk requirements are fully satisfied.

The job holder will contribute to the strategic development of the Bank’s precious metals franchise, deepen wallet share across existing relationships, acquire new-to-bank flows, and position the Bank as a trusted regional liquidity, financing and physical bullion partner.

**Job Content**

**Sales strategy and revenue delivery:**
Develop and execute a client and product sales plan to achieve annual revenue, volume, profitability and franchise objectives. Maintain a disciplined pipeline, identify white-space opportunities and convert prospects into recurring business.

**Client origination and relationship management:**
Build senior relationships with banks, refiners, bullion traders, jewellery groups, retailers, family offices, sovereign-linked entities and large corporates. Lead account planning with relationship teams and coordinate multi-product engagement.

**Physical bullion solutions:**
Originate and execute outright sales and purchases of allocated or unallocated gold and silver, minted and investment products, consignment, deferred-payment structures, import/export flows, custody and vault-related solutions, subject to approved product and risk frameworks.

**Hedging and investment solutions:**
Advise clients on precious metals price-risk management and investment requirements using approved spot, forward, swap, option and structured solutions. Translate market views into suitable, executable ideas without compromising conduct or suitability standards.

**Financing and balance-sheet solutions:**
Partner with structuring, credit and relationship teams on gold loans, bullion repo, inventory or transit financing, collateralised structures and other approved precious metals financing solutions.

**End-to-end transaction leadership:**
Coordinate pricing, credit, documentation, KYC, sanctions screening, logistics, insurance, settlement, vaulting and post-trade follow-up. Escalate execution risks early and ensure responsibilities are clearly assigned.

**Market intelligence and franchise development:**
Monitor precious metals markets, regional physical premiums, competitor activity, regulation, refining and supply-chain developments. Provide actionable intelligence to clients and management and support new product, corridor and partnership development.

**Governance, risk and controls:**
Operate within approved mandates and policies covering market, credit, legal, operational, conduct, financial-crime and reputational risk. Maintain complete records and ensure transactions meet relevant internal approvals and regulatory requirements.

**Cross-functional collaboration and leadership:**
Work closely with trading, structuring, research, operations, finance, legal, compliance, credit and coverage teams. Share product knowledge, support joint client meetings, coach junior team members and strengthen a collaborative sales culture.

Achieve financial targets

Originate profitable client flows, manage the opportunity pipeline and deliver an appropriate mix of recurring and strategic transactions.

Expand client franchise

Build account plans, conduct regular senior client engagement and create cross-sell opportunities with coverage teams.

Deliver execution excellence

Lead transactions from idea through settlement, align internal stakeholders and resolve issues promptly.

Build strategic capability

Identify market gaps, support product development and establish scalable routes to market across priority jurisdictions.

Maintain strong controls

Ensure suitability, approvals, documentation, KYC, sanctions, credit and operational controls are completed before execution.

Strengthening team and connectivity

Share market and product expertise, support junior colleagues and improve coordination across sales, trading and support functions.

**Education**

* Bachelor’s degree in finance, economics, business, engineering or a related discipline.
* Postgraduate qualifications are advantageous.
* CFA, FRM or relevant treasury/commodities qualifications.

**Experiences**

Minimum 10 years of relevant banking, precious metals experience, including a strong record in client-facing sales and revenue generation. Experience with physical bullion and/or precious metals derivatives is required.

**Knowledge & Skills**

* Strong knowledge of gold and silver markets, physical supply chains, spot/forward/swap pricing, hedging, financing and settlement conventions.
* Understanding of vaulting, logistics, custody and refining ecosystems is highly desirable.
* Demonstrated ability to originate opportunities, build senior relationships, negotiate commercial terms, manage a pipeline and convert complex requirements into executable solutions.

**Behavioral Competencies**

* Client centricity and trusted-adviser mindset
* Commercial judgement and revenue orientation
* Precious metals market expertise
* Strategic thinking and market development
* Negotiation and influencing
* Execution discipline and attention to detail
* Risk awareness, integrity and control ownership
* Collaboration, leadership and talent development

It also goes without saying that we provide extremely competitive rewards, benefits and perks too, like our flexible work policy so you can work from home whenever it suits.

* Speak for Credit Management on the Credit Committee and in regulatory discussions
* Act as the main link between the business, risk, legal, finance and operations teams, and help train staff to build a strong risk culture

**Candidate Requirements:**

* Postgraduate qualification or professional certification in finance or risk (e.g. MBA, CFA, FRM, CA) is preferred
* Minimum of 15+ years in banking, much of it in counterparty or traded credit risk, with several years leading teams
* Deep practical knowledge of treasury and capital markets products, including derivatives, FX and securities financing
* Solid understanding of how counterparty exposure is measured and how Basel-related capital rules apply to it
* Proven experience with collateral and margining arrangements and with standard trading documentation
* A track record of assessing a wide range of counterparties, such as banks, sovereigns, corporates and clearing houses, across several countries

jobs.description:
**Discover your future at Citi**

Working at Citi is far more than just a job. A career with us means joining a team of approximately 219,000 dedicated people from around the globe. At Citi, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your career, give back to your community and make a real impact.

**Job Overview**
----------------

**Role Description:**

This role is responsible for the ongoing monthly testing of the Quality Assurance program for all Wealth clients records in UAE. The Post Execution Quality process is a key risk indicator that is reported to the regulators monthly. The PEQ process is reviewed numerous times a year by Regulators, Internal Audit and Compliance Testing to ensure adherence to regulatory and Citi-wide policies and standards. This role is responsible to test the Post Execution Quality accuracy to ensure all KYC Quality reporting is in line with our regulatory commitments to the OCC. This role is responsible for independently testing each PEQ analyst and report all findings to the Head of Wealth KYC Quality for effective oversight of personnel.

  
  

**Responsibilities:**

This role is critical in identifying any quality deficiencies immediately, raise self-identified issues for proper oversight and execution on the correction action plans in a timely manner. Without this role and process, KYC could introduce significant risks related to regulatory and internal audit findings for insufficient KYC program and controls. These results would lead to significant remediation population, remediation populations, procedures changes or even MRA (Matters Requiring Attention) if identified by a regulator.

Partner with internal units to ensure adequate due diligence process is carried out for customer accounts and documentation reviews.

Ensure all information and documentation comply with local regulation and Citi standards.

Ensure all AML risks are mitigated based on local regulation and internal procedural requirements.

Review all screening activities and making sure all true, false, and potential matches are dispositioned correctly including sanctions related activities, if applicable.

Update and review forms according to local regulation requirements and work with Compliance to expedite documentation reviews, providing clarification as needed.

Appropriately assess and verify CIP requirements based on internal and global requirements.

Strong understanding of wealth holding vehicles which includes the various structures, legality, and documentation for each type of entity.

Participate and assist with the organization of weekly meetings and calls to discuss “Sustainability and Remediation” population.

Appropriately assessing risk when business decisions are made, demonstrating particular consideration for the firm's reputation and safeguarding Citigroup, its clients and assets, by driving compliance with applicable laws, rules and regulations, adhering to Policy, applying sound ethical judgment regarding personal behavior, conduct and business practices, and escalating, managing and reporting control issues with transparency.

jobs.description:
**Our Purpose**

Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*
**Title And Summary**
Director, Technical Program Management’
  
  
**Overview**
Mastercard is a global technology company in the payments industry. Our mission is to connect and power an inclusive, digital economy that benefits everyone, everywhere by making transactions safe, simple, smart, and accessible. Using secure data and networks, partnerships and passion, our innovations and solutions help individuals, financial institutions, governments, and businesses realize their greatest potential. Our decency quotient, or DQ, drives our culture and everything we do inside and outside of our company. With connections across more than 210 countries and territories, we are building a sustainable world that unlocks priceless possibilities for all.
  
  
Mastercard’s Business & Market Insights (B&MI) group empowers organizations to achieve growth & innovation goals by providing unparalleled data-driven insights and advanced analytics. By leveraging proprietary data and global expertise, B&MI helps businesses make smarter, more informed decisions that drive profitability and success. We turn complex data into actionable strategies that lead to better outcomes and sustained competitive advantage.
  
  
We are currently looking for a ‘Director, Technical Program Management’ for Payment Reconciliation Intelligence program within B&MI, to provide program management leadership, cutting across different product areas.
  
  
**Roles And Responsibilities**

* Successfully lead major projects and complex assignments with broad scope and long-term business implications. Collaborate with business and technical partners to scope the opportunities, outline potential value and ROI, and identify risks, benefits and constraints.
* Be the owner for all Program-level initiatives while also ensuring success of individual delivery teams. Provide people leadership to technical program managers across the program.
* Assist in examining commercially available and forthcoming industry technologies related to area of expertise. Research on current and upcoming technologies and application frameworks and provide recommendations. Proactively create and maintain solution and technology roadmaps.
* Create detailed cost and time estimates for implementing business solutions, define technical scope and requirements of the project and assist your team with managing scope during the lifecycle of the project. Identify Program quality methodologies, define and track quality metrics and ensure continued process quality improvement within the program.
* Manage multiple scrum teams and be responsible to organize and lead all Agile/SAFe ceremonies. Be accountable for overall progress of the committed projects and enhance processes to streamline deliveries. Champion in tracking initiatives progress/reports using Agile project management tools such as Jira, Rally.
* Develop good technical understanding of product architecture & flows and be able to propose technical solutions. Possess hands-on technical capabilities to track, analyse or resolve critical issues and customer queries.
* Effectively manage internal and external stakeholders and participate in technical discussions as a program representative.
* Help customers and the product/engineering teams make trade-off decisions by considering all the data including business goals, technical platform strategy, customer experience and maintainability. You identify blocking issues and manage their resolution.

  
  
**All About You**

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science or engineering or equivalent work experience, with a proven track-record of successfully leading and managing complex programs/projects/products.
* Advanced level understanding of Agile/SAFe methodologies with a demonstrated experience in organizing Agile/SAFe ceremonies, planning program & iteration deliverables, leading scrum meetings, managing cost & effort estimation and driving prioritization discussions.
* A solid foundation in Computer Science, with prior hands-on experience on .Net stack and/or Java stack (preferably on web applications and microservices-based software architecture and with an exposure to cloud technologies). Strong SQL skills would be a huge plus.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities, with quick adaptation to new technologies, methodologies, and systems.
* Excellent English communication skills (both written and verbal) and experience with managing internal and external stakeholders at all management levels.
* High-energy, detail-oriented and proactive, with ability to function under pressure in an independent environment along with a high degree of initiative and self-motivation to drive results.

**Corporate Security Responsibility**
All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:
  
  

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

jobs.title: Director-Technology Controls Testing Team Lead
jobs.description:
**Why Mizuho**

At Mizuho, we provide the stability of an international industry leader with the career trajectory of a growing business. **Profile Summary:**

The Technology Controls Team Lead leads the India-based Chief Technology Controls Team and the EMEA Technology Internal Control Testing Programme.

The role is responsible for the risk-based assessment of technology controls, including control design and operating effectiveness testing, evidence quality, issue identification, remediation monitoring and management reporting. The role also develops data-led, automated and continuous control-assurance capabilities.

Working across EMEA Technology, the role partners with control owners, Technology leadership and relevant oversight and assurance functions to strengthen the technology control environment while maintaining clear accountability across the three lines of defense.

**Technology Controls Framework and Testing:**

* Own and maintain the EMEA Technology Controls Testing Framework.
* Lead the Technology Internal Control Testing Programme, including methodology, planning, scope, approval, execution, quality assurance and reporting.
* Develop a risk-based testing plan using RCSA results, process mapping, risk appetite measures, incidents, control failures, audit findings, regulatory priorities and material technology changes.
* Prioritize controls associated with Critical and High inherent risks, while including Moderate-rated controls where justified by risk concentration, limited assurance coverage, control failures or emerging risk.
* Maintain a technology testing inventory covering control ownership, risk linkage, testing frequency, previous results, existing assurance coverage and open issues.
* Lead control walkthroughs and assessments of control design and operating effectiveness.
* Define testing methods, evidence requirements, sampling approaches and quality standards.
* Ensure conclusions are supported by complete, reliable and traceable evidence.
* Coordinate with IT Risk Assurance lead on SOX, Compliance, Head Office and other assurance programmes to minimize unnecessary duplication.
* Continuously improve testing methodology, guidance, templates and supporting tools.

**Issues and Remediation:**

* Ensure control deficiencies, self-identified issues, risk acceptances and treatment plans are consistently identified, recorded and escalated.
* Challenge control ownership, testing conclusions, remediation plans and proposed issue closure.
* Ensure remediation actions have clear owners and target dates.
* Monitor remediation through to closure and arrange validation or retesting where required.
* Identify recurring or systemic control weaknesses requiring coordinated remediation.
* Escalate material control failures, overdue actions and risk appetite breaches through the appropriate governance channels.

**Audit and Regulatory Readiness:**

* Coordinate Technology responses to internal audit, external audit, SOX and regulatory assurance activity.
* Maintain a coordinated view of assurance activity, findings, evidence requests, management responses and remediation commitments.
* Improve the quality and timeliness of evidence, walkthroughs and management responses.
* Maintain a reusable regional evidence base to support assurance activity.
* Ensure recurring audit and regulatory themes inform the control framework, testing plan and remediation priorities.
* Support senior-management and regulatory briefings on material technology control matters.

**Reporting and Governance:**

* Own management information covering technology control testing delivery, control effectiveness, issues, remediation, risk acceptances and recurring themes.
* Provide concise, accurate and decision-oriented reporting to Technology leadership and relevant governance forums.
* Act as the central escalation and prioritisation point for Technology control-testing matters.
* Represent the Chief Technology Controls Team at relevant committees and working groups.
* Ensure material control weaknesses and risks are escalated promptly and transparently.

**Data, Tools and Continuous Assurance:**

* Own the Technology Controls testing toolset, workflows, dashboards and analytics capability.
* Ensure testing plans, evidence, samples, conclusions, issues and remediation records are accurately maintained in approved repositories.
* Establish standards for evidence quality, naming, ownership, version control, retention, permissions and audit traceability.
* Lead evidence coordination and quality review with process and control owners.
* Develop automated monitoring and continuous control-testing capabilities where supported by reliable data and repeatable testing logic.
* Define appropriate governance for automated testing, including data quality, access, change control, exception handling and periodic validation.
* Explore the responsible use of AI to support evidence review, control mapping, testing preparation, exception identification, thematic analysis and reporting.
* Ensure that automation and AI retain appropriate governance, validation and human oversight.

**Leadership and People Management:**

* Lead and develop the India-based Chief Technology Controls Team, initially comprising three VP-level control resources.
* Set team priorities and allocate coverage according to risk, assurance requirements and business demand.
* Lead implementation of the target operating model.
* Establish clear objectives, accountabilities and quality expectations.
* Build team capability through training, coaching and knowledge management.
* Promote a constructive, evidence-led risk and control culture.
* Provide broader local Technology Management or Operations oversight only where formally assigned.

**Decision Authority (Within delegated authority, the role may):**

* Approve the proposed testing plan and material scope changes before governance submission.
* Determine testing methods, evidence requirements, sampling approaches and quality standards.
* Require additional evidence, expanded testing or retesting.
* Escalate material control failures, overdue remediation and inadequate risk acceptance.
* Prioritise team activity and allocate testing resources.
* Recommend control improvements and automation opportunities.
  ***Control owners remain accountable for operating their controls and remediating identified weaknesses. Risk acceptance remains subject to approval under the applicable risk-management framework.***

**Experience and Skills:**

* Significant experience in technology risk, technology controls, IT audit, cyber risk or a related discipline within regulated financial services.
* Experience leading a technology control-testing or management-assurance programme.
* Strong knowledge of control design and operating effectiveness testing, including walkthroughs, evidence assessment, sampling, reperformance and issue validation.
* Experience of RCSA, risk appetite, issue management, risk acceptance and governance reporting.
* Broad understanding of material technology risks and controls.
* Experience supporting audits, regulatory reviews or SOX activity.
* Proven leadership of senior risk or control professionals.
* Strong analytical, written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to challenge constructively and explain complex control matters to senior management.
* Ability to work effectively across jurisdictions and multicultural teams.
