jobs.title: Principal Consultant / Program Lead – Process & Organization Transformation
jobs.description:
Principal Consultant / Program Lead – Process & Organization Transformation
  

**Experience:**
10 to 15 years

**Location:**
Pune
  
  

**About Aligned Automation**

At Aligned Automation, we live by our "Better Together" philosophy to build a better world. We digitally enable business strategy by connecting processes, technologies and people to unlock value and drive critical business outcomes. Our culture is rooted in our 4Cs – Care, Courage, Curiosity and Collaboration – so every employee is empowered to grow, innovate and thrive in an inclusive workplace.

Role Overview
  
  
  

We are seeking a seasoned transformation leader to own the process, organization and program-delivery side of large digital transformation engagements. You will be the trusted advisor to senior customer stakeholders, lead Business Analysts and Program Managers, and translate business goals into process designs, operating models and executable programs. The ideal candidate can move between executive conversations and detailed technical discussions, keeping customer needs and technical implementation aligned. Prior work with large enterprises or government organizations is strongly preferred.

Key Responsibilities
  
  
  
• Lead end-to-end process discovery, current-state mapping, gap analysis and future-state process creation across complex, multi-department environments.
  
• Define the target operating model, including organization structure, role design, spans and layers, governance and decision rights.
  
• Own staffing and capacity methodology: workload-based FTE models, manpower rationalization and headcount justification presented to customer leadership.
  
• Serve as program lead or senior BA on digital transformation programs: scope, roadmap, budget, risk, benefits tracking and stakeholder governance.
  
• Engage directly with customer senior leadership (directors, VPs, CXOs, government officials) through steering committees, executive reviews and workshops.
  
• Lead conflict resolution and escalation handling: resolve disagreements between business, IT and vendor teams, and secure agreement on trade-offs.
  
• Shape proposals, statements of work and solution approaches with sales and practice leadership; contribute to pre-sales and client presentations.
  
• Review and assure the quality of BA and process deliverables (BRDs, process maps, SOPs, RACI, change plans).
  
• Mentor and build a team of consultants, BAs and program managers; set standards and reusable frameworks for the practice.
  
• Drive change management and adoption so new processes and structures are sustained after go-live.
  
• Work with technology, automation and data teams to keep solution design consistent with approved process and organizational changes.
  
  
Required Qualifications
  
  
  
• Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Business or a related field; MBA or equivalent Master's degree preferred.
  
• 10+ years of experience in process consulting, business analysis, program management or transformation leadership.
  
• Proven track record in process mapping, gap analysis, process creation, organization structuring and staffing calculations on large programs.
  
• Experience leading digital transformation engagements as BA lead or Program Manager, with direct customer-facing ownership.
  
• Demonstrated success communicating with senior customer executives and resolving conflict and escalations.
  
• Experience managing and mentoring teams of consultants or analysts.
  
• Exceptional communication, stakeholder management and leadership skills.
  
• Ability to translate technical complexity into actionable business outcomes.
  
  
Preferred Qualifications
  
  
  
• Substantial experience with large enterprises or government / public-sector organizations.
  
• Certifications such as PMP, PgMP, PRINCE2, CBAP, Lean Six Sigma Black Belt, or SAFe.
  
• Experience with enterprise transformation involving ERP, RPA, workflow automation or process mining.
  
• Pre-sales, proposal-writing and practice-building experience.
  
• Domain exposure to procurement, supply chain, manufacturing, shared services, or infrastructure and construction programs.

jobs.title: USI-EH27-Consulting-FT-BF-Anaplan-Manager, Functional Transformation
jobs.description:
**Summary**
**Position Summary**
**Finance Transformation**
Join our Finance Transformation practice to help Deloitte client service teams define and execute Finance and Global Business Services agendas and strategies. You will work with world-class teams and insights, helping support delivery in challenging environments, market uncertainty, technology development, and regulatory considerations to help unlock value. Your work may span strategy, operations, process design, and technology as we collaborate with teams to enable transforming finance.
  
  
**Level: Anaplan Manager**
As a Manager at Deloitte Consulting, you will oversee the technical delivery of enterprise-scale software solutions, lead cross-functional and global teams and mentor junior members. You will collaborate to understand functional requirements, support sales and proposal efforts, and drive end-to-end project delivery, including estimation and planning, to ensure successful outcomes.
  
  
**Work you'll do**
As a Manager, Functional Transformation on the Business Finance team, you will be responsible for:
  
  

* Lead end-to-end delivery of Anaplan implementations, including solution architecture, estimation, planning, quality management, and deployment.
* Manage project scope, staffing, timelines, risks, issues, and delivery execution across cross-functional and global teams.
* Serve as a primary client contact, provide strategic guidance, and align solution delivery with business objectives.
* Mentor and develop team members, support knowledge sharing, and help build Anaplan delivery capability across the practice.
* Contribute to practice development through go-to-market support, proposal activity, thought leadership, and capability-building initiatives.

**The team**
Business Finance is part of the Finance Transformation portfolio within Deloitte US India Consulting. Our team advises and implements digital finance strategies and technology solutions, helping clients enhance financial planning, analysis, and enterprise performance through a holistic approach from strategy to technology enablement.
  
  
**Location: Bengaluru / Hyderabad / Pune / Chennai**
**Qualifications**
**Required:**

* B. Tech or equivalent from an accredited university (required) / Master’s degree (preferred)
* 10+ years of experience delivering Anaplan implementations, including model design, development, deployment, and Hypercare.
* Experience leading large-scale, multi-phase Anaplan programs across business functions or geographies.
* Experience translating business requirements into multidimensional Anaplan models.
* Experience integrating Anaplan with enterprise systems such as SAP, Oracle, or Workday using native capabilities, application programming interfaces (APIs), or middleware tools.
* Experience conducting user acceptance testing (UAT) and preparing design, test, training, and administration documentation.
* Anaplan Certified Model Builder Level 1, Level 2, Anaplan Way, Level 3, and Anaplan Certified Solution Architect credentials.
* Bachelor of Technology (B. Tech) or equivalent from an accredited university.

**Preferred:**

* Anaplan Certified Master Anaplanner credential.
* Anaplan Data Orchestrator (ADO) certification.
* Experience supporting Anaplan Center of Excellence (CoE) initiatives, including governance, security, model standards, and model lifecycle management.
* Experience with Anaplan PlanIQ, Optimizer, Workflow, or Anaplan XL.
* Experience supporting request for proposal (RFP) responses for Anaplan solution opportunities.
* Master's degree.

**Our purpose**
Deloitte’s purpose is to make an impact that matters for our people, clients, and communities. At Deloitte, purpose is synonymous with how we work every day. It defines who we are. Our purpose comes through in our work with clients that enables impact and value in their organizations, as well as through our own investments, commitments, and actions across areas that help drive positive outcomes for our communities.
  
  
**Our people and culture**
Our inclusive culture empowers our people to be who they are, contribute their unique perspectives, and make a difference individually and collectively. It enables us to leverage different ways of thinking, ideas and perspectives, and bring more creativity and innovation to help solve our clients’ most complex challenges. This makes Deloitte one of the most rewarding places to work.
  
  
**Professional development**
At Deloitte, professionals have the opportunity to work with some of the best and discover what works best for them. Here, we prioritize professional growth, offering diverse learning and networking opportunities to help accelerate careers and enhance leadership skills. Our state-of-the-art DU: The Leadership Center in India, located in Hyderabad, represents a tangible symbol of our commitment to the holistic growth and development of our people. Explore DU: The Leadership Center in India .
  
  
**Benefits To Help You Thrive**
At Deloitte, we know that great people make a great organization. Our comprehensive rewards program helps us deliver a distinctly Deloitte experience that helps that empowers our professionals to thrive mentally, physically, and financially—and live their purpose. To support our professionals and their loved ones, we offer a broad range of benefits. Eligibility requirements may be based on role, tenure, type of employment and/ or other criteria. Learn more about what working at Deloitte can mean for you.
  
  
**Recruiting tips**
From developing a stand out resume to putting your best foot forward in the interview, we want you to feel prepared and confident as you explore opportunities at Deloitte. Check out recruiting tips from Deloitte recruiters.

* Coordinate risk assessment activities to identify security gaps within Azure workloads and associated payment services then translate findings into prioritized remediation plans with measurable outcomes.
* Provide direction for establishing program wide security governance structures including policies standards and procedures that embed Azure security practices into everyday operations and decision making.
* Align program deliverables with organizational strategy by ensuring that Azure security investments support long term growth improved customer trust and efficient digital payment experiences.
* Manage stakeholder expectations by communicating program status risks and achievements through concise narratives and dashboards that highlight progress toward secure cloud and payment transformation goals.

* Mentor senior program managers and technical leads by sharing best practices in strategic leadership Azure security risk management and stakeholder engagement to build strong succession pipelines.

**Qualifications**

This role drives the roadmap for enterprise resource planning, ensuring that the SAP landscape is not just a system of record, but a driver of operational excellence and real-time visibility.

* Exploring Business Technology Platform (BTP) capabilities, including AI-driven forecasting and automated financial closing.
* Architect end to end SAP solutions, ensuring robust integration across core modules (FICO, SD, MM, PP, QM, PM, PS) and connected platforms such as BlackLine, HighRadius, OneSource, Concur, Kinaxis, SAP SAC, HFM & WMS systems.
* Manage global vendors, Managed Service Providers (MSPs), and offshore delivery teams, driving accountability and adherence to SLAs and quality standards.

The experience we're looking for

* Deep understanding of end to end manufacturing processes including planning, production execution and quality management with proven ability to design and deliver SAP solutions that optimize manufacturing efficiency and operational performance.

* Strong experience collaborating with global process owners and regional teams to deliver compliant global solutions and country-specific localizations.

The skills for success
  
  
SAP Solution Design, SAP Implementation, Business Processes, Functional Expertise , Functional Architecture, SAP Digital Transformation, SAP FICO, SAP Supply Chain, S/4 HANA, Migration, Manufacturing process, End to End SAP Implementation

For eligible roles, we also offer short-term incentives to recognise, appreciate and reward your work for delivering outstanding results. With deep platform expertise and a strong focus on business outcomes, we work with some of India's most complex and strategic organisations — making a real global impact from one of Salesforce's highest-priority growth markets.

You see risk before it lands and leave the portfolio and the team stronger than you found them. Keeping a project green is not enough.

  
  

**What You'll Actually Be Doing:**

* Program and portfolio governance: Own program governance, value-realization and recovery plans for strategic accounts, across multi-cloud and enterprise AI roadmaps in Indian FS (lending, onboarding, servicing, collections). * People leadership: You have led pre-sales and delivery teams across geographies and cultures. You support learning, career growth, well-being, and diversity and inclusion. You coach people toward becoming well-rounded leaders and manage a workable span of control.
* Methodology and mindset:You have mastered Agile and Hybrid delivery, adapting these frameworks to the iterative testing loops of generative AI. As a self-starter, you will lead consultants and influence stakeholders across a matrixed organization. From a management perspective, you will champion an AI-First engineering methodology while tracking program health, team velocity, and overall efficiency.
  

  

**Education and certifications:**

* A degree or equivalent experience. You hold at least one of PMI-ACP, PMP, PgMP or Prince2.

Unleash Your Potential

Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and *be your best* , and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can *do your best* . Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.

**Job Summary**
---------------

Treasury works closely with senior management, the businesses, Country CEOs / CFOs, and Finance to manage and promote the bank’s liquidity, capital, and balance sheet position. Treasury is laser-focussed on its vision to be “Open, progressive and trusted, working commercially with our partners” to create sustainable value by balancing the supply and demand of liquidity and capital.

Within Treasury (which comprises Capital, Liquidity & Markets), the Treasury Liquidity function is responsible for driving the strategic liquidity agenda and Interest Rate Risk in the Banking Booking (‘IRRBB’).

The Associate Director – IRRBB, India hub will support the Head of IRRBB, India Hub in advancing IRRBB Analytics for overseeing and executing comprehensive internal analyses. The role holder will help in migrating and centralising global IRRBB processes from Group and Clusters, performing detailed stress tests and scenario analyses, leveraging IRRBB data to provide insightful risk assessments and mitigation strategies. This position requires a deep understanding of IRRBB, strong analytical skills, and the ability to collaborate effectively with senior stakeholders across the organization.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

**Strategy**  
• Keep up to date with the Group’s business strategy (incl. SC Ventures) and ensure the IRRBB frameworks are aligned to that.
  
• Partner with Global Head of IRRBB in developing and recommending risk mitigation strategies based on the findings from stress tests and scenario analyses. Ensure that these strategies are effectively communicated and implemented across relevant business units.

**Business**  
• Awareness and understanding of the wider business, economic and market environment in which the Group operates, with a focus on the Group’s participation in the Digital Assets and platforms space.
  
• Provide insights on current and forward looking IRRBB exposures, impact assessments on interest income and actions available for balance sheet optimisation.
  
• Lead the engagement with businesses on balance sheet optimisation strategies including but not limited to asset & liability mix to manage IRRBB while optimising returns.

**Processes**  
• **Analytics:** Support the newly developed IRRBB analytics capabilities on a regular basis, including operating the RCO IRRBB calculation engine to run bespoke scenarios and extracting and analysing the results, covering key metric including, but not limited to, Weekly NIIS Flash, Hedging Strategy Assessments, Corporate Plan NII impact simulations and PV01 analysis. This will also involve working with CPM and Finance closely to prepare MI slides for relevant committees like GALCO, ALCO and IRRBB Steering Forums.

* **Strategy:** Support IRRBB strategy by engaging Treasury Markets on NII sensitivities, hedging performance and P&L forecasting. Support investor relations for quarterly results, including GALCO/ALCO hedging updates, and contribute to annual disclosures through slide preparation, briefing notes, Q&A drafting and investor query responses.

* **Framework & Governance:** Support IRRBB governance through preparation of monthly GALCO/ALCO packs with commentary, review of risk metrics and monitoring of group, solo and local limits. Lead regulatory submissions and challenge returns, oversee MAT and risk appetite reviews, maintain IRRBB policies, support disclosures and audits, escalate emerging topics and drive regulatory engagement and interpretation.

* **Modelling & Methodology** : Apply and maintain IRRBB models per regulatory requirements, including PTR and CASA assumptions. Review and update IRRBB and structural hedging policies, maintain standards, and perform annual forecasts of NII, EBE, and P2A. Conduct policy effectiveness, self-assessment, gap and impact analyses, harmonize models with group, and run simulations and scenario analyses to support regulatory and corporate planning.

* **Structural Hedging:** Support the structural hedging in planning, executing, and monitoring hedges, including P&L sign-off and capacity management. Support group IRBB hedging programs, assess available instruments, forecast and quantify hedge requirements, run analytics and simulations, and provide MI for GALCO discussions to drive informed hedging decisions.

* **Stress Testing:** Support IRRBB stress testing including ICAAP and Pillar 2 assessments, NMD parameter stress, country/cluster ICAP, and reverse stress testing. Conduct basis risk evaluations, Pillar 2 charge reviews, and prepare Pillar 3 disclosures. Support IRBB-related GIA and audit reviews, ensuring all stress testing aligns with ORF requirements and regulatory expectations.

* **IRRBB Technology Journey:** Support delivery of new system rollouts, enhancements and data fixes by providing requirements, validating functionality, and ensuring data accuracy. Collaborate with stakeholders to implement changes efficiently, maintain alignment with IRRBB policy and reporting standards, and drive continuous improvement of systems and processes.

Monitor, measure and manage exposures, set limits, and perform scenario analysis and stress testing. Maintain robust frameworks, policies and governance, validate models, provide insights for strategic planning and support senior management, GALCO/ALCO and regulators on risk mitigation, reporting and capital optimisation.

Our technology is designed to reduce environmental impact while improving performance and efficiency. We are a purpose-driven company with a passion for innovation and a growing global presence.**

**Your impact**

Submer India is seeking an experienced, commercially minded and strategic Chief Financial Officer (CFO) to lead and build the Finance function in India. This is a growth- and investment-oriented role with particular responsibility for capital strategy, fundraising and the financial architecture supporting enterprise growth and infrastructure expansion.

The CFO will own the India capital agenda within approved mandates, working with India and Group leadership to secure financing and lead transactions through financial closure. The role requires an accomplished senior finance leader with demonstrated CFO-level responsibility and a proven record of personally leading and closing capital-raising transactions, preferably within technology, infrastructure, digital infrastructure, datacentres, engineering, energy or other high-growth and capital-intensive businesses.

The successful candidate will combine capital-raising capability with strong financial stewardship, governance and compliance. The CFO must understand the complete business lifecycle, from establishment and capitalisation through growth, scaling, restructuring and potential strategic transactions and/or potential exit, and be able to operate in an entrepreneurial technology and infrastructure environment.

**What you'll do**

**1. Strategic Financial Leadership**
=====================================

* Act as a key member of the India leadership team and provide strategic financial leadership to support Submer's growth and long-term enterprise value.
* Develop and execute the financial and capital strategy for the India business, linking enterprise growth and infrastructure expansion to appropriate sources of funding.
* Partner with business and operational leadership on investments, expansion plans and commercial opportunities, providing financial insight, strategic decisions and constructive challenge.
* Build scalable financial structures, processes, controls and planning capabilities suitable for a high growth organisation
* Build long term business planning and value creation.

**2. Investment, Fundraising and Capital Raising**
==================================================

* Lead the development and execution of capital-raising strategies for Submer's India business and strategic initiatives, aligned with approved plans and funding mandates.
* Build and maintain relationships with institutional, private equity, venture capital, infrastructure and strategic investors/partners, banks, financial institutions and structured-finance providers, as relevant.
* Lead India investor and lender engagement, financial presentations and, 'fund-sourcing to fund-raising to investment' plans and subsequent discussions; *(coordinate with Group finance and support Group-led transactions under the agreed mandate.)*
* Distinguish corporate capital for enterprise growth, including growth equity, strategic investment and corporate debt, from project or asset capital, including JV/SPV equity, infrastructure debt, construction finance and project finance.
* Develop financial models, investment cases and business plans; evaluate funding structures, financing costs, dilution, security requirements and investment returns.
* Lead financial due diligence readiness, strategic investment, financial structuring and financing negotiations through financial closure, coordinating legal, tax, business and technical inputs and obtaining required approvals.
* Agree capital-raising milestones with leadership and report on funding secured, transaction progress, financing terms and deployment of proceeds; maintain appropriate investor and lender reporting.

**3. Business Lifecycle and Growth Strategy**
=============================================

Guide the business through its financial lifecycle and ensure that funding structures and financial capabilities evolve with its stage of development. This includes:

* Business establishment, entity structuring, financial planning and initial capitalisation.
* Early-stage growth, scaling, fundraising and infrastructure or project expansion.
* Financial governance, commercial growth, profitability and long-term value creation.
* Mergers, acquisitions, strategic partnerships, restructuring and business transformation.
* Transaction readiness and potential exit planning.

Align corporate growth capital, project or asset financing and subsequent refinancing or strategic transactions with business needs, risk appetite and approved return objectives.

**4. Financial Planning, Analysis and Performance Management**
==============================================================

* Lead annual budgeting, long-term financial planning, forecasts and scenario modelling.
* Monitor financial and operational performance against approved plans
* Analyze profitability, cash flow, capital requirements and investment returns.
* Track business and project performance against approved investment cases, identify variances and recommend corrective action.
* Develop management reports and financial dashboards for senior leadership, identifying risks and opportunities and enabling informed decisions.

**5. Corporate Finance and Strategic Transactions**
===================================================

* Evaluate investment and strategic opportunities through valuation, financial analysis and assessment of returns and risks.
* Lead financial due diligence and financial transaction structuring for India-led transactions; *(support Group-led transactions within the agreed mandate.)*
* Structure and financially govern joint ventures and special purpose vehicles (JVs/SPVs), including shareholder funding, debt/equity arrangements, inter-company transactions and project returns.
* Develop and oversee cash waterfalls, distributions, dividend or repatriation arrangements and investor reporting in accordance with approved agreements and applicable requirements.
* Contribute to mergers, acquisitions and strategic partnerships, working with legal, tax, banking and external advisory partners
* Support exit readiness and strategic transaction planning.

**6. Finance Operations, Governance and Compliance**
====================================================

* Establish and maintain robust financial controls, policies and governance, including oversight of capital deployment and entity-level reporting.
* Ensure compliance with applicable Indian accounting, taxation, corporate and regulatory requirements
* Oversee financial, accounting and statutory compliance reporting.
* Ensure timely and accurate financial management and statutory filings.
* Manage relationships with auditors, tax advisors and external consultants; *(coordinating with Group finance as appropriate.)*
* Identify and mitigate financial and business risks, including financing covenant compliance and related-party exposures.

**7. Cash Flow and Working Capital Management**
===============================================

* Lead cash flow, liquidity and working capital planning and management.
* Align liquidity and financing requirements with business growth, capital expenditure and project or JV/SPV funding commitments.
* Manage banking relationships and financing facilities
* Monitor funding availability, drawdown conditions and covenant headroom.
* Monitor capital expenditure and investment commitments and optimise the use of capital across approved business, for infrastructure- and project-based requirements.

**8. Technology and Infrastructure Business Understanding**
=======================================================

jobs.description:
**Who are we?**
===============

At Finastra, we’re a global leader in financial services software, dedicated to expanding access to financial services and shaping what’s next for the industry. Our technology powers mission‑critical solutions across Lending, Payments and Universal Banking, supporting over 7,000 customers, including 80% of the world’s top 50 banks, in more than 110 countries.




**Disclaimer:**
===============

  

Finastra has signed an agreement to sell its Universal Banking business to Pollen Street Capital, with completion expected end 2026 / early 2027, subject to consultation and customary closing conditions. Upon completion, this role is expected to transition to the standalone Universal Banking business, creating opportunities to support its future growth and success.

**Finastra: Who are we?**

Formed in 2017 by the combination of Misys and D+H, we provide the broadest portfolio of financial services software in the world today—spanning Lending, Payments and Universal Banking businesses.

Our solutions enable customers to deploy mission critical technology on premises or in the cloud. With our scale and geographical reach we drive valued solutions and opportunity for customers regardless of size or geography. Through our open, secure, and reliable solutions, we empower customers to accelerate growth, optimize cost, mitigate risk and continually evolve to meet their changing needs.

  

**Universal Banking business:**

In June 2026, Finastra agreed to sell its Universal Banking business to Pollen Street Capital, with the sale expected to complete in early 2027. This role is part of the CTO Leadership Team for Universal Banking and will play a critical part in shaping the engineering organization of the new Universal Banking business. You will join Finastra initially and, on completion of the sale, your employment will transfer with the Universal Banking business to its new ownership.

  

**Role Summary**

The Lending Engineering Director is a Grade 9, M4 (Director) leadership role accountable for the engineering of the Universal Banking Lending product line. Managing through others, the Director leads a multi-disciplinary engineering organization of squads and squad leads, and owns end-to-end software delivery, from requirements and design through build, test, release, deployment and production operations, using an agentic AI-first engineering model. Operating independently within business and functional policies, the Director sets engineering direction and allocates resources across programmes and services. As a member of the CTO Leadership Team, the Director partners with Product, GTM and Services, and represents Lending engineering up to the Executive Leadership Team (ELT).

  

**Role Impact**

* **Scope and direction:** Owns the Lending engineering domain and acts independently to set direction and allocate people, budget and capacity across programmes, projects and services.
* **Problem solving and standards:** Resolves complex technical, operational and organizational problems, and recommends standards and operating strategies that mitigate risk and drive growth.
* **Planning and execution:** Develops and executes plans to achieve key Lending business objectives in collaboration with senior management.
* **Influence:** Fosters collaboration across the business, influences more senior colleagues and presents to the management chain up to the ELT when required.
* **Innovation:** Brings forward new ideas, notably in agentic AI engineering, that benefit Universal Banking and Finastra as a whole.

**Key Responsibilities**

***Engineering Strategy and Agentic AI Transformation***

* Define and own the Lending engineering strategy and multi-year roadmap, aligned with product strategy, architecture and business outcomes, including modernization on Cloud, SaaS, Java and microservices.
* Lead the shift to an agentic AI-first engineering model in which AI agents and engineers work together across the full lifecycle, with clear adoption targets and measurable gains in productivity, quality and cycle time.
* Make and own decisions on resource allocation, investment, tooling and build, buy or partner options, and influence platform and architecture decisions across the CTO organization.

***AI-Enabled End-to-End Software Delivery***

* **Plan:** Use AI agents with Product to refine requirements, generate user stories and acceptance criteria, and improve estimation and backlog prioritization.
* **Design and build:** Apply AI-assisted design reviews, agentic code generation, refactoring, legacy modernization and code review using tools such as GitHub Copilot.
* **Test and secure:** Drive AI-generated test cases, test data and automated regression, with AI-assisted security and vulnerability scanning built into CI/CD (shift-left quality and DevSecOps).
* **Release and deploy:** Own CI/CD pipelines, release readiness, versioning, change approvals and deployment orchestration, including containerized deployments to Kubernetes across cloud and on-premises environments, with a high degree of automation.
* **Document and enable:** Use AI to keep technical documentation, release notes and knowledge bases current for Services, Support and implementation partners.

***SDLC/PMLC and AI Governance***

* Own the SDLC and PMLC for Lending, ensuring rigour, transparency and measurability, in alignment with the Enterprise PMO, Product Strategy and Architecture.
* Establish guardrails for the responsible use of AI agents, including human-in-the-loop review, model and prompt governance, data classification, IP and security controls, and auditability, in line with Finastra policies and regulatory requirements.
* Track delivery, quality and AI-adoption metrics (for example, DORA metrics, defect leakage and AI acceptance rates) and act on trends.

***Operations, Reliability and Service Management***

* Participate and provide product support for Production incident triage, root-cause analysis and problem management, using AIOps and AI-assisted diagnostics to reduce MTTR and recurring issues.
* Contribute to change, release, configuration and environment management, and oversee performance, scalability and capacity planning across environments.
* Partner with SRE/Platform and Infrastructure teams to meet agreed SLAs and SLOs.

***People Leadership and Stakeholder Influence***

* Lead, coach and develop squad leads and senior technical staff, building succession and AI-ready engineering skills across the organization.
* Own organization design, workforce planning, hiring and performance management within budget, and lead teams through change, including the transition to new ownership.
* Partner daily with Product, GTM, Services and shared services, act as the technical voice of Lending with customers, and present to senior leadership up to the ELT.

**Competencies / Experience:14+Years**

  

***Essential***

* Track record of leading engineering tribes or domains of 20+ smart engineers across multiple squads, managing through squad leads.
* Proven leadership of application engineering and strategy for enterprise-grade, B2B, mission-critical solutions. A background in fintech and financial services is required; lending experience is preferred.
* Strong exposure to Cloud, SaaS, Java and microservices, with hands-on experience of container-based deployment using Docker and Kubernetes (or managed services such as AKS, EKS or OpenShift), Helm and GitOps-driven release pipelines.
* Hands-on experience deploying AI engineering tools such as GitHub Copilot and leading agentic AI adoption across the SDLC, with demonstrable productivity and quality outcomes.
* Has led Agile engineering transformation, with a strong understanding of SAFe and, preferably, LeSS or the Spotify model. Well versed in DevOps/DevSecOps and tools such as Jira and Confluence.
* Mature leader with strong communication, strategic thinking, complex problem solving and senior stakeholder

The U.S. Pharmacopeial Convention (USP) is an independent scientific organization that collaborates with the world’s leading health and science experts to develop rigorous quality standards for medicines, dietary supplements, and food ingredients. At USP, we believe that scientific excellence is driven by a commitment to fairness, integrity, and global collaboration. At USP, we value inclusive scientific collaboration and recognize that attracting diverse expertise strengthens our ability to develop trusted public health standards. **Purpose of the role**

To analyse and assess market trends, competitor landscape, and potential risks and opportunities to inform strategic decision-making.

**Accountabilities**

* Development and presentation of compelling strategic recommendations to senior management, addressing key business challenges and opportunities.
* Monitoring and evaluation of the effectiveness of implemented strategies, recommending adjustments as needed.
* Communication of complex strategic information clearly and concisely to diverse stakeholders.
* Identification and assessment of potential risks associated with the bank's strategic plans and recommend mitigation strategies.
* Conducting in-depth research and analysis of internal and external data, including market trends, competitor analysis, and economic forecasts.

**Director Expectations**

* To manage a business function, providing significant input to function wide strategic initiatives. Contribute to and influence policy and procedures for the function and plan, manage and consult on multiple complex and critical strategic projects, which may be business wide..
* They manage the direction of a large team or sub-function, leading other people managers and embedding a performance culture aligned to the values of the business. Or for an individual contributor, they lead organisation wide projects and act as deep technical expert and thought leader, identifying new ways of working and collaborating cross functionally. They will train, guide and coach less experienced specialists and provide information affecting long term profits, organisational risks and strategic decisions..
* Provide expert advice to senior functional management and committees to influence decisions made outside of own function, offering significant input to function wide strategic initiatives.
* Manage, coordinate and enable resourcing, budgeting and policy creation for a significant sub-function.
* Escalates breaches of policies / procedure appropriately.
* Foster and guide compliance, ensure regulations are observed that relevant processes in place to facilitate adherence.
* Focus on the external environment, regulators, or advocacy groups to both monitor and influence on behalf of Barclays, when appropriate.
* Demonstrate extensive knowledge of how the function integrates with the business division / Group to achieve the overall business objectives.
* Maintain broad and comprehensive knowledge of industry theories and practices within own discipline alongside up-to-date relevant sector / functional knowledge, and insight into external market developments / initiatives.
* Use interpretative thinking and advanced analytical skills to solve problems and design solutions in often complex/ sensitive situations.
* Exercise management authority to make significant decisions and certain strategic decisions or recommendations within own area.
* Negotiate with and influence stakeholders at a senior level both internally and externally.
* Act as principal contact point for key clients and counterparts in other functions/ businesses divisions.
* Mandated as a spokesperson for the function and business division.

All Senior Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others.

All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. They will also be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Mindset – to Empower, Challenge and Drive – the operating manual for how we behave.

jobs.title: Client Solutions Partner
jobs.description:
Role: Client Solutions Partner

Experience: 8-14 years

Location: Bangalore/Mumbai

We are looking for a strategic and execution-focused
**Client Solution Partner**
to lead pre-sales and solutioning for our Customer Experience (CX) practice across the US and Canada. This role will be instrumental in driving AI-led contact center transformations powered by Google GECX and the broader Google ecosystem.

You will partner closely with sales, alliances, delivery, and client stakeholders to shape compelling, differentiated solutions that modernize contact centers using GenAI, automation, analytics, and cloud-native capabilities.

This is a high-impact, client-facing leadership role requiring deep domain expertise in Contact Center transformation and strong commercial acumen.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Pre-Sales & Solution Leadership**

* Lead end-to-end solutioning for CX transformation opportunities across US & Canada.
* Engage with C-level stakeholders (CXOs, Heads of Contact Center, CIOs, Digital leaders) to understand business objectives and translate them into AI-led transformation roadmaps.
* Design differentiated solutions leveraging Google’s CX stack (CCaaS, Conversational Agents, Agent Assist, Analytics).
* Own RFP/RFI responses, solution narratives, architecture vision, and pricing alignment.
* Drive solution workshops, discovery sessions, and executive presentations.

**2. Domain Advisory & Thought Leadership**

* Act as a trusted advisor to clients on:
* AI-powered virtual agents (voice & chat)
* Agent augmentation and productivity
* Workforce optimization & routing modernization
* Omnichannel CX transformation
* Contact center analytics & insights
* Articulate business value (cost reduction, containment, AHT reduction, CSAT improvement, revenue uplift).
* Represent the practice in industry forums, client events, and partner engagements.

**3. GTM & Practice Enablement**

* Collaborate with sales leaders to shape account strategy and pipeline development.
* Develop reusable solution assets, industry playbooks, and accelerators.
* Partner with Google alliance teams to co-sell and strengthen ecosystem alignment.
* Support marketing initiatives (case studies, POVs, webinars, event content).

**4. Commercial & Engagement Ownership**

* Own solution integrity from pre-sales through transition to delivery.
* Ensure alignment between proposed architecture, scope, and execution feasibility.
* Provide effort estimation guidance and defend solution economics during deal cycles.
* Support deal negotiations with a value-first positioning.

**Required Experience & Qualifications**

* X years of experience in Contact Center / CX transformation.
* Strong experience in CCaaS platforms (Google, Genesys, NICE, Five9, Amazon Connect, etc.).
* Demonstrated experience with AI/GenAI-driven CX solutions (virtual agents, agent assist, conversational AI).
* Proven track record of leading large, complex pre-sales engagements.
* Experience working with enterprise clients across US and Canada markets.
* Strong business acumen with the ability to articulate ROI and value realization.
* Excellent executive communication and storytelling skills.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with Google Cloud ecosystem and alliances.
* Prior experience in consulting or system integration organizations.
* Familiarity with regulated industries (Insurance, Utilities, Healthcare, BFSI).
* Exposure to multi-vendor contact center migrations and cloud modernization programs.

**What Success Looks Like**

* Increased win-rate and pipeline growth across US & Canada.
* Strong executive relationships within strategic accounts.
* High-quality, scalable solution frameworks for AI-led CX transformation.
* Measurable revenue contribution and margin discipline.
* Recognition as a trusted CX transformation leader within the ecosystem.

**Why Join Us**

At Quantiphi, we are redefining customer experience using AI, data, and cloud. As part of the CX GTM leadership team, you will:

* Shape next-generation AI-powered contact centers.
* Work closely with strategic partners like Google Cloud.
* Influence enterprise CX strategy across North America.
* Operate at the intersection of technology, business value, and innovation.

jobs.title: Client Partner
jobs.description:
**Job Requirements**
At Quest Global, it’s not just what we do but how and why we do it that makes us different. With over 25 years as an engineering services provider, we believe in the power of doing things differently to make the impossible possible. Our people are driven by the desire to make the world a better place—to make a positive difference that contributes to a brighter future. We bring together technologies and industries, alongside the contributions of diverse individuals who are empowered by an intentional workplace culture, to solve problems better and faster.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Revenue and Profit Growth. Lead overall effort to grow [Account] account revenue and profit to emerge as a key strategic partner for [Account].
* Relationships. Leverage existing customer relationships with [Account] engineering influencers and decision makers at both executive and mid-level manager levels. Develop and expand relationships with senior and mid-level customers.
* Account Analysis, Plans and Implementation. Develop and implement in-depth analysis and strategic account planning (StrAP) for [Account] to identify key focus areas for growth including account headcount, competitive analysis, customer needs per engineering service area, SWOT, Quest relationship summary and Quest capability gaps. Make key business decisions on what services/solutions to pursue and invest in.
* Unsolicited Campaigns. Identify and lead unsolicited, strategic campaigns to grow the account. Leverage Quest relationships, influence customer decision makers, monitor milestones, track action item progress and lead the campaign proposal effort.
* Solicited Proposals. Lead and manage all solicited proposal responses for all new business services or customers. Develop plans and proposals to realize the revenue target from the account, quarter on quarter.
* Expand to New Locations/ Divisions. Develop and implement plans to enter new geographies or divisions of [Account] as per the strategic account plan.
* Customer Communications. Hold quarterly customer reviews, lead/author Account Branding Newsletters and other communications per Quest process.
* Cross Sell and Up Sell. Leverage Quest best practices and from other accounts, to develop and operationalize plans to introduce new services to [Account].
* Annual Budgets and Forecasts. Lead efforts to create annual revenue and expense forecasts as well as monthly rolling revenue forecasts.
* Lead ‘Virtual Account Unit’ (VAU). Lead sales-delivery matrixed team for [Account]. Coordinate efforts, hold weekly meetings and lead monthly report out to Quest Sales & Delivery executives.
* Invest Sales Discretionary Funding. Identify, approve, and monitor internal investments for operations support to achieve target growth opportunities.
* Billing Rate Negotiations. Lead efforts to establish rates that leverage value pricing. Includes data gathering, analysis, proactive engagement of customer champions, pricing strategies, competitive positioning, competitor assessment, etc.

We are known for our extraordinary people who make the impossible possible every day. Questians are driven by hunger, humility, and aspiration. We believe that our company culture is the key to our ability to make a true difference in every industry we reach. Our teams regularly invest time and dedicated effort into internal culture work, ensuring that all voices are heard.
  
  
We wholeheartedly believe in the diversity of thought that comes with fostering a culture rooted in respect, where everyone belongs, is valued, and feels inspired to share their ideas. We know embracing our unique differences makes us better, and that solving the worlds hardest engineering problems requires diverse ideas, perspectives, and backgrounds. We shine the brightest when we tap into the many dimensions that thrive across over 21,000 difference-makers in our workplace.
  
  
**Work Experience**

* Deep domain knowledge of the [Vertical] Vertical, specifically [sub sectors], with knowledge of products & lifecycle, engineering & manufacturing processes, major OEMs, major engineering services suppliers, external drivers and funding.
* Strong relationships with senior and mid-level technical managers at [Account]
* [Account] engineering knowledge and complete product life-cycle knowledge including,
* Engineering processes including design, manufacturing, analysis, aftermarket, quality, fielded product support (both software & hardware)
* challenges related to cost, delivery, schedule, or support
* internal funding process including timing, influencers and approvals
* outsourcing processes, funding, upcoming changes and leadership
* Existing major outsourcing suppliers including SWOT and [Account’s] assessment of respective suppliers
* Strong commercial skills and experience including selling process, negotiating, pricing, costing, discount structures, terms and conditions, sales strategy development, execution and sales proposal development.
* Understanding of relevant/adjacent technologies and competitor’s services.
* Experience in authoring complex proposals; experienced in negotiating master service contracts and long-term agreements.
* Experience working with global remote team / offshore delivery model environment
* Proven ability to grow businesses profitably
* Experience with sales and account management and in developing strategic plans
* Experience leading cross functional teams
* Excellent interpersonal and communication skills, both verbal and written and ability to communicate effectively at all levels.
* Results driven, high energy, self-motivated, persistent and able to work independently
* Decisive, analytical, strategic thinker.

**Vice President, Client Technology | Bangalore, India**

I’m partnering with a growing, global AI-powered insurance technology business seeking a senior leader to shape its client technology function and lead strategic customer engagements.

Experience within SaaS, AI or InsurTech, alongside exposure to Generative AI or intelligent automation, would be particularly valuable.

jobs.title: Sr Applied Scientist - Semantics
jobs.description:
**Job Summary**   

AuxoAI is seeking a Senior Applied Scientist to design and deploy structured knowledge systems that enable reliable, schema-grounded AI and agent reasoning. This role sits at the intersection of large language models, knowledge graphs, semantic architectures, and hybrid retrieval systems. The ideal candidate will build systems that transform unstructured data into structured knowledge representations, enforce semantic constraints, and enable hybrid symbolic-neural reasoning in production environments. You will play a key role in designing scalable semantic infrastructures that support advanced AI use cases such as GraphRAG pipelines, structured extraction, and agent reasoning workflows. You will work on problems where existing architectures may not be sufficient and will experiment with new approaches that combine machine learning, knowledge graphs, semantic constraints, and classical AI techniques to build reliable, production-grade systems. Location - Mumbai / Bangalore / Hyderabad / Gurgaon (Hybrid - 3 Days a week in Office)

  
  
**Responsibilities**   

* Design schema-guided information extraction systems using zero-shot and few-shot structured prompting, constrained decoding approaches such as JSON schema enforcement or grammar-based decoding, and function-calling or tool-driven extraction techniques.
* Develop recursive or multi-stage extraction pipelines capable of handling nested entities, hierarchical structures, and cross-document relationships.
* Build ontology-driven systems using frameworks such as LinkML, OWL, SHACL, or similar schema modeling tools, and implement knowledge representations using RDF triples or labeled property graphs.
* Design and optimize entity resolution algorithms using techniques such as blocking strategies, embedding similarity, and rule-based matching.
* Develop ontology alignment techniques and graph embedding models such as Node2Vec or TransE-style approaches where appropriate.
* Design hybrid retrieval architectures combining dense vector retrieval, sparse retrieval techniques, and graph traversal algorithms such as BFS, DFS, path ranking, and neighborhood expansion.
* Build validation systems that enforce schema conformance, detect semantic inconsistencies, and reduce hallucinated or invalid structured outputs.
* Integrate structured knowledge systems into GraphRAG pipelines, agent planning frameworks, and tool-selection workflows.
* Deliver production-grade semantic systems with clear targets for latency, scalability, reliability, and data integrity.

  
  
**Requirements**   

* 5+ years of experience building production AI or machine learning systems.
* Strong experience designing and implementing knowledge graphs or ontology-driven architectures.
* Hands-on experience implementing structured extraction techniques, including grammar-constrained decoding, JSON schema enforcement, or AST-style parsing approaches.
* Experience building entity resolution systems beyond simple embedding similarity methods.
* Experience working with graph query languages such as SPARQL or Cypher and optimizing graph query performance.
* Familiarity with RDF, OWL, or property graph data models and semantic data architectures.
* Strong Python engineering skills, with emphasis on data validation, schema integrity, and system reliability.
* Experience designing hybrid symbolic and neural AI systems.

  
  
**Nice to Have**   

* Experience implementing graph algorithms such as PageRank, community detection, or shortest-path algorithms for reasoning chains.
* Experience building graph-enhanced retrieval systems such as GraphRAG.
* Experience designing compositional semantic extraction pipelines.
* Experience implementing reasoning engines or rule-based inference systems.
* Experience benchmarking and evaluating structural extraction accuracy and consistency.

jobs.title: Strategic Account Director (ID # 912)
jobs.description:
**About the Company**

Sarvam is building the bedrock of Sovereign AI for India. The company is developing India’s full-stack sovereign AI platform, building across research, models, infrastructure and applications with a singular focus on making AI genuinely work for India. Sarvam works with leading enterprises and public institutions and is backed by Lightspeed, Peak XV, and Khosla Ventures. Sarvam partners with India’s leading brands, including Tata Capital, SBI Life, CRED, IDFC, and LIC.

**About the Role**

The role owns the commercial relationship and ensures each account is getting real value from Sarvam’s products, expanding into new use cases, and renewing with conviction. You are the single point of commercial accountability for your book of business. You will work at the intersection of the client, the delivery team (FDSEs, CSEs, CSMs), and Sarvam’s product and GTM leadership. What you learn in the field shapes how the company prioritises product improvements, structures pricing, and designs its post-sales playbooks. If you are someone who combines commercial sharpness with genuine curiosity about how AI products create value for enterprise clients, this role is for you.

**Responsibilities**

* Own the full commercial relationship across a portfolio of Sarvam’s enterprise accounts: renewals, expansion, cross-sell, and net revenue retention
* Build and maintain trusted relationships with key stakeholders across your accounts, from operational teams running Sarvam products daily to CXO-level sponsors
* Drive account expansion by identifying new use cases, business units, and product lines where Sarvam can deliver incremental value
* Lead renewal negotiations end-to-end, including pricing, scope, and contract structuring, in close coordination with GTM leadership
* Run structured account reviews (QBRs, health checks, success plans) that demonstrate measurable business impact and align both sides on next steps
* Use product usage data, delivery metrics, and client feedback to proactively identify health signals, adoption gaps, and churn risk
* Work closely with FDSEs, CSEs, and CSMs to ensure delivery quality remains high and client expectations are met throughout the engagement lifecycle
* Translate client feedback, feature requests, and competitive intelligence back to product teams with enough context and specificity to be actionable
* Contribute to building Sarvam’s post-sales playbook: account segmentation frameworks, expansion motions, health scoring models, and renewal processes

**Qualifications**

* 8-20 years of experience in enterprise sales ales, account management, customer success, or post-sales roles within B2B SaaS, enterprise technology, or AI/ML products
* Proven track record of owning and exceeding revenue targets, specifically renewal rates and net revenue retention (NRR) metrics

**Required Skills**

* Commercial instinct: you segment your book by expansion potential, keep active expansion conversations going, and build business cases that land with economic buyers
* Ability to hold a technical conversation with an engineering or product team on the client side. You do not need to write code, but you need to understand how APIs, integrations, and AI workflows connect
* Strong communication skills: you can move fluidly between an operational lead, a technical counterpart, and a procurement team within the same account
* Comfort using product data and analytics to drive account decisions rather than relying on gut feel alone
* Experience working in a fast-moving environment where you build process as you go, not inherit it from a mature org

**Preferred Skills**

* Prior experience managing accounts in conversational AI, voice technology, language technology, or document intelligence
* Familiarity with the Indian enterprise buying landscape: procurement cycles, compliance requirements, multi-stakeholder decision-making, and government contracting norms
* Experience working alongside Forward Deployed Engineering, professional services, or delivery teams in a post-sales capacity
* Background in consulting, solutions engineering, or customer success before moving into account management
* Hands-on experience with CRM and customer health tools (Salesforce, HubSpot, Gainsight, or equivalent)

**Pay range and compensation package**

Note: We are looking for people who can own the outcomes described here, not people who match every line of this specification. If this problem excites you and you believe you can do this work, we want to hear from you.

**Equal Opportunity Statement**

Sarvam is a fast-moving, high talent-density team building full-stack AI for India, working on problems that push the frontiers of AI with real population-scale impact. Work alongside researchers, engineers, builders, and business leaders who move fast and hold each other to a very high bar. High ownership and high impact, from day one. Everything we do is AI-first, from the way we build and ship to the way we think about problems. You can work on problems that could change how an entire country learns, works, and communicates. If you want to work on problems at the frontier of AI in India, Sarvam is the place to be.

* Acquire clients through e-boarding of the provided leads and nurture the relationship for AUM build up in a steady manner.

* Empower DBS IN clients embrace the value delivery channels to improve transaction efficiency and effectiveness

* Quality engagement with Emerging Affluent and Treasures clients to retain and developing sustainable relationships
* Ensure effective and efficient on-boarding, client coverage and client economics.
* Coordinate and drive timely investment and insurance portfolio reviews partnering with Investment / Insurance / Wealth specialists in Cluster locations.

* While technical competence is not essential, ability to handle client requests via e-channels and versatility with digital tools would be beneficial.
* Good knowledge of wealth management products, both investment and insurance

* Holder of relevant insurance, investment certification requirements (AMFI / IRDAI Composite license) would be an advantage
* Good command of spoken English and Hindi. Fluency in other regional languages (Marathi, Bengali, Tamil, Telugu etc.) would be an advantage.

**Education / Preferred Qualifications**

* University level education, preferably in finance, business or a related discipline. Postgraduation in marketing or finance or banking would be desirable

**Core Competencies**

* Selling and team influencing skills to grow customer numbers and customer product uptake
* People Management
* Communication Skills
* Drive for Action
* Ability to work in an ambiguous environment
* Excellent understanding of the Bank’s Strategy and ability to interpret this and execute effectively to grow customer wallet share
* Proven track record in execution of sales or marketing strategy that resulted in business growth

Work Relationship
  
  

* Ensuring remote coverage and engagement of customers along with Branch teams for support.
* Close interaction with Channels / Segments and Clusters to ensure consistent delivery of service and business objectives.

DBS is committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and their opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment. * Build Pride and Passion to Protect, Maintain and Enhance DBS’ Reputation
* Enhance Self Knowledge, Skills and develop Competencies aimed at continuous improvement
* Maintain the Highest Standards of Honesty and Integrity.

jobs.title: Cloud Technology Consultant - AWS Cloud, Director
jobs.description:
We are seeking an experienced **Cloud Technology Consultant** to serve as a strategic advisor and hands-on expert for enterprise clients embarking on their AWS cloud transformation journeys. In this Director-level role, you will shape cloud strategies, guide large-scale migrations, and influence adoption of cloud-native architectures and modern engineering practices. This is a senior individual contributor position ideal for a technically strong consultant who combines architectural depth with an advisory mindset.

  

**Responsibilities**

* Partner with enterprise clients to assess current-state environments and define future-state cloud strategies with AWS as the primary platform
* Advise clients on cloud transformation approaches, including platform engineering, modernization, and migration
* Provide thought leadership on cloud-native architectures, landing zones, multi-account strategies, and operating models
* Lead cloud consulting engagements involving large-scale workload assessments and migration planning (rehost, re-platform, refactor, re-architect)
* Guide clients in designing scalable, secure, and cost-efficient cloud environments
* Contribute to strategic discussions on cloud governance, security models, CI/CD pipelines, observability, and operational excellence
* Shape solution approaches for RFPs, proposals, and client workshops, working closely with pre-sales, architecture, and delivery teams
* Stay current with GenAI / LLM-powered cloud use cases and advise clients on adopting innovative cloud capabilities
* Influence cloud adoption decisions through deep expertise in automation, containerization, DevSecOps, and platform scalability
* Serve as a hands-on technical advisor and strategic individual contributor, bringing clarity and direction to complex cloud transformation initiatives

**Requirements**

* 20+ years of overall IT experience, including extensive hands-on cloud consulting or platform engineering experience
* Expertise in AWS services across compute, storage, networking, security, governance, and DevOps
* Background in multi-cloud environments, with exposure to Azure as an added advantage
* Proven experience delivering enterprise-scale cloud migration and modernization programs
* Familiarity with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, CloudFormation, CDK), CI/CD pipelines, and container platforms (EKS, ECS, Kubernetes)
* Understanding of cloud security, IAM, and networking, along with encryption, compliance, and cost optimization
* Capability to collaborate directly with business, technology, and architecture stakeholders to influence strategy and guide transformation choices
* Cloud certifications (AWS preferred; Azure certifications considered a plus)
* Depth of an architect combined with the mindset of an advisor, comfortable operating as a senior individual contributor and influencing strategy through hands-on expertise
* Confident in client-facing discussions and capable of translating complex cloud concepts into actionable business insights
* Passionate about cloud transformation, platform engineering, and modern cloud-native practices
* Strong English communication skills (B2 level or higher)

**Nice to have**

* Skills in application development using .NET, Java, or Python
* Background in SRE practices
* Proficiency in DevSecOps practices

jobs.title: Enterprise Sales - Strategic Account Manager
jobs.description:
Job Description

  

**Location:** Bangalore, India

**Function:** Enterprise Sales / Strategic Account Management

**Market Coverage:** India & Southeast Asia (SEA)

**Experience:** 5 to 9+ Years

  

**Role Purpose:**

  

The Enterprise Sales Capital Markets (Farmer / Strategic Account Management) role will be responsible for managing, retaining, and growing Azentio's existing Capital Markets customer relationships across India and Southeast Asia.

  

The role will focus on understanding each customer's business priorities, technology landscape, operational challenges, and transformation roadmap, and identifying how Azentio's broader portfolio can address those evolving needs.

  

A key expectation is to identify whitespace within existing accounts and drive incremental revenue growth through cross-selling and upselling opportunities across Azentio's product portfolio, while protecting existing revenue, expanding account penetration, and building long-term strategic customer relationships.

  

The successful candidate must possess strong BFSI domain expertise and proven experience in managing strategic BFSI accounts, with a demonstrated track record of driving business growth, achieving sales targets, and expanding customer relationships within this segment.

The individual should bring strong business and sales acumen, consultative selling capabilities, commercial awareness, and the ability to identify and convert opportunities into incremental revenue. Experience in managing large enterprise accounts, driving complex sales cycles, developing C-level relationships, and positioning technology solutions across the BFSI landscape will be essential. The candidate should also be comfortable operating in a dynamic and relatively unstructured environment, taking end-to-end ownership of accounts and proactively creating new business opportunities

  

**Key Responsibilities:**

  

**Strategic Account Management & Growth**

  

* Manage a portfolio of existing Capital Markets customers across India and SEA.
* Develop comprehensive account plans covering existing products, revenue, stakeholder relationships, customer priorities, whitespace, competitive presence, risks, and growth opportunities.
* Own account growth and develop clear strategies for increasing Azentio's share of wallet within strategic customers.
* Identify opportunities across business units, functions, geographies, and technology environments within existing accounts.
* Build a sustainable account-level pipeline for cross-sell, upsell, renewals, extensions, and new requirements.
* Maintain a strong understanding of the competitive landscape within each strategic account.

  

**Understanding Customer Needs & Consultative Selling**

  

* Develop a deep understanding of each customer's business strategy, operational model, technology landscape, and transformation priorities.
* Engage customers proactively rather than waiting for requirements or RFPs to emerge.
* Conduct structured discovery sessions with business and technology stakeholders to uncover new requirements.
* Understand the underlying business problem and map the appropriate Azentio products and capabilities to the customer's needs.
* Develop solution propositions and business cases aligned to customer objectives.
* Position Azentio as a strategic technology partner, rather than a single-product vendor.

  

**Portfolio Selling, Cross-Sell & Upsell**

  

* Develop a strong understanding of Azentio's broader BFSI portfolio and its relevance to Capital Markets customers.
* Identify whitespace opportunities within existing customer accounts.
* Drive cross-sell and upsell by connecting customer business requirements with relevant Azentio solutions.
* Identify opportunities for additional products, modules, licenses, users, geographies, upgrades, integrations, or transformation initiatives.
* Work with Product and Pre-Sales teams to build integrated propositions where multiple Azentio capabilities can address customer requirements.
* Develop and maintain an account-level upsell and cross-sell roadmap for key customers."

  

**Customer Relationship & Stakeholder Management**

  

* Develop trusted relationships with senior business, operations, technology, procurement, and leadership stakeholders.
* Expand relationships beyond existing contacts and build multiple stakeholder connections within each account.
* Conduct regular Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs), customer reviews, and strategic account discussions to assess customer satisfaction, identify growth opportunities, and drive account expansion.
* Understand stakeholder priorities, influence levels, decision-making processes, and potential relationship risks.
* Maintain strong customer engagement through regular meetings, workshops, market visits, and executive interactions.
* Act as the commercial relationship owner and customer advocate within Azentio.

  

**Renewals, Retention & Commercial Expansion**

  

* Protect and grow existing account revenue through proactive management of renewals, extensions, upgrades, and commercial opportunities.
* Engage customers ahead of renewal cycles to identify potential risks and expansion opportunities.
* Drive commercial negotiations for renewals, upsell and cross-sell opportunities.
* Identify competitive threats, customer dissatisfaction, or relationship risks early and develop appropriate retention strategies.
* Partner with internal teams to ensure customer commitments are addressed and commercial relationships remain healthy.
* Balance customer requirements with commercial quality, margins, contractual terms, and long-term account value.

  

**India & Southeast Asia Account Development**

  

* Manage and grow assigned strategic accounts across India and Southeast Asia.
* Develop an understanding of market-specific customer dynamics and business practices.
* Build strong customer relationships through regular in-person engagement.
* Candidates who bring strong market intelligence, industry insights, competitive awareness, and an understanding of emerging business opportunities across India and Southeast Asia, enabling them to identify new growth avenues and add strategic value to Azentio's business, will have an advantage
* Travel extensively across India and Southeast Asia based on customer and business requirements.

  

**Cross-Functional Collaboration**

  

* Collaborate closely with Pre-Sales, Product Management, Delivery, Customer Success, Support, Finance, Legal, Marketing, and Leadership.
* Coordinate product demonstrations, solution workshops, customer presentations, RFP/RFI responses, and commercial proposals.
* Work closely with Delivery and Customer Success teams to understand ongoing projects and identify potential account opportunities or risks.
* Provide structured customer and market feedback to Product teams.
* Coordinate internal stakeholders to ensure a consistent approach to strategic customers. Salesforce Hygiene, Pipeline Management & Sales Governance

  

The candidate should be expected to:

  

* Maintain the highest standards of Salesforce (SFDC) hygiene, ensuring timely and accurate updates of account information, sales opportunities, deal values, pipeline stages, probability, expected closure dates, and customer engagement activities.
* Maintain a healthy and actionable sales pipeline, with clear visibility into opportunity progression, next steps, dependencies, potential risks, and closure plans.
* Consistently adopt and apply the MEDDPICC sales qualification methodology across strategic opportunities to ensure structured opportunity assessment and deal governance.
* Maintain accurate and realistic revenue forecasts, booking projections, and closure estimates.
* Participate in mandatory weekly sales review calls with management, providing updates on pipeline movement, opportunity progression, MEDDPICC qualification status, revenue outlook, challenges, and action plans.
* Take complete ownership

jobs.title: Lead Program Manager, Finance Transformation
jobs.description:
**Job Summary**

Veeam's Finance Transformation Office (FTO) is looking for a highly organized and execution-focused Lead Program Manager to drive strategic Finance transformation initiatives across the organization. This role is ideal for someone who thrives in complex, cross-functional environments and enjoys connecting Finance, Corporate Technology, and implementation partners to deliver meaningful business outcomes.

As a Lead Program Manager, you will own the day-to-day execution of one or more transformation programs, ensuring projects remain on track, risks are proactively managed, and executive stakeholders have clear visibility into progress, dependencies, and business value. You'll serve as the operational backbone of the program, helping Finance leaders successfully deliver large-scale initiatives that modernize systems, processes, and reporting capabilities.

This role reports into the Finance Transformation Office Governance & Process Architecture team and requires a combination of program management expertise, financial systems knowledge, strong executive communication, and the ability to influence stakeholders across multiple organizations.

Working hours: 5 PM IST to 2 AM IST

**What You'll Do**

* Lead the execution of one or more Finance Transformation initiatives, driving timelines, milestones, deliverables, and cross-functional coordination.
* Build and maintain program governance, including executive status reporting, steering committee materials, RAID logs, and portfolio dashboards.
* Identify, track, and proactively manage risks, issues, assumptions, and dependencies across Finance, Corporate Technology, and external implementation partners.
* Partner with Functional Transformation Leads across FP&A, Controllership, Treasury, Tax, and other Finance organizations to ensure business requirements remain aligned throughout delivery.
* Collaborate with Corporate Technology teams and System Integrators to support successful implementation of Finance systems, data platforms, and enterprise applications.
* Monitor program health, benefit realization, and strategic outcomes, ensuring initiatives deliver measurable business value beyond project completion.
* Support organizational change management activities by partnering on communication plans, training, adoption strategies, and stakeholder engagement.
* Facilitate governance meetings, executive reviews, decision-making sessions, and cross-functional workshops with senior leadership.
* Drive continuous improvement by standardizing governance processes, templates, reporting frameworks, and program management best practices across the Finance Transformation Office.
* Foster collaboration, accountability, and transparency across all program stakeholders while maintaining focus on delivery excellence.

**What You'll Bring**

* Bachelor's degree in Finance, Business Administration, Information Systems, Computer Science, or a related field.
* 5+ years of program or project management experience delivering Finance Transformation, ERP, Enterprise Planning, or Data Platform initiatives within complex, matrixed organizations.
* Experience managing enterprise implementations involving platforms such as Oracle Cloud ERP, SAP, NetSuite, Pigment, Anaplan, Adaptive Planning, Databricks, Snowflake, or similar technologies.
* Strong knowledge of project governance methodologies, including RAID management, RACI/DACI frameworks, executive reporting, and portfolio governance.
* Demonstrated ability to manage multiple cross-functional initiatives while balancing competing priorities and executive expectations.
* Excellent analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills with a proactive approach to risk management.
* Exceptional written and verbal communication skills in English, with experience presenting program updates and recommendations to senior leadership.
* Experience working collaboratively with Finance organizations, Corporate Technology teams, and third-party implementation partners.
* Ability to operate effectively in fast-paced environments with evolving priorities and ambiguous requirements.

**Nice to Have**

* PMP, PRINCE2, PMI-ACP, Scrum Master, or equivalent project management certification.
* Experience supporting Finance organizations through digital transformation or enterprise modernization initiatives.
* Exposure to SOX controls, audit readiness, or IPO environments.
* Familiarity with business intelligence and reporting platforms such as Tableau or Power BI.
* Experience within SaaS, enterprise software, or high-growth technology companies.
* Understanding of Finance functions including Financial Planning & Analysis (FP&A), Accounting, Revenue Recognition, Treasury, Tax, and Financial Reporting.
