jobs.description:
****Job Description******Overview**  

Our Transmission Distribution (TD) business delivers end-to-end engineering solutions for power networks, including substations, transmission lines, and grid modernization.

The Protection Control (PC) Design team plays a critical role in ensuring the safe operation, monitoring, automation, and protection of power system assets. The team develops engineering designs for 11kV,33kV,132kV,275Kv and 400kV substations, including protection schemes, control systems. Opportunities include working on complex international projects, developing detailed engineering deliverables, supporting multidisciplinary coordination, and driving design excellence through digital engineering tools and industry best practices. This role is ideal for professionals passionate about substation protection and control engineering, electrical system reliability, digital transformation, and delivering innovative solutions for the evolving energy sector.

AtkinsRalis Global Technology Centre (GTC) is seeking an experienced Electrical Protection Control (PC) Lead Designer with 5-10 years of substation design experience and strong proficiency in AutoCAD to join our Bangalore office. This role involves supporting the delivery of Protection Control engineering and CAD deliverables for 132 kV to 400 kV AIS and GIS substations, covering both greenfield and brownfield projects across domestic and international markets.

The successful candidate will be responsible for developing high-quality PC design outputs, including protection schematics, control and relay panel drawings, wiring diagrams, interconnection diagrams, AC/DC schematics, cable schedules, and Substation documentation. Working closely with Protection Engineers and multidisciplinary project teams, the role requires ensuring compliance with international standards, client specifications, and project quality requirements.

This position offers the opportunity to contribute to complex projects across Power Generation, Transmission Distribution (TD), Renewable Energy and nuclear sectors, while supporting the digital transformation of substations through modern engineering practices and innovative design solutions. The ideal candidate will have a strong technical understanding of substation protection and control systems, excellent drafting skills, and a commitment to delivering engineering excellence.

  
  
**Your role**  

*Key Responsibilities*

* Prepare Protection Control (PC) deliverables for 132 kV to 400 kV AIS/GIS substations
* Develop SLDs, KLDs, AC/DC schematics, LVAC/LVDC diagrams, tripping schemes, relay wiring diagrams, panel layouts and cable schedules.
* Prepare interface/interconnection diagrams, terminal block drawings, SCADA/SCS drawings, communication drawings and As-Built documentation.
* Develop transformer, feeder and busbar protection drawings in accordance with project requirements.
* Develop Control Protection Bay Control Drawings, Relay Panel Drawings, DC Distribution Schemes, AC Auxiliary Schemes, RTU/SCADA Drawings, SCS Drawings, LAN/Fiber Network Drawings, Cable Routing Termination Drawings, As-Built Documentation.
* Develop and maintain engineering drawings using AutoCAD and other approved CAD tools in accordance with project and client standards.
* Coordinate with Protection, Primary, Civil, Telecom, and multidisciplinary engineering teams to support project delivery.
* Support design reviews, drawing updates, revisions, and preparation of As-Built documentation.
* Perform self-checks and quality reviews to ensure accuracy, consistency, and timely delivery of engineering documentation.
* Coordinate with internal teams and external stakeholders.
* Ensure quality assurance and compliance with CAD/BIM standards.
* Mentor junior staff and contribute to team motivation.

*Ideal Candidate Profile*

* We are seeking an experienced Protection Control (PC) Lead Designer with:
* Proven experience in 132kV to 400kV AIS/GIS Substation Protection Control design for both Greenfield and Brownfield projects.
* Strong knowledge of protection schemes, control systems, SCADA, SAS, and IEC 61850-based substations.
* Proficiency in AutoCAD and Raster Design; exposure to MicroStation, Revit, or other engineering design tools is advantageous and experience in preparing protection schematics, wiring diagrams, panel layouts, interconnection diagrams, and cable schedules.
* Good understanding of IEC, IEEE, utility, and client-specific standards related to substation design.
* Ability to coordinate effectively with Protection Engineers, Primary, Civil, Telecom, and multidisciplinary project teams.
* Experience in preparing, checking, and reviewing PC drawings while ensuring quality, accuracy, and compliance with project requirements.
* A strong grasp of drawing standards, CAD/BIM protocols, and project workflows.
* Familiarity with National Grid (UK) standards is a significant advantage.
* Ability to prepare and check complex drawings, ensuring quality and compliance with CAD/BIM standards.
* Exposure to international substation projects and utility standards is an advantage.
* Strong technical, analytical, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to mentor junior designers and support project delivery.

 **About you**  

*Technical Competencies*

*Essential*

* Proficiency in AutoCAD Raster Design
* Excellent drafting and detailing skills.
* Strong understanding of substation protection and control systems.
* Strong understanding of CAD/PC standards and drawing protocols.
* Ability to prepare and check PC Interface drawings.
* Ensure quality assurance and compliance with CAD standards, project procedures, and drawing control requirements

*Desirable*

* Exposure to international standards (UK, India, Middle East, APAC).

* Experience in greenfield and brownfield substation projects.
* Proficiency in AutoCAD; exposure to Raster Design, MicroStation, Revit, or other electrical CAD tools is advantageous.

Since 1889, we have aligned our efforts with our three guiding Principles That Endure: Service, Expertise, and Integrity. jobs.title: Senior SAP & ERP Transformation Lead
jobs.description:
**Senior SAP & ERP Transformation Lead**

**Experience:** 1012+ Years  
 **Qualification:** B.E. / B.Tech in Computer Science, Information Technology or equivalent  
 **Preferred Expertise:** SAP, ERP Architecture, ERP Migration, Process Re-engineering and System Integration

**Role Overview**

We are looking for an experienced SAP & ERP Transformation professional with deep end-to-end knowledge of SAP's technical and functional architecture, who can assess, rationalise and eventually lead the migration of the organisation's existing SAP ecosystem to an alternative ERP platform.

The individual will be responsible for understanding the existing SAP landscape across modules, mapping interdependencies between processes, identifying redundancies and recommending an appropriate future-state ERP architecture.

The role requires a strong combination of technical programming capabilities, functional SAP expertise, business process understanding and ERP migration experience. The individual should be capable of evaluating how a change in one module, process or configuration impacts other interconnected business functions.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. End-to-End SAP Architecture & Expertise**

* Develop a comprehensive understanding of the existing SAP landscape, including its modules, configurations, customisations, workflows and integrations.
* Demonstrate strong techno-functional knowledge across SAP modules such as:

+ SAP MM – Materials Management
+ SAP PP – Production Planning
+ SAP SD – Sales & Distribution
+ SAP FI/CO – Finance & Controlling
+ SAP QM – Quality Management
+ SAP PM – Plant Maintenance
+ SAP WM/EWM – Warehouse Management
+ SAP HCM – Human Capital Management

* Understand the interdependencies between modules and assess the downstream and upstream impact of system-level changes.
* Review existing custom developments, ABAP code, interfaces, reports and system configurations.

**2. ERP Migration & Transformation**

* Lead the assessment and migration strategy for transitioning from the existing SAP environment to an alternative ERP platform.
* Evaluate suitable ERP solutions such as Oracle ERP, ERPNext or other enterprise platforms based on business requirements.
* Develop a comprehensive migration roadmap covering data, processes, applications, integrations and infrastructure.
* Identify functionalities that can be migrated, redesigned, consolidated or eliminated.
* Ensure data integrity, business continuity and minimal operational disruption during migration.
* Lead migration planning, testing, validation, deployment and post-implementation stabilisation.

**3. Business Process Re-engineering**

* Map and document existing end-to-end business processes across departments.
* Identify redundant, overlapping, outdated or inefficient processes.
* Design, restructure, consolidate or eliminate processes wherever required.
* Develop future-state workflows aligned with business requirements and operational efficiency.
* Ensure that changes in one business process are evaluated for their impact on other interconnected functions.

**4. Technical & Development Expertise**

* Possess strong understanding of SAP technical architecture, ABAP programming, debugging and custom code development.
* Understand APIs, database architecture, data structures, integrations and middleware.
* Assess the feasibility of replicating or redesigning existing SAP functionalities in the new ERP environment.
* Work with technical teams to develop customised solutions, interfaces and automation wherever required.

**5. Stakeholder Management & ERP Governance**

* Work closely with Finance, HR, Manufacturing, Supply Chain, Sales, Projects and other business functions.
* Conduct functional assessments and gather business requirements from stakeholders.
* Establish centralised control over ERP-related projects, changes and process improvements.
* Develop system documentation, process maps, impact assessments and migration governance mechanisms.
* Coordinate with implementation partners, consultants and internal IT teams.

  

**Desired Candidate Profile**

* 10–12+ years of relevant experience in SAP consulting, ERP architecture, ERP transformation or large-scale ERP migration.
* B.E. / B.Tech in Computer Science, IT or a related engineering discipline preferred.
* Strong techno-functional expertise across multiple SAP modules.
* Hands-on experience with ABAP programming, debugging, system configuration and integration.
* Demonstrated experience in ERP migration, preferably from SAP to Oracle, ERPNext or other enterprise ERP platforms.
* Strong understanding of cross-functional business processes and system interdependencies.
* Experience in process mapping, process redesign and business process re-engineering.
* Ability to independently assess existing systems and recommend appropriate technology and process solutions.
* Strong project management, analytical and stakeholder management capabilities.

  

**Key Expectations from the Role**

The successful candidate should be able to:

1. Understand the existing SAP ecosystem end-to-end without depending entirely on external consultants.
2. Map all existing modules, processes, customisations and system interdependencies.
3. Identify what needs to be retained, modified, consolidated or discontinued.
4. Assess the impact of any proposed change across the entire ERP ecosystem.
5. Recommend the most suitable alternative ERP platform and migration approach.
6. Develop and execute a structured migration roadmap with minimal business disruption.
7. Establish a centralised ERP architecture and governance framework for the organisation.

  

**The ultimate objective is to move from a fragmented and heavily dependent SAP environment towards a streamlined, integrated and scalable ERP ecosystem.**

Ecolab seeks a business-centric analytics professional who excels at turning ambiguous questions into actionable insights and has deep expertise in evolving those insights into scalable, production-ready solutions.

This role is the leader of a small team that sits at the intersection of business strategy, data, and product thinking. The primary strength of this role is the ability to quickly understand business context, translate it into meaningful metrics and analyses, and deliver relevant outputs that move decision-making forward.

In addition to leading the team, this individual will work iteratively with a variety of stakeholders across the enterprise. The day-to-day may include rapidly prototyping analyses, tools, or visualizations, refining them with stakeholders, and ultimately identifying which solutions should be scaled. As solutions mature, they will partner with BI developers and data engineers to operationalize them.

The person in this role will either facilitate the start of scaled solutions or they may contribute to hands-on delivery of scaled solution.

Success in this role is defined not by technical complexity, but by the ability to deliver relevant, impactful, data solutions.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* **Translate business needs into data-driven solutions**
  + Engage stakeholders to understand goals, context, and constraints
  + Identify the most relevant questions, metrics, and drivers of value

  + Deliver early versions of analyses, dashboards, models, or lightweight tools either via PowerPoint, PowerBI, Streamlit, or custom AI tools.
  + Iterate based on feedback to refine usefulness and clarity

* **Perform data transformation and analysis**

* **Design meaningful metrics and outputs**
  + Define metrics that align with real business outcomes. Work with stakeholders to understand gaps in metric definitions or propose functional alternatives.
  + Ensure outputs are interpretable, actionable, and relevant to business needs.
* **Evolve prototypes into scalable solutions**
  + Translate prototypes into clear requirements for BI developers and data engineers
  + Partner cross-functionally to scale solutions into production
  + Sometimes contribute to scaled products.
* **Operate flexibly between guidance and execution**
  + Provide direction and oversight when resources allow

* **Drive insight-led decision-making**
  + Use outputs to guide and advance stakeholder conversations
  + Continuously refine questions and approaches through iteration

**Required Qualifications:**

jobs.title: Sales Support Representative
jobs.description:
The Sales Support Representative (SSR) delivers prompt transactional support to Account Executives (AE) and Area Sales Directors (ASD) by preparing quotes, cost proposals, pilot orders, drop shipments, and implementations via a CRM system. The SSR handles transactional tasks so AEs and ASDs can concentrate on selling and building relationships, driving revenue and customer satisfaction.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Cost Proposals/Quotes**
  + Create and assist with cost proposals and quotes using the Salesforce (CRM) within the established service level agreement (SLA) timeframe.
  + Ensure pricing accuracy and compliance with approval workflows with each quote.
  + Generate standard and customized quote documents for customers.
* **Implementation/Gratis, Sample Orders, and Pilots**
  + Process, monitor, and track implementation/gratis requests based on established guidelines by product, Line of Business (LoB), or unique conditions.
  + Submit and track sample orders. Provide detailed information for custom shipments and labeling.
  + Execute pilot orders following the established guidelines and directions from the HMH Pilot team.
* **Sales Operations**
  + Handle inbound requests for quotes, samples, implementation/gratis, etc., from AE and ASD teams.
  + Research product availability, pricing, and tracking information.
  + Escalate issues to management when necessary.
* **Systems Tools**
  + Develop and maintain working knowledge of Salesforce, SAP, Sales Hub, and Customer Care platforms.
  + Perform daily sales transactions via SFDC and maintain organized records of sales activities.
* **Collaboration Communication**
  + Liaise with sales support team members and internal departments to troubleshoot and resolve issues.
  + Participate in process improvement initiatives and team meetings.
  + Provide clear, concise, and frequent updates related to transaction status with Sales Support manager(s), AEs, ASDs, etc.

**Core Competencies**

* **Adaptability** Maintain effectiveness when experiencing major changes in work responsibilities or environment, adjusting effectively to work within new work structures, processes, or requirements.
* **Navigating Complexity** Proactively and quickly making sense of complex issues; responding effectively to complex and ambiguous situations; communicating complicated information simply.
* **Communication** Clearly conveying information and ideas through a variety of media to individuals or groups in a manner that helps them understand and retain the message.
* **Continuous Improvement** Originating action to improve existing conditions and processes; identifying improvement opportunities, generating ideas, and implementing solutions.
* **Time Management** Effectively manages one's time and resources to ensure that work is completed efficiently.
* **Technical / Professional Knowledge and Skills** Having achieved a satisfactory level of technical and professional skill or knowledge in position-related areas; keeping up with current developments and trends in areas of expertise.

**Qualifications**

* **Education:** AA/BS/BA degree
* **Experience:** 3-5 years sales support experience required.
* **Skills:**
  + Proficiency in MS Office (Word, Excel).
  + Experience with Salesforce and SAP, NetSuite is a plus.
  + Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  + Ability to work in a fast-paced, results-oriented environment.

**Physical Requirements**

* Stationary position for a considerable time (sitting and/or standing).
* Constantly operates a computer
* Must be able to collaborate with colleagues via face-to-face, email, Teams, conference calls, and online meetings.

**Project description**

Our client is undertaking a re-implementation of the R24 core banking solution to replace the existing R21 system. This project includes implementation, migration, development of new integrations, and a review of the current Level 3 development to adapt it for the new system. The project is led by the bank, with DXC contributing resources at full capacity.

* Oversee the design and development of migration extraction, transformation, and loading processes.
* Manage data quality assessments, cleansing activities, and issue remediation.
* Define and execute reconciliation and validation processes to ensure data accuracy and completeness.
* Plan, coordinate, and manage trial migrations, mock migrations, and production migration rehearsals.
* Develop migration runbooks, cutover plans, and go-live migration procedures.
* Monitor migration risks, issues, dependencies, and mitigation actions.
* Provide migration status reporting and governance updates to project stakeholders.
* Coordinate migration activities across Customer, Accounts, Deposits, Lending, Limits, Collateral, Payments, Treasury, FX, Securities, Private Equity, Wealth Management, and Financial Accounting domains.
* Lead production migration execution and support post-migration validation and sign-off activities.

**Skills**

Must have

* Hard skills:
* 10-15 Years of Experience in Data Migration
* Demonstrates strong expertise in Temenos Transact data structures, application architecture, and migration methodologies.
* Proficient with core Data Migration (DM) tools and experienced in JBC programming for data extraction from source releases.
* Skilled in utilizing Jira, Azure DevOps, and Confluence for project tracking and collaboration.
* Capable of designing data migration solutions and performing mapping for core components when necessary.
* Soft skills:
* Ability to analyze complex data environments and develop efficient migration approaches.

Nice to have

* Familiarity with SQL tools: Basic understanding of SQL for data query and manipulation tasks.
* Development experience in Java or Python: Practical coding skills in either Java or Python programming languages.

**Other**

* Languages: English: B1 Intermediate
* Seniority: Regular

jobs.title: Regional Compliance (FCC)
jobs.description:
KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES  
  

**Fiserv Screening**

  
  

  
* Perform 1st level review all alerts from client’s Local business units (LBU), close alerts determined to be “false positives”, follow up with data owners to evaluate alerts which requires further information, and escalate to LBU MLRO alerts which are true matches of PEP, SIP/SIE and sanctions prohibition.
  
* Assist RMLRO in monitoring the status of Fiserv alerts across all LBUs, identify LBU with significant backlog and to work with LBU on a remediation plan.
  
* Explore obtaining and extracting data from Fiserv into MI form
  

  
  

**HO sanctioned securities screening**

  
  

  
* Provide operational support on sanctions hits generated at pre-trade and post-trade screening in Aladdin.  This includes –  
    
    
  + Extract case report from **Refinitiv/World-Check One** and ascertain if the sanctions hit is a “false positive” or “true match”.
    
  + Performs ad-hoc screening of securities upon request by portfolio managers.
    
  + Collate and document outcome of alerts review.  This includes maintaining a list of sanctioned securities reviewed by MLRO, including the final assessment and follow up actions (eg impose investment ban in Aladdin)
  
* Assist in the regular review of applicable sanctions programs captured in the Aladdin screening.
  
* Troubleshoot Fiserv/World Check One related issues with vendor as applicable and act as point of liaison between LBUs and IT and PCA support team
  
* Be the in-house SME on all things Refinitiv/World Check one from a user perspective as it relates to the system and how data is compiled, analysed, extracted and managed in Refinitiv/World Check One.
  

  
  

**HO oversight on ABC and AML/Sanctions risk metrics and staff training**

  
  

  
* Assist RMLRO in the review of quarterly ABC and AML/Sanctions MIs submitted by LBUs.
  
* Collate and document outcome of RMLO review and submission of MI to Group Compliance.
  
* Assist RMLRO in collating and documenting the outcome of RMLRO review of LBU annual Financial Crime Risk Assessment.
  
* Assist RMLRO in updating the HO training deck for ABC and AML computer-based training for staff.
  

  
  

**AML and ABC processes and controls**

  
  

  
* Assist Singapore (SG) MLRO in performing customer due diligence and enhanced due diligence to identify issues presenting potential legal, regulatory, sanctions or reputational risk.
  
* Assist SG MLRO in conducting transaction monitoring and identifying suspicious activity, and to process filing of Suspicious Transaction Report to the authorities in Singapore as well as reporting to Group Compliance.
  
* Assist SG MLRO in updating and implementing KYC and client onboarding policies and procedures
  
* Coordinate staff training.
  
* Assist SG ABC Officer in maintaining the Gifts & Hospitality Register and performing the quarterly G&H reconciliation against expense records filed with Finance Department.
  

  
  

EXPERIENCE / QUALIFICATIONS

  
  

  
* Graduate or post-graduate degree in Accountancy/Law/Business/Banking/Finance.
  
* Minimum 5 years of relevant compliance experience in asset management compliance setup.
  
* Strong foundation in AML/CFT/Sanctions regulations with proven ability to apply such regulatory concepts in the day-to-day function and to articulate such concepts clearly to management and internal stakeholders. Experience in dealing with Monetary Authority of Singapore (MAS) Notices and relevant Acts is desirable.
  
* Individual should also possess strong technical knowledge and understanding of key global sanctions regimes (e.g. OFAC and EU).
  
* Sanctions expertise (sanctions law qualification, ACAMS) a plus
  
* Excellent communication skills (written and verbal) and effective inter-personal skills with experience in working with different stakeholders.
  
* Business transformation and innovation skills
  
* Adaptive, mature, motivated and has ability to use own initiative.
  
* Resilient in dealing with multiple initiatives and challenges and pay attention to detail.
  
* Forward looking mindset, independent and has positive “can do” attitude

* Identify risks, control gaps, and compliance impacts early in the delivery lifecycle to support effective mitigation.
* Contribute to data governance, metadata, and documentation standards where applicable.

**Continuous Improvement:**

* Recommend changes to business analysis practices, delivery processes, and documentation standards to enhance quality and consistency.
* Stay current on industry best practices, regulatory updates, and developments in the data warehousing payments landscape to inform solution design and delivery.
* Monitor changes to business processes and systems to ensure downstream data and reporting impacts are identified

**CROSS-FUNCTIONAL RELATIONSHIPS:**

* This job collaborates with project managers to provide status updates, requirement insights, risk assessments, and delivery support.

* Provides specialized business analysis expertise for data processed from the wire engine and wire room applications
* Acts as a primary liaison between Business, Operations, Quality Engineering, and Technology partners for assigned projects and enhancements.

* Provides advisory and support services

jobs.description:
**Position: Data Transformation Analyst**

**Shift Timings : 12 PM to 9 PM (cab facility will be provided)**

**Job Type : Permanent**

  
  

**Job Summary**

The Data Analytics professional is responsible for analyzing procurement and spend data to provide actionable insights that support strategic sourcing, cost optimization, supplier management, and business decision-making. The role focuses on transforming complex data into meaningful dashboards, reports, KPIs, and recommendations for procurement and business stakeholders.

  

**Key Roles & Responsibilities**

* Analyze procurement, spend and savings data across **suppliers, categories, business units, regions,** and **time periods** to identify trends, opportunities, and potential areas for cost optimization.
* Develop, maintain and enhance **Spend and Savings Analytics dashboards and reports** using tools such as **Power BI, Excel, SQL, and data visualization platforms**.
* Consolidate, cleanse, validate, and classify spend data from multiple systems and data sources to improve reporting accuracy and consistency.
* Perform **spend classification and category analysis** to provide greater visibility into organizational spending patterns.
* Support for the modernization of the reporting landscape, including migration of Power BI products to Databricks Unity Catalog.
* Track and report key procurement metrics and **KPIs**, including spend by category, supplier concentration, sourcing coverage, savings performance, and procurement compliance.
* Partner with **Procurement, Strategic Sourcing, Category Management, Finance, and other business stakeholders** to understand analytical and reporting requirements.
* Identify opportunities for **supplier consolidation, sourcing initiatives, and cost reduction** using data-driven analysis.
* Conduct supplier-level analysis to highlight spend concentration, supplier fragmentation, and opportunities for improved supplier management.
* Create executive-level dashboards and presentations translating analytical findings into **clear business insights and recommendations**.
* Establish data validation and quality-control processes to ensure the reliability and consistency of procurement reporting.
* Support monthly, quarterly, and annual procurement reporting cycles and ensure timely delivery of dashboards and metrics.
* Automate recurring reports and analytical processes where possible to improve efficiency and reduce manual effort.
* Work with data and technology teams to resolve **data-quality, integration, mapping, and reporting issues**.
* Maintain reporting documentation, business definitions, KPI logic, and standardized reporting methodologies.
* Support ad-hoc analysis requested by procurement leadership and other stakeholders.

  

**Technical Skills**

* **Power BI** Dashboard development, data visualization, DAX, Power Query
* **Microsoft Excel** PivotTables, Power Query, advanced formulas and analytical models
* **Databricks:** Dashboard connections, data preparation for Power BI Dashboards
* **SQL** Data extraction, transformation, validation and analysis
* **Python** – Advantageous for data cleansing, automation and advanced analytics
* Strong understanding of **data modeling, data quality, spend classification and KPI reporting**
* Familiarity with procurement/ERP platforms such as **SAP, SAP Ariba or similar systems** is advantageous

  

**Core Competencies**

* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
* Procurement and spend-analysis knowledge
* Data visualization and storytelling
* Attention to data accuracy and quality
* Stakeholder management
* Ability to translate business requirements into analytical solutions
* Strong communication and presentation skills
* Ability to manage multiple reporting priorities and deadlines

  

**Typical Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in **Business, Supply Chain, Data Analytics, Information Systems**, or a related discipline.
* Experience in **Spend Analytics, Procurement Analytics, Business Intelligence, Reporting, Supply Chain Analytics, or Data Analytics**.
* Hands-on experience developing dashboards and analytical reports using **Power BI and Excel**.
* Experience working with large procurement or financial datasets is preferred.

jobs.title: Head of Transformation, Field Operations
jobs.description:
Job Description   
   **About the Team**  

The Strategy and Transformation team for the Field Operations organization at Uber sets the vision and strategy for Field Ops, runs agent operations, undertakes our most complex and transformative projects, and drives the optimization of our global operations. We execute this future-state vision across five core pillars: Special Projects, Strategy and Programs, Business Planning and Improvement, Transformation, and Analytics. Within Transformation, we act as the catalyst for large-scale structural change, redefining our operating models, optimizing our global footprint, and fostering a high-performance culture that empowers our globally distributed workforce to thrive.

  **About the Role**  

As the Head of Transformation, you will lead the Transformation Office for the entire Field Ops organization. You will be the central force driving our most critical organizational shifts, taking ownership of key workstreams spanning our footprint, operating model, people, technology, and culture.

In this highly visible leadership role, you will set the overarching agenda and narrative for the transformation, ensuring alignment across the business. You will build the robust tracking and reporting infrastructure necessary to measure success and define the target culture that underpins our future state. Operating in a highly matrixed environment, you will manage complex, interdependent initiatives involving multiple internal and external stakeholders. You are a seasoned leader with exceptional executive presence, capable of influencing senior management and driving large-scale change across a highly distributed global network.

This is not a traditional PMO or program management role. We are looking for a leader who can combine strategic thinking with operational executionsomeone who can define the future state, influence executive stakeholders, and personally lead complex transformation initiatives from concept through implementation.

  **What You''ll Do**  

* **Transformation Office Leadership:**   Direct the central Transformation Office, overseeing end-to-end strategy and execution for core workstreams including footprint, operating model, people, tech, and culture.
* **Agenda Narrative Setting:**   Define the strategic agenda and author the overarching narrative for the transformation, ensuring clear alignment and purpose across the organization.
* **Culture Definition:**   Set the target culture and cultural narrative, ensuring structural changes are supported by the right behaviors and mindsets.
* **Infrastructure Tracking:**   Build and manage a rigorous tracking, reporting, and governance infrastructure to monitor the health and progress of all transformational initiatives.
* **Stakeholder Executive Influence:**   Manage complex, highly interdependent cross-functional initiatives, leveraging strong reporting and influencing abilities to align senior management and diverse stakeholders.
* **Drive AI Technology Transformation:** Partner across Product, Engineering, and Operations to identify opportunities to leverage AI, automation, and technology to reduce manual work, improve operational efficiency, and enable scalable growth.

  **Basic Qualifications and Experience**  

* Bachelor''s or Postgraduate degree.
* 10 to 15 years of professional experience, with at least 5+ years specifically dedicated to leading large-scale change and transformation programs in a large, distributed organization.
* **Must Have:**   Prior experience in management consulting combined with a background in direct operating roles.

  **Preferred Experience**  

* Led enterprise-wide operating model transformations within complex global organizations.
* Experience driving productivity, cost optimization, or organizational effectiveness programs.
* Built governance models for multi-workstream transformation portfolios.
* Exceptional executive communication and stakeholder management skills.
* Experience partnering directly with C-level executives or executive steering committees.
* Experience leading change management and organizational capability-building initiatives.

* Stay current with trends, treatment guidelines, and regulatory updates in both OTC and Rx domains.

**Medical and Scientific Content Development**

* Leverage scientific expertise to create high-quality communication materials in the OTC and Rx space.
* Research, write, edit, organize, interpret, curate, and quality-check various types of scientific content across multiple formats and channels.
* Prepare, review, and edit a range of scientific documents, including:
  + Literature reviews
  + Manuscripts for peer-reviewed journals
  + Abstracts, posters, and slide decks for scientific conferences
  + Treatment guideline summaries
  + Publication summaries and white papers
* Ensure scientific accuracy, clarity, and compliance with applicable guidelines (e.g., ICMJE, CONSORT).

**Content Review and Quality Assurance**

* Review medical, promotional, and scientific materials in accordance with internal SOPs and external guidelines.
* Verify references and ensure content is plagiarism-free.
* Ensure clear, factual, and effective presentation of data and discussions.
* Maintain and apply templates, formats, and styles to ensure compliance with industry and client standards.

**Project Execution**

* Understand and define client requirements during project initiation, including objectives and timelines.
* Develop scientifically accurate and medically relevant content across therapeutic areas, adhering to branding and regulatory guidelines.
* Manage multiple projects simultaneously, ensuring quality and client satisfaction.
* Respond to and deliver ad-hoc client requests within agreed timelines.
* Collaborate with medical writing colleagues, the graphics team, and clients as needed.

**Other Responsibilities**

* **Mentorship:** Actively mentor team members to support effective task execution and goal achievement.
* **Values and Behaviors:** Consistently demonstrate WNS values and foster positive relationships with internal and external stakeholders.
* **Personal Development:** Identify learning and development needs in collaboration with the line manager and pursue relevant training opportunities.

**Key Performance Indicators**

**Process-Related**

* **Domain Expertise:** Quickly build subject matter expertise in assigned therapeutic areas.
* **Efficiency:** Develop effective search strategies, organize data for analysis, and prepare medical and scientific content.
* **Accuracy:** Validate sources, identify data gaps, and ensure scientific rigor.
* **Quality:** Deliver well-structured, grammatically sound, and visually engaging documents using appropriate templates and tone.

**People-Related**

* Demonstrate strong teamwork, collaboration, and professionalism.
* Actively participate in team meetings, knowledge-sharing sessions, and training initiatives.

**Required Competencies & Skills**

**Must Have**

* Strong understanding of the pharmaceutical, OTC, and consumer healthcare landscape.
* Clear grasp of medical, scientific, and statistical terminology and concepts.
* Robust knowledge of various types of clinical studies, the structure, and formats of different manuscript types (e.g., SLR, TLR, Meta-analysis), along with their relevance and application in evidence synthesis and utilization.

----------------

Citi, the leading global bank, has approximately 200 million customer accounts and does business in more than 160 countries and jurisdictions. Citi provides consumers, corporations, governments and institutions with a broad range of financial products and services, including consumer banking and credit, corporate and investment banking, securities brokerage, transaction services, and wealth management. We strive to earn and maintain our clients and the publics trust by constantly adhering to the highest ethical standards and making a positive impact on the communities we serve. Our Leadership Standards is a common set of skills and expected behaviors that illustrate how our employees should work every day to be successful and strengthens our ability to execute against our strategic priorities.

  
  

**The Quality Assurance and Testing Validation (QATV) team** delivers independent oversight and rigorous validation across the organization's regulatory reporting ecosystem and is dedicated to ensuring the highest standards of accuracy, reliability and control through testing Citi’s regulatory and management reporting while providing an objective assessment of issue remediation.

QATV Reporting & Analytics team provides analytical support on:

Reporting & Intelligence — Building and maintaining data marts, synthesizing test results into quantitative metrics, and authoring detailed qualitative narratives and formal publication reports for senior stakeholders and report owners.

Operational Intelligence & Capacity Planning — Monitor testing sprints to ensure timeline adherence, leading proactive capacity planning across all execution phases, and leveraging skill assessments to assign qualified personnel to appropriate testing stages.

Testing & Exception Management Automation — Automation of design, creation, and execution of test scripts

  
  

**Job Summary:**

The **Business Analytics****Int Analyst** will be part of QATV team within Citi AIM vertical, a global community driving data-driven transformation across Citi. In this role, the Analyst will support the QATV function by maintaining dedicated testing data marts, consolidating validation outcomes, identifying data inconsistencies, and assisting in the drafting of detailed narrative reports and metrics for final publication to key stakeholders.

Working in close collaboration with team leads, the Analyst will also support testing delivery governance and resource management. This includes monitoring sprint cycles to track milestone adherence, maintaining capacity planning models to ensure balanced workload distribution, and assisting with skills-matrix assessments to align team capabilities with testing demand across all phases of regulatory validation.

**In this role, you are expected to:**

* Assist in organizing and maintaining dedicated testing data marts and data pipelines.
* Extract, validate, and analyze test execution data to calculate key quality and performance metrics.
* Help draft initial narrative summaries, executive dashboards, and documentation for final test result publication.
* Research and identify data inconsistencies, trends, or reporting gaps to support root-cause analysis.
* Track and update sprint milestones, deliverables, and cycle times to ensure on-time testing execution.
* Support team capacity planning by gathering allocation data and tracking utilization across testing stages.
* Assist in maintaining skill inventory matrices to facilitate optimal, competency-based resource assignment.
* Continuously improve processes and strategies by exploring and evaluating new data sources, tools, and capabilities
* Work closely with internal and external business partners in building, implementing, tracking and improving decision strategies
  

  

**Qualifications:**

* Work experience: 5+ years with Masters as Educational background

* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to identify and quantify opportunities for improvement.

* Technical Skills: Basic statistical Modeling (Logistic Regression, Decision Tree), SQL, SAS , Python

* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills

* Banking Knowledge: Good understanding of the banking domain, banking products and Operations in banking is preferred.

* Soft Skills: Ability to multi-task effectively and efficiently in a fast-paced environment.

* Bachelors/University degree or equivalent experience

jobs.title: Sr. SAP SD / CS Functional Consultant
jobs.description:
**Who We Are**

At Kyndryl, we run and reimagine the mission-critical technology systems that drive advantage for the world’s leading businesses. We are at the heart of progress; with proven expertise and a continuous flow of AI-powered insight, enabling smarter decisions, faster innovation, and a lasting competitive edge. For our people—Kyndryls—that means doing purposeful work that powers human progress. Join us and experience a flexible, supportive environment where your well-being is prioritized and your potential can thrive.

**The Role**

**Your Role**

Senior SAP Sales & Distribution (SD) and Customer Service (CS) Functional Consultant. You will architect, configure, and maintain end-to-end commercial sales, order fulfillment, and aftermarket customer service processes. You will serve as the functional SME guiding business teams through Order-to-Cash (OTC) and service lifecycle transformations across SAP ECC and SAP S/4HANA environments.

  

**What You Will Do**

* **Order-to-Cash Execution:** Lead business blueprinting and configuration for complete OTC processes, including sales orders, contracts, quotations, pricing condition techniques, delivery, shipping, and billing.
* **Customer Service Operations:** Design and configure core SAP CS components, including service notifications, service orders, repair orders, returns processing, warranty checks, and service level agreements (SLAs).
* **Technical Master Data & Assets:** Define and manage structures for Installed Base (IBASE), Equipment Master, Functional Locations, and Customer/Business Partner master records.
* **Cross-Module Integration:** Drive seamless functional integration between SD/CS and Materials Management (MM), Plant Maintenance (PM), Financial Accounting (FI), and S/4HANA Service/FSCM.
* **Credit & Risk Controls:** Configure and maintain credit management workflows, credit checks, release strategies, and billing plans.
* **Implementation Delivery:** Drive Fit-to-Standard workshops, author Functional Specification Documents (FSDs), coordinate technical developments, and lead SIT, UAT, and hypercare support.

  

One of the benefits of Kyndryl is that we work with clients in a variety of industries, from banking to retail. Whether you want to broaden your knowledge base or narrow your scope and specialize in a specific sector, you can find your opportunity here. You’ll also get the chance to share your expertise by recommending modernization options, identifying new business opportunities, and cultivating relationships with other teams and stakeholders. Does the work get challenging at times? Yes! But you’ll collaborate with a diverse group of talented people and gain invaluable management and organizational skills, which will come in handy as you move forward in your career.

**Your future at Kyndryl**  
Every position at Kyndryl offers a way forward to grow your career, from Junior System Administrator to Architect. We have opportunities for Cloud Hyperscalers that you won’t find anywhere else, including hands-on experience, learning opportunities, and the chance to certify in all four major platforms. One of the benefits of Kyndryl is that we work with clients in a variety of industries, from banking to retail. Whether you want to broaden your knowledge base or narrow your scope and specialize in a specific sector.

**Who You Are**

You’re good at what you do and possess the required experience to prove it. However, equally as important – you have a growth mindset; keen to drive your own personal and professional development. You are customer-focused – someone who prioritizes customer success in their work. And finally, you’re open and borderless – naturally inclusive in how you work with others.

**Required skills and experience**

* **Experience Level:** 10+ years of total IT experience with 8+ years of core functional expertise in SAP SD and SAP CS.
* **SD / OTC Depth:** Deep configuration experience in Sales Order Processing, Advanced Pricing Procedures, Availability Check (ATP), Delivery/Shipping, Invoicing, and Partner Determination.
* **CS / Service Depth:** Comprehensive knowledge of Service Orders, Service Contracts, Warranties, Equipment Management, Installed Base, and Return & Repair workflows.
* **Integration Knowledge:** Proven experience integrating SD and CS with SAP FI (revenue account determination, billing), MM (procurement of service parts), and PM.
* **Project Delivery:** Strong capability in conducting requirement-gathering workshops, writing functional specifications for RICEFW items, and managing defect tracking.

  

**Preferred skills and experience**

* **Certifications:** SAP Certified Application Associate – SAP S/4HANA Sales or SAP Service.
* **S/4HANA Service Transition:** Hands-on exposure to S/4HANA Service management, SAP Fiori service apps, or transition from classical CS to S/4HANA Service.
* **Advanced Capabilities:** Experience with EDI/IDoc processing for sales orders and advanced credit management in SAP S/4HANA.

**Being You**

The “Kyn” in Kyndryl means kinship, which represents the strong bonds we have with each other, our customers and our communities. We focus on ensuring all Kyndryls feel included and we welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We believe in growth, and we’re excited to see what you can bring. At Kyndryl, employee feedback has told us that our number one driver of employee engagement is belonging. That sense of belonging — being a valued, respected, trusted member of the team — is fundamental to our culture and fueling great experiences for our customers. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you the ability to thrive and contribute to our culture of empathy and shared success. That’s The Kyndryl Way.

**What You Can Expect**

Your career with us isn’t just a job—it’s an adventure with purpose. We offer a dynamic, hybrid-friendly culture that supports your well-being and empowers you to grow. Our Be Well programs are thoughtfully designed to support your financial, mental, physical, and social health—because we know that when you feel your best, you do your best.
  
  
From your very first day, you’ll dive into impactful work that powers the systems our customers rely on every day. You won’t just contribute—you’ll make a difference, tackling meaningful projects that sharpen your skills and fuel your growth.
  
  
We’re here to champion your journey. With powerful tools to chart your career path, personalized development goals aligned with your ambitions, and continuous feedback to keep you inspired and on track, you’ll have everything you need to thrive and evolve. You’ll develop in-demand skills to grow your career and achieve your ambitions with access to cutting-edge learning opportunities—from certifications with Microsoft, Google, and Amazon to coaching and hands-on experiences. And through it all, you’ll be part of a culture that values empathy, restless learning, and a devotion to shared success.
  
  
We want you to thrive here—and we’re committed to helping you do just that. Ready to make an impact? Join us and help shape what’s next.

**Get Referred!**

If you know someone that works at Kyndryl, when asked ‘How Did You Hear About Us’ during the application process, select ‘Employee Referral’ and enter your contact's Kyndryl email address.

The primary purpose of an SAP HR / SAP Human Capital Management for SAP S/4HANA (H4S4) Consultant is to design, implement, and maintain a modernized, on-premise or private cloud core HR and payroll transition solution that bridges legacy SAP ERP HCM systems to the next-generation SAP S/4HANA architecture. Employees in this role define and use design documentation, functional programming specifications, and high-level design documents to implement identified components. **What you will do**

* **Lead Solution Design & Workshops:** Drive requirements-gathering workshops, conduct fit-gap analyses against standard SAP H4S4 and SuccessFactors functionalities, author configuration workbooks, and document business processes and approval workflows.

But you’ll collaborate with a diverse group of talented people and gain invaluable management and organizational skills, which will come in handy as you move forward in your career.

  

**Your future at Kyndryl**  
Every position at Kyndryl offers a way forward to grow your career, from Junior System Administrator to Architect. We have opportunities for Cloud Hyperscalers that you won’t find anywhere else, including hands-on experience, learning opportunities, and the chance to certify in all four major platforms. One of the benefits of Kyndryl is that we work with clients in a variety of industries, from banking to retail. Whether you want to broaden your knowledge base or narrow your scope and specialize in a specific sector.

**Who You Are**

You’re good at what you do and possess the required experience to prove it. However, equally as important – you have a growth mindset; keen to drive your own personal and professional development. You are customer-focused – someone who prioritizes customer success in their work. And finally, you’re open and borderless – naturally inclusive in how you work with others.

  

**Required skills and experience**

* Minimum 10+ years of hands-on functional experience in SAP HR/HCM, SAP ERP, or SAP SuccessFactors, including full-cycle SAP S/4HANA implementations or migrations.

Proven track record authoring functional specifications, managing ETL/data migrations (LSMW, BDC, MDG), and leading SIT, UAT, cutover, and hypercare phases across the full project lifecycle.  

  

**Preferred skills and experience**

* **Hybrid Cloud & Talent Integration:** Practical experience prototyping, configuring, and integrating SAP SuccessFactors modules with on-premise/private cloud H4S4 environments.
* **Professional Certifications:** Relevant SAP certifications in SAP HCM, SAP S/4HANA (H4S4), or SAP SuccessFactors.

**Being You**

The “Kyn” in Kyndryl means kinship, which represents the strong bonds we have with each other, our customers and our communities. Working across multiple business functions, the role ensures that reconciliation outcomes are achieved within agreed service levels while maintaining adherence to reconciliation policies, control standards and governance requirements.

• Escalate aged, material or high-risk exceptions through appropriate governance channels to enable timely resolution and management oversight.

• Identify emerging risks, recurring exceptions and control weaknesses, recommending actions that improve reconciliation effectiveness and reduce operational losses.

**Who We Are**

At Kyndryl, we run and reimagine the mission-critical technology systems that drive advantage for the world’s leading businesses. We are at the heart of progress; with proven expertise and a continuous flow of AI-powered insight, enabling smarter decisions, faster innovation, and a lasting competitive edge. For our people—Kyndryls—that means doing purposeful work that powers human progress. Join us and experience a flexible, supportive environment where your well-being is prioritized and your potential can thrive.

**The Role**

**Your Role**

An SAP Integration Developer (BTP Integration Suite / CPI / PI/PO) acts as the central connective tissue of an enterprise’s IT ecosystem. This role is responsible for designing, building, and maintaining seamless end-to-end data flows and process integrations between SAP systems (S/4HANA, SuccessFactors, C/4HANA, Ariba) and non-SAP cloud or on-premise applications.

With your vast knowledge of SAP and industry, you assist top-tier clients in their SAP digital transformation efforts. Your role entails providing guidance and executing SAP digital transformation initiatives. You also conceptualize, create, improve and optimize solutions using SAP development tools and platforms. Additionally, you work alongside global teams and partners across various functions to deliver solutions. You define and update solution and technology roadmaps, and architecture documents.

  

In this role, you will design, build, and optimize high-throughput interfaces running on SAP Process Orchestration (PI/PO) and SAP BTP Integration Suite. Concurrently, you will lead the refactoring and modernization of legacy interfaces to modern APIs, event-driven pipelines, and cloud-native integration patterns, enabling seamless data flow between core SAP S/4HANA systems and broader cloud or third-party enterprise platforms.

  

Lead enterprise integration assessments, interface architecture, and migration of legacy middleware to modern cloud integration platforms. Translate complex business and functional requirements into scalable, secure, resilient, and cost-effective integration solutions. Own interface development from design through implementation and transition to operations, balancing long-term integration strategy with day-to-day stability, maintainability, and business continuity.

  

Professionals in this role author and leverage detailed technical design documentation, mapping specifications, and interface runbooks to build robust data flows across hybrid landscapes. Ensure all integration components are thoroughly documented, rigorously unit-tested, and validated for seamless end-to-end processing across connected systems. Lead interface walkthroughs and playback demonstrations with functional teams and client stakeholders. Triage, isolate, and remediate integration defects during pre-production testing cycles, cutovers, and hypercare support. Provide precise development effort estimates and guide project teams on integration patterns, BTP capabilities, and technical trade-offs.

  

Bring your deep integration engineering background to an organization modernizing enterprise application ecosystems, playing a central role in connecting critical business processes. You will collaborate alongside a global community of SAP and cloud specialists driving the future of hybrid connectivity—professionals who value knowledge sharing, technical excellence, and open collaboration.

  

**What you will do**

* **Integration & Modernization Strategy:** Lead discovery and assessment of legacy PI/PO landscapes, evaluate interface technical debt, and build migration roadmaps to transition workloads toward SAP BTP Integration Suite.
* **Architecture & Interface Governance:** Establish enterprise integration guidelines, select optimal communication patterns (hub-and-spoke, API-led, event-driven), enforce error-handling standards, and ensure interface compliance with corporate security mandates.
* **Cloud & Hybrid Integration:** Architect, develop, and tune end-to-end integration flows across SAP BTP Integration Suite (Cloud Integration/CPI, API Management, Integration Advisor, Open Connectors, Event Mesh).
* **Core SAP & Third-Party Connectivity:** Build and support mission-critical interfaces linking SAP S/4HANA, SuccessFactors, Ariba, and C/4HANA with third-party SaaS and on-premise systems (e.g., Salesforce, Workday, ServiceNow).
* **Protocol, Mapping & Security Management:** Implement data transformations using Groovy Script, XSLT, and Graphical Mapping; configure enterprise security standards including OAuth 2.0, SAML, Principal Propagation, SSL/TLS, and Keystore management.
* **Technical Leadership & Delivery:** Lead client design workshops, conduct code and mapping reviews, manage cutover/go-live risks, mentor junior developers, and coordinate interface testing between functional consultants and external partner counterparts.

  

**Your Future at Kyndryl**

Every position at Kyndryl offers a structured pathway to expand your career, from Integration Consultant to Principal Integration Architect. We provide unique opportunities to engage with hybrid architectures and hyperscaler-connected ecosystems, paired with dedicated learning resources and support to achieve professional certifications across modern SAP and cloud platforms.

You will partner with top-tier clients across a wide range of industries—from banking and retail to manufacturing and healthcare. Whether your ambition is to deepen your focus on enterprise iPaaS architectures or broaden your leadership across complex multi-cloud digital transformations, you can build that trajectory here. You will contribute to critical business initiatives, influence technology roadmaps, and cultivate relationships with diverse technical communities while mastering modern integration practices.

**Who You Are**

You bring seasoned hands-on technical proficiency in SAP integration and possess the delivery track record to back it up. Equally critical: you possess a continuous learning mindset, an analytical approach to solving complex interface issues, and a customer-first focus dedicated to operational resilience. You thrive in open, globally distributed teams and communicate technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

**Required Skills and Experience**

* **8–10+ years** of hands-on experience in SAP integration engineering, middleware architecture, and interface delivery.
* **4+ years** of dedicated design and development experience on **SAP BTP Integration Suite / Cloud Integration (CPI)** .
* Proven track record in full-lifecycle **SAP PI (7.3/7.4) and PO (7.5)** implementations, dual-stack/single-stack administration awareness, and interface remediation.
* Solid experience delivering integration architecture for **SAP S/4HANA implementation and roll-in projects** , including legacy-to-cloud migrations.
* Deep proficiency in advanced mapping techniques: **Groovy Scripting, XSLT, Graphical Mapping, Value Mapping, and Custom Functions** .
* Comprehensive expertise across standard integration protocols and data structures: **OData (V2/V4), REST, SOAP/WSDL, IDoc, RFC, EDI/EDIFACT, AS2, SFTP, AMQP, JSON, and XML** .
* Strong grasp of BTP platform connectivity, including **SAP Cloud Connector** , Destination Services, Cloud Integration Automation Framework, and multi-tenant subaccount structures.
* Solid background in integration security: certificate and key lifecycle management, **OAuth 2.0, SAML 2.0, mutual TLS, and Principal Propagation** .

**Preferred Skills and Experience**

* Hands-on implementation experience with **SAP API Management, SAP Event Mesh / Advanced Event Mesh, and SAP Integration Advisor** .
* Familiarity with non-SAP enterprise ecosystems and SaaS platforms such as **Salesforce, Workday, ServiceNow, and hyperscaler services (AWS, Azure, GCP)** .
* Experience establishing automated CI/CD deployment pipelines, automated interface

This role will also be pivotal in shaping and advancing the organization’s enterprise-scale AI strategy, by integrating AI capabilities into the architectural vision and technology roadmap. As the pivotal orchestrator between business strategy and technical execution, the Enterprise Architect fosters collaboration, governance, and continuous improvement to advance Zand’s growth and digital transformation.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Shape Architectural and AI Vision:**
  Develop, maintain, and communicate the architectural and AI vision, principles, standards, and reference models supporting a digital-first, AI-enabled organization.
* **Deliver Blueprints:**
  Create architectural blueprints and target state architectures across data, application, technology, and security domains.
* **Governance & Compliance:**
  Lead architectural governance, evaluating and guiding major technology initiatives for strategic alignment and compliance.
* **Technology Scouting:**
  Assess emerging technologies, , including AI/ML advances, trends, and regulatory changes; recommend adoption and integration where valuable.
* **Business & IT Bridge:**
  Serve as the strategic interface between IT and business, translating strategy and requirements into effective architectures that optimize value and manage risk.
* **AI Roadmap Leadership:**
  Develop and continuously evolve an AI roadmap in alignment with business goals—identify opportunities for AI-driven solutions, prioritize AI initiatives, and ensure robust data, ethics, and governance practices are in place for responsible AI adoption and scaling.
* **Champion AI Adoption**
  : Guide the integration of AI technologies into business processes and digital platforms, enabling automation, predictive analytics, and improved customer experiences.
* **Project Oversight:**
  Provide architectural oversight to priority programs, including AI related initatives, ensuring designs comply with enterprise standards and security requirements.
* **Collaborative Delivery:**
  Partner with solution architects, engineers, and stakeholders to deliver end-to-end architecture.
* **Technology Transformation:**
  Lead the target-state architecture for digital banking, cloud migration, advanced analytics, and enterprise AI/ML platforms and modern delivery models.
* **Legacy Modernization:**
  Champion modernization and migration initiatives, minimizing disruption and maximizing value.
* **Risk & Security:**
  Ensure architecture meets all regulatory, security, and privacy standards; proactively assess and remediate architectural risks, including those emerging from AI implementations.

**Key Skills, Qualifications & Experience**

*Qualifications & Certification*

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field.
* TOGAF, AWS/Azure/GCP Architect, CISSP, AI/ML or Data Science certifications (preferred)or equivalent certifications.
* Familiarity with relevant frameworks (ITIL, COBIT, etc.).

*Experience*

* 10+ years in enterprise or solution architecture, preferably in banking, financial services, or digital organizations.
* Track record of leading architecture for major digital transformations, cloud initiatives, AI/ML use cases, and technology modernization.

*Technical & Professional Skills*

* Deep knowledge of enterprise architecture frameworks (TOGAF, Zachman, SABSA), with experience in capability modeling, solution roadmaps, and reference architectures.
* Proficiency across multiple domains: applications, data, infrastructure, security.
* Experience designing/architecting AI-powered solutions (e.g., machine learning workflows, generative models, NLP, automation), and familiarity with enterprise AI/ML platforms and tools.
* Hands-on experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP), microservices, API management, event-driven architectures, DevOps, and Agile delivery.
* Understanding of core banking systems, digital ecosystems, and the financial regulatory environment.
* Proven ability to align enterprise stakeholders, influence business-technology roadmaps, and drive change in complex environments.

**Job Summary / Introduction**
Define and lead the strategic vision for Open API and Open Banking services across the enterprise, enabling secure, scalable, and innovative digital ecosystems. The role focuses on decomposing legacy systems into modular, reusable APIs, fostering third-party collaboration, and ensuring compliance with Open Banking regulations.
  
  
Drives platform modernization, developer enablement, and cross-functional alignment to accelerate digital transformation and customer-centric innovation. Ensure APIs are designed and managed as strategic digital assets that deliver measurable business value.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Align API initiatives with enterprise architecture, data strategy, and reusable adoption goals.
* Establish metrics and KPIs to measure API performance, adoption, and business impact.
* Lead the development and lifecycle management of Open APIs in compliance with Open Banking standards (e.g., PSD2, UAE Central Bank guidelines).
* Collaborate with product, compliance, and architecture teams to define API strategies that support business capabilities and customer journeys.
* Champion API-first design principles and ensure APIs are reusable, secure, and developer-friendly.
* Drive the adoption of Open Banking ecosystems by enabling third-party integrations and fintech partnerships.
* Define and maintain API documentation, sandbox environments, and developer portals.

* Ensure compliance with IT governance, security, and regulatory frameworks.
* Collaborate with enterprise architecture, security, and infrastructure teams to ensure platform scalability and resilience.
* Track and report KPIs related to API performance, adoption, and risk metrics.
* Promote DevSecOps, CI/CD, and test automation practices across the API lifecycle.

**Requirements / Qualifications**

* Exp Overall: 12+ Years, Banking 8+ Years
* Deep understanding of Open Banking frameworks, API security (OAuth2, OpenID Connect), and regulatory compliance.
* Strong experience in API management platforms (e.g., Apigee, Kong, WSO2).
* Expertise in RESTful API design, JSON, Swagger/OpenAPI specifications.
* Familiarity with domain-driven design and microservices architecture.
* Proven ability to lead cross-functional teams and manage complex stakeholder environments.
* Strong communication, leadership, and mentoring skills.
* Proficiency in API analytics, usage tracking, and performance optimization.
* Experience with tools like API Management, Kong, Cloud Native Services, Kubernetes.

jobs.title: Implementation Engineer Islamic Core BankingDubai UAE On-site Hybrid
jobs.description:
**Job Description**
Fimple is a product company building a cloud-native, highly composable and extendible platform. It covers the full platform needs of digital, disruptive and new financial players who need to move fast. Our solution is modern, API-native and built around an ecosystem with strong marketplace support, so financial institutions can grow in a fast-changing market.
  
  
We are looking for an Implementation Engineer to join our Fimple Delivery team in Dubai, UAE. Your main goal will be to set up the Fimple banking platform for the bank and configure it in line with the bank’s needs, first during the implementation and then as the bank’s needs grow after go-live. You will be Fimple’s face to the bank’s business teams: working closely with them to understand their business needs, set up the platform to match their banking products and processes, and help them go live successfully.
  
  
You don’t need to know everything on day one. Working closely with and be supported by Fimple’s core banking experts, and learning our platform and Islamic banking products on the job.
  
  
We are not looking for a traditional core banking implementer. We are looking for agile, open-minded people who are curious to learn and improve, don’t just repeat old methods, and always look for a better, faster way to get things done. You should use AI tools in your daily work and turn complex banking needs into simple, practical solutions.
  
  
**Who You Are**

* Open to innovation: you enjoy new technologies and new ways of working, and you don’t cling to old methods
* AI-savvy: you already use AI tools (e.g., ChatGPT, Claude, Copilot) to analyze requirements, write documents, prepare test scenarios, investigate issues and speed up your work
* Solution-oriented: you focus on solving the problem, not on listing obstacles
* Flexible and practical: you adapt quickly when priorities change and look for the simplest solution that works, not the most complicated one
* Ownership mindset: you take responsibility and carry things through to the end
* Fast learner: you pick up new products, domains and tools quickly

**Key Responsibilities**

* Set up the Fimple banking platform for the bank and configure it in line with the bank’s needs, both during the implementation and after go-live
* Act as the day-to-day contact for the bank’s business teams and Fimple’s face to the bank
* Take part in end-to-end core banking implementation projects, from requirement gathering to go-live and post-go-live support
* Run workshops with clients to understand their banking products, business processes and regulatory needs
* Perform gap analysis between client requirements and Fimple platform capabilities, and suggest practical solutions
* Configure and set up banking products and parameters on the platform, such as Islamic financing and deposit products, customer onboarding, limits, fees and charges, and accounting rules
* Use AI-powered tools and automation to speed up analysis, documentation, testing and issue resolution
* Write clear, concise functional documents, including business requirements, functional specifications, configuration workbooks and process flows
* Prepare test scenarios and support SIT and UAT phases with clients
* Work with Fimple’s product, development and QA teams to deliver solutions and handle change requests
* Train client users and create user guides
* Analyze and troubleshoot functional issues during implementation and after go-live
* Suggest improvements to our delivery processes and help build a faster, smarter way of implementing core banking

**Qualifications**

* Fluent English– must
* Arabic – strong plus
* Turkish – plus
* Must be currently living in Dubai, UAE or willing to relocate
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Engineering, Software Engineering, Management Information Systems, Banking, or a related discipline
* 3+ years of experience in banking, in banking operations, core banking, loan, trade finance or treasury implementation functional consulting or business analysis
* Solid knowledge of banking business processes, such as retail and/or corporate banking, deposits, lending, payments, general ledger, accounting, customer lifecycle, Trade Finance and Treasury.
* Understanding of how banking systems work, including products, parameters, end-of-day processes and integrations
* Core banking business knowledge and hands-on experience with one or more core banking systems is a must
* Previous Experience in implementing core banking solutions in GCC is a must
* Experience with Islamic banking products is must
* Hands-on use of AI tools in your daily work
* Examples of how you used AI or automation to improve a process or save time
* Basic technical skills: reading APIs (REST/JSON), writing SQL queries, understanding system integrations
* Experience with Agile delivery and tools like Jira or Azure DevOps
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
* Ability to turn business needs into clear functional requirements
* Excellent communication and presentation skills with a client-focused approach
* No travel restrictions; willing to travel when needed

**Why Join Us**

* Work on modern, cloud-native Islamic core banking implementations in UAE
* Be part of a team that uses AI in daily delivery work
* Freedom to bring new ideas and shape how core banking is implemented
* Be part of Fimple’s international team with growth opportunities across the region
* Hybrid working model
* A growth mindset culture where challenges are learning opportunities

Job Details
  
  
Role Level: Not Applicable Work Type: Full-Time Country: United Arab Emirates City: Dubai Company Website: https://fimple.co.uk/ Job Function: Engineering Company Industry/
  
  
Sector: IT Services and IT Consulting
  
  
What We Offer

**About Synechron:**

Synechron is a global digital transformation consulting and technology services company that helps organizations modernize their businesses through innovative technology, data, and engineering solutions. With expertise across banking, financial services, payments, and emerging technologies, Synechron works with clients to deliver secure, scalable, and business-focused solutions.

At Synechron, you will have the opportunity to work with experienced technology professionals on mission-critical payment and banking platforms, collaborate with global teams, and contribute to innovative solutions for leading organizations.

**Required Experience & Skills:**

15+ years of overall experience, with significant experience within the banking or financial services sector.

Proven track record of managing large-scale, enterprise-level transformation and technology programs.

Strong understanding of banking domains such as Retail Banking, Corporate Banking, Payments, Cards, Lending, Digital Banking, Risk & Compliance, Data & Analytics, or Core Banking.

Extensive experience in program governance, financial management, resource planning, RAID management, dependency management, and executive reporting.

Strong experience working with C-suite, senior executives, business heads, and technology leadership.

Demonstrated ability to manage complex programs involving multiple internal teams, vendors, system integrators, and geographically distributed stakeholders.

Strong commercial and vendor management capabilities.

Excellent leadership, communication, negotiation, influencing, and problem-solving skills.

Strong understanding of Agile, Waterfall, and hybrid program delivery models.

Experience with program management and delivery tools such as Jira, Confluence, Microsoft Project, Azure DevOps, or equivalent platforms.

**Key Responsibilities:**

Lead end-to-end delivery of large, complex banking programs, from initiation and planning through implementation, stabilization, and transition to BAU.

Manage multiple projects and workstreams, ensuring alignment with overall business strategy, program objectives, timelines, budgets, and expected outcomes.

Establish and drive robust program governance, including steering committees, executive reporting, RAID management, dependency management, decision tracking, and escalation mechanisms.

Partner with senior Business and Technology stakeholders to translate strategic objectives into clear delivery roadmaps and executable plans.

Coordinate across Business, Technology, Operations, Risk, Compliance, Finance, Data, Cybersecurity, and Architecture teams.

Lead programs across areas such as digital transformation, core banking, payments, cards, lending, customer onboarding, data and analytics, regulatory transformation, and technology modernization.

Manage program budgets, forecasts, resource plans, procurement dependencies, and vendor commitments.

Provide clear and concise program reporting to senior management, steering committees, and executive leadership, highlighting progress, risks, decisions, financial position, and required interventions.

Proactively identify and resolve cross-program risks, issues, dependencies, and delivery bottlenecks.

Manage strategic technology partners, system integrators, consultants, and third-party vendors, ensuring delivery against agreed scope, timelines, quality, and commercial commitments.

Ensure programs comply with relevant banking governance, regulatory, risk, cybersecurity, data privacy, and internal control requirements.

Drive effective change management, business readiness, implementation planning, production deployment, stabilization, and transition to operational teams.

Promote strong delivery practices across Agile, Waterfall, and hybrid methodologies.

Mentor Project Managers and workstream leads and promote accountability, collaboration, and delivery excellence across the program."

**Diversity and Inclusion:**

Synechron is committed to fostering an inclusive, respectful, and supportive workplace where everyone has the opportunity to contribute, grow, and succeed.

We value diversity in backgrounds, perspectives, experiences, abilities, and identities. Employment decisions are based on qualifications, skills, experience, and business requirements.
