jobs.location: Abu Dhabi Emirate, United Arab Emirates
jobs.description:
**Summary**

The Manager, Enterprise Transformation will be responsible for leading business transformation, process re-engineering, and operational excellence initiatives across Finance House Group. The role will focus on identifying process inefficiencies, redesigning and optimizing workflows, reducing turnaround times (TAT), eliminating operational bottlenecks, and implementing sustainable improvements that enhance productivity, cost efficiency, customer experience, and overall business performance.

Working closely with Business Heads, Product Managers, Technology, Operations, Risk, Compliance, and other stakeholders, the Transformation Manager will drive end-to-end process improvement and digital transformation initiatives. The role will leverage business process re-engineering (BPR), process mining, automation, and data analytics to deliver measurable improvements while ensuring alignment with the Group's strategic objectives, operational priorities, and regulatory requirements.

**Major Responsibilities**

**Business Transformation & Process Re-engineering**

* Lead end-to-end business transformation and process re-engineering initiatives across business units and support functions.
* Assess existing business processes to identify inefficiencies, redundancies, bottlenecks, control gaps, and improvement opportunities.
* Conduct AS-IS process assessments and design optimized TO-BE processes to improve efficiency, service quality, and customer experience.
* Redesign business processes by eliminating non-value-adding activities, simplifying workflows, reducing manual interventions, and improving operational controls.
* Develop process maps, workflow diagrams, process models, standard operating procedures (SOPs), and supporting documentation.
* Identify opportunities for process standardization, centralization, digitization, and automation.
* Apply Lean, Six Sigma, and continuous improvement methodologies to drive sustainable operational improvements.
* Ensure redesigned processes comply with applicable regulatory requirements, internal policies, and risk management standards.

**Operational Excellence & Process Optimization**

* Drive operational excellence initiatives aimed at improving productivity, cost efficiency, process quality, and service delivery.
* Establish turnaround time (TAT) monitoring frameworks, service-level agreements (SLAs), and operational performance indicators.
* Analyze process cycle times, handoffs, rework, and operational delays to identify root causes and improvement opportunities.
* Collaborate with business stakeholders to establish performance baselines, improvement targets, and measurable KPIs.
* Develop and implement solutions to reduce processing times, improve first-time-right performance, and enhance customer satisfaction.
* Monitor process performance and track improvements through dashboards, management reports, and operational analytics.
* Conduct periodic process reviews to ensure continued efficiency, effectiveness, and alignment with business requirements.

**Business Analysis & Requirements Management**

* Engage with business stakeholders to understand objectives, operational challenges, customer requirements, and transformation priorities.
* Conduct business requirement workshops, stakeholder interviews, process walkthroughs, and gap analysis sessions.
* Gather, analyze, and document business requirements, functional specifications, process flows, and user stories.
* Translate business requirements into practical process improvement recommendations and solution specifications.
* Assess proposed solutions to ensure alignment with business objectives, operational requirements, and customer expectations.
* Collaborate with Product Owners and Technology teams on backlog refinement, prioritization, and solution development.
* Evaluate the financial, operational, and technological impact of proposed process and system changes.

**Digital Transformation, Automation & Process Mining**

* Identify opportunities to leverage digital technologies, workflow automation, robotic process automation (RPA), and AI-enabled solutions to optimize business processes.
* Work closely with Technology teams to translate process improvement opportunities into digital transformation initiatives.
* Utilize business process management and process mining tools such as ARIS, Bizagi, and Celonis to analyze and optimize workflows.
* Assess existing system capabilities, integration requirements, and technology limitations to recommend appropriate solutions.
* Support the implementation of automated workflows and system enhancements to reduce manual processing and operational risks.
* Leverage Power BI and other analytical tools to monitor process performance, identify trends, and support data-driven decision-making.
* Evaluate automation opportunities through feasibility assessments, cost-benefit analysis, and expected business benefits.

**Project Delivery & Stakeholder Management**

* Lead assigned transformation initiatives from initial assessment and business case development through implementation and benefits realization.
* Develop project plans, milestones, deliverables, resource requirements, and implementation timelines.
* Manage stakeholder expectations by establishing priorities, maintaining communication, and providing regular project updates.
* Coordinate with Business, Technology, Operations, Risk, Compliance, and other stakeholders to ensure successful delivery.
* Identify and manage project risks, issues, dependencies, and implementation challenges.
* Facilitate cross-functional workshops, project reviews, and management discussions.
* Apply Agile, Waterfall, or hybrid project delivery methodologies as appropriate.
* Prepare business cases, project status reports, management presentations, and recommendations for senior leadership.

**Change Management, Testing & Implementation**

* Support change management activities to ensure successful adoption of redesigned processes and technology solutions.
* Assess the impact of proposed changes on business operations, roles, responsibilities, workflows, and systems.
* Coordinate User Acceptance Testing (UAT), including test scenarios, execution, defect resolution, and business sign-off.
* Ensure implemented solutions meet approved business requirements and deliver expected operational improvements.
* Prepare user manuals, SOPs, training materials, and implementation documentation.
* Conduct user training and knowledge-transfer sessions to support effective adoption.
* Coordinate the transition of completed initiatives into Business as Usual (BAU) operations.
* Conduct post-implementation reviews to assess effectiveness, user adoption, and achievement of expected benefits.

**Governance, Reporting & Continuous Improvement**

* Establish and maintain process governance standards, documentation, and ownership frameworks.
* Develop dashboards and management reports covering transformation progress, TAT performance, process efficiency, and operational improvements.
* Track measurable benefits, including cost savings, productivity improvements, cycle-time reductions, and service quality enhancements.
* Maintain accurate documentation of transformation initiatives, process improvements, and project deliverables.

jobs.description:
**Job Description**
Our Architecture team is looking for a skilled and experienced Digital Asset Technical Architect to design, implement, and manage a greenfield digital asset ecosystem, focusing on custody management, stablecoin issuance, and seamless integration with our banks mobile banking platform. The ideal candidate will have a proven track record of deploying digital asset solutions, strong technical expertise in key management, security architecture, cloud technologies, and a comprehensive understanding of regulatory compliance, particularly with the Central Bank of UAE (CBUAE) mandates.
  
  
**What You Will Do**

* Architect and implement a secure, scalable digital asset ecosystem.
* Design institutional-grade custody solutions including wallets, HSMs and key management.
* Lead stablecoin issuance and lifecycle management capabilities.
* Integrate digital asset platforms with core banking, payments and mobile banking.
* Establish security architecture, risk controls and operational governance.
* Ensure compliance with CBUAE regulations and AML/CFT requirements.

Digital Asset Platform Architecture
  
  

* Design and deploy a secure, scalable, and compliant digital asset ecosystem from the ground up.
* Establish custody management, stablecoin issuance, tokenization, and digital wallet capabilities.
* Integrate digital asset services with core banking systems, mobile banking platforms, exchanges, and third-party ecosystems through APIs.

**Blockchain And Distributed Ledger Technology (DLT)**

* Expertise in blockchain technologies and distributed ledger protocols (e.g., Ethereum, Hyperledger) for building custody management and stablecoin issuance solutions.

Blockchain & Smart Contract Development.
  
  

* Architect solutions using blockchain and distributed ledger technologies such as Ethereum and Hyperledger.
* Design, develop, and govern secure smart contracts for stablecoin issuance, transaction processing, and digital asset management.
* Enable interoperability across external digital asset networks, exchanges, and banking infrastructure.

Security & Key Management.
  
  

* Implement enterprise-grade cybersecurity controls, including HSM-based cryptographic key management.
* Establish security frameworks based on NIST, ISO 27001, and industry best practices.
* Lead penetration testing, vulnerability assessments, incident response planning, and disaster recovery strategies. Cloud, Infrastructure & DevOps.

**Cloud And API Integration**

* Architect cloud-native, highly available, scalable, and resilient digital asset platforms.
* Define end-to-end infrastructure architecture covering HA, DR, performance, security, and elimination of single points of failure.
* Establish CI/CD pipelines and DevSecOps practices to ensure secure and efficient solution delivery.

Regulatory Compliance & Governance.
  
  

* Ensure compliance with CBUAE regulations, AML/KYC requirements, and applicable international digital asset standards.
* Monitor regulatory developments and adapt technology solutions and operating models accordingly.
* Collaborate with regulators and internal control functions to maintain governance and compliance.

Operations & Vendor Management.
  
  

* Manage the complete solution lifecycle from requirements gathering through production support.
* Develop operational playbooks, monitoring frameworks, dashboards, and automation capabilities.
* Evaluate and manage technology vendors, blockchain providers, custodians, and strategic partners.

Enterprise Architecture & Strategic Leadership.
  
  

* Apply TOGAF and Enterprise Architecture principles to create a future-ready digital asset platform aligned with business strategy.
* Design modular, API-first, microservices-based architectures to promote flexibility and scalability.
* Drive stakeholder engagement, change management, and cross-functional collaboration across business, technology, risk, compliance, and security teams.

jobs.title: Manager, IT Business Analysis (UAE National)
jobs.description:
**Job Purpose:**

The Manager, IT Business Analysis turns business needs into well-defined digital solutions across EDB’s priority programmes. Working with Business, IT and enterprise functions such as Risk, Compliance, Operations, Finance and HR, the role leads business analysis from discovery to Go-Live with a product owner mindset: framing work around customer and business outcomes, crafting end-to-end digital journeys and prioritizing what delivers the most value. It works within EDB’s change-governance standards, reports against agreed metrics and raises risks, issues and blockers early. In line with EDB’s agentic-AI-based delivery model, it uses AI to produce requirements, workflows and indicative UI wireframes, and sets the standard for business analysis across the bank.

**Key Roles and Responsibilities:**

**Business Analysis Responsibilities:**

* Lead business analysis on assigned programmes from discovery to Go-Live: elicit and analyze requirements through workshops and interviews, and produce BRDs, functional specifications, user stories and clear acceptance criteria.
* Work iteratively with the business – draft early, review while gathering requirements, refine to sign-off – and stay engaged through design, build, SIT, UAT and Go-Live rather than handing over at sign-off.
* Map as-is and to-be processes; identify bottlenecks, control gaps and manual effort; and recommend simplification, automation and straight-through processing.
* Maintain end-to-end traceability from business objective to requirement, design, test case and defect; review vendor specifications and test coverage; and support SIT, UAT and business sign-off.
* Work across Business, IT and enterprise functions – Risk, Compliance, Legal, Finance, Operations, HR and Audit – to align requirements and secure timely decisions and sign-offs

**Product Ownership Responsibilities:**

* Bring a product owner mindset to every initiative: frame it around the customer and business outcome, the problem it solves and how its value will be measured.
* Craft end-to-end digital journeys for customers, Relationship Managers and operations teams – mapping today’s pain points and designing target journeys that remove manual steps, handoffs and re-keying.
* Shape scope into MVPs and phased releases, write epics and user stories, and own and prioritise backlogs with business owners on value, risk, regulatory need and effort.
* Define journey success measures such as turnaround time, straight-through-processing rate and adoption, and track them after Go-Live.

**AI-Assisted Delivery Responsibilities:**

* Use EDB-approved AI tools to accelerate the drafting of requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria and test scenarios, verifying and owning every output.
* Build AI-assisted workflows, BPMN process flows and indicative UI wireframes that let the business picture the end result early, and iterate them with stakeholders before build.
* Apply responsible-AI practice: approved tools only, data kept within approved boundaries, and human review and sign-off before any AI-drafted content is final.
* Contribute reusable prompts, templates and agent workflows to EDB’s agentic-AI delivery model.

**Governance, Reporting and Risk Responsibilities**

* Adhere to EDB’s change-governance standards – stage gates, change control, approvals and documentation – and apply BA and project management principles consistently across programmes.
* Manage requirement changes, decisions and dependencies through formal change control, and ensure solutions meet regulatory, compliance, risk, control and audit requirements.
* Provide regular, structured status reporting and track delivery and BA metrics – requirements progress, sign-offs, change volumes, defect trends and benefits – for programme leadership.
* Highlight risks, issues and blockers early, before they become serious, with their impact and a recommended mitigation, and escalate them through the right forums.

jobs.title: AI Change Management Leader - Banking
jobs.description:
**An opportunity to shape enterprise-wide AI adoption within a leading financial institution.**

Edison Smart is exclusively supporting a leading banking group in the UAE with the appointment of a Senior Manager to establish the institutions AI change and adoption programmes.

This is an exciting opportunity to join a growing Group Digital & AI function and play a pivotal role in one of the organisation's most important strategic transformation initiatives.

The organisation is making significant investments in Enterprise AI and Generative AI capabilities and is looking for an experienced banking transformation leader to ensure these technologies are successfully adopted, embedded and utilised across the business.

This is not a traditional Change Management position. The successful individual will take ownership of the bank-wide AI Champions and Change programme, building the structures, communities and engagement strategies required to make AI adoption successful at enterprise scale.

**IMPORTANT: This is an international relocation-only opportunity based in UAE. Candidates must be currently based outside the UAE and genuinely willing to relocate.**

The Role

Reporting into the Group Digital & AI function, you will lead the strategy and execution of the organisation's enterprise AI change and adoption programme.

You will work closely with AI Product Owners, senior business stakeholders, HR, Learning & Development and Internal Communications to ensure AI capabilities translate into meaningful changes in how employees work.

Key responsibilities will include:

* **AI Champions Network:**
  Design, establish and lead a bank-wide AI Champions network, developing the operating model, selection criteria, engagement strategy and governance required to drive adoption across multiple business units.
* **Enterprise AI Adoption:**
  Own the change and adoption strategy for enterprise AI and CRM platforms, ensuring successful integration into everyday business operations.
* **Change Strategy:**
  Develop and execute comprehensive change management strategies, assessing organisational readiness, people impacts and potential barriers to adoption.
* **Stakeholder Engagement:**
  Build strong relationships with senior business leaders, securing executive sponsorship and accountability for AI adoption outcomes.
* **Employee Enablement:**
  Partner with Learning & Development to develop AI training programmes, role-based learning pathways, prompt libraries and practical enablement resources.
* **AI Engagement & Communications:**
  Lead internal engagement campaigns, champion forums and communications that build confidence and enthusiasm around AI.
* **Adoption Measurement:**
  Monitor employee engagement, adoption levels and proficiency, identifying areas requiring additional intervention and support.
* **Responsible AI:**
  Ensure AI adoption is aligned with organisational policies, data privacy requirements and responsible AI principles.
* **Product Collaboration:**
  Work closely with AI Product Owners to capture employee feedback and influence future product enhancements.

You will also lead a dedicated team within the Champions & Change function and play an important role in developing the wider enterprise AI adoption operating model.

The Candidate We Want

We are looking for an established change and transformation leader with direct experience within the banking and financial services sector.

**Direct banking experience is essential.**
We are particularly interested in candidates who have worked within leading international banks, ideally within a centralised AI Centre of Excellence (CoE), Chief Data & AI Office, Group Digital & AI function or similar enterprise transformation environment.

The strongest candidates will have been directly involved in establishing, scaling or leading AI adoption programmes within a large banking organisation.

We are particularly interested in people who have:

* Led enterprise-wide AI adoption or Generative AI transformation programmes within a bank.
* Established or scaled AI Champions networks, communities of practice or internal AI ambassador programmes.
* Driven the adoption of AI tools across large, complex and highly regulated organisations.
* Built AI literacy, employee enablement and workforce capability programmes.
* Worked closely with senior leadership, business executives and technology teams.
* Developed change management strategies covering multiple business units and employee populations.
* Experience with Microsoft 365 Copilot, enterprise AI platforms and CRM technologies.

* Minimum 7 years' experience in Change Management, Technology Adoption or Organisational Transformation.
* Minimum 4 years' direct experience within banking or financial services.
* A demonstrable track record of enterprise technology adoption, ideally with a strong focus on AI and Generative AI.
* Experience establishing and managing AI adoption programmes, communities or champion networks.
* Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Human Resources, Communications, Psychology or a related discipline.
* Professional Change Management certification, ideally Prosci or APMG.
* Excellent senior stakeholder engagement, communication and leadership capabilities.
* Experience within a central AI CoE, Chief Data & AI Office or enterprise AI transformation function would be particularly attractive.

Why Consider This Opportunity?

This is an opportunity to take on a strategically important leadership position at a time when AI is fundamentally changing the banking industry.

You will have the opportunity to:

* Shape how AI is adopted across an entire banking organisation.
* Build and lead an enterprise-wide AI Champions network.
* Work alongside senior AI leadership and enterprise product teams.
* Influence the organisation's long-term AI transformation strategy.
* Establish yourself within one of the Middle East's most ambitious digital and AI environments.

International Relocation – UAE

This position is based in the UAE and is open exclusively to candidates relocating internationally.

For the right individual, this represents an opportunity to take a significant career step while relocating to one of the world's fastest-growing financial and technology hubs.

The UAE offers an established international banking sector, excellent global connectivity and an attractive lifestyle for internationally experienced professionals and their families.

Relocation and employment package details will be discussed with shortlisted candidates.

Interested?

If you have directly led AI adoption within a major banking organisation and are interested in relocating to the UAE, we would welcome a confidential conversation.

**Apply directly through Edison Smart or contact our team to discuss the opportunity.**

Edison Smart – Connecting exceptional talent with the future of technology.

**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is looking for a Senior Solutions Architect to join our Commercial Sector Enterprise team in the UAE. You will work directly with customers in Financial Services organizations navigating complex digital transformations where the technology strategy is not yet defined and the right path forward requires both technical depth and business judgment.
  
  
This is a builder role. You will go into customer environments, understand their hardest problems, and design solutions that work — from whiteboard architecture through proof of concept to production. You will bring deep expertise across cloud infrastructure, modern application development, data and analytics, and increasingly, generative AI and machine learning. You will earn trust by shipping things that matter, not by presenting slides.
  
  
You will be part of a collaborative, supportive team that values curiosity, ownership, and impact. We learn from each other, develop each other, and build an environment where every voice is heard.  
  
Key job responsibilities  
As a Senior Solutions Architect, you will own the technical relationship with customers end-to-end. This means:
  
  

* Partnering with enterprise FSI customers to understand their business objectives, assess their current technology landscape, and architect cloud solutions that deliver real outcomes — in cost optimization, operational efficiency, security, reliability, and innovation.

  

* Building hands-on: prototypes, proofs of concept, reference architectures, and production-ready designs. You lead by doing, not just advising.

  

* Helping customers adopt and build with generative AI and machine learning — identifying high-value use cases, designing architectures for foundation models and intelligent applications, and guiding teams from experimentation to production.

  

* Acting as the customer's technical advocate inside AWS — translating field insights into clear, prioritized feedback that shapes the roadmap for AWS services and features.

  

* Creating and sharing technical content that scales your impact: workshops, blog posts, code samples, reference architectures, and public talks at meetups, user groups, and conferences.

**Role Summary:**

We are seeking an experienced Project Manager to manage the planning, coordination and execution of DevOps initiatives across multiple product teams and Agile Release Trains (ARTs). The individual will manage a globally distributed shared-services team of 610 members across India and the US, ensuring predictable delivery, effective resource utilization and stakeholder alignment. The role also includes Scrum Master responsibilities, driving SAFe practices, PI Planning, sprint execution and achievement of PI objectives. This is a non-technical management role focused on planning, execution, cross-functional coordination, risk management, communication and operational excellence.

**Experience Required:**

* Have 812 years of overall IT industry experience.
* Minimum 5 years of Project Management or Delivery Management experience.
* Minimum 3 years of Agile delivery and Scrum Master experience.
* Experience managing globally distributed shared-services teams and multiple projects.
* Strong project planning, execution, resource management and delivery governance capabilities.
* Experience in SAFe, PI Planning, Scrum, Kanban and ART coordination.
* Strong proficiency in JIRA for Agile execution, tracking and reporting.
* Strong risk, dependency, issue and escalation management capabilities.
* Excellent communication, presentation, negotiation and stakeholder management skills.
* Strong organizational, analytical, problem-solving and decision-making abilities.
* Demonstrated ability to drive accountability, delivery predictability and continuous improvement.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* **Project Planning Execution:**  
  + Manage project plans, milestones, delivery schedules and commitments.
  + Drive resource allocation, capacity planning and prioritization across multiple projects.
  + Ensure timely execution, accountability and closure of deliverables.
* **Agile Delivery Scrum Master Responsibilities**  
  + Perform Scrum Master responsibilities and drive Agile and SAFe practices.
  + Facilitate PI Planning, sprint execution, Agile ceremonies and achievement of PI objectives.
  + Manage backlog prioritization, cross-team dependencies and impediments.
  + Leverage JIRA for work tracking, delivery metrics and reporting.
* **Cross-functional Coordination**  
  + Coordinate DevOps activities across Engineering, Architecture, QA, Information Security and Application Support teams.
  + Facilitate execution of releases, infrastructure changes, maintenance and improvement initiatives.
  + Ensure clear ownership, effective collaboration and alignment across India and US teams.
* **Risk Escalation Management**  
  + Proactively identify, assess, track and mitigate risks, issues and dependencies.
  + Manage escalations and coordinate resolution with relevant teams.
  + Track corrective actions and permanent fixes to closure.
* **Stakeholder Management and Communication**  
  + Manage stakeholder expectations, competing priorities and delivery commitments.
  + Facilitate stakeholder meetings, management reviews and decision-making discussions.
  + Ensure timely, accurate and transparent communication of progress, risks and business impacts.
* **Process Governance and Continuous Improvement**  
  + Ensure process adherence, governance, documentation and audit readiness.
  + Define and monitor KPIs covering delivery predictability, timeliness, cycle time and stakeholder satisfaction.
  + Drive process improvements, automation and AI adoption initiatives in collaboration with technical teams.

**Educational Qualification:**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, Business Administration or a related discipline.
* Preferred certifications: PMP, SAFe Scrum Master, SAFe Agilist, CSM, PSM or ITIL.

**Work Timings (Shift Timings) : 2:30 PM to 11:30 PM IST**

* Ensure effective collaboration with US-based teams and stakeholders.
* Provide flexibility for critical escalations, production releases, scheduled maintenance and business requirements.
* Must be flexible to work till midnight every 5 days in 3 months for PI Planning
* Accommodate occasional timing adjustments based on US daylight saving time

**Good-to-Have Experience**

* Functional understanding of DevOps, cloud infrastructure, CI/CD and release management processes.
* Familiarity with incident management, change management and IT service management practices.
* Experience coordinating infrastructure modernization, cloud migration and automation initiatives.
* Experience leveraging AI for process improvement and AI-driven productivity initiatives.

**Note:**  Hands-on technical expertise in AWS, Terraform, CI/CD tools or infrastructure engineering is not mandatory. The candidate should have sufficient functional understanding to effectively coordinate activities and manage delivery.

It’s an exciting time to be part of BizTX at Twinings Ovaltine. At the heart of this iconic brand, we’re on a mission to drive exponential growth and productivity through cutting-edge technology to transform the business globally.

To create one clear infrastructure roadmap across cloud and hosting, networks, workplace, site and manufacturing technology, resilience and automation as well as roadmap into a prioritised, funded programme of projects and lead delivery from business case and initiation through execution, go-live, benefits realisation and transition to operations.

Global infrastructure strategy, standards, operational performance, site infrastructure and end-to-end delivery of the infrastructure project portfolio.
  
  
**Travel:**
Occasional international travel required.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Own and evolve the Global Infrastructure Strategy and Roadmap, aligned to business priorities and the BizTX technology strategy.
* Own the end-to-end global infrastructure project portfolio, including demand intake, prioritisation, business cases, funding, resource planning, delivery governance and benefits realisation.
* Translate the roadmap into a sequenced annual and multi-year project plan covering cloud, hosting, networks, workplace, sites, manufacturing and operational technology (OT), resilience, lifecycle and automation.

* Lead infrastructure portfolio reviews and provide concise executive reporting on project health, budget, schedule, risks, decisions, capacity and benefits.

* 10+ years in enterprise infrastructure, including significant leadership responsibility in a complex, multi-site or global organisation.
* Proven ownership of a multi-year infrastructure strategy, investment roadmap and complex transformation portfolio.
* Strong knowledge of cloud and hybrid hosting, enterprise networks, workplace and site infrastructure, observability, resilience and disaster recovery.
* Experience managing significant operating expenditure (Opex) and capital expenditure (Capex) budgets and strategic suppliers or shared-service organisations.
* Commercial strength, with the ability to translate technical complexity and risk into clear investment and sourcing decisions.
* Credibility with senior leaders and the ability to lead globally through influence, matrix relationships and partners.
* Proven ability to lead geographically distributed teams remotely, combining direct line management with functional leadership through a matrix operating model.
* Excellent written and verbal communication in English, including concise executive reporting.
* Experience of infrastructure in manufacturing and operational technology (OT) environments.

**Desirable:**

* ITIL 4, PRINCE2, PMP or equivalent practical experience.
* Microsoft Azure, Amazon Web Services (AWS) or relevant cloud qualifications; familiarity with FinOps and Infrastructure as Code (IaC).
* Understanding of Zero Trust, technology controls and recognised security frameworks.
* Lean, Six Sigma or equivalent continuous-improvement experience.
* Background in consumer goods, FMCG or manufacturing.

* Medical Insurance 5 lakhs Flat Coverage.
* PF and Gratuity.
* Long Service Policy.
* Life Term Policy
* Monthly Broadband Bill Reimbursement - Rs.2000 or on actual whichever is lower

jobs.title: Investor Services Senior Manager
jobs.description:
**About Us**
As a world leading provider of integrated solutions for the alternative investment industry, Alter Domus (meaning “The Other House” in Latin) is proud to be home to 90% of the top 30 asset managers in the private markets, and more than 6,000 professionals across 24 jurisdictions.
  
  
With a deep understanding of what it takes to succeed in alternatives, we believe in being different in what we do, how we work, and most importantly in how we enable and develop our people. Invest yourself in the alternative, and join an organization where you progress on merit, where you can speak openly with whoever you are speaking to, and where you will be supported along whichever path you choose to take.
  
  
Find out more about life at Alter Domus at careers.alterdomus.com
  
  
**Job Description**
As Investor Services India Lead you lead Investor Services in India. You build the team, bring each specialist team live with the right controls in place, and run India to our global service levels as part of one team across India, Europe, Asia and the US.
  
  
You are the senior Investor Services voice in India and a partner to Investor Services leaders in other locations, Compliance and our transformation programme.
  
  
**What You'll Do**
**Leading Investor Services India**

* Own performance of every India specialist team against our service levels, quality measures and capacity targets, and report monthly.
* Plan capacity and growth with the Regional Head and partner hubs, including cover when other hubs are stretched.

**Building and launching**

* Recruit, onboard and assess the India team.
* Bring each specialist team live once the systems, routing and reporting it needs are in place.
* Run interim arrangements and parallel running until then; nothing is switched off before its replacement works.

**Controls and risk**

* Run India to a high-risk control standard: separation of duties, independent quality checks in another hub, documented sign-off and a complete audit trail.
* Own business continuity for India: take over live cases within 24 hours when needed, and test it twice a year.
* Lead India's part in audits and regulatory reviews, and close findings on time.

**Working as one global team**

* Run handovers with hubs in Europe and Asia so cases keep moving around the clock.
* Route work between hubs so every team member can build the experience they need.
* Make sure escalations follow the right compliance route for each country.

**People and culture**

* Lead the India team and build a culture of quality, ownership and growth.
* Own engagement, retention and succession for Investor Services India.

**Transformation**

* Represent India in the design of our end-to-end KYC process, the Fenergo roadmap and the wider Investor Services programme.
* Drive improvements that remove manual handoffs and shorten the time investors wait.

**How You Grow**
Our people build their careers by moving through ten KYC specialisms every 6–12 months, each ending with a skills assessment and a certification. Progression is by competency, not tenure, and experienced hires are assessed on joining and start at the level they have earned.
  
  
The role is a platform for wider regional or global Investor Services leadership.
  
  
**What You Bring**
Your CV needs to show at least 10 years in KYC, AML or CDD operations, including 5 or more years leading multi-team operations; applications without this won't be taken forward.
  
  

* 10+ years in KYC, AML or CDD operations, including 5+ years leading multi-team operations in financial services.
* Experience building and scaling a team in India for global stakeholders.
* A strong control mindset: audits, regulatory reviews and operational risk.
* Data-driven management of service levels, quality and capacity.
* Excellent senior stakeholder management across Europe, Asia and the US.

**Nice To Have**

* Fund administration, transfer agency or private markets experience.
* Experience of technology-led operations change, ideally with Fenergo.
* ACAMS, ICA diploma or equivalent.
* Experience of a global capability centre or round-the-clock operating model.

**What We Offer**
We are committed to supporting your development, advancing your career, and providing benefits that matter to you.
  
  
Our industry-leading Alter Domus Academy offers six learning zones for every stage of your career, with resources tailored to your ambitions and resources from LinkedIn Learning.
  
  
**Our Global Benefits Also Include**

* Support for professional accreditations
* Flexible arrangements, generous holidays, plus an additional day off for your birthday!
* Continuous mentoring along your career progression
* Active sports, events and social committees across our offices
* 24/7 support available from our Employee Assistance Program
* The opportunity to invest in our growth and success through our Employee Share Plan
* Plus additional local benefits depending on your location

Alter Domus is an Equal Opportunity Employer: Equity Statement
  
  
All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, or protected veteran status.

Core Insurance Platforms (CIP) is Zurich’s global capability responsible for building, running, and evolving core insurance technology. We set a unified, scalable operating model—covering governance, standards, architecture, service delivery, and reuse—so our business units can deliver at speed and scale.

CIP is the strategic steward of Zurich’s Guidewire ecosystem, aligning platform roadmaps to business strategy while driving stability, modernization, reduced supplier dependency, and long term cost efficiency.

India delivery center is one of our global delivery and capability hub. We bring together experts in AI, engineering, analysis, quality, and architecture to deliver product & process solutions, application run services, change and transformation initiatives, and centralized platform services across both on prem and Guidewire Cloud environments. Our teams operate from multiple global delivery centers, supporting Zurich’s business units worldwide.

**Senior Service Delivery Manager, Enterprise Utilities & AI COE, India**

Lead a multi-service organization in India, grow regional adoption, embed AI as the default way of working, and build India into a scalable Centre of Excellence for enterprise utility delivery.

**Purpose of the Role:**

Lead and develop a multi-disciplinary organization in India, bringing together multiple enterprise utility teams and service lines under one accountable leadership structure. The role owns the end-to-end performance, growth and continuous improvement of services including Testing, Enterprise Content Management, Application Support, Project Management and PMO, and offshore support for services led from Mexico.

* The role acts as a senior interface between regional business and technology stakeholders, global Service Owners, delivery teams, and risk and control functions, ensuring that services are scalable, governed, cost-effective and aligned with strategic priorities.
* Build India team into a recognized
  **Centre of Excellence for Enterprise Services delivery and AI-enabled operations**
  , with reusable capabilities, consistent standards, strong talent and scalable delivery practices.
* Establish
  **AI as the default approach**
  to service design, delivery and improvement. The role will identify opportunities across APAC and the wider organization, convert regional needs into a prioritized demand pipeline, and embed automation and AI-enabled ways of working across all service lines.

**Accountability:**

**Multi-Team and Service-Line Leadership:**

* Lead multiple India-based teams across Testing, Enterprise Content Management, Application Support, Project Management and PMO, and other enterprise utility services.
* Provide clear end-to-end accountability across all service lines, while empowering team leads and service leads to manage day-to-day delivery.
* Establish a common operating model, governance structure, performance framework and delivery culture across the organization.
* Build a strong leadership bench, with clear accountabilities, succession plans and development pathways.
* Create one integrated India organization while retaining the specialist capabilities required by each service line.

**End-to-End Service Portfolio Ownership:**

* Own the performance, quality, resilience and cost-effectiveness of the enterprise utilities portfolio delivered from India.
* Ensure all service lines achieve agreed SLAs, KPIs, customer outcomes and control requirements.
* Drive standardization and reuse across processes, tools, templates, controls and reporting.
* Maintain clear service ownership, service catalogues, delivery metrics and escalation paths.
* Identify opportunities to consolidate, industrialize and scale services from India.
* Partner with Mexico-based service leadership to establish effective offshore delivery from India for relevant ZNA and Latin America services.

**Regional Adoption, Demand and Growth:**

* Explore and accelerate adoption of enterprise utility services across supported APAC countries and other agreed markets.
* Engage business and technology leaders to understand regional priorities, pain points and unmet needs.
* Build and manage a transparent, prioritized demand pipeline across countries, functions and service lines.
* Translate opportunities into clear service propositions, business cases, delivery options and capacity requirements.
* Partner with regional and global Service Owners to convert validated demand into funded and executable delivery.
* Use regional feedback and demand trends to shape the India capability roadmap, workforce plan and investment priorities.

**AI-First Service Transformation:**

* Make AI and automation the default consideration in the design, delivery and improvement of every service line.
* Review service processes systematically to identify opportunities for AI-enabled delivery, automation, productivity improvement and better customer outcomes.
* Embed AI into operational workflows, service management, quality assurance, knowledge management, reporting and decision support.
* Develop reusable AI-enabled delivery patterns and assets that can be adopted across teams, services and regions.
* Establish measurable value cases and track the operational, financial and customer outcomes delivered through AI.
* Promote responsible experimentation, rapid learning and scaled adoption while maintaining appropriate governance and human oversight.
* Build AI literacy and practical AI capabilities across managers, team leads and delivery teams.

**Build India as a Centre of Excellence:**

* Develop India into a Centre of Excellence for scalable enterprise utility delivery and AI-enabled operations.
* Define the COE vision, capability roadmap, operating model, governance and success measures.
* Build deep specialist capabilities, reusable methods, accelerators, playbooks and knowledge assets.
* Create communities of practice across service lines to promote learning, reuse and consistent quality.
* Attract, develop and retain talent with strong service, domain, data, automation and AI capabilities.
* Position the India organization as a trusted partner for regional and global Service Owners.
* Demonstrate the value of the COE through measurable improvements in service quality, speed, productivity, scalability and stakeholder satisfaction.

**Experience requirements:**

* Prior responsibility for a team of at least 40–50 people, ideally more, in an offshore or near shore setup.
* Track record of delivering services to multiple regions or markets.
* Experience working in or with Zurich, or comparable global insurance/financial institutions, is a plus.
* Proven experience leading
  **multiple teams, service lines or capability areas**
  within a complex technology or shared-services environment. – 10 years +
* Demonstrated accountability for a sizeable technology delivery organization, including leadership through team leads or service leads.
* Experience establishing or scaling an offshore delivery centre, shared-services capability or Centre of Excellence.
* Strong track record of growing regional adoption and converting stakeholder needs into funded delivery demand.
* Evidence of applying AI and automation to transform service operations, rather than managing AI as a stand-alone programme. 3+ years leading AI, Advanced Analytics, Data, Generative AI or Digital Transformation initiatives is highly desirable.
* Ability to balance growth, service performance, financial management, talent development and risk controls.
* Senior stakeholder leadership across regional and global organizations.

jobs.title: Deployment Strategist, Applied AI
jobs.description:
**The role**
------------

You own a set of enterprise accounts once they go live, and your job is to grow them. That means making sure delivery lands, the client sees results in their own numbers, and each account has a clear plan for what we do next with them.

You work with the client's business leaders on one side and our forward deployed engineers (FDEs) on the other. You run discovery with the client, turn their business logic into a call flow, and hand the FDE a clear spec for the workflow. When the FDE is deep in a complex build, you write the agent prompt yourself.

This is not a sales role. You grow accounts by delivering value the client can measure, and by spotting where else in their business we can do the same.

 **Requirements**  

**What you'll do**
------------------

* Run discovery. Understand the use case and the client's process, find the real pain point, and agree the north star metric with the client so everyone knows what outcome the agent has to deliver.
* Design the call flow. Translate business logic into a call flow and conversation design, then brief the FDE on the workflow to build.
* Build agents. Write and iterate production prompts, especially when the FDE is busy on a complex workflow.
* Do RCA. When results dip, listen to the conversations, work out why they failed (prompt, data, flow or telephony) and drive the fix.
* Own the client relationship. Be the person the client calls first. Run governance calls, reviews and escalations, and build trust with stakeholders from operations teams up to business heads.
* Make delivery happen. Plan and run the project with the FDEs: scope, timelines, dependencies on the client's tech and data teams, go-lives. Unblock things before they slip.
* Run on numbers. Own the account's metrics (connect rate, conversion, collections, cost per outcome). Build the analysis, explain what moved and why, and turn it into the next change to the agent.
* Build the account roadmap. For every account, write a strategic plan for expansion: new use cases, new teams, more volume. Size each one, build the business case and take it to the client.
* Sell through value. Pitch upsell and cross-sell with evidence from your own account's results, working with sales and leadership on commercials.
* Test and improve. Run A/B tests on agents, prompts and voices, and read them out.

**Who we're looking for**
-------------------------

Two backgrounds have worked best for this role:

* A growth product manager, ideally with about 2 years of consulting before moving into product, or
* A consultant with 3 to 4 years at a top-tier consulting firm.

Either way, you have:

* Strong client handling. You're comfortable in a room with senior stakeholders and can manage difficult conversations.
* Sharp analytics. You can pull and work the data yourself (SQL, spreadsheets) and turn it into a recommendation.
* Project management discipline across several workstreams and people you don't manage.
* Commercial instinct: you can see where an account can grow and make the case for it.
* Clear, short writing.
* Prompt engineering experience. We don't mean using ChatGPT or Claude day to day; we mean you have built agents that carry out a specific task and have run at scale with real users.
* Conversation design sense. You can read a transcript, see where it went wrong, and fix the flow or the prompt.

**Nice to have**
----------------

* Experience at a voice or conversational AI company, or deploying AI for enterprise clients.
* BFSI background: lending, collections or insurance operations.
* Working proficiency in Hindi or a South Indian language.

  
**Benefits**  

* You own real revenue accounts from day one and work directly with the partner who runs them.
* You'll learn what makes AI agents work in production at scale.
* There's a clear path to running a portfolio of accounts as the team grows.

Capco is a global technology and business consultancy, focused on the financial services sector. We are passionate about helping our clients succeed in an ever-changing industry.

**Role Description**
We are looking to recruit Financial Crime, Sanctions and Fraud transformation candidates across different senior levels into our growing Financial Crime, Risk, Regulation and Finance capability.
  
  
**Requirements**
Successful candidates will be involved in advising on financial crime risk management and delivering transformation across AML/KYC, Transaction Monitoring, Sanctions and Fraud. The role will entail working across all types of financial institutions in the market to help them navigate and deliver against key regulatory requirements and business objectives. This would range across:
  
  

* Supporting our clients to achieve compliance with regulatory obligations, including dealing with remediation and response to regulatory reviews.
* Transforming and automating financial crime, sanctions and fraud operating models and processes through the implementation of new technologies (e.g. AI) that can bring a holistic and faster approach to identifying and managing financial crime, sanctions and fraud risk, whilst delivering cost optimisation for our clients.

* Assessing, benchmarking, and re-designing financial crime and fraud target operating models and controls, identifying weaknesses and proposing improvements.
* Supporting clients in dealing with operational backlogs (e.g. KYC files and alerts).
* Sourcing and implementing technology solutions for KYC, TM, Sanctions and Fraud.

**Skills & Expertise**

* A good understanding of the wider picture of financial crime, sanctions and fraud including regulatory requirements, risk assessment, KYC and how all components interrelate and support each other across the three lines of defence.
* Experience of delivering automation and transformation using AI
* Financial crime tooling and processes (across risk assessment, screening, transaction monitoring, KYC/CDD),
* Fraud (detection, prevention, response)
* Sanctions regimes, including tooling and processes

This will be coupled with strong change management experience (preferably Agile certifications) and prior success, either as a management consultant or within a change role in a financial services institution.
  
  

* This role allows you to deliver as part of a long-term strategic partnership with our clients, whilst developing within a forward thinking and entrepreneurial business.
* An understanding of the key market, global and regulatory drivers shaping the financial crime and the wider industry and an ability to articulate these by way of opportunities for consulting firms to support the industry.
* Proven expertise delivering change and lead transformation programmes
* Self-starter and strong team player.
* Strong interpersonal & written communication skills.
* Strong problem-solving skills and an analytical mind-set.
* Demonstrable expertise in building and leveraging relationships.
* To be able to face off to key stakeholders with strong credibility.
* The ability to present to a wide range of stakeholder from AVP to senior MDs.

**Other Expectations**

* To balance client delivery with supporting development of new client opportunities or market propositions and proactive sales efforts within Financial Crime team.

**For senior level candidates**

* Mentor and coach other members of the team.
* Solution development, showing a clear ability as a Subject Matter Expert (SME) to enhance existing propositions, and develop new ones.
* People management, building a team of consultants with the right mix of grades, skills and experience to support client opportunities and projected growth.

You will work on engaging projects with some of the largest banks in the world, on projects that will transform the financial services industry.

**Sales Relationship Manager I Housing Loan Business**

**Location: Bangalore**

**About the Team**

The Home Loans team helps customers access housing finance in a simple, fast, and transparent way. The team works closely with customers, builders, and internal teams to ensure smooth loan processingfrom application to disbursal. Focused on delivering a great customer experience, the team handles internal and external stakeholders along with compliance. By combining field presence with strong central support, the team plays a key role in making home ownership easier and more accessible.

About the Role

Step into the front line of the digital lending journey. Youll be the friendly voice that turns a quick tap on the app into a customer’s very first home loan.

Your day starts with warm, jargon-free conversations—explaining how the loan works, clearing doubts, and guiding customers through home loan journeys on the app. As soon as questions pop up, you tackle them.

The smoother you make the journey, the faster a customer moves from “I’m curious” to “Loan disbursed.” Your success is measured by happy borrowers, quick turnaround, and the trust you earn along the way.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Drive conversions:** Make timely, high-quality calls to move customers from “interest” to “loan disbursed.”
* **Own every lead:** Log, update, and follow up in the CRM until the query is fully resolved.
* **Build trust quickly:** Listen actively, think of quick solutions, and inspire confidence in the value proposition.
* **Collaborate cross-functionally:** Work with internal teams to ensure seamless processing and exceptional service.
* **Champion customer insights:** Flag product or process gaps and support continuous improvement initiatives.
* **Deliver against goals:** Meet or exceed assigned targets for sales, productivity, quality, and compliance.

Must Haves

* **Education:** Graduate in any discipline.
* **Experience:** 1–3 years of high-volume telesales / inside-sales.
* **Language skills:**

+ Fluency in English and one South-Indian language (Kannada or Telugu), with moderate fluency in Hindi.
+ Proficiency in Tamil is an added advantage.

* **Influencing ability:** Proven track record of converting B2C prospects and meeting sales targets.
* **Communication:** Clear, confident phone etiquette with strong listening and objection-handling skills.
* **Tech readiness:** Working knowledge of CRM systems, calling tools, and basic chat/email platforms.
* **Customer-first mindset:** Detail-oriented, ethical, and committed to delivering a high-quality experience end-to-end.

**Our Culture**

We’re a place where ambition meets opportunity and ideas turn into impact quickly. We empower people with high ownership from the start, encouraging them to solve meaningful problems and build with excellence. Teams work in an environment that values speed, collaboration and craftsmanship, while celebrating learning, growth and shared wins along the way.

Whether you’re shaping the future of fintech products or driving innovation behind the scenes, life here means being part of a high-energy, talent-driven workplace where your contributions truly make a difference.

We’re guided by our own operating system—an internal set of principles that shape how we work and win together.

**Position Summary**
**Finance Transformation**
**Level: Hyperion P&E Manager**
As a Manager at Deloitte Consulting, you will manage Oracle Cloud FP&A implementations, working with global teams to translate requirements into deliverables. You will guide junior staff and manage all project phases to deliver solutions on time and with quality.
  
  
**Work you'll do**
As a Manager, Functional Transformation on the Finance Transformation team, you will be responsible for:
  
  

* Leading Oracle Planning implementation engagements across estimation, requirements gathering, planning, execution, testing, hypercare, and ongoing support
* Managing delivery of Oracle Enterprise Performance Management solutions, including EPBCS, PCMCS, and EPCMCS components such as integrations, calculation scripts, business rules, dashboards, forms, and reports
* Overseeing project governance activities, including risk management, issue resolution, escalation management, and delivery tracking for client engagements
* Driving application quality through system testing, user acceptance testing, performance optimization, troubleshooting, and root cause analysis
* Collaborating with client stakeholders, onsite and offshore teams, and internal leaders while mentoring junior practitioners and supporting sales proposal efforts

**The team**
Business Finance, part of our Finance Transformation portfolio, delivers solution-as-a-service offerings focused on digital finance strategies, financial planning and analysis, and enterprise performance technologies. We take a holistic approach, integrating strategy development, process design, and technology enablement to help clients overcome challenges and achieve sustained business success. Our team partners with organizations to drive profitable growth, manage costs strategically, and navigate financial risks. We are seeking a highly motivated individual with strong analytical skills and business acumen to join us in delivering innovative solutions and supporting clients in their transformation journey.
  
  
**Location: Bengaluru / Hyderabad / Pune / Chennai**
**Qualifications**
**Required:**

* CA, BE, BTech, or equivalent degree
* 10+ years of experience in Oracle Planning implementations
* Experience with Oracle Enterprise Planning and Budgeting Cloud Service (EPBCS) or Profitability and Cost Management Cloud Service (PCMCS)
* Experience with EPBCS out-of-the-box modules, custom cubes, and reporting cubes
* Experience building and supporting Groovy scripts, business rules, forms, dashboards, data integration, metadata management, and Multidimensional Expressions (MDX) calculations
* Experience leading Enterprise Performance Management project delivery, including estimation, requirements gathering, project planning, system testing, user acceptance testing, and hypercare
* Experience with user provisioning, security setup, EPM Automate, and batch or shell operations

**Preferred:**

* Experience with Oracle Data Integrator (ODI), Enterprise Data Management Cloud Service (EDMCS), or Enterprise Performance Reporting Cloud Service (EPRCS)
* Experience with prototyping, solution enhancement, and application performance optimization
* Experience supporting sales proposals or pursuit activities

**Our purpose**
Deloitte’s purpose is to make an impact that matters for our people, clients, and communities. At Deloitte, purpose is synonymous with how we work every day. It defines who we are. Our purpose comes through in our work with clients that enables impact and value in their organizations, as well as through our own investments, commitments, and actions across areas that help drive positive outcomes for our communities.
  
  
**Our people and culture**
Our inclusive culture empowers our people to be who they are, contribute their unique perspectives, and make a difference individually and collectively. It enables us to leverage different ways of thinking, ideas and perspectives, and bring more creativity and innovation to help solve our clients’ most complex challenges. This makes Deloitte one of the most rewarding places to work.
  
  
**Professional development**
At Deloitte, professionals have the opportunity to work with some of the best and discover what works best for them. Here, we prioritize professional growth, offering diverse learning and networking opportunities to help accelerate careers and enhance leadership skills. Our state-of-the-art DU: The Leadership Center in India, located in Hyderabad, represents a tangible symbol of our commitment to the holistic growth and development of our people. Explore DU: The Leadership Center in India .
  
  
**Benefits To Help You Thrive**
At Deloitte, we know that great people make a great organization. Our comprehensive rewards program helps us deliver a distinctly Deloitte experience that helps that empowers our professionals to thrive mentally, physically, and financially—and live their purpose. To support our professionals and their loved ones, we offer a broad range of benefits. Eligibility requirements may be based on role, tenure, type of employment and/ or other criteria. Learn more about what working at Deloitte can mean for you.

jobs.title: Accordion India - Director - Data & Analytics Consulting
jobs.description:
**Company overview**

Accordion is a global financial consulting and technology firm helping CFOs and their teams drive value creation. Rooted in private equity rigor and powered by data, analytics, and AI, we partner with companies across industries to turn insight into impact.

Accordion works at the intersection of Private Equity sponsors and portfolio companies’ management teams across every stage of the investment lifecycle. We provide hands-on, execution-oriented support, driving value through the office of the CFO by building data and analytics capabilities and identifying and implementing strategic work, rooted in data, analytics and AI.

Accordion is headquartered in New York City with 10 offices worldwide, including the India office

based out of Hyderabad. Join us and make your mark on our company.

**Data & Analytics (Accordion | Data & Analytics)**

Accordion's Data & Analytics (D&A) practice in India delivers cutting-edge, intelligent solutions to a global clientele, leveraging a blend of domain knowledge, sophisticated technology tools, and deep analytics capabilities to tackle complex business challenges.

We partner with Private Equity clients and their Portfolio Companies across diverse sectors, including Retail, CPG, Healthcare, Media & Entertainment, Technology, and Logistics.

D&A team members deliver data and analytical solutions designed to streamline reporting capabilities and enhance business insights across vast and complex data sets ranging from Sales, Operations, Marketing, Pricing, Customer Strategies, and more.

Working at Accordion in India means joining 800+ analytics, data science, finance, and technology experts in a high-growth, agile, and entrepreneurial environment to transform how portfolio companies drive value. It also means making your mark on Accordion’s future—by embracing a culture rooted in collaboration and a firm-wide commitment to building something great, together.

Join us and experience a better way to work!

**Location:**
Hyderabad, Telangana

**Role Overview:**

The Business Director at Accordion will own multiple client relationships and provide analytics- oriented thought partnership. (S)he will oversee multiple project teams to facilitate delivery of high-quality analytics services and identify opportunities for deeper client engagement.

**What You will do:**

* Develop a thorough understanding of client's business challenges to proactively recommend analyses that can deliver results for the client.
* Facilitate value addition to the client's business by driving the problem-solving process and bringing an independent perspective based on domain knowledge and past experience.
* Regularly engage in peer level discussions with the C-Suite of client companies, to partner with them as a trusted analytics advisor.
* Develop a robust knowledge of functional areas (Marketing, Finance, Pricing, Supply Chain etc.) across a diverse set of industries to provide relevant and actionable insights backed by robust analytics.
* Facilitate people development and proactively ensure that development agenda is fulfilled for all.
* Think from a company point-of-view and take up additional responsibilities outside of regular client projects to support the growth of the company.

**Ideally, you have:**

* Undergraduate degree (B.E/B.Tech.) from tier-1 colleges
* MBA degree from top tier colleges is preferred
* Should have 6 - 9 years of experience
* Strong analytical reasoning & problem-solving capabilities to identify patterns, draw insights and recommend solutions live
* Ability to share complex thoughts and tailor written and verbal communication based on the context
* Strong multi-tasking skills to manage multiple projects across diverse industries
* Experience in client facing/professional services environment

**Why Explore a Career at Accordion:**

**A Culture of Impact & Excellence**

* **A culture of merit & recognition:**
  Thrive in a meritocratic, high-growth environment with semi-annual performance and promotion cycles.
* **Multi - dimensional exposure**
  : Navigate complex, high stakes workstreams across diverse industries and domains. At Accordion, you will engage with varied intellectual challenges that keep your perspective sharp, and your curiosity fuelled.
* **Entrepreneurial environment:**
  Exercise the intellectual freedom to make definitive decisions and the autonomy to own their outcomes. We reward initiative, encouraging you to expand your influence and assume larger responsibilities.
* **Collaborative vitality**
  : Experience a non-bureaucratic, high-energy culture alongside high-calibre peers. Our environment is designed to challenge your thinking and accelerate your growth through shared expertise and collective ambition.

**Our Commitment to Your Well-being**

We believe that our collective success is rooted in the personal well-being and growth of our people. We have curated a suite of benefits designed to support you and your family’s health, celebrate your milestones, and empower your professional journey.

* **Comprehensive health & security:**
  We provide fully covered Health and Group Term Life Insurance for you, with health insurance coverage extending to your immediate family.
* **Care on your terms:**
  Access expert medical guidance through on-site health camps or our integrated tele-health services. This ecosystem includes free professional consultations alongside discounted healthcare services including dental and vision care.
* **Integrated family support:**
  We support working parents with a fully sponsored, premium on-site Day Care facility.
* **Empowering leave structures:**
  Our robust leave policy is an intentional commitment to work-life integration, featuring dedicated maternity and parental support designed to help new parents through life’s major transitions.
* **A culture of recognition:**
  We believe every breakthrough deserves an audience. Through our dedicated rewards platform, we pause to celebrate both your professional triumphs and your most meaningful personal milestones.
* **Architecting your growth:**
  Thrive in a positive & transparent environment designed for the continuous evolution of your craft. We provide the infrastructure - through learning programs and engagement initiatives - to bridge the gap between your personal aspirations and professional mastery.

jobs.description:
Senior Executive – Finance & Accounts (Client Servicing)

**Company:** Floraison India Strategic Consulting Pvt. Ltd.  
**Location:** Jayanagar 3rd Block, Bengaluru, Karnataka  
**Work Mode:** In-Office  
**Experience:** 3+ Years  
**Number of Openings:** 2  
**Industry:** Business & Strategic Consulting  
**Employment Type:** Full-time  
**Salary:** As per company standards

About the Role

Floraison India Strategic Consulting Pvt. Ltd. is looking for a dynamic and experienced Senior Executive – Finance & Accounts to join its Client Servicing vertical.

This is not a typical back-end accounting role. The selected candidate will work as a financial consultant for a portfolio of small to medium-sized corporate clients, including domestic and global businesses.

The role involves managing end-to-end financial activities for assigned clients, covering daily bookkeeping, monthly statutory compliances, payroll, financial reporting, book closure and annual finalisation.

The ideal candidate should have strong accounting and taxation knowledge, excellent communication skills and the ability to independently manage multiple client engagements.

Key Responsibilities1. End-to-End Accounting & Bookkeeping

* Handle daily bookkeeping and accounting of expenses on an accrual basis.
* Ensure all financial transactions are accurately recorded and categorised.
* Manage the complete accounts payable cycle, including vendor invoice verification and GST compliance on bills.
* Prepare and maintain weekly vendor registers and coordinate timely payments.
* Raise domestic and export invoices.
* Reconcile invoices and customer collections to ensure proper cash flow management.
* Maintain and reconcile General Ledger accounts, including intercompany accounts and other balance sheet accounts.

2. Banking, Reconciliations & Cash Management

* Manage client bank accounts and cash flows.
* Prepare monthly fund request statements.
* Execute bank transfers and monitor daily liquidity.
* Perform monthly Bank Reconciliations (BRS) and foreign exchange reconciliations.
* Update and maintain fixed asset registers.
* Identify and resolve discrepancies between bank statements and accounting records.
* Ensure all sub-ledgers are aligned with the General Ledger at weekly and monthly intervals.

3. Monthly Closing & Financial Reporting (MIS)

* Manage month-end closing activities.
* Record depreciation, prepayments and accrual provisions.
* Prepare and finalise monthly Balance Sheets and Profit & Loss Statements.
* Prepare detailed MIS reports for assigned clients.
* Participate in monthly client calls.
* Present financial reports, budget variances and operational insights to client SPOCs.

4. Statutory Compliance & Taxation

**GST and Indirect Taxation**

* Handle GST computations and remittances.
* Manage Input Tax Credit (ITC) adjustments.
* Apply for GST refunds and manage GST return filings.

**Direct Taxation**

* Prepare monthly TDS statements and manage timely remittances.
* Handle quarterly advance tax planning, computations and payments.
* File e-TDS returns.
* Provide proactive tax-related guidance and tax-saving strategies.

**Year-End Finalisation & Audit**

* Manage annual books of accounts closure.
* Prepare Schedule III financial statements, including notes and accounting policies.
* Coordinate statutory audits.
* Provide required explanations and documentation to auditors.
* Resolve audit queries and ensure smooth audit sign-off.

5. Comprehensive Payroll & Labour Law Management

* Manage end-to-end payroll processing for assigned clients.
* Calculate salaries, employee benefits and reimbursements accurately.
* Handle monthly statutory remittances and filings related to:
* Provident Fund (PF)
* Employee State Insurance (ESI)
* Shops & Establishments (S&E)
* Gratuity
* Professional Tax (PT)
* Ensure accurate salary TDS deductions and timely deposits.
* Manage Form 16 issuance and related payroll compliance.
* Provide guidance and support on applicable labour law requirements under central and state regulations.

6. Global Client Engagement & Strategic Communication

* Act as the primary point of contact (SPOC) for Indian entities of global subsidiaries.
* Interact confidently with Board Directors, senior leadership and global stakeholders.
* Explain Indian financial, taxation and regulatory frameworks in a clear and actionable manner.
* Respond proactively to parent-company queries relating to financial performance, risks and compliance.
* Maintain timely and accurate information flow between clients and internal teams.
* Build professional client relationships through clear communication and ownership of responsibilities.

Required Skills & QualificationsTechnical Expertise

* Minimum 3+ years of relevant experience in Finance & Accounts.
* Experience in a professional services environment, preferably a CA firm or consulting firm.
* Strong understanding of Indian accounting practices and standards.
* Good knowledge of GST laws and Income Tax provisions.
* Hands-on experience with accounting software such as:
* Tally
* QuickBooks
* Zoho Books
* Experience with payroll software such as:
* GreytHR
* KEKA
* Advanced proficiency in MS Excel is mandatory.
* Practical experience in accounting, taxation, payroll and statutory compliance.

Essential Skills

* Strong client-first mindset and ability to manage multiple client engagements simultaneously.
* Excellent verbal and written English communication skills.
* Confidence in interacting with global parent companies and local stakeholders.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
* Ability to assess tax implications of business decisions and provide sound professional opinions.
* Strong ownership, time management and organisational skills.
* Proactive approach towards client servicing and financial operations.

Why Join Floraison?

At Floraison, you will work in a high-growth business and strategic consulting environment where you are more than just an accountant—you are a strategic partner to clients.

The organisation values disciplined, self-motivated professionals who take proactive ownership of their work and contribute to delivering high-quality financial and consulting services.

Job Details

* **Company:** Floraison India Strategic Consulting Pvt. Ltd.
* **Location:** Jayanagar 3rd Block, Bengaluru
* **Work Mode:** In-Office
* **Experience:** 3+ Years

Pay: From ₹15,000.00 per month

HandyPay Services Private Limited is a growing FinTech and Digital Payments company focused on payment solutions, digital financial services, merchant payments, collections, payouts and business technology solutions.

We are looking for a highly capable and execution-oriented **Chief of Staff** who will work closely with the **Managing Director** and act as a key point of coordination across business functions.

* Work directly with the Managing Director on strategic and operational priorities.
* Understand the MD's priorities and ensure timely execution through relevant teams.
* Prepare meeting agendas, action points, follow-up trackers and management updates.

* Prepare concise presentations and data-driven updates for management reviews.

* Strong analytical and problem-solving ability.
* Excellent Excel / Google Sheets and PowerPoint / presentation skills.
* Ability to work with MIS, dashboards, business data and management reports.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Strong follow-up, coordination and stakeholder-management skills.
* Ability to handle confidential information professionally.

Candidates from **FinTech, Digital Payments, Banking, Financial Services, SaaS, Technology, Internet businesses, Startups or high-growth companies** will be preferred.

Experience in **Founder’s Office / CEO Office / MD Office / Strategy & Operations** will be an advantage.

* Think strategically but execute at ground level.
* Work independently with senior leadership.

* Handle multiple priorities simultaneously.

Work Location

**Mumbai – Andheri West**

The role is primarily **office-based** and requires close interaction with the Managing Director and internal teams.

Role Summary
  
The Technology Business Management manager is responsible for establishing and leading the Cloud Security Technology Business Management function. This role provides end-to-end ownership of hardware and software asset visibility across private, public, and hybrid environments, ensuring assets are effectively tracked, allocated, utilized, maintained, and retired throughout their lifecycle. The manager partners closely with Operations, Delivery, Finance, Sales, Partner Programs, Procurement, Global Sourcing, and Regional teams to optimize asset utilization, improve cost recovery, reduce stranded costs, and support data-driven investment and lifecycle decisions.

* Own and maintain the authoritative inventory and system of record for all Cloud Security hardware and software assets.

* Oversee asset commitment and allocation management, ensuring accurate tracking of reserved, available, and deployed capacity.

* Identify and implement continuous improvements to asset management processes, tools, controls, and reporting capabilities.
